descriptionHtml:
Desde Grupo Newsan llevamos adelante la búsqueda de una persona para ocupar el rol de Analista Sr. de Control de Gestión, para trabajar dentro de nuestra oficina ubicada en Saavedra - CABA.

Tu objetivo principal será liderar la planificación financiera (budget y forecasts), el control presupuestario y el análisis integral del P&L para optimizar la rentabilidad, identificar desvíos y brindar soporte analítico a la toma de decisiones estratégicas del negocio.

Tus principales desafíos y responsabilidades serán

  • Liderar el proceso integral de armado del Budget anual y los Forecasts periódicos.
  • Seguimiento riguroso de indicadores de Márgenes, ventas, precios, costos, gastos y rentabilidad.
  • Monitorear la ejecución presupuestaria, identificando causas raíz de las variaciones.
  • Participar activamente en el cierre mensual. Liderar el análisis profundo del P&L, explicando variaciones en ingresos, costos y gastos para identificar oportunidades de mejora.
  • Elaborar reportes mensuales y tableros de control.
  • Colaborar en la mejora de indicadores de gestión (KPIs).
  • Brindar colaboración y soporte a las áreas de Producto y Ventas para mejorar la toma de decisiones.


Requisitos


¿Qué buscamos en aquella persona que se sume al equipo de trabajo?

  • Estudiantes avanzados/as o graduados/as de Ciencias Económicas, Administración, o afínes.
  • Experiencia previa en posiciones similares o relacionadas al área.
  • Solidos conocimientos contables (ya que estará vinculado con la interacción de Control de Gestión con el área de contabilidad)
  • Manejo avanzado de Excel.
  • Buen nivel de habilidades interpersonales y capacidad de influencia.
  • ¡Y tener muchas ganas de continuar aprendiendo e innovando!

Beneficios

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Jornada laboral 4x1 (4 presenciales + 1 remoto)
  • Medicina prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar directo.
  • Comedor en la oficina, frutas y bebidas calientes a disposición.
  • Licencia extendida por maternidad y para personas no gestantes.
  • Viernes flex y jornada de trabajo flexible.
  • Día de cumpleaños libre.
  • Vacaciones extendidas.
  • Acceso a descuentos en productos de la compañía.
  • Programa de bienestar.
  • … ¡Y más que nos encantará comentarte durante el proceso de selección!

En Newsan tenemos todo lo que se necesita para acercarle a la comunidad los mejores productos y servicios de electrónica de consumo. Disponemos de la mejor tecnología con una amplia red logística, un gran talento humano y la representación de más de 20 marcas nacionales e internacionales (propias, licenciadas y acuerdos comerciales). Entre las propias tenemos a NOBLEX, PHILCO, ATMA y SIAM. Gracias a la eficiencia y compromiso, somos un partner elegido por las principales compañías tecnológicas del mundo como LG, MOTOROLA, HISENSE Y BOSCH. 

Recientemente incorporamos la Unidad de Negocios de Consumo Masivo para las marcas de Pampers, Pantene, Head & Shoulders, Gillette, Always, Downy, Vick, Cebión, que se suman a los negocios existentes de Electrónica y Electrodomésticos, Movilidad Urbana y Exportación de Alimentos. Somos más de 9.000 colaboradores, en oficinas centrales, 7 plantas productivas, 3 centros logísticos y una vasta operación pesquera en toda la Argentina, quienes hacemos de NEWSAN una de las compañías más relevantes de los sectores en los que participamos.

En Newsan fomentamos la colaboración y el respeto a la diversidad, creando espacios de trabajo inclusivos donde todas las personas puedan aportar sus ideas y perspectivas. Para conocer más sobre nuestra política de diversidad e inclusión ingresa a https //www.youtube.com/watch?v=kFn24QtfKT4

BioStatera se encuentra en la búsqueda de un/a Asistente de Marketing para incorporarse a su equipo de trabajo.


Principales responsabilidades

  • Brindar soporte en la planificación y ejecución del plan de Marketing.
  • Colaborar en el desarrollo, revisión y seguimiento de materiales promocionales y científicos.
  • Participar en la organización y coordinación de congresos, eventos médicos y actividades institucionales.
  • Gestionar la relación operativa con agencias, proveedores y otros interlocutores.
  • Realizar el seguimiento administrativo de facturas, órdenes de compra y pagos, coordinando con las áreas involucradas.
  • Elaborar presentaciones, reportes y herramientas de soporte comercial.
  • Realizar el seguimiento de proyectos, cronogramas, presupuestos y entregables.
  • Colaborar en la recopilación y análisis de información de mercado y productos.
  • Mantener ordenada y actualizada la documentación administrativa del área.
  • Coordinar acciones con las distintas áreas de la compañía, de acuerdo con las necesidades del sector.

Requisitos

  • Experiencia mínima de 1 año en posiciones de Marketing, preferentemente en empresas de la industria farmacéutica o de salud.
  • Estudiante avanzado/a o graduado/a de las carreras de Marketing, Comercialización, Administración o afines.
  • Manejo de herramientas de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel y PowerPoint.
  • Capacidad de organización, planificación y seguimiento de múltiples tareas.
  • Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.
  • Perfil proactivo, responsable, organizado y orientado al cumplimiento de objetivos.
  • Nivel de ingles intermedio

Jornada: Full time

Lugar de trabajo: Palermo

Modalidad: Full Presencial

descriptionHtml:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

Monks is seeking a Project Manager with a knack for design, animation and video editing at scale. This person will work closely with our clients in the region, so client-facing experience is a must. This role requires prior experience in digital advertising, transcreation, asset creation and/or integrated production, as well as an understanding of what is needed in the first place to make first-rate projects come about.

Role


  • You’ll partner with one of our biggest clients to produce digital advertising assets that require our in-house teams to deliver quality x quantity.
  • You are responsible for the process and completion of multiple design & animation projects simultaneously, managing the in- and output of our Design, Illustration and Animation Monks.
  • A quality watchdog, you work closely together with our Program/Project Managers and production teams across several time zones to make sure pixels are pushed to perfection.
  • You make sure that the work meets the client’s strategy, brand and creative goals, as well as our own quality standards.
  • You help scoping and quoting projects, working with senior Monks and department leads to propose timelines and ballparks.
  • As part of Monks, you are part of an international production company, with 7,000+ Monks from all production disciplines working together to craft the best of work.


Responsibilities


  • A big part of your day-to-day is briefing team members on delivery objectives and keeping everyone informed on the progress of projects, and the latest office gossip.
  • You make sure deadlines are met with lethal precision, and flag the ones that aren’t attainable upfront.
  • You schedule, track and prioritize assignments and make sure the right resources (we mean people of course!) are available.
  • You liaise between clients and teams to make sure Monks nails milestone after milestone, hustling internal resources to meet external deadlines no matter what.
  • You’ll be responsible for managing a team of producers and designers in your region, leading with passion and care.


Requirements


  • You have at least 4+ years of hands-on experience doing awesome work as a Producer or Project Manager in digital advertising or creative production.
  • You have a solid understanding of the creative workflow of fast-paced design and animation projects.
  • You also have sufficient technical knowledge to foresee and address possible planning/production issues, translating the complexity of such projects into lucid language that clients can understand.
  • We need a true-born and fun-loving team player who can successfully work across teams, time zones and technologies.
  • You can collaborate comfortably with digital artisans including creatives, illustrators, designers, 2D animators, 3D animators, concept artists.
  • Setting up and managing production projects between offices is no easy task and requires superb written and verbal communication skills.
  • Spreadsheets are your natural habitat, project management tools your best friend (e.g., TeamGantt, 10,000ft, Basecamp, Post-it notes).
  • You break the ice, instead of breaking a sweat when in front of the client and when facing crazy cases of ambiguity.
  • You have the experience and tools to solve problems in your back pocket, and you're not afraid to use them as needed.
  • Advanced English.


About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.

This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

  • Do you enjoy helping customers with complex issues?
  • Are you a champion of customer-first processes?
  • Do you have an interest in competitive video gaming?
  • Are you able to work on weekends?

If the answers to the above questions are yes, then this role could be ideal for you!

In this role, you will join the Support Organization at GRID, a team of 10+ customer-facing Support Agents across the globe, where a professional client-first mentality is crucial to delivering customer service excellence.

You will be involved in various activities before, during, and after esports tournaments, working with our partners (Tournament Organizers, Game Publishers) and customers (which include esports, media, and betting household names) to ensure tournaments are running smoothly and relevant game data is properly captured, processed, and distributed in a timely manner.

You will play a key role in identifying, documenting, and reporting technical and data issues. You will engage with customers through email, Slack, Discord, Telegram, and Teams to ensure customers' questions and issues are quickly acknowledged and resolved as soon as possible or escalated to the engineering team if needed.

Job Requirements

What you will do

  • Collaborate with esports tournament organizers to ensure content is correctly configured for GRID to collect and distribute official data
  • Monitor live esports data feeds to ensure accuracy, integrity, and uninterrupted delivery to clients
  • Identify and resolve real-time data discrepancies, delays, or feed issues, escalating when necessary
  • Communicate directly with clients to resolve operational or data-related questions across multiple channels
  • Help improve the GRID product suite based on customer feedback and defects you’ve identified.
  • Log and track data quality and process issues
  • Continuously develop your knowledge of esports titles and GRID products to enhance service quality and decision-making
  • Contribute daily to our knowledge base to share your knowledge with GRID employees, partners, and customers

Your skills will include

  • A strong customer-first mindset
  • An interest in competitive video games (CS2, Valorant, Dota 2, PUBG with other games a plus)
  • Understanding of esports tournament structures, formats and rules
  • Previous experience in customer-facing Support roles
  • Experience with collaborative tools such as Slack, GSuite, Discord, Teams
  • Some level of computer science knowledge would be a plus
  • Available to work shifts and weekends if required
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with other languages a plus

descriptionHtml:
¿Estás preparado/a para liderar una operación gastronómica de alto volumen y asumir un verdadero desafío profesional?


﻿📍 Zona Sur, Buenos Aires | Modalidad presencial


Desde FAIRWAY HR Consultores nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a CHEF EJECUTIVO para un emblemático restaurante multicocina de Zona Sur, con capacidad para 500 cubiertos.

Buscamos un perfil con sólida trayectoria gastronómica, liderazgo, visión estratégica y capacidad para gestionar equipos numerosos, garantizando excelencia operativa y calidad en cada servicio.


Principales responsabilidades

  • Liderar, coordinar y desarrollar los equipos de cocina.
  • Supervisar el funcionamiento de las distintas áreas gastronómicas.
  • Planificar y optimizar procesos de producción y servicio.
  • Gestionar costos, inventarios, compras y desperdicios.
  • Garantizar estándares de calidad, higiene y seguridad alimentaria.
  • Impulsar mejoras continuas y alcanzar objetivos operativos.

Requisitos excluyentes

  • Experiencia comprobable en posiciones de Chef Ejecutivo o liderazgo gastronómico equivalente.
  • Trayectoria en restaurantes de gran volumen y alta exigencia operativa.
  • Experiencia en coordinación de múltiples cocinas y equipos numerosos.
  • Sólidos conocimientos de gestión, planificación y control de costos.
  • Capacidad de liderazgo, organización y resolución de problemas bajo presión.


Qué ofrece el desafío

La oportunidad de asumir un rol estratégico en una operación gastronómica de gran escala, dentro de un entorno profesional, dinámico y exigente.


No buscamos solamente experiencia en cocina. Buscamos liderazgo, criterio de gestión y capacidad para llevar un equipo al siguiente nivel.

Solutions 2GO Inc.

Solutions 2 GO INC. es un distribuidor global líder de productos de videojuegos, con operaciones en 19 países de Norteamérica, Centroamérica y Sudamérica, y alianzas estratégicas que amplían nuestro alcance a Europa, África, Australia y Asia. Representamos empresas editoras de videojuegose de la industria en el mercado canadiense, ofrecemos una red de distribución de costa a costa en Estados Unidos y somos el socio exclusivo de distribución de Sony PlayStation en Latinoamérica. Nuestro liderazgo, experiencia, procesos y alianzas estratégicas nos han consolidado como un referente global en soluciones de distribución flexibles, dinámicas y adaptadas a las necesidades de publishers, fabricantes y retailers alrededor del mundo.Buscamos personas con iniciativa, orientación a resultados y ganas de generar un impacto real. Profesionales que disfruten asumir nuevos desafíos, trabajar de manera colaborativa y contribuir tanto al crecimiento del negocio como a la construcción de una cultura donde las personas puedan desarrollarse y alcanzar su máximo potencial.

Si te identificas con esta forma de trabajar y quieres ser parte de nuestro crecimiento, queremos conocerte!

Analista Senior de Planificación Comercial

Buscamos incorporar un/a Analista Senior de Planificación Comercial para sumarse al equipo de Planning, siendo responsable de la gestión integral de las Órdenes de Compra, el control del PSI, el stock y el seguimiento de las ventas de las distintas marcas — con foco en Nintendo dado su ritmo de crecimiento — y asegurando la correcta disponibilidad de mercadería y la calidad de la información que sustenta la toma de decisiones.

Más allá de la ejecución, se espera que la posición analice el negocio, identifique oportunidades y desvíos, y proponga y ejecute mejoras concretas sobre los procesos, herramientas y reportes de Planning. Tendrá interacción constante con los equipos de Comercial, Operaciones, Compras, eCommerce y Finanzas, y con clientes y partners, siendo un rol clave para anticipar necesidades, ordenar el flujo de información y garantizar la correcta ejecución del PSI semanal.

Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión de Órdenes de Compra

  • Ser responsable de la generación, emisión y correcta ejecución de las Órdenes de Compra de las distintas marcas, definiendo cantidades y fechas en base a forecast, ventas, stock y tránsito, y coordinando con Comercial, Compras y Operaciones.

Seguimiento de Órdenes de Compra

  • Realizar el seguimiento end-to-end de las POs, monitoreando fechas, cantidades, embarques y arribos, anticipando riesgos de demora o faltante y dando visibilidad a los equipos y a las marcas sobre su estado.
  • Coordinar el seguimiento de las distintas etapas de las compras importadas (producción, embarque, tránsito, nacionalización y arribo), controlando diariamente embarques y movimientos de mercadería contra lo planificado.

Control y Gestión del PSI

  • Liderar la preparación, actualización y controls del PSI semanal de Nintendo y de las demás marcas, consolidando compras, ventas y stock, validando la consistencia de la información y comunicando las conclusiones y acciones a seguir.

Control de Stock y Disponibilidad

  • Monitorear el stock propio, en tránsito y en canales, calculando cobertura y rotación, detectando quiebres, sobrestock y producto de baja rotación, y proponiendo acciones para corregirlos en conjunto con Comercial y Operaciones.
  • Velar por la exactitud del inventario, detectando discrepancias entre sistemas, depósito y reportes, y promoviendo su corrección.
  • Mantener comunicación proactiva con Operaciones sobre la mercadería en tránsito y recibida (incluyendo Costa Oriental), consolidando y comunicando la disponibilidad a los equipos correspondientes.

Seguimiento y Análisis de Ventas

  • Consolidar y analizar la información de Sell In y Sell Out por cliente, canal, categoría y SKU, identificando tendencias, estacionalidad, desvíos contra forecast y contra objetivos, y elaborando conclusiones accionables para Comercial y las marcas.

Gestión de Desvíos e Incidencias

  • Detectar, analizar y dar seguimiento a desvíos o incidencias relacionados con Órdenes de Compra, stock, ventas e información, identificando la causa raíz y articulando con las áreas correspondientes para lograr una resolución ágil.

Forecast y Planificación

  • Participar activamente en la construcción y actualización del Forecast y la planificación comercial, contrastándolo con las ventas reales, explicando variaciones relevantes y proponiendo ajustes.
  • Colaborar en el armado del presupuesto, las metas de ventas y las proyecciones por marca, cliente y categoría, considerando rentabilidad y disponibilidad de producto.

Seguimiento de KPIs e Indicadores

  • Definir y dar seguimiento a los KPIs de Planning (cumplimiento de forecast, cobertura y rotación de stock, cumplimiento de fechas de POs, disponibilidad, avance de ventas por cliente, campaña y lanzamiento), detectando desvíos de manera temprana.
  • Presentar periódicamente los resultados y las acciones correctivas propuestas a Comercial, Operaciones y las marcas.

Reportes y Herramientas de Planning

  • Diseñar, mantener y mejorar los reportes, dashboards (Power BI / Looker Studio), bases de datos y trackers del equipo para el seguimiento de ventas, stock, órdenes de compra, lanzamientos y PSI, asegurando su confiabilidad y actualización.
  • Preparar reportes periódicos y análisis ad-hoc solicitados por Planning, Comercial, Dirección o las marcas.

Propuestas de Mejora

  • Analizar los procesos y la información de Planning, identificar oportunidades de mejora (eficiencia, calidad de datos, automatización, niveles de stock, tiempos de abastecimiento) y elaborar propuestas con su impacto esperado.
  • Ejecutar e implementar las mejoras aprobadas, haciendo seguimiento de resultados y ajustando cuando sea necesario.
  • Impulsar, junto con Sistemas, el uso de herramientas de BI, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial para reducir tareas manuales y mejorar la eficiencia y la calidad de la información.

Calidad de Datos y Sistemas

  • Asegurar la correcta carga de información en los sistemas internos y el mapeo de productos y SKUs, detectando inconsistencias en la información recibida y coordinando su resolución con los equipos comerciales y/o clientes.

Soporte a Lanzamientos de Software

  • Participar en las reuniones de nuevos lanzamientos, consolidando la información para su comunicación a Ventas y eCommerce, y dar seguimiento operativo hasta el arribo al país.

Reuniones con Marcas

  • Participar en la preparación y presentación de información en las reuniones con las marcas, aportando análisis de ventas, stock, órdenes de compra y propuestas.

Acompañamiento del Equipo

  • Ser referente funcional del Analista de Planificación Comercial, guiando su trabajo, revisando la calidad de sus entregables y compartiendo criterios y buenas prácticas.

Requisitos y Competencias

  • Estudiante de Administración, Comercialización, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial, Marketing o afines.
  • Experiencia mínima de 3 años en Planning, Supply Chain, Compras, Comercial, Operaciones o posiciones similares (deseable en consumo masivo, tecnología, electrónica o gaming).
  • Experiencia comprobable en gestión y seguimiento de Órdenes de Compra, importaciones, y control de stock e inventarios.\
  • Excluyente: dominio avanzado de Excel / Google Sheets (tablas dinámicas, funciones avanzadas, análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos).
  • Excluyente: conocimiento de herramientas de BI y visualización (Power BI y/o Looker Studio).
  • Experiencia en armado de presupuestos, metas de ventas y proyecciones, deseable.
  • Conocimiento de comercio exterior e importaciones (Incoterms, tiempos de nacionalización, logística), deseable.
  • Experiencia con sistemas ERP y con herramientas de reporting, deseable.
  • Uso de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial aplicadas al análisis y la productividad, valorado.
  • Inglés avanzado, deseable.
  • Competencias: iniciativa y proactividad, capacidad de análisis, orientación a resultados y a la mejora continua.
  • Organización y capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades y deadlines, con autonomía en sus responsabilidades.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y trabajo colaborativo con Comercial, Operaciones, Compras, Finanzas, clientes y partners.

La persona seleccionada recibirá una oferta de empleo condicional, sujeta a la finalización satisfactoria de una verificación de antecedentes realizada por un proveedor externo contratado por la compañía. Los requisitos específicos de verificación podrán variar según la posición y pueden incluir uno o más de los siguientes: verificación de antecedentes penales, verificación crediticia, validación de experiencia laboral, verificación de estudios académicos y revisión del historial de conducción.

Si tienes alguna pregunta durante el proceso, no dudes en consultarnos.

For more information on Solutions 2 GO Inc., please visit our website at: www.solutions2go.ca

Company Description

About Syngenta

Syngenta is a global leader in agricultural innovation with a presence in more than 90 countries. Syngenta is focused on developing technologies and farming practices that empower farmers, so they can make the transformation required to feed the world’s population while preserving our planet. Its bold scientific discoveries deliver better benefits for farmers and society on a bigger scale than ever before. Guided by its Sustainability Priorities, Syngenta is developing new technologies and solutions that support farmers to grow healthier plants in healthier soil with a higher yield. Syngenta Crop Protection is headquartered in Basel, Switzerland; Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States. Read our stories and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram & X.

Job Description

At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers’ success. To support this mission, Syngenta’s Marketing team is seeking an Executive Assistant to the Marketing Head LATAM & Sur in Vicente Lopez, Buenos Aires, Argentina. This role will provide executive support to the Marketing Head LATAM & Sur, managing a dynamic agenda, coordinating key interactions, and ensuring priorities, meetings and follow-up actions are handled with accuracy and sound judgment. In addition, the role will provide high-level support to the Marketing team, bringing a consultative, creative and engaging perspective to team communications, meetings and workshops.

Accountabilities

  • Provide high-level executive support to the Marketing Head LATAM & Sur, managing a dynamic agenda and making informed decisions to optimize time and priorities.
  • Coordinate meetings, business trips and key activities, anticipating requirements and ensuring smooth execution across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact between the Marketing Head, the Marketing team and other business areas, facilitating timely and effective communication.
  • Develop and coordinate presentations, meeting materials and action follow-ups, transforming inputs from different teams into clear and well-structured content.
  • Contribute to Marketing meetings, workshops and team communications by bringing a consultative, creative and engaging perspective that encourages collaboration and participation.

Qualifications

Required

  • University degree or advanced studies in Business Administration, Communications, Institutional Relations or related fields.
  • At least 5 years of experience providing executive assistance to senior leaders, preferably within a multinational or complex corporate environment.
  • Advanced English, with the ability to communicate confidently with local, regional and global stakeholders.
  • Proven experience managing complex agendas, travel arrangements and multiple competing priorities, including organizing workshops, team events and meetings.
  • Strong command of Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and PowerPoint, and confidence in adopting new digital tools.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a high level of autonomy, judgment, adaptability, confidentiality and attention to detail.

Desired

  • Experience using AI tools to improve productivity, organize information or support the preparation of presentations and meeting materials, while applying sound judgment when handling confidential information.

Additional Information

What We Offer

  • A culture that celebrates diversity & inclusion, promotes professional development, and strives for a work-life balance that supports the team members. Offers flexible work options to support your work and personal needs.
  • Full Benefit Package (Medical, Dental & Vision) that starts your first day.
  • Paid Vacation, Paid Holidays, Maternity and Paternity Leave, Education Assistance, Wellness Programs, Corporate Discounts, among other benefits.

Important

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Beyond just believing in the power of diversity, Syngenta Group promotes an inclusive culture that includes differences in all its forms. We believe that the feeling of belonging allows people to become their best version, building an increasingly welcoming and productive environment.

All qualified candidates will be considered for our positions, without distinction of race, gender, age, nationality or disability

Social Discovery Group (SDG) is a group of social discovery companies. SDG solves the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG’s products redefine the way people interact and connect with one another.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world.

We’re proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025).

We are looking for a Junior Partner Account Manager (fluent in Spanish, Russian, and English) to join our Quality Compliance team in Content & Service Quality Operations department.

Your Main Tasks Will Be

  • Independently managing operational and analytical tasks from goal setting through to execution and result control;
  • Analyzing statistics, reports, and key partner performance metrics to identify quality improvement opportunities;
  • Developing and implementing quality sufficiency and strategies in collaboration with the team and cross-functional stakeholders;
  • Supporting and managing partners in Bitrix CRM, including handling complex and non-standard requests;
  • Contributing to the improvement of partner-related processes and tools (CRM, reporting, files, internal guidelines);
  • Collaborating with internal teams to achieve shared goals related to efficiency and cost optimization.

We Expect From You

  • Proficiency in Spanish and Russian (reading, writing, ability to communicate) - C1+;
  • Proficiency in English (reading, writing, ability to communicate) - B1+;
  • Excellent communication skills;
  • Experience in negotiating, working with contractors, partners, working with claims;
  • Confident work with data in tables (Google Sheets, Excel);
  • Advanced user of Google Workspace.

What Do We Offer

  • REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full time;
  • Vacation 28 calendar days per year;
  • 7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave;
  • Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company;

descriptionHtml:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

Our Programmatic Managers are our resident experts in programmatic and direct buying. You are responsible for keeping on top of industry-wide trends and best practices, putting them to optimal use for each client’s initiatives. You will be part of a cross-functional team including Paid Search, Paid Social, Ad Operations, and Data Strategy, ensuring client needs are anticipated and met. From negotiating direct deals to building stellar full-funnel media plans, you move with precision to drive growth for our most ambitious brands.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Strategic Planning: Design and execute programmatic strategies across Display, Video, CTV, and Audio that align with client business objectives.
  • Campaign Management: Manage mid-to-high level budgets, ensuring optimal allocation across tactics and inventory to maximize ROI.
  • Deal Negotiation: Lead the negotiation and management of Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) and Private Marketplace (PMP) deals with premium publishers.
  • Data-Driven Optimization: Translate complex programmatic data into actionable insights for client presentations, moving beyond the "what" to the "why."
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Integrated Planning and Data Strategy teams to ensure programmatic activity is a cohesive part of the total media mix.
  • Technical Oversight: Oversee the technical quality of campaigns, ensuring brand safety standards and 3rd-party verification (IAS, DV) are strictly maintained.


WHAT YOU BRING:

  • 2-4 years of hands-on experience in programmatic media buying, specifically within DSPs like DV360, The Trade Desk, or Amazon DSP.
  • Deep understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including identity solutions, real-time bidding, and the evolving cookie-less landscape.
  • Proven ability to manage full-funnel campaigns, moving from broad awareness to performance-based conversion.
  • Proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools; you can find the "story" within the spreadsheet.
  • Experience with ad servers (Google Campaign Manager 360) and 3rd party verification tools (IAS, DoubleVerify, MOAT).
  • Exceptional communication skills—you can explain the complexities of programmatic to clients in a clear and compelling way.
  • A "better together" spirit and a relentless curiosity to test new platforms and inventory sources.


TAKE INTO ACCOUNT:

  • You will have to communicate with your team members abroad, therefore fluency in English and excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) are a must for this role.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?

  • We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!
  • Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members
  • Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases
  • Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses
  • Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes
  • 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub
  • Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda
  • A flexible vacation policy


WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo y vive la experiencia de ser parte de una gran compañía!

Propósito Del Rol

Garantizar la disponibilidad, confiabilidad y seguridad de los sistemas eléctricos de baja, media y alta tensión de la planta, ejecutando actividades de mantenimiento preventivo, predictivo y correctivo, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares de seguridad, calidad, medio ambiente y continuidad operativa.

Principales Responsabilidades

Operación y mantenimiento eléctrico

  • Ejecutar actividades de mantenimiento preventivo, predictivo y correctivo sobre equipos eléctricos de baja, media y alta tensión.
  • Operar y supervisar maniobras de energización y desenergización de instalaciones eléctricas.
  • Realizar inspecciones periódicas de transformadores, celdas, interruptores, tableros, barras y sistemas asociados.
  • Diagnosticar fallas eléctricas y coordinar acciones correctivas para minimizar tiempos de detención.
  • Verificar parámetros operativos y condiciones de funcionamiento de equipos eléctricos críticos.

Sistemas de Media y Alta Tensión

  • Ejecutar trabajos sobre redes e instalaciones de media tensión.
  • Participar en maniobras y mantenimiento de alimentaciones de alta tensión de acuerdo con procedimientos autorizados.
  • Realizar análisis de condiciones operativas de transformadores de potencia.
  • Supervisar pruebas eléctricas y termografías en equipos críticos.
  • Controlar el estado de protecciones eléctricas y sistemas de puesta a tierra.
  • Coordinar trabajos con la distribuidora eléctrica y contratistas especializados cuando corresponda.

Seguridad Eléctrica

  • Cumplir estrictamente los procedimientos de bloqueo y etiquetado (LOTO).
  • Identificar riesgos eléctricos y proponer acciones preventivas.
  • Participar en investigaciones de incidentes y planes de acción.
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de normas de seguridad eléctrica y trabajos de riesgo.
  • Verificar el correcto uso de elementos de protección personal y colectiva.

Mejora Continua

  • Participar en análisis de causa raíz de fallas eléctricas.
  • Generar propuestas para mejorar la confiabilidad y eficiencia de los sistemas eléctricos.
  • Actualizar documentación técnica, esquemas unifilares y registros de mantenimiento.
  • Colaborar con proyectos de ampliación, modernización y automatización de instalaciones.

Gestión de Contratistas

  • Supervisar trabajos realizados por proveedores externos.
  • Verificar el cumplimiento de estándares técnicos y de seguridad.
  • Controlar la correcta ejecución de tareas contratadas.

Responsabilidades Específicas sobre los siguientes equipos

  • Subestaciones eléctricas.
  • Transformadores de potencia.
  • Centros de distribución en media tensión.
  • Celdas MT.
  • Interruptores de potencia.
  • Grupos electrógenos.
  • Sistemas UPS.
  • Bancos de capacitores.
  • Sistemas de puesta a tierra.
  • Protecciones eléctricas.
  • Redes de distribución interna.

Requisitos

Formación

  • Técnico Electromecánico o Técnico Electricista. (Excluyente)
  • Estudios terciarios o universitarios en Ingeniería Eléctrica o Electromecánica. (Deseable)

Experiencia

  • Mínimo 3 a 5 años en mantenimiento eléctrico industrial. (Excluyente)
  • Experiencia comprobable en sistemas de media tensión. (Excluyente)
  • Experiencia en alta tensión. (Deseable)
  • Experiencia en plantas de proceso continuo. (Deseable)
  • Experiencia en industrias de consumo masivo, papel, química o manufactura. (Deseable)

Conocimientos Técnicos

Excluyentes

  • Media y alta tensión.
  • Distribución eléctrica industrial.
  • Transformadores.
  • Protecciones eléctricas.
  • Interpretación de planos eléctricos.
  • Maniobras eléctricas seguras.
  • Sistemas de puesta a tierra.
  • Motores eléctricos industriales.
  • Variadores de velocidad.
  • Normativa de seguridad eléctrica.
  • Procedimientos LOTO.

Deseables

  • Relés de protección.
  • Calidad de energía.
  • Termografía.
  • Análisis de fallas.
  • PLC.
  • Sistemas SCADA.
  • SAP PM o sistema de mantenimiento similar.

En Softys, somos una empresa que valora la innovación, la experimentación, el compromiso y la actuación responsable basada en la ética. Nos adaptamos de manera proactiva a los cambios y necesidades del mercado, con un enfoque integral de cada individuo. Buscamos integrar a nuestros equipos personas que vivan estos valores y sientan comodidad en trabajar de esta manera.

Valoramos y celebramos la diversidad en nuestra organización, reconociendo que esta enriquece nuestro entorno laboral. Fomentamos una cultura que aprecia los diversos talentos, la singularidad y la identidad de cada persona, así como sus experiencias únicas. En Softys, nos esforzamos por desarrollar una cultura donde cada persona se sienta cómoda expresándose y mostrando su autenticidad.

Nuestra política de diversidad, equidad e inclusión se basa en garantizar prácticas de adquisición de talento que promuevan la valoración, el respeto y la igualdad de oportunidades. Desde la alta dirección, estamos altamente comprometidos en este sentido y lo reconocemos como fundamental para fortalecer y asegurar el éxito de nuestro negocio.

About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

  • Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
  • Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
  • Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
  • Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
  • Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and make it hold up in the real environment.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are debugging why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is application engineering: you make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

  • Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.
  • Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.
  • Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.
  • Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch.

  • Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes.
  • Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually.
  • Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two.
  • Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success.
  • Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better.
  • Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology.

What You'll Do

  • Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Come back with a scoped, defensible point of view.
  • Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably.
  • Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components.
  • Build. Ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware.
  • Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments.
  • Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one mainstream production stack (TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, C#/.NET, or Go).
  • 1 - 4 years of professional experience building and shipping LLM-powered and agentic AI systems beyond prototypes or demos.
  • Advanced English is required.
  • Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
  • Hands-on experience with frontier AI developer tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex.
  • Proven experience evaluating current-state environments and defining technical roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated experience with APIs, service design, event-driven and distributed systems, and data modeling.
  • Experience designing and owning CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, release, environments, and deployment processes.
  • Strong understanding of context and specification engineering to produce reliable AI output.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS platforms such as n8n or MuleSoft, and MCP.
  • Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls, asking "why" before "how" to decompose unstructured business problems.
  • Skilled at exercising end-to-end delivery ownership and managing project scope without requiring product manager supervision.
  • Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
  • Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
  • Forensic attention to detail.
  • A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
  • Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.
  • Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
  • Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
  • Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Strong Plus

  • Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems.
  • Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases.
  • Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing).
  • Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense.
  • Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background.
  • Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system.
  • Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts.

Work Authorization Requirements

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
  • FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay.
  • 100% remote work.
  • The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
  • Continuing education opportunities.
  • Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

Requisitos


🎯 ¿Qué estamos buscando?

  • 3 a 5 años de experiencia en Growth, Performance Marketing o posiciones similares.
  • Experiencia en estrategias Full-Funnel y Paid Media.
  • Manejo de Google Ads, Meta Ads y LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
  • Conocimientos de GA4, GTM, CRO, UTMs y herramientas de atribución.
  • Experiencia con CRM, Looker Studio y/o Power BI.
  • Perfil analítico, estratégico, hands-on y orientado a resultados.
  • Experiencia en seguros, logística, transporte o comercio exterior (deseable).
  • Formación en Marketing, Comercialización, Administración, Publicidad, Sistemas, Ciencia de Datos o carreras afines.

Beneficios

🎁 ¿Qué ofrecemos?

🎯 Rol clave en un área estratégica para el negocio.

🤝 Posibilidad de formar parte de un equipo profesional, con objetivos claros y enfoque colaborativo.

🍔 Almuerzo en compañía a cargo de la empresa.

🍎 Snacks saludables.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre.

💆 Pausas activas y acciones de bienestar.

🏠 Modalidad híbrida 3x2.

Hanseatica, una de las aseguradoras líderes en Latinoamérica en seguros de transporte, ofrece seguros integrales diseñados para proteger lo que más valoran las empresas y las personas, ofreciendo soluciones que garantizan la protección de sus activos, fortalecen su capacidad para enfrentar imprevistos y ayudan a construir un futuro más seguro y próspero.

Las soluciones que ofrece se adaptan a las necesidades específicas de cada cliente, e incluyen seguros de transporte de mercaderías, seguros de contenedores, seguros de cascos de embarcaciones comerciales, seguros integrales de consorcios y comercios, seguros de responsabilidad civil, seguros contra incendios, seguros técnicos, seguros de caución, seguro de embarcaciones de placer y seguros combinado familiar.

descriptionHtml:
Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com

We are seeking an Lead AI Engineer to contribute to our next level of growth and expansion.



Job Description

Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead project delivery end to end, with clear governance, stakeholder communication, and accountability for outcomes
  • Build and mentor a high-performing AI engineering team, establishing technical standards and fostering a culture of quality and pragmatism
  • Own proposals and new business initiatives, defining technical feasibility and communicating risks and tradeoffs clearly to clients
  • Define what AI systems should and should not attempt, setting realistic expectations and being upfront about limitations
  • Conduct technical reviews and architectural assessments to maintain high standards across projects and team

AI Development

  • Guide the design and delivery of RAG systems, agentic frameworks, and LLM-powered solutions that are robust enough for production
  • Lead the application of advanced prompt engineering techniques including instruction design, few-shot sets, structured outputs, and tool/agent prompts
  • Run feasibility assessments to choose the right approach for each problem: prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, or classical ML
  • Mentor engineers on end-to-end AI system design and production deployment practices

Evaluation and Quality

  • Design evaluation frameworks including LLM-as-a-judge approaches, metric creation (recall@k, precision@k), and go/no-go gates
  • Lead structured experiments across prompts, retrievers, chunking strategies, and models, grounded in evidence not intuition
  • Establish team practices for identifying and categorising model failures including hallucinations, retrieval misses, and instruction-following errors
  • Set quality standards that ensure AI systems meet production reliability requirements

MLOps and Infrastructure

  • Build scalable inference infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML models that support rapid iteration and reliable deployment
  • Automate the full MLOps/LLMOps lifecycle: tracking, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and retraining across the team
  • Design APIs, microservices, and orchestration layers optimised for latency, cost, and reliability
  • Lead infrastructure decisions that balance technical excellence with business efficiency

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years building and deploying AI solutions in production environments
  • Expert Python proficiency, strong Git practices, and experience with ML/LLM versioning and deployment
  • Solid cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP—preference for Azure—plus containerisation and orchestration knowledge
  • Hands-on RAG experience covering chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, and evaluation
  • Proven MLOps/LLMOps track record using tools like MLflow, Weights and Biases, or similar
  • Practical evaluation design skills: metrics, dataset curation, and structured experimentation
  • Experience with event-driven architectures, APIs, and microservices
  • A clear communicator equally comfortable with engineering teams and senior stakeholders
  • Strong hiring and team-building instincts with proven mentoring experience

What about languages?

  • English: Advanced (required for effective communication with global teams and client leadership).

How much experience must I have?

5+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience in production environments, with 2+ years of direct team leadership or technical management responsibility.

Nice to Have

  • Databricks MLOps platform
  • LLM fine-tuning experience
  • Building agentic GenAI systems
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • Security and observability for AI services
  • Classical ML background
  • Open-source contributions

Additional Information

Our Perks and Benefits:

📚 Learning Opportunities:

  • Certifications in AWS (we are AWS Partners), Databricks, and Snowflake
  • Access to AI learning paths to stay up to date with the latest technologies
  • Study plans, courses, and additional certifications tailored to your role
  • Access to Udemy Business, offering thousands of courses to boost your technical and soft skills
  • English lessons to support your professional communication

👨🏽‍💻 Travel opportunities to attend industry conferences and meet clients

👩‍🏫 Mentoring and Development:

  • Career development plans and mentorship programs to help shape your path

🎁 Celebrations & Support:

  • Special day rewards to celebrate birthdays, work anniversaries, and other personal milestones
  • Company-provided equipment

⚖️ Flexible working options to help you strike the right balance

Other benefits may vary according to your location in LATAM. For detailed information regarding the benefits applicable to your specific location, please consult with one of our recruiters.

So what are the next steps?

Our team is eager to learn about you! Send us your resume or LinkedIn profile below and we'll explore working together!

Esta posición es responsable de los procesos de Configuración de Contratos, Operaciones de Facturación, Crédito y Cobranzas, y Aplicación de Pagos para las diferentes líneas de negocio de la compañía, incluyendo Proyectos de Integración, Servicios, personal tercerizado, Servicios Gestionados y Venta de Equipamiento. Esta posición puede tener hasta 1-2 reportes directos.

Responsabilidades Diarias

  • Colaborar con Contabilidad para conciliar las cuentas auxiliares, validar el reconocimiento de ingresos y establecer políticas para las provisiones de cuentas por cobrar.
  • Liderar el proceso mensual de revisión de WIP (trabajo en curso) y garantizar el reconocimiento preciso de los ingresos de los proyectos, de acuerdo con las políticas de la compañía, los términos contractuales y las normas contables aplicables.
  • Trabajar en conjunto con Project Managers, Finanzas y líderes de Operaciones para validar el avance de los proyectos, los costos estimados para su finalización, los márgenes proyectados y los supuestos utilizados para el reconocimiento de ingresos.
  • Analizar el desempeño financiero de los proyectos, identificar riesgos relacionados con el reconocimiento de ingresos y recomendar acciones correctivas para garantizar reportes precisos y proyecciones de rentabilidad confiables.
  • Brindar soporte a los equipos de Cuentas por Pagar/Tesorería en la gestión del flujo de caja general, con el objetivo de optimizar la salud financiera de la compañía.
  • Supervisar la configuración de contratos, coordinando la facturación de proyectos, servicios y productos para garantizar una configuración y procesos de facturación oportunos.
  • Gestionar y revisar órdenes de cambio, modificaciones y revisiones contractuales para garantizar su cumplimiento y exactitud.
  • Coordinar la facturación de proyectos de acuerdo con los términos contractuales y garantizar que las solicitudes de facturación sean procesadas correctamente.
  • Supervisar las actividades de facturación por avance, por hitos y mediante el método de porcentaje de finalización, asegurando el cumplimiento de los contratos con clientes y de los requisitos de reconocimiento de ingresos.
  • Actuar como principal punto de comunicación para las actividades de contabilidad de proyectos entre Finanzas, Ventas y Operaciones (Project Managers).
  • Trabajar con clientes internos y externos para investigar y resolver problemas pendientes relacionados con pagos, ajustes o créditos.
  • Brindar soporte a las proyecciones de ingresos mediante reportes sobre proyectos no facturados, cuentas por cobrar, backlog y otros indicadores clave del ciclo de ingresos.
  • Generar y mantener reportes operativos mensuales, participar en reuniones de revisión de proyectos y gestionar proyectos especiales según sea necesario.
  • Capacitar y acompañar a los miembros del equipo en herramientas, sistemas y operaciones del ciclo de ingresos, con el objetivo de desarrollar capacidades internas.
  • Supervisar directamente al personal de Facturación, Contabilidad de Proyectos y Cobranzas, estableciendo prioridades, monitoreando el desempeño y garantizando la ejecución oportuna de las actividades del ciclo de ingresos.
  • Proporcionar liderazgo y supervisión sobre los procesos de configuración de contratos, facturación de proyectos, cobranzas, aplicación de pagos y contabilidad de proyectos.
  • Colaborar en iniciativas estratégicas de crecimiento y brindar soporte a los Project Managers en la actualización y comunicación de los presupuestos de los proyectos.
  • Participar en revisiones de proyectos junto con los Project Managers, asegurando que los presupuestos y las estimaciones de tiempo para la finalización estén actualizados.
  • Brindar soporte al área de Finanzas impulsando las conciliaciones de cuentas necesarias y alineando la información de los proyectos con los objetivos presupuestarios.
  • Realizar otras tareas, responsabilidades y proyectos según sea necesario para brindar soporte al equipo y a la organización, demostrando flexibilidad para adaptarse a prioridades y objetivos cambiantes.

QUÉ BUSCAMOS

Requisitos Indispensables

  • Capacidad para analizar e interpretar información financiera y preparar reportes.
  • Capacidad para liderar con confianza y generar alineación entre los distintos niveles de management.
  • Capacidad para comprender y aprovechar los sistemas existentes de la compañía para brindar soluciones al negocio, así como recomendar nuevos sistemas cuando sea necesario.
  • Experiencia demostrada en liderazgo y gestión de equipos dentro de un entorno colaborativo y orientado al trabajo en equipo.
  • Excelentes habilidades de pensamiento estratégico y resolución estructurada de problemas.
  • Excelente capacidad para cambiar de tarea y adaptarse a prioridades cambiantes.
  • Capacidad para gestionar conflictos y mantener relaciones de trabajo constructivas con personas de todos los niveles de la organización.
  • Perfil proactivo, capaz de trabajar de manera independiente y cumplir con los plazos establecidos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales, tanto verbales como escritas.
  • Sólidos conocimientos de contabilidad de proyectos, gestión de WIP (trabajo en curso), principios de reconocimiento de ingresos y contabilidad basada en el porcentaje de finalización.
  • Capacidad para analizar información financiera de proyectos, validar proyecciones e identificar riesgos relacionados con el reconocimiento de ingresos.
  • Capacidad demostrada para colaborar eficazmente con stakeholders internos y clientes externos en un entorno basado en proyectos.
  • Estudiante que se encuentre promediando la carrera en Contabilidad, finanzas o administración.
  • Manejo avanzado de excel
  • Intermedio de inglés

Requisitos Deseables

  • Experiencia trabajando con contabilidad basada en el porcentaje de finalización y proyecciones financieras de proyectos.
  • Experiencia demostrada trabajando en conjunto con equipos de Operaciones y Project Management para contribuir al desempeño financiero de los proyectos y al cumplimiento de las normas de reconocimiento de ingresos.

Program Manager - Argentina National Cybersecurity Operations Center (SOC)

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina (Primary / In-Country)

Position Type: Full-Time

Category: Program / Project Management

Make a Difference in International Cybersecurity Cooperation

Sincerus Global Solutions seeks an experienced Program Manager (PM) to lead an anticipated U.S. Department of State (DOS) Bureau of Emerging Threats (ET) cooperative agreement in Argentina. This high-visibility initiative will design, establish, operationalize, and sustain a centralized, civilian-led national Cybersecurity Operations Center (SOC).

The PM will direct all four phases-Assess, Build, Operationalize, and Sustain/Transition-while managing scope, budget, compliance, and a multidisciplinary advisory team. As chief in-country interlocutor, the PM will coordinate with DOS ET/CI, U.S. Embassy Buenos Aires, senior Argentinian ministry leaders, CERT.ar, and critical infrastructure operators.

Program Manager Duties And Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Stakeholder Interface

  • Lead in-country coordination with DOS ET/CI, the U.S. Embassy, senior Argentinian counterparts-including defense, interior, executive leadership, and CERT.ar-and other program partners.

Programmatic, Operational & Financial Execution

  • Deliver milestones on time, within scope and budget; manage startup, work planning, adaptive risk management, phased execution, and closeout/transition.
  • Oversee finances, burn rates, and projections in compliance with 2 CFR 200, Department of State Standard Terms and Conditions, and Foreign Assistance Data Review requirements.

Technical Team Supervision & Deliverable Direction

  • Synchronize five lines of effort: baseline assessments; legal and policy frameworks; governance and operational design; technical architecture advisory; and sustainable workforce development, including exercises and train-the-trainer programs.

Required Qualifications

  • - Proven experience managing complex donor-funded, international development, national security, digital transformation, or cyber resilience programs.
  • - Demonstrated experience leading multi-stakeholder initiatives involving government institutions, donors, technical experts, and implementing partners.
  • - Experience working on cybersecurity, digital resilience, critical infrastructure protection, cyber capacity building, emergency management, technology governance, or related fields.
  • - Familiarity with national-level cybersecurity frameworks, cyber workforce development, resilience planning, incident response preparedness, or digital governance initiatives.
  • - Experience managing programs in Argentina and working with Argentinian government institutions.
  • - Experience with U.S. Government cooperative agreements, grants, or contracts and familiarity with federal award requirements.
  • - Ability to effectively manage multidisciplinary teams supporting technical, policy, institutional strengthening, and capacity-building objectives.
  • - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Spanish and English.
  • - Strong leadership, stakeholder engagement, diplomacy, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Education/Certifications: Degree in cybersecurity policy, information systems management, or business; PMP, PgMP, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, or comparable credentials.
  • Domain Expertise: National SOC/CSIRT development, critical-infrastructure cybersecurity, threat-informed defense, or international cyber capacity-building.
  • Supply Chain/Transition: Familiarity with Western Hemisphere security policies and transitions from high-risk telecommunications vendors to trusted architectures.

descriptionHtml:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

  • Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
  • Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
  • Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
  • Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
  • Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and make it hold up in the real environment.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are debugging why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is application engineering: you make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

  • Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.
  • Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.
  • Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.
  • Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com 



Job Description

We’re looking for a Lead Data Engineer with strong experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise data solutions. This role will be responsible for the design, structure, integration, and maintenance of data across data warehouses, operational data stores, and other enterprise data infrastructures.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in SQL, data engineering, ETL, data integration, and data architecture with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. This person will work closely with technical and business stakeholders to design reliable data solutions, optimize high-volume workloads, and ensure data is accurate, accessible, and fit for business needs.

What will you be doing?

  • Own the middle layer of the data pipeline, combining Quantum interaction data with account, device, and other operational data sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows that transform data on daily, weekly, and monthly schedules.
  • Develop and manage AWS processing resources, validate outputs, and prepare reliable datasets for Tableau.
  • Design and maintain application data structures that minimize compute requirements and support efficient dashboard performance.
  • Investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and adapt workflows as application features and reporting needs evolve.
  • Collaborate with the engineering lead, fellow data engineers, application developers, and data product owners as pipelines grow in complexity.

Qualifications

What are we looking for?

  • + 5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or a related field.

  • Strong hands-on AWS experience, including managing resources for data processing.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with Spark.
  • Experience building ETL pipelines, integrating multiple data sources, and organizing data for analytics.
  • An investigative mindset and the ability to independently work through ambiguous technical problems.
  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to take ownership of assigned work within an established team.
  • Advanced English (B2+)

Additional Information

Our Perks and Benefits:

📚 Learning Opportunities:

  • Certifications in AWS (we are AWS Partners), Databricks, and Snowflake.

  • Access to AI learning paths to stay up to date with the latest technologies.

  • Study plans, courses, and additional certifications tailored to your role.

  • Access to Udemy Business, offering thousands of courses to boost your technical and soft skills.

  • English lessons to support your professional communication.

🛫 Travel opportunities to attend industry conferences and meet clients.

👩‍🏫 Mentoring and Development:

  • Career development plans and mentorship programs to help shape your path.

🎁 Celebrations & Support:

  • Special day rewards to celebrate birthdays, work anniversaries, and other personal milestones.

  • Company-provided equipment.

⚖️ Flexible working options to help you strike the right balance.

Other benefits may vary according to your location in LATAM. For detailed information regarding the benefits applicable to your specific location, please consult with one of our recruiters.

Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

 

THE ROLE

You'll be one of the people who makes a brand's social presence happen, day in, day out. From content ideation, trend tracking and scheduling to community engagement, copy writing, and performance tracking, you'll manage the daily rhythm of social channels and ensure the brand shows up consistently and compellingly across platforms.

This is a role for someone who is organised, culturally-fluent, and genuinely enthusiastic about social media as a discipline. You understand what makes content work on TikTok versus Instagram versus YouTube, you can write copy that fits the tone of each platform, and you notice when something is trending before it peaks. We're looking for someone who is as comfortable managing a content calendar and pulling a performance report as they are drafting a reactive post or briefing a content creator on an emerging format.

Success means channels that run smoothly, content that consistently meets brand and platform standards, a community that feels listened to and engaged, and performance data that shows steady growth in reach, engagement, and brand affinity.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

Content Planning and Publishing

  • Create and manage social content calendars across TikTok, Instagram and emerging platforms, ensuring a consistent cadence of planned, campaign, and reactive content.

  • Schedule and publish content across platforms, ensuring every post meets brand guidelines, platform specifications, and accessibility standards (captions, alt text, format requirements).

  • Write and adapt social copy for each platform, ensuring tone of voice is consistent, compelling, and native to the channel.

  • Coordinate with the creative team and content creators to ensure assets are delivered on time, correctly formatted, and ready to publish.

  • Support the Senior Social Media Manager in planning always-on content, campaign activations, and seasonal or product-launch moments.

Community Management and Engagement

  • Monitor social channels daily, responding to comments, messages, and mentions in a timely, on-brand, and thoughtful manner.

  • Engage proactively with audiences, fostering a sense of community and connection that reflects values of inclusivity and authenticity.

  • Track trending topics, hashtags, cultural moments, and platform features, flagging relevant opportunities to the wider team and, where appropriate, drafting reactive content.

  • Identify opportunities to surprise and delight audiences through creative engagement, timely responses, and community-building moments.

Performance Tracking and Reporting

  • Track and report on social content performance across platforms, compiling regular reports on key metrics including reach, engagement, saves, shares, and audience growth.

  • Use native platform analytics and social management tools to monitor content effectiveness, identify trends, and flag insights that can inform future content decisions.

  • Support the Senior Social Media Manager and Data Analyst in building a continuous learning loop between content output and performance data.

Collaboration and Coordination

  • Collaborate with content creators, designers, and copywriters to ensure social assets align with the content calendar and campaign objectives.

  • Support the coordination of influencer and creator content within the publishing schedule, ensuring assets are approved, scheduled, and tracked.
