El pipeline no se construye solo: se trabaja con método, persistencia y las herramientas correctas. Este rol existe para generar oportunidades de alto valor desde cero, abriendo puertas en cuentas corporativas a través de una prospección outbound disciplinada y orientada a resultados.

Como SDR Outbound, serás el primer punto de contacto con potenciales clientes, responsable de identificar, calificar y desarrollar oportunidades que alimenten el pipeline comercial. Reportarás directamente al Sales Manager y operarás desde Argentina en modalidad híbrida.

Tus principales responsabilidades incluirán:

  • Prospectar activamente cuentas objetivo mediante cold calling, correo electrónico y LinkedIn, con foco en generar reuniones calificadas para el equipo de Account Executives.

  • Aplicar la metodología BANT para calificar oportunidades con precisión, asegurando que cada prospecto transferido cumpla con los criterios de idoneidad definidos.

  • Gestionar y actualizar el CRM HubSpot con información precisa y oportuna de cada interacción, garantizando trazabilidad completa del proceso de prospección.

  • Ejecutar secuencias de contacto persistentes y estratégicas, adaptando el discurso comercial al contexto y desafíos específicos de cada prospecto.

  • Monitorear el comportamiento del mercado y compartir feedback constante con el equipo comercial para afinar la estrategia de prospección.

  • Generar reportería periódica sobre los principales KPIs de prospección y el estado del pipeline en desarrollo.

El perfil ideal combina dominio de técnicas de prospección outbound —especialmente cold calling—, manejo fluido de HubSpot y una orientación clara a resultados medibles en cada etapa del ciclo comercial.

descriptionHtml:
¡Únete a nuestro equipo y vive la experiencia de ser parte de una gran compañía!

Misión del Puesto

Desarrollar y gestionar las cuentas asignadas del canal E-commerce, liderando la ejecución de la estrategia comercial digital para asegurar el crecimiento sostenible de ventas, rentabilidad, participación de mercado y visibilidad de las marcas de Softys. Será responsable de identificar oportunidades de negocio, gestionar relaciones de largo plazo con clientes y coordinar internamente la ejecución de iniciativas que impulsen el desarrollo del canal.

Principales Responsabilidades

  • Ejecutar la estrategia comercial definida para el canal E-commerce, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas, rentabilidad y participación de mercado.
  • Gestionar y desarrollar las cuentas asignadas (Pure Players, Marketplaces, Supermercados omnicanal, Mayoristas online y clientes B2B), construyendo relaciones de largo plazo y detectando oportunidades de crecimiento.
  • Negociar acuerdos comerciales, calendarios promocionales, acciones de visibilidad digital, inversiones y planes de desarrollo conjunto.
  • Liderar la ejecución comercial de lanzamientos, campañas, promociones, activaciones digitales y big events (Cyber, Hot Sale, Black) en coordinación con Marketing, Trade Marketing y equipos de clientes.
  • Analizar indicadores clave de negocio (sell in, sell out, market share, conversión, surtido, disponibilidad, precio, share of shelf y Perfect Store Online) para identificar oportunidades y generar planes de acción.
  • Realizar seguimiento de la rentabilidad de las cuentas, evaluando inversiones comerciales y proponiendo acciones para optimizar resultados.
  • Gestionar el surtido y mix de productos adecuado para cada cliente, impulsando el desarrollo de categorías y el crecimiento de las marcas de acuerdo a la misión de compra del shopper.
  • Coordinar con las áreas de Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finanzas y Marketing para asegurar una correcta ejecución operativa y comercial.
  • Monitorear tendencias del mercado digital, comportamiento del consumidor y movimientos de la competencia, proponiendo nuevas iniciativas para acelerar el crecimiento del canal.
  • Elaborar reportes, análisis y presentaciones de negocio para el seguimiento de resultados y la toma de decisiones.

Requerimientos Del Rol

  • Graduado/a de Administración de Empresas, Comercialización, Marketing, Publicidad, Comunicación, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.
  • Experiencia
    • Experiencia mínima de 3 años en posiciones comerciales relacionadas con E-commerce, Trade Marketing Digital o Desarrollo de Negocios.
    • Experiencia en empresas de consumo masivo, retail, marketplaces o agencias especializadas en comercio electrónico.
    • Experiencia gestionando cuentas de supermercados omnicanal, marketplaces o clientes digitales será altamente valorada.
  • Conocimientos
    • Excel intermedio/avanzado.
    • Manejo de herramientas de análisis comercial y reporting.
    • Conocimiento de ecosistemas Omnicanales.
    • Conocimiento de métricas digitales, performance comercial y ejecución online.
    • Deseable experiencia con SAP, Power BI, Scentia, plataformas de analítica digital.
En Softys, somos una empresa que valora la innovación, la experimentación, el compromiso y la actuación responsable basada en la ética. Nos adaptamos de manera proactiva a los cambios y necesidades del mercado, con un enfoque integral de cada individuo. Buscamos integrar a nuestros equipos personas que vivan estos valores y sientan comodidad en trabajar de esta manera.

Valoramos y celebramos la diversidad en nuestra organización, reconociendo que esta enriquece nuestro entorno laboral. Fomentamos una cultura que aprecia los diversos talentos, la singularidad y la identidad de cada persona, así como sus experiencias únicas. En Softys, nos esforzamos por desarrollar una cultura donde cada persona se sienta cómoda expresándose y mostrando su autenticidad.

Nuestra política de diversidad, equidad e inclusión se basa en garantizar prácticas de adquisición de talento que promuevan la valoración, el respeto y la igualdad de oportunidades. Desde la alta dirección, estamos altamente comprometidos en este sentido y lo reconocemos como fundamental para fortalecer y asegurar el éxito de nuestro negocio.

descriptionHtml:
We are Folqs, a fast-growing DTC supplement brand specializing in premium health and wellness products across the United States.

We are looking for an experienced Google Ads Specialist to take full ownership of scaling our core Google Ads ecosystem - including Search, Shopping, and Performance Max - while expanding our cold-traffic acquisition on YouTube. You will work closely with our marketing team to test angles, optimize funnels, and scale profitable ad spend.

This role goes far beyond simple set-and-forget campaign management. Primary focus is placed on driving core Google Ads performance, with YouTube Ads serving as our critical secondary scaling engine. If you specialize in high-scale Google Ads, DR video funnels, VSL testing, and landing page optimization, this role is built for you.

What You'll Do

  • Drive full-funnel Google ads (#1 priority): Architect, manage, and optimize high-converting Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and Demand Gen, maintaining strict brand defense and retargeting logic.
  • Scale YouTube video campaigns: Build and scale cold-traffic YouTube campaigns using VSLs - optimizing campaign structure, placement strategy, creative hooks, and view-through vs. click attribution.
  • Optimize Merchant Center & tracking: Oversee Google Merchant Center feeds, policy compliance, and server-side/conversion tracking setups (GTM, GA4, and multi-touch attribution tools).
  • Collaborate on creative strategy: Brief and collaborate with copywriters and video editors on high-performing ad copy, fresh VSL concepts, visual hooks, script angles, and landing page messaging.
  • Test & analyze continuously: Execute systematic A/B tests across keywords, bidding strategies, ad copy, video angles, and landing page flows. Monitor CAC, ROAS, and overall spend efficiency daily.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on media buying experience with Google ads in eCommerce.
  • Proven track record managing $50k+/month in profitable ad spend across Google Ads.
  • Google Ads & GMC mastery: Deep expertise with Performance Max, Google Shopping, keyword strategy, and Merchant Center feed management.
  • Strong YouTube Ads capability: Solid hands-on experience running cold traffic on YouTube using VSLs and long-form video creatives.
  • Funnel & DR expertise: Strong working knowledge of VSLs, long-form landing pages, quiz funnels, and direct-to-checkout flows.
  • Time zone overlap: Minimum 6-hour daily overlap with US Eastern Time (10:00 AM–4:00 PM ET).
  • Language skills: Proficient in English (written and verbal) for clear team collaboration.
  • AI & data fluency: Daily use of AI tools for research, ideation, and rapid workflow execution, combined with strong data analysis capabilities.


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience navigating policy restrictions in the supplement, health, or beauty niches.
  • Hands-on experience with attribution platforms (Triple Whale, Northbeam, etc.).
  • Experience with native ads.
  • Proven experience scaling DTC brands from six to seven figures per month.

descriptionHtml:
Turn interest into bookings—and keep players coming back

Community Sports Partners operates sports and recreation businesses. We are looking for someone who combines strong email and SMS marketing skills with sales follow-through and organized day-to-day coordination.

Your work will connect three things: campaigns that generate interest, conversations that turn interest into bookings, and pickup games that run smoothly enough for people to return. You will help sell available sports facility time and permit-backed bookings, support pickup-game operations remotely, and build email and SMS campaigns that increase participation and repeat business.

What You Will Own

Email and SMS marketing

  • Plan, write, build and send campaigns promoting available facility time, pickup games, registration opportunities and relevant offers
  • Create useful segments by location, sport, expressed interest, booking history and engagement
  • Build and improve welcome messages, lead follow-up, incomplete-booking recovery where supported, reminders, repeat-booking and win-back flows
  • Write clear English copy with specific offers and calls to action. Adapt existing brand assets into mobile-friendly emails
  • Check audiences, dates, time zones, prices, links, personalization and suppression rules before launch
  • Monitor delivery failures, bounces, complaints and opt-outs; maintain consent records and healthy lists
  • Test messaging, timing, offers and journeys, then report qualified enquiries, paid bookings, repeat participation and revenue alongside engagement metrics

Permit and facility-time sales

  • Maintain an accurate view of available locations, dates, time slots, capacity and approved pricing
  • Respond to enquiries from teams, coaches, leagues, organizers and other customers looking for sports space
  • Understand what customers need, recommend suitable availability, prepare approved quotes and follow up through booking and payment confirmation
  • Keep the sales pipeline current, document customer commitments and pursue renewals or repeat bookings
  • Coordinate with the operations team before promising availability or exceptions. Escalate pricing, terms and conflicts outside your authority

Pickup-game coordination

  • Create and maintain accurate game listings, including location, start time, capacity, pricing and player instructions
  • Monitor registrations and fill levels; use targeted outreach to help fill available places
  • Coordinate with local hosts and venue contacts, making sure each game has the information and support it needs
  • Manage routine player questions and waitlists, and communicate approved changes promptly
  • Identify low-enrolment games, host gaps or venue problems early and escalate cancellation, refund or safety decisions to the appropriate manager
  • Track attendance, feedback and repeat participation, and use what you learn to improve future games

This is one role advertised across multiple recruitment locations. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome. Please apply once using your preferred location listing.

Requirements

What we are looking for

  • Practical experience building email campaigns and automations, plus hands-on SMS experience
  • Strong written and spoken English for North American customer conversations
  • Confidence following up with leads, explaining an offer and asking for the booking
  • Strong attention to detail with schedules, prices, customer records and competing deadlines
  • Experience with a CRM and an email/SMS platform; examples include Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Mailchimp or comparable tools. Experience with every platform is not required
  • Comfort using spreadsheets and reports to understand conversion, bookings and campaign performance
  • Dependable communication and willingness to own the next action until an issue is resolved
  • Availability to work evenings and weekends in Toronto/Eastern time is required. This is when most games and customer activity take place, so these shifts are a core part of the role. The specific weekly schedule will be agreed before hiring

Experience in sports, venue bookings, inside sales, event coordination, customer service or ecommerce retention is helpful. You should enjoy both campaign execution and customer follow-through.

What Success Looks Like

In the first month, learn the inventory, customer journeys and operating processes; audit existing campaigns and establish a reliable follow-up and QA routine.

Over the following two months, take ownership of the campaign calendar and sales pipeline, improve priority automations, and make pickup-game coordination dependable. We will agree measurable goals for paid bookings, use of available facility time, game fill rates, repeat participation and service quality after reviewing the baseline.

Apply with your resume and answer the questions in this application. Remove customer data and confidential employer information from examples. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome; the selected location is a recruitment location, not a residence requirement.

Required Assessments

Please complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners with that email, indicate this in the application.

  • Culture Index survey
  • Criteria GAME assessment — English

Benefits

Remote from Latin America. Monthly base of US$800-US$1,000 based on experience, plus expected variable commissions of US$500-US$1,000. Expected total US$1,300-US$2,000 per month. Commissions depend on performance and are not guaranteed. Evening and weekend work in Toronto/Eastern time is required, when most games and customer activity take place. The specific weekly schedule and commission terms will be agreed before hiring.

descriptionHtml:
KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work - building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.

We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta, so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.

The mission of this role

Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.

Who are we?

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

  • Better Everyday - keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round
  • Speed Is King - move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day
  • Work Smart - AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts
  • Overdeliver - catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told

If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.

Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

  • Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands - measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)
  • Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert - CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)
  • Continuous improvement across the website - tests live every week; winners shipped
  • AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise - AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)
  • No conversion drop goes unnoticed - drops caught and raised the same day

Key Objectives

  • Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first
  • Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells
  • Brief, QA and launch tests every week - then call results honestly and ship the winners
  • Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor
  • Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix
  • Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house
  • Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

Requirements

  • Fully remote, full-time
  • Fluent in English
  • CRO Experience: 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must
  • Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV - with the data to back it up
  • Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages
  • Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help
  • Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency
  • Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule
  • Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
  • Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder
  • Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience

Accountabilities

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

  • CRO test plan and backlog - Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next
  • Funnels - Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV
  • Build, QA and launch tests - Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week
  • Results, winners and conversion monitoring - Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day
  • CRO agency - Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house
  • CRO reporting and meetings - Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

  • Application + Screening
  • Test Project
  • Technical Interview
  • Culture Fit Interview

Salary Expectation

USD $4,000 - $6,000+ per month (based on experience and expertise).

descriptionHtml:
At Marvik, we’re looking for a Machine Learning or Robotics Engineer with experience in simulation to help us build AI solutions that interact with the physical world.

You’ll work on projects combining machine learning, perception, robotics, and simulated environments. We’re looking for a strong engineering foundation, hands-on simulation experience, and the flexibility to contribute across different industries and technical challenges as our projects evolve.

🧑🏻‍💻 What you'll do:

  • Develop and evaluate machine learning and robotics solutions, from early experimentation to production integration.
  • Build and use simulated environments to test algorithms, generate synthetic data, and evaluate system behavior.
  • Develop pipelines for data collection, processing, training, and evaluation.
  • Integrate models with sensors, software systems, and hardware when required.
  • Design experiments to assess performance, understand failure modes, and measure how well simulation results transfer to real-world conditions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, researchers, and clients to translate project requirements into practical solutions.
  • Write maintainable code and contribute reusable tools and engineering practices across projects.

🤝 What we’re looking for:

  • Professional experience in machine learning engineering, robotics, or a closely related field.
  • Hands-on experience with a simulation platform such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo, PyBullet, or a comparable tool.
  • Strong Python programming skills and solid software engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience developing and evaluating ML models or robotics algorithms, with a clear understanding of validation and performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with relevant foundations such as sensor modeling, coordinate transformations, kinematics, dynamics, or physics-based simulation.
  • Comfort working with Linux, Git, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Ability to navigate open-ended problems, communicate trade-offs, and take ownership of implementation and validation.

We welcome both ML engineers who have used simulation for model development and robotics engineers with experience integrating machine learning. Depth in one area and the ability to work across disciplines matter more than expertise in every part of the stack.

🦾 It’s a major plus:

  • Computer vision, 3D perception, or multimodal learning.
  • Synthetic data generation, domain randomization, or sim-to-real evaluation.
  • Reinforcement learning, imitation learning, motion planning, or control.
  • ROS / ROS 2 and integration with physical sensors or robots.
  • Deployment on edge devices such as NVIDIA Jetson.
  • C++, GPU optimization, Docker, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience bringing prototypes into reliable production systems.

- Hands-on experience with a simulation platform such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo, PyBullet, or a comparable tool.
- Strong Python programming skills and solid software engineering fundamentals.
- Experience developing and evaluating ML models or robotics algorithms, with a clear understanding of validation and performance metrics.
- Familiarity with relevant foundations such as sensor modeling, coordinate transformations, kinematics, dynamics, or physics-based simulation.
- Comfort working with Linux, Git, and collaborative development workflows.
- Ability to navigate open-ended problems, communicate trade-offs, and take ownership of implementation and validation.

We welcome both ML engineers who have used simulation for model development and robotics engineers with experience integrating machine learning. Depth in one area and the ability to work across disciplines matter more than expertise in every part of the stack.

🦾 It’s a major plus:



- Computer vision, 3D perception, or multimodal learning.
- Synthetic data generation, domain randomization, or sim-to-real evaluation.
- Reinforcement learning, imitation learning, motion planning, or control.
- ROS / ROS 2 and integration with physical sensors or robots.
- Deployment on edge devices such as NVIDIA Jetson.
- C++, GPU optimization, Docker, or cloud infrastructure.
- Experience bringing prototypes into reliable production systems.
location: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
title: Machine Learning / Robotics Engineer — Simulation

Fundada en 2004, OLIVER es la primera y única empresa del mundo especializada en diseñar, crear y gestionar agencias internas, como así también ecosistemas de marketing a medida para las distintas marcas con las que trabajamos. Actualmente, contamos en nuestro haber con más de 300 clientes, situados en más de 40 países. Nuestro modelo único impulsa la creatividad y la eficiencia, lo que nos permite ofrecer soluciones personalizadas que impactan de forma positiva en el público.

Como parte de The Brandtech Group, estamos a la vanguardia del desarrollo de la tecnología a través de la IA más avanzada para revolucionar la forma en que creamos y realizamos nuestro trabajo. Nuestras soluciones de IA mejoran la eficiencia, despiertan la creatividad e impulsan la toma de decisiones acertadas, lo que permite a nuestros equipos producir resultados innovadores e impactantes.

THE OPPORTUNITY 

This is an opportunity to join OLIVER’s in-house team embedded with a leading global technology brand as a Program Manager, responsible for coordinating and delivering marketing programs and initiatives across multiple stakeholders and workstreams. 

You’ll bring structure, visibility, and momentum to complex programs, translating priorities into clear plans, coordinating teams and partners, tracking progress, and ensuring deliverables move forward on time. 

The role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, proactive, comfortable managing multiple moving pieces, and confident communicating across different audiences. Strong communication skills are important, but the primary focus is program coordination, stakeholder management, and execution. 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead the day-to-day coordination and execution of multiple marketing programs and initiatives. 
  • Build and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and priorities. 
  • Track actions and deliverables through completion, proactively addressing blockers and escalating risks when needed. 
  • Coordinate across client stakeholders, internal teams, specialist functions, and external partners to keep activities aligned and moving forward. 
  • Maintain clear and accurate program documentation, trackers, status updates, and reporting. 
  • Support the execution of campaign, customer, and event-related initiatives, coordinating the operational activities required for successful delivery. 
  • Coordinate stakeholder and program communications, ensuring clarity around priorities, actions, responsibilities, and next steps. 
  • Support financial and administrative aspects of program delivery, including budget and forecast tracking, reporting, and reconciliation where required. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and ways of working, including the effective use of Gen AI and automation. 

 

WHAT YOU BRING 

  • Proven experience in program management, project management, marketing operations, or a related discipline, ideally within a complex or fast-paced environment. 
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. 
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence working with cross-functional and distributed teams. 
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communications to different audiences. 
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with strong ownership, judgment, and problem-solving skills. 
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing priorities while maintaining structure and momentum. 
  • Familiarity with modern collaboration, productivity, and project management tools, with an interest in using Gen AI to improve efficiency and ways of working. 
  • Experience in marketing, campaigns, customer programs, or event-related environments is a plus. 

 

QUALIFICATIONS: 

Backgrounds in program management, project management, marketing operations, campaign operations, integrated marketing, event programs, or related fields are encouraged. 

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

  • Ser ambiciosos para alcanzar el éxito.
  • Ser imaginativos para superar los límites de lo posible.
  • Ser inspiradores para realizar un trabajo innovador.
  • Estar siempre aprendiendo y escuchando para comprender.
  • Estar enfocado en los resultados para superar las expectativas.
  • Ser activamente pro inclusivos y antirracistas en nuestra comunidad, clientes y creaciones

Nosso processo de recrutamento não utiliza inteligência artificial para seleção. Utilizamos a IA para apoiar a eficiência e a consistência, e não para substituir o julgamento humano. A avaliação e a seleção de candidatos são realizadas sem o uso de IA para triagem ou tomada de decisão. Estamos comprometidos com uma experiência justa, cuidadosa e equitativa para cada candidato.

OLIVER, que forma parte del Grupo Brandtech, es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a crear entornos de trabajo inclusivos en los que se motive a todos los empleados a alcanzar su máximo potencial, valorando y respetando las diferencias individuales. Todos los candidatos serán tenidos en cuenta sin distinción de raza, etnia, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, edad, neurodivergencia, estado de discapacidad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la legislación local. 

OLIVER ha establecido ambiciosos objetivos medioambientales en torno a la sostenibilidad, con objetivos de reducción de emisiones basados en la ciencia. Colectivamente, trabajamos para cumplir nuestra misión, integrando la sostenibilidad en todos los departamentos y en todas las fases del ciclo de vida de los proyectos.

descriptionHtml:
Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Analista Financiero Sr. para una importante compañía de servicios financieros con fuerte foco en soluciones digitales y tecnología, que continúa ampliando y profesionalizando su operación.

La posición tendrá un rol relevante en el análisis del negocio y la generación de información para la toma de decisiones, trabajando en contacto con distintas áreas y acompañando la planificación financiera, el seguimiento de resultados y la evaluación de nuevas iniciativas.

Principales responsabilidades

Analizar la performance financiera del negocio, identificando desvíos, tendencias y oportunidades de mejora.

Elaborar presupuestos, forecasts y proyecciones financieras.

Realizar el seguimiento de resultados y principales indicadores económicos y financieros.

Preparar reportes de gestión y presentaciones para la toma de decisiones.

Analizar rentabilidad por producto, segmento o unidad de negocio.

Participar en la evaluación financiera de nuevos proyectos e iniciativas comerciales.

Desarrollar modelos financieros y escenarios para acompañar decisiones estratégicas.

Trabajar de manera transversal con áreas comerciales, operaciones, producto y management.

¿Qué perfil buscamos?

Apuntamos a una persona con fuerte capacidad analítica, criterio de negocio y autonomía, que pueda transformar información financiera en conclusiones claras y accionables.

Valoraremos especialmente perfiles con:

Experiencia en análisis financiero, planificación o control de gestión.

Capacidad para construir y analizar modelos financieros.

Manejo de presupuestos, forecasts y análisis de desvíos.

Mirada de negocio y capacidad para comprender los drivers que impactan en los resultados.

Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de información.

Buen nivel de comunicación para interactuar con diferentes áreas y presentar conclusiones.

Interés por desenvolverse en entornos dinámicos, digitales y de crecimiento.

Requisitos

Graduado/a universitario/a en Finanzas, Economía, Administración de Empresas, Contador Público o carreras afines.

Experiencia previa en posiciones de análisis financiero, FP&A, planeamiento o control de gestión.

Excel avanzado.

Experiencia trabajando con herramientas de análisis y visualización de datos.

Conocimientos de modelización financiera.

Se valorará experiencia previa en compañías de servicios financieros, medios de pago, banca digital o negocios con un fuerte componente tecnológico.

El desafío

La posición ofrece la posibilidad de sumarse a un negocio en evolución, con un volumen creciente de información y decisiones cada vez más orientadas a datos. El principal desafío será aportar profundidad analítica y visión financiera para acompañar el crecimiento y la toma de decisiones del negocio.

descriptionHtml:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.

As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.

We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.

If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.

Let’s build what’s next, together.

What This Role Is All About

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you will focus on outbound prospecting and pipeline generation across assigned regions and industries. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Business Development Lead and a key entry point into Infobip’s commercial organization, designed to prepare you for future growth into Mid-Market or Tier 1 customer-facing roles.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute outbound prospecting across target accounts, industries, and regions
  • Engage prospects via email, phone, LinkedIn, and digital outreach channels
  • Research accounts, stakeholders, and buying personas to identify opportunities
  • Generate qualified meetings and sales opportunities for Account Executives
  • Collaborate with Regional Sales and Customer Facing teams on pipeline initiatives
  • Maintain and execute outreach sequences using approved tools and methodologies
  • Use prospecting and research tools to enrich and validate account data
  • Maintain accurate prospect and activity data in Salesforce and outreach platforms
  • Follow qualification standards and outreach best practices to ensure pipeline quality
  • Leverage AI tools and automation to improve research, outreach, and productivity
  • Continuously learn Infobip products, solutions, and customer use cases

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Interest in sales, business development, or B2B tech environments
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable with targets, structured processes, and outbound activity
  • Curious, coachable, and motivated to grow within a commercial career path
  • Organized, data-driven, and detail-oriented
  • Fluent English, spoken and written

Why you'll love it here

  • Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
  • Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.
  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
  • Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
  • Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path. 
  • Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
  • International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection

Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.

Read more about our hiring process.

descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Web Developer to join an engineering team supporting a global entertainment and media organization. You will work within an agile development team, partner closely with product management, perform code reviews, and mentor other developers as you help build and maintain high-quality web applications.

This role is a strong fit for self-motivated engineers who are passionate about both the business and the technology behind it. Deep knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Node.js is essential, and hands-on experience with React, Redux, Jest, Azure SQL, and MongoDB is a strong plus. Just as important is the ability to adapt quickly as technologies and priorities change.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications using modern web technologies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product management, to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
  • Identify and resolve bottlenecks and fix bugs.
  • Guide and mentor other full stack developers on business and technical concepts to improve code quality and delivery speed.
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation across the codebase.
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.
  • Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience as a Full Stack Web Developer or in a similar role.
  • Mastery of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript, along with frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Strong experience with a Node.js framework such as Hapi.js or Express.js.
  • Experience with database systems such as MongoDB, MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience working on large single-page web applications with complex state management.
  • Familiarity with UI frameworks such as Bootstrap, Semantic UI React, Material, Tailwind, or similar.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Chai, Cypress, or similar.
  • Experience performing code reviews to ensure security, code quality, maintainability, and knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  • Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Very strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience with React, Redux, Jest, Azure SQL, and MongoDB.
  • Experience with SAP/BTP integrations.
  • Experience with cloud services such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience working in FinTech or financial systems environments.
  • Experience working in agile development teams.
  • Experience mentoring or leading other developers.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a seasoned full stack engineer who takes ownership of quality, from clean code and solid test coverage to thoughtful code reviews. They are comfortable working across the front end and back end, collaborate easily with product and engineering peers, and enjoy helping other developers grow.

Just as important as technical depth is the ability to adapt to changing technology, understand the business context behind the work, and contribute to a team culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

Your partner for AI, consulting, software development, and nearshore staffing.

descriptionHtml:
Acerca del Rol


El Líder de Confiabilidad es responsable del liderazgo general sobre las distintas áreas de Mantenimiento en definir y llevar a cabo las Buenas Prácticas de Mantenimiento sobre los equipos e instalaciones, con el objetivo de asegurar la confiabilidad requerida.

Es responsable de evaluar, diseñar, entrenar e implementar Planes de Mantenimiento Preventivo (PM), Planes de Mantenimiento Predictivo (PdM) y programas de mejora continua en lo referido a confiabilidad. Esta posición requiere habilidades particulares y conocimiento especializado en herramientas de Gestión de Mantenimiento: RCA, RCM, Indicadores de Confiabilidad y otras herramientas estadísticas. Reporta al Sr Lead de Mantenimiento y lidera un equipo de 10 personas.


Responsabilidades


  • Confiabilidad y Gestión de Planes de Mantenimiento: Responsable del desarrollo y optimización de los Planes de Mantenimiento a equipos basados en análisis de falla, recomendaciones y experiencias.
  • Análisis de Fallas y Mejora Continua: Liderar los Análisis estadísticos y de Causa Raíz (RCA) y dar seguimiento sobre las acciones surgidas de los mismos. Ajustar las estrategias de Mantenimiento de acuerdo a lo requerido.
  • Liderazgo de Equipos: Liderazgo sobre los Planificadores y Programadores de Mantenimiento de las distintas Áreas, Administradores de Stock Room.
  • Gestión Presupuestaria y Contratos de Servicio: Liderar la confección y seguimiento del Presupuesto de Mantenimiento, en conjunto con las Áreas de Procurement y Finanzas de la Compañía. Es responsable por desarrollar/actualizar los Pliegos asociados a los Servicios de Mantenimiento, siendo nexo entre el Área de Mantenimiento y los Servicios contratados por la misma.
  • Relaciones con Proveedores y Compras: Responsable en desarrollar las especificaciones de compra de nuevos equipos, considerando aspectos de mantenibilidad y confiabilidad.
  • Indicadores y Reporte: Administrar los KPI's de Mantenimiento, con seguimiento diario, semanal y mensual; reportando al equipo de Mantenimiento y Liderazgo los resultados.
  • Seguridad, Calidad y Medio Ambiente: Mantener el cumplimiento de Normas de Seguridad y Medio Ambiente, asegurando que todos los equipos están correctamente mantenidos y operando según sus especificaciones de diseño.


Calificaciones


  • Formación universitaria en carreras de ingeniería Industrial, Mecánica, Electromecánica o afines.
  • Experiencia en rol similar, liderando equipo de confiabilidad (Planificadores & Programadores, Inspectores de Condición y Stock Room) en operación con altos estándares de calidad y seguridad.
  • Radicación en Balcarce o cercanía.
  • Horario de trabajo en horario central, con disponibilidad para contingencias operativas.
  • Manejo de SAP.
  • Inglés intermedio (lectoescritura).


Habilidades Requeridas


  • Conocimiento en herramientas de Gestión de Mantenimiento.
  • Habilidades de liderazgo y gestión de equipos.
  • Capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas.

Solutions 2GO Inc.

Solutions 2 GO INC. es un distribuidor global líder de productos de videojuegos, con operaciones en 19 países de Norteamérica, Centroamérica y Sudamérica, y alianzas estratégicas que amplían nuestro alcance a Europa, África, Australia y Asia. Representamos empresas editoras de videojuegose de la industria en el mercado canadiense, ofrecemos una red de distribución de costa a costa en Estados Unidos y somos el socio exclusivo de distribución de Sony PlayStation en Latinoamérica. Nuestro liderazgo, experiencia, procesos y alianzas estratégicas nos han consolidado como un referente global en soluciones de distribución flexibles, dinámicas y adaptadas a las necesidades de publishers, fabricantes y retailers alrededor del mundo.Buscamos personas con iniciativa, orientación a resultados y ganas de generar un impacto real. Profesionales que disfruten asumir nuevos desafíos, trabajar de manera colaborativa y contribuir tanto al crecimiento del negocio como a la construcción de una cultura donde las personas puedan desarrollarse y alcanzar su máximo potencial.

Si te identificas con esta forma de trabajar y quieres ser parte de nuestro crecimiento, queremos conocerte!

Jr Key Account Manager Scope

The Jr Key Account Manager holds direct responsibility for managing strategic customer relationships. This position reports directly to the Sr Key Account Manager. The individual in this role is accountable for achieving sales targets, optimizing and enhancing retail space and product placement, and overseeing the administrative functions associated with the position. Additionally, they are responsible for maintaining and expanding existing relationships with key retailers and strategic partners.

The Key Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for all matters related to client relationships and the sales process. This individual must possess in-depth knowledge of the vendor’s brand and product portfolio, while also demonstrating familiarity with competitor offerings, industry trends, and the retail landscape.

Responsibilities

  • To build and maintain relationships with existing retailers
  • To support the development of new relationships with non-traditional retail partners
  • To coordinate retail sales activities and promotional calendars based on established account plans and priorities
  • To support the execution of vendor by coordinating retail support at the point of sale and across applicable advertising channels
  • To coordinate product placements and assortments for each account, based on established commercial strategies and retailer characteristics
  • To support negotiations for additional floor space and other commercial areas for displays, interactive units, and promotional materials
  • To coordinate the execution of product transitions and pricing adjustments across retail accounts and stores
  • To monitor retail inventory levels and coordinate with internal teams and retail partners to support sales opportunities
  • To support the development and tracking of the annual retail marketing and promotional budget
  • To conduct weekly analysis of sell-in data, inventory levels, and other market/account information, providing insights and recommendations to support account performance
  • To collaborate with a Sales Analyst who will provide operational support, weekly store-level purchase recommendations, sales analysis reports, and forecasts
  • To participate in weekly or bi-weekly meetings with each retail buyer/client to review sales performance, opportunities, and action items
  • To support the preparation of the annual sales budget by account and by product, and to track monthly performance with a three-month forecast horizon
  • To monitor account performance and coordinate with Finance, Logistics, and other relevant departments to follow up on account-related matters
  • To identify potential new business opportunities and support their development in coordination with the Sr KAM
  • To support the development and tracking of sales objectives for the field marketing promoter team
  • To ensure compliance with partner sales guidelines, including street date adherence

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Sales, Marketing, Communication or equivalent related experience
  • At least 2 years of previous experience in a retail sales role
  • Experience in consumer electronics or a related field
  • General knowledge of marketing, brand development, sales analysis, planning and retail advertising.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate the communication process, with the ability to convey information and ideas clearly
  • Proven ability to establish and maintain strong working relationships with a variety of stakeholders
  • Understanding of P&L drivers
  • Good analytical skills with a creative approach to idea generation and problem-solving
  • Ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • The individual must be organized, resourceful and results oriented
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office software
  • Bilingual (Spanish and English) preferred

La persona seleccionada recibirá una oferta de empleo condicional, sujeta a la finalización satisfactoria de una verificación de antecedentes realizada por un proveedor externo contratado por la compañía. Los requisitos específicos de verificación podrán variar según la posición y pueden incluir uno o más de los siguientes: verificación de antecedentes penales, verificación crediticia, validación de experiencia laboral, verificación de estudios académicos y revisión del historial de conducción.

Si tienes alguna pregunta durante el proceso, no dudes en consultarnos.

For more information on Solutions 2 GO Inc., please visit our website at: www.solutions2go.ca

descriptionHtml:
At EY GDS – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY, Managed Services (MS) is a significant part of our business, comprising more than $7b in revenue with major clients across the globe. We help clients with people based, asset based & integrated solutions, leveraging our deep sector and domain expertise to deliver enhanced value to our clients.

At EY, Managed Services (MS) is a significant part of our business, comprising more than $7b in revenue with major clients across the globe. We help clients with people based, asset based & integrated solutions, leveraging our deep sector and domain expertise to deliver enhanced value to our clients. In MS we are also ambitious, seeking to more than double our success in the future.

The opportunity

A GMx Payroll Win Centre Specialist/Senior role focused on supporting end‑to‑end integrated payroll services pursuits—contributing to RFx responses, commercials, solution coordination, reporting & deal compliance, sales enablement to consistently produce timely, high-quality deliverables for complex, multi-stakeholder pursuits.

Working within a global and virtual team, the Senior is expected to manage assigned pursuit activities with increasing independence, coordinate inputs from multiple stakeholders, identify risks and dependencies early, and escalate decisions appropriately. The role is an individual contributor position and does not include formal people-management or appraisal responsibilities.

Your Key Responsibilities

Bid Management:

  • Respond to RFx opportunities and pursuits, including proposal development, presentation materials, oral presentations and demonstration coordination across bid stages.
  • Support the pursuit owner and bid manager throughout the bid lifecycle to deliver timely, accurate and professionally presented outputs.
  • Coordinate assigned workstreams, timelines, reviews, actions and stakeholder inputs, and flag risks or delays early.
  • Contribute to deal qualification, renewals and expansion opportunities, win themes, value propositions and other upstream or downstream business development activities.
  • Support analyst- and alliance-led pursuits where required.

Commercials management:

  • Delivers pricing quote requests with good understanding of different commercial elements like implementation, recurring services, scope, add-ons, margins, discounts and allocation.
  • Support commercial modelling and analysis to inform better pricing discussions & client negotiations
  • Coordinate commercial review protocols & approval processes, bid tollgate management
  • Support contracting stage activities, including BAFO, and finalizing commercial scope

Solution Support:

  • Understand client requirements and map them to relevant payroll offerings, solution capabilities and supporting credentials.
  • Coordinate inputs from solution, technology, implementation, service management, country and subject-matter teams.
  • Prepare solution presentations, demonstrations, client-visit materials, business cases and supporting content for oral presentations and negotiations.
  • Contribute to win strategy, value proposition, solution and commercial reviews, and deal-closure activities.

Sales Enablement:

  • Contribute & manage collateral repository for offerings, industry/client/competitor research, credentials, standard templates, RFx response databases, and other pursuit material
  • Administration, Governance and reporting on the CoE to manage compliance to presales performance metrics
  • Leverage Industry insights, adoption of next-wave digital solutions (AI/automation etc) tools and best practices to continuously improve sales enablement experience working with internal presales teams & stakeholders, to enhance sales support processes & results

MIS reporting & insights:

  • Contribute & manage Pursuit lifecycle/ pipeline tracking, bid-logs, win-loss, reporting, dashboards and participating in governance to drive sales metrics
  • Record creation and maintenance of data in Dynamics internal pursuit tracker online tool and core CRM
  • Cross checking with CRM main source for tagging the deal IDs and details to Dynamics
  • Ad-hoc and periodic follow-up governance and tracking process management with stakeholders
  • Periodic reporting and pipeline management actions

Deal Compliance Management:

  • Manage the Pre-deal submission compliance & risk process
  • Collaborate with Sales, Pursuit Leaders, Risk & other functions to capture solution risks, tech & infosec risks, implementation risks, etc. and complete the Risk & independence checklists and deliverables
  • Tracking, Analysis and Reporting of Deal compliance to Quality & Senior Management leadership on a monthly basis
  • Governance of Deal Risk procedures & templates, including conducting regular communications and trainings with internal & external stakeholders

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Excellent communications and presentation skills (written, verbal, interpersonal)
  • Excellent organizational skills, ability to work under pressure, stringent deadlines, prioritise effectively and multi-task
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to interpret complex documents to highly professional business language
  • Team & result orientation - ability to work effectively in a remote, virtual, global environment with different stake holders at various levels
  • Proficiency in MS Office/Office 365 tools
  • Proficiency in Bid Automation tools, MS Project/PowerBI, AI, Advanced Excel, dashboarding tools like PowerBI. Tableau, Macro, will be added advantage

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • A Graduate/MBA degree or equivalent.
  • 5-7+ years of experience.

About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is looking to incorporate a Business Development Executive to join the Sales team. This person will provide for the growth and development of the organization through the sale of services and technological solutions / consulting (Data & IA, Cloud + Dev), for Argentina.

The responsibilities will include driving revenue, adoption and market penetration in enterprise accounts and the ideal candidate will possess technical and sales expertise that allows them to drive CXO - level engagement with both business areas and infrastructure leaders, software developers and IT architects. With a consultative sales approach is expected of the candidate: prioritizing the relationship, the account/opportunity plan, stakeholder mapping, BANT, etc. You should also be a entrepreneur who is prepared to develop and execute the account coverage plan and consistently meet quarterly revenue goals.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Drive revenue, generating sales contract and market share in a defined account territory
  • Meet or exceed quarterly/yearly revenue targets
  • Know and make known to the market the offering Netrix Global, through the practices of Migration & Devops, Security, Development, Data & IA, MSP, IOT, among others
  • Develop the plan/forecast, participating in the definition of sales target
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive account/territory plan
  • Manage sales processes and CRM Pipeline: keep updated
  • Operational activities: participate in sales meetings, coordinate agendas with clients / team Netrix Global, documentation in internal tools (CRM, APN, etc.), assembly of presentations and proposal to clients, etc.
  • Proposal process: ensures end-to-end compliance from the identification of documented lead/BANT to its transition to the operations area
  • Proposal process: create , coordinate and articulate compelling value propositions around Netrix Global services, to be delivered to the client
  • Proposal process management, including Pricing
  • Accelerate costumer adoption by interacting with C-level and different stakeholders
  • Maintain a solid and recurring sales flow
  • Work with partners to expand reach and drive adoption to sales
  • Client relationship: identify, build, develop and manage strategic relationships and long-term links with key accounts
  • Ensure costumer satisfaction
  • Demand generation: collaborate and participate in the assembly and execution of a demand generation strategy working as a team with Mkt and Executive Management
  • Hunting: identify new accounts to work with, expanding the installed base and generating commercial activities such as Immersion Day, Round Tables, etc.

What You Will Bring To The Table

  • Must have Advanced English Level (oral and written)
  • 3 plus years of experience that requires basic knowledge of sales with the Microsoft partnership, as well as the ability to develop compelling thought leadership and promotional content and programs to fuel demand generation, engagement, and conversions across multiple Alliances
  • 3-5 years of technology-related sales or business development experience
  • Client facing: 3-5 years of experience in the direct field working with enterprise accounts (highly desirable to own customer base)
  • Excellent treatment with clients, in terms of dialogue, empathy and understanding
  • Ability to "translate" customer needs to technical pre-sales teams
  • Knowledge of the technology market in general, and Cloud computing in particular (highly desirable)
  • Proactively understand technological trends, to design better solutions for customers
  • Be able to communicate fluently in Spanish and highly desirable in English (verbal and written)
  • Preferably knowledge of cloud technologies in general, and AWS in particular, not exclusive
  • Sales leadership: autonomy and independence track record with evidence.

Location

  • Buenos Aires, Argentina

Shift

  • 9 a.m to 6 p.m from Monday to Friday

What We Offer

  • Swiss Medical SMG 30 (primary family group)
  • AWS certifications.
  • Happy Club: Pedidos Ya
  • Discounts at Unilever, Samsung, BGH, Peña Flor, among others
  • Discounts in educational institutions
  • Internet and connectivity
  • Compensation for childcare expenses (from 0 to 3 years old)
  • Competitive salary and benefits
  • English in company
  • Work from Anywhere: You can work from all over the world
  • Gifts for special dates (marriage, graduation, birthdays, etc.)
  • Christmas Box
  • Day off for birthdays
  • 10 (ten) calendar days of paternity leave
  • An awesome learning environment for you to develop

About Us

At Netrix Global our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals and commit us to a common purpose.

We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!

Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today’s most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution.

We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country’s top system integrators.

At Netrix, we’re driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction.

What You Can Expect From Us

We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If you need reasonable accommodations, please let us know by contacting NetrixHR@Netrixglobal.

To learn more about Netrix Global please go to www.netrixglobal.com

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Resumen e Impacto del Rol

La búsqueda está centrada en Estudiantes avanzados o promediando carrera Lic. en Publicidad o afines para sumarse al equipo. Buscamos un perfil organizado, prolijo, con ganas de seguir aprendiendo, que tenga capacidad para trabajar en equipo y con excelente predisposición.

Habilidades y Experiencia

  • Experiencia de por lo menos un año como planner Sr. en cuentas o agencias grandes, o dos años en cuentas chicas.
  • Experiencia en pautas ON y OFF.
  • Manejo de Excel
  • Manejo de armado de planes, tácticas on, reportes digitales, conocimientos de métricas digitales para armado de recomendaciones.
  • Inglés nivel intermedio.

Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios (Be Extraordinary), invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo (Lead Optimistically), creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo (Championing Growth and Development) de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto (Create an Open Environment) basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Nuestro paquete integral de beneficios refleja este compromiso e incluye seguro médico, de visión y dental, planes grupales de retiro, un generoso programa de tiempo libre pagado, descuentos preferenciales con aliados y días dedicados al bienestar y la salud mental de nuestro equipo.

En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Por eso, hemos adoptado un modelo de trabajo híbrido, asistiendo a la oficina alrededor de cuatro días a la semana. Si requieres alguna adaptación o flexibilidad, te invitamos a conversarlo con el equipo de selección durante el proceso de entrevista. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Agradecemos a todas las personas que se postulen a esta vacante; sin embargo, solo contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados para una entrevista.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work - building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.

We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta, so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.

The mission of this role

Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.

Who are we?

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

  • Better Everyday - keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round
  • Speed Is King - move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day
  • Work Smart - AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts
  • Overdeliver - catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told

If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.

Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

  • Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands - measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)
  • Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert - CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)
  • Continuous improvement across the website - tests live every week; winners shipped
  • AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise - AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)
  • No conversion drop goes unnoticed - drops caught and raised the same day

Key Objectives

  • Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first
  • Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells
  • Brief, QA and launch tests every week - then call results honestly and ship the winners
  • Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor
  • Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix
  • Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house
  • Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

Requirements

  • Fully remote, full-time
  • Fluent in English
  • CRO Experience: 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must
  • Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV - with the data to back it up
  • Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages
  • Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help
  • Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency
  • Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule
  • Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
  • Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder
  • Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience

Accountabilities

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

  • CRO test plan and backlog - Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next
  • Funnels - Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV
  • Build, QA and launch tests - Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week
  • Results, winners and conversion monitoring - Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day
  • CRO agency - Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house
  • CRO reporting and meetings - Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

  • Application + Screening
  • Test Project
  • Technical Interview
  • Culture Fit Interview

Salary Expectation

USD $4,000 - $6,000+ per month (based on experience and expertise).

About Howard Financial

Howard Financial is a tech-forward outsourced accounting and finance firm serving clients across Vacation Rental, Hospitality, Consumer & E-Commerce, and Development & Real Estate. We combine strong technical accounting with modern tools to give our clients clarity and confidence in their numbers.

About The Role

We're looking for a Tax Manager to join our growing tax team. You'll support the full scope of our tax work, from income tax and year-end filings to compliance projects, while taking ownership of our sales tax function. This is a great fit for someone with solid U.S. tax experience who enjoys being both a hands-on preparer and a trusted point of contact for clients and teammates.

What You'll Do

  • Partner closely with the tax team, supporting all areas of the tax practice
  • Run point on sales tax: own compliance, filings, nexus reviews, and client questions
  • Prepare and review business and individual income tax returns and year-end deliverables
  • Manage tax calendars and deadlines across a multi-client portfolio
  • Communicate clearly with clients and internal accounting teams, translating tax requirements into actionable next steps
  • Help build and improve tax processes, checklists, and documentation as the team grows
  • Stay current on federal, state, and local tax changes that affect our clients


What We're Looking For

  • Enrolled Agent (EA) credential, or equivalent experience and knowledge at that level
  • Proven experience in U.S. tax preparation and review, especially income tax and year-end work
  • Sales tax experience is a plus, but not required; we'll support you in growing into that ownership
  • Highly organized, able to juggle multiple clients and deadlines without losing track of details
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Proactive and comfortable working independently in a remote environment


Nice to Have

  • Experience with clients in hospitality, vacation rental, or e-commerce
  • Familiarity with tax software and sales tax platforms (e.g., Avalara, TaxJar)
  • Experience in an outsourced accounting or CPA firm environment


Why Howard

  • Fully remote role with a collaborative, growing team
  • Direct impact on building out our tax function
  • Exposure to a diverse client base across multiple industries
