About Us
Coderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. With a strong technical foundation and a product-oriented mindset, our teams lead complex software projects from architecture to execution. We value autonomy, clear communication, and technical excellence. We work closely with international teams and partners, creating technology that makes a difference.

More information: http://coderio.com

The Role
We are seeking a Senior Enterprise AI & Automation Engineer to design, build, and operate intelligent workflows and conversational agents at scale. This role bridges the gap between advanced AI development (Python, LLMs) and enterprise operations (Microsoft Stack, Azure).

You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of mission-critical AI solutions: developing custom agents, integrating them with enterprise data platforms (Snowflake), and ensuring robust observability (Splunk) in cloud environments. If you thrive in complex ecosystems and know how to turn AI capabilities into tangible business value—while leveraging tools like Cursor IDE or GitHub Copilot to accelerate your own delivery—this high-impact role is for you.

What To Expect In This Role (Responsibilities)
  • AI & Agentic Development: Design and build conversational solutions, custom copilots, and agentic workflows using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, and custom Python architectures.
  • Enterprise Integration: Connect AI agents and automated workflows seamlessly with enterprise data ecosystems, specifically Snowflake and SharePoint.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Architect and operate resilient, large-scale cloud infrastructures on Azure, managing deployments via CI/CD pipelines (YAML, GitOps patterns).
  • Observability & Governance: Develop advanced monitoring, logging, and auditing strategies using Splunk to track agent performance, latency, and operational bottlenecks.
  • Engineering Excellence: Actively leverage AI-assisted development tools (Cursor IDE, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate coding, improve code quality, and set best practices for the team.
  • Technical Leadership: Collaborate with cross-functional, global teams, providing technical direction, participating in client discussions, and recommending emerging AI technologies.


Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Automation roles with demonstrated impact at an enterprise scale.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience developing with Python (building robust backend services, APIs, and data integrations).
  • 2+ years of experience designing and deploying solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio (or Power Virtual Agents) and Power Automate.
  • Proven experience building agentic workflows or AI pipelines, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into business processes.
  • Solid cloud expertise, strongly focused on Azure (AWS is a plus).
  • Experience integrating applications or agents with Snowflake.
  • Proven background in building high-volume logging and monitoring ecosystems (e.g., Splunk, multi-region ingestion, automated reporting).
  • Daily active user of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor IDE, ChatGPT) to optimize engineering workflows.
  • Bilingual English


Nice to Have
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps (pipelines, repos, artifacts, YAML).
  • Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen).
  • Experience with SharePoint integrations, reusable modules, and reproducible infrastructure standards.


Benefits
  • 100% remote work.
  • High-impact strategic role with autonomy and ownership.
  • Opportunity to scale cloud and automation practices in global environments.
  • Collaborative senior engineering culture with strong technical leadership.
  • Clear growth pathway and access to leadership opportunities.


Why Join Coderio?
At Coderio, we value talent regardless of location. We are a fully remote company passionate about technology, collaboration, and fair compensation. We offer an inclusive and challenging environment with real growth opportunities. If you are motivated to design scalable cloud infrastructures, elevate DevOps practices, and build AI-powered automation that makes a difference, we’d love to meet you.

Apply now.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 120-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators works with leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, wellness, and DTC brands to accelerate growth through performance-driven creative and marketing.

We move quickly, challenge assumptions, and constantly look for better ways to grow. We’re looking for an Amazon Account Manager who understands the Amazon ecosystem, knows how to turn data into action, and takes ownership of driving measurable marketplace performance.

Why This Role Matters

Amazon is more than a sales channel. For many brands, it’s one of the most important drivers of revenue, customer acquisition, and long-term growth.

As our Amazon Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing and growing Amazon accounts across our portfolio. You’ll oversee marketplace performance, listings, advertising, promotions, inventory coordination, reporting, and account health while continuously identifying opportunities to increase revenue and profitability.

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t simply maintain an Amazon account. You should be constantly asking: Where can we improve conversion? What’s hurting organic ranking? Which campaigns are wasting spend? Where are we losing margin? What can we test next?

If you know Seller Central inside and out and enjoy turning marketplace data into growth opportunities, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Manage Amazon Accounts

  • Own day-to-day management of assigned Amazon Seller Central accounts.
  • Monitor account performance, sales, traffic, conversion rates, inventory, and account health.
  • Manage product listings, variations, categories, pricing, and other catalog updates.
  • Troubleshoot listing suppressions, account issues, stranded inventory, and other marketplace problems.
  • Ensure accounts remain compliant with Amazon policies and marketplace requirements.

Optimize Product Listings

  • Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, keywords, images, and A+ Content.
  • Conduct keyword and competitor research to improve organic visibility and conversion.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product detail pages and overall customer experience.
  • Coordinate with creative and copy teams to develop stronger listing assets.
  • Run ongoing tests and improvements based on marketplace performance.

Manage Amazon Advertising

  • Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.
  • Monitor budgets, bids, keywords, search terms, and campaign performance.
  • Improve advertising efficiency while supporting revenue growth.
  • Track metrics including ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and attributed sales.
  • Identify winning campaigns and opportunities to scale while reducing inefficient spend.

Drive Revenue & Profitability

  • Develop strategies to increase Amazon revenue, market share, and profitability.
  • Analyze sales trends and identify opportunities across products, categories, and campaigns.
  • Plan promotions, coupons, deals, and other marketplace initiatives.
  • Monitor competitor pricing, positioning, reviews, and marketplace activity.
  • Balance revenue growth with advertising efficiency and contribution margin.

Monitor Inventory & Forecasting

  • Coordinate with operations and supply chain teams to maintain healthy inventory levels.
  • Monitor sell-through rates and identify potential stockout or overstock risks.
  • Support demand forecasting using historical performance, seasonality, promotions, and growth trends.
  • Help ensure inventory decisions align with advertising and sales strategies.

Analyze & Report Performance

  • Build regular reports covering sales, advertising, profitability, inventory, and account health.
  • Translate Amazon data into clear recommendations and next steps.
  • Identify performance trends, problems, and growth opportunities before they become obvious.
  • Communicate results and strategic recommendations to internal teams and leadership.
  • Establish and track KPIs for each account.

Who You Are

Amazon Marketplace Expert

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.
  • Strong understanding of Amazon marketplace operations, catalog management, account health, and listing optimization.
  • Proven experience growing Amazon revenue and improving marketplace performance.
  • Experience managing multiple brands or accounts simultaneously is strongly preferred.
  • Agency or multi-brand eCommerce experience is a major plus.

Strong Amazon PPC Experience

You understand how organic performance and paid advertising work together.

You’re comfortable building, analyzing, and optimizing Amazon advertising campaigns and can explain exactly why you’re increasing spend, reducing bids, changing targeting, or restructuring a campaign.

Data-Driven

You’re comfortable working with large amounts of marketplace data and turning it into decisions.

You understand metrics such as ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CVR, sessions, Buy Box percentage, organic ranking, and contribution margin.

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills are required. Experience with Amazon analytics and third-party marketplace tools is a plus.

Commercially Minded

You understand that growing revenue alone isn’t enough.

You think about profitability, advertising efficiency, inventory, pricing, conversion, and customer behavior together when making decisions.

Highly Organized

You can manage multiple products, campaigns, deadlines, and priorities without losing attention to detail.

You document your work, communicate clearly, and keep stakeholders informed without needing to be chased for updates.

Always Looking for the Next Opportunity

You don’t wait for someone to tell you an account is underperforming.

You notice the change, investigate the cause, develop a solution, and move quickly.

Why This Role Matters

Amazon is more than a sales channel. For many brands, it’s one of the most important drivers of revenue, customer acquisition, and long-term growth.

As our Amazon Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing and growing Amazon accounts across our portfolio. You’ll oversee marketplace performance, listings, advertising, promotions, inventory coordination, reporting, and account health while continuously identifying opportunities to increase revenue and profitability.

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t simply maintain an Amazon account. You should be constantly asking: Where can we improve conversion? What’s hurting organic ranking? Which campaigns are wasting spend? Where are we losing margin? What can we test next?

If you know Seller Central inside and out and enjoy turning marketplace data into growth opportunities, this role is for you.

Manage Amazon Accounts



- Own day-to-day management of assigned Amazon Seller Central accounts.
- Monitor account performance, sales, traffic, conversion rates, inventory, and account health.
- Manage product listings, variations, categories, pricing, and other catalog updates.
- Troubleshoot listing suppressions, account issues, stranded inventory, and other marketplace problems.
- Ensure accounts remain compliant with Amazon policies and marketplace requirements.

Optimize Product Listings



- Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, keywords, images, and A+ Content.
- Conduct keyword and competitor research to improve organic visibility and conversion.
- Identify opportunities to improve product detail pages and overall customer experience.
- Coordinate with creative and copy teams to develop stronger listing assets.
- Run ongoing tests and improvements based on marketplace performance.

Manage Amazon Advertising



- Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.
- Monitor budgets, bids, keywords, search terms, and campaign performance.
- Improve advertising efficiency while supporting revenue growth.
- Track metrics including ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and attributed sales.
- Identify winning campaigns and opportunities to scale while reducing inefficient spend.

- Analyze sales trends and identify opportunities across products, categories, and campaigns.
- Plan promotions, coupons, deals, and other marketplace initiatives.
- Monitor competitor pricing, positioning, reviews, and marketplace activity.
- Balance revenue growth with advertising efficiency and contribution margin.

- Coordinate with operations and supply chain teams to maintain healthy inventory levels.
- Monitor sell-through rates and identify potential stockout or overstock risks.
- Support demand forecasting using historical performance, seasonality, promotions, and growth trends.
- Help ensure inventory decisions align with advertising and sales strategies.

- Build regular reports covering sales, advertising, profitability, inventory, and account health.
- Translate Amazon data into clear recommendations and next steps.
- Identify performance trends, problems, and growth opportunities before they become obvious.
- Communicate results and strategic recommendations to internal teams and leadership.
- Establish and track KPIs for each account.

Amazon Marketplace Expert



- 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.
- Strong understanding of Amazon marketplace operations, catalog management, account health, and listing optimization.
- Proven experience growing Amazon revenue and improving marketplace performance.
- Experience managing multiple brands or accounts simultaneously is strongly preferred.
- Agency or multi-brand eCommerce experience is a major plus.

You understand how organic performance and paid advertising work together.

descriptionHtml:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

The Total Rewards Program Director is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and ongoing management of global Total Rewards programs. This role ensures that compensation, benefits, mobility, recognition, and wellbeing programs are scalable, consistent, and operationally strong.

The role contributes to the evolution of Total Rewards strategy and develops programs aligned with the company’s EVP, talent strategy, and Total Rewards philosophy. It translates strategic priorities into well-designed programs, clear frameworks, effective governance, and consistent execution across both ongoing operations and key program cycles.

The Director partners closely with HRBPs, People Services, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to deliver high-quality programs and a consistent experience globally.

Key Responsibilities

Program Design & Development

  • Design and build global Total Rewards programs, frameworks, and operating models that are scalable, predictable, and easy to navigate
  • Define program requirements, workflows, governance, and supporting documentation
  • Establish clear ownership, decision-making structures, and cross-functional alignment

Program Implementation & Execution

  • Lead end-to-end implementation of global TR programs, including compensation cycles, market benchmarking, benefits renewals, equity processes, recognition programs, mobility workflows, and M&A integration support
  • Manage timelines, workplans, and stakeholder coordination across functions
  • Ensure high-quality, consistent execution across all programs

Program Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Own the ongoing operation of TR programs, ensuring they run smoothly and efficiently day-to-day
  • Maintain and evolve documentation, playbooks, and process maps
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate to improve the operating model

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with HRBPs, People Services, HRIS, People Analytics, Finance, and Legal to ensure programs are compliant, integrated, and well-governed
  • Support due diligence and post-acquisition integration of Total Rewards programs
  • Align with Finance on budgeting, forecasting, and cost management

Data, Systems & Reporting

  • Ensure data integrity and reporting accuracy in partnership with HRIS and People Analytics
  • Define reporting needs and support development of dashboards and insights
  • Use data and program insights to identify issues and inform improvements

Employee & Manager Experience

  • Develop clear, practical materials (guides, FAQs, toolkits, templates) that make programs easy to understand and use
  • Ensure changes to programs are well-communicated and supported through strong change management

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Total Rewards, HR program management, compensation, or related areas
  • Proven experience designing and managing global or large-scale HR programs
  • Strong program and project management skills with the ability to drive execution
  • Ability to translate strategy into structured programs and operational delivery
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex topics
  • Comfortable working with data, systems, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Global experience preferred

What Success Looks Like

  • Programs are well-designed, scalable, and consistently executed across regions
  • Day-to-day operations run smoothly with clear ownership and minimal friction
  • Frameworks, governance, and ways of working are clearly defined and adopted
  • Stakeholders understand how programs work and how to engage with them
  • Programs evolve over time based on data, feedback, and changing business needs

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside

Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.

Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve

Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build Each Other Up

Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

AAUSA_FY20_CBS_63972_HR_Talent_Recruiter_Assistant Director_Executive Recruiter - TA

Everything we do for our clients comes down to having the right business, technical knowledge and leadership for every occasion. Our colleagues across the business look to us to consistently provide the most promising talent to our world-class organization. As a Talent Attraction Recruiter, you’ll be right at the heart of that goal, directly engaging with business leaders, colleagues and candidates from a diverse array of backgrounds.

The opportunity

As an Executive Talent Attraction Recruiter, Assistant Director, you’ll own executive recruiting responsibilities aligned to a various service lines and sectors, serving the US market. You’ll partner with an Executive Recruiter to manage the talent pipeline by identifying top talent and converting prospects into active candidates. As part of a high performing team, you’ll serve as a trusted business advisor to our leaders, Talent team and hiring managers by overseeing all external candidate engagement and driving talent to EY. You’ll ensure an exceptional candidate experience for every candidate, so our reputation for quality and innovation will be in your hands. In return, you’ll have the support of a network of highly knowledgeable colleagues and the opportunity to make a significant impact to your team and EY.

Your key responsibilities include

  • Developing recruiting strategies to attract executive hires and serve as a key contact to client groups and external candidates
  • Assessing business leadership resource needs against the talent market to build a compelling pipeline through various channels
  • Ensuring all appropriate sourcing strategies are utilized, including inclusiveness initiatives and other creative sourcing techniques
  • Integrating EY's brand strategy into all recruitment activity at all levels across all platforms
  • Acting as a change agent for new technology, tools and processes that are rolled out to the broader recruiting community
  • Staying informed of talent and labor market insights
  • Conducting training and performance related feedback for teammates
  • Innovating and leveraging Ai in your everyday work environment to further efficiencies and impact sourcing strategies and execution

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Demonstrating knowledge and prior experience in attracting and engaging executive hires and leveraging a variety of recruitment resources
  • Ability to function in a lead recruiter role providing coaching and counseling to other recruiters and team members
  • Providing operational and process excellence to ensure a quality candidate experience
  • Strategic-thinking skills and ability to collaborate with team members on best practices
  • Consultative approach with clients, serving as a talent advisor on the external pipeline of prospective candidates
  • Ability to be agile and embrace new technology and tools which are designed to improve the recruitment process

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Extensive experience in the executive level search and recruitment process
  • Ability to develop an effective sourcing strategy
  • Ability to identify and solve complex recruitment issues
  • Ability to develop and foster relationships
  • Ability to provide training and performance related feedback to team
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • 8-10+ years of experienced hire recruitment experience, including executive recruitment
  • Experience recruiting talent in the US market
  • Knowledge and experience in creative sourcing techniques of experienced hires
  • Deep understanding of current recruitment/hiring laws and practices
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Copilot and PowerPoint) and experience working with applicant tracking software. Avature experience a plus
  • Advanced English and can communicate confidently in professional settings, lead discussions, handle complex topics, and write professional communications with minimal errors

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Experience in a professional services environment
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with numerous projects happening simultaneously
  • Strong reporting and data analytic skills
  • Executive recruiting experience

What We Look For

We’re interested in knowledgeable professionals ready to take ownership for attracting and engaging external candidates for EY. You’ll need to be naturally curious, ready to learn and have a genuine passion for finding the right people for the right roles. If you’re aiming to influence change within a world class recruiting organization, all while developing your own career, this role is for you.

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, both pension and 401(k) plans, a minimum of 18 days of paid time off with additional time based on your level and years of service plus 12 observed holidays, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being.

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in building a better working world. Apply now.

Company Description

Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private, and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems.

To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.

Job Description

As a Proposal Specialist you will support Pursuit Strategists and Proposal Managers in developing, coordinating, and delivering high-quality client proposals across strategic and competitive pursuits. You will serve as a key contributor across coordination and content development; ensuring every submission is client-focused and aligned with our firm’s services and value proposition.

This role requires strong writing and editing capability, disciplined follow-through, and effective collaboration with subject matter experts (SMEs), delivery leaders, and commercial teams. The role is delivery-oriented ensuring proposals are accurate, compliant, well-written, and submitted on time.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Daily Core Activities

  • Support Proposal Managers by reviewing new RFPs/proposal requests and breaking down requirements, deadlines and deliverables
  • Draft and tailor proposal content, including executive summaries, service overviews, methodologies, bios, and case studies, using content libraries and templated assets.
  • Edit and refine inputs from subject matter experts (SMEs) to ensure clarity, consistency, and client ready language
  • Apply proposal writing best practices to improve structure, readability, and responsiveness to client requirements
  • Load RFPs and proposal materials into the proposal automation platform and ensure projects are set up correctly
  • Maintain proposal timelines, task assignments, and status updates within the proposal tool
  • Coordinate day-to-day proposal activity, tracking inputs, sending reminders, and managing follow-ups
  • Create and maintain shared working folders and ensure documents are accurately version controlled
  • Support collaboration across contributors by managing working drafts and consolidating inputs

Additional Responsibilities (Weekly/Ad Hoc)

  • Support proposal kick-off sessions, check-in meetings, and oral prep calls by preparing materials, documenting actions, and tracking follow-ups
  • Perform compliance and completeness checks against RFP instructions prior to review and submission
  • Support proposal submission activities, including uploads to client portals where required
  • Assist with post-submission administration, including archiving materials and updating proposal records
  • Identify recurring content and process issues and escalate to the Proposal Manager or Content Manager

Qualifications

  • 2+ years’ experience in proposal writing, editing and bid support in a professional services, consulting, or B2B environment
  • Excellent written English, with the ability to edit, simplify, and tailor content to different client audiences
  • High attention to detail and strong document management skills
  • Familiarity with proposal structures, formal RFP responses, and portals like Ariba, Jaggaer, or SAP
  • Proficient in MS Word, PowerPoint, Adobe, and document formatting best practices
  • Experience using tools like Loopio, Responsive, and SharePoint
  • Proficient using AI in day-to-day work, especially Copilot and Claude

Key Attributes for Success

  • Execution focused with a strong sense of ownership for assigned tasks
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a focus on quality
  • Able to work to direction and deliver consistently under time pressure
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks simultaneously

Why This Role?

  • Play a pivotal role in winning new business for a fast-growing global services firm.
  • Work closely with leadership and experts on high-impact, global opportunities.
  • Develop deep expertise in proposal writing and editing within a growing proposal environment.
  • Opportunities for advancement into senior pursuits, bid strategy, or commercial operations roles.

We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status.

About The Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, highly analytical, and proactive Accountant with 2 to 3 years of experience to join our finance team. The ideal candidate possesses a rock-solid accounting foundation, advanced proficiency in QuickBooks, and exceptional English communication skills.

In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, handling day-to-day accounting operations, assisting with monthly closings, and ensuring full compliance. You will collaborate directly with native English-speaking stakeholders, making strong verbal and written communication crucial.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accounting Operations: Manage general ledger entries, accounts payable (A/P), accounts receivable (A/R), and routine bank reconciliations using QuickBooks.
  • Month-End & Year-End Close: Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes, preparing trial balances, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Financial Reporting: Prepare timely, accurate financial statements and reports for management and key stakeholders.
  • Process Improvement: Continuously identify operational efficiencies and automate accounting workflows to optimize productivity.
  • Compliance & Reconciliation: Ensure internal controls are maintained and resolve any accounting discrepancies or variances proactively.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Serve as a primary financial point of contact, presenting financial figures clearly and collaborating with cross-border teams.


Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: 2 to 3 years of hands-on accounting experience (experience in international, US-based, or remote accounting environments is a major plus).
  • Software: Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks (Online or Desktop) is required. Familiarity with Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP) and modern financial tools is essential.
  • Language Skills: Fluent/Native English (verbal and written). Ability to conduct meetings and write formal business correspondence seamlessly.
  • Core Competencies: Strong, verified knowledge of fundamental accounting principles (GAAP or IFRS).
  • Proactive Mindset: Self-starter attitude with high autonomy, problem-solving initiative, and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.


What We Offer

  • 100% remote working environment.
  • Competitive salary in USD (or local equivalent).
  • Opportunities for career growth and professional development.
  • Collaborative, international team culture.

✅ Design and promote healthy & effective engineering practices in the team: Conduct code reviews to ensure code & architecture quality, write and review software design documents, and drive efficient and effective test automation.

This would make you the ideal candidate

✨ 8+ Years of engineering substantial full-stack web codebases live in production, including ownership of systems at scale.

✨ 7+ Years of hands-on experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frontend development and React (or equivalent component frameworks), with deep expertise in state management, performance optimization, and component architecture.

✨ 5+ Years designing and shipping complex distributed systems, including API design, microservices integration, and performance-critical architectures.

✨ Strong foundations in Computer Science and software engineering.

✨ Fluency with Internet web technologies and modern full-stack Web Application tech stacks.

✨ Familiar with best practices of web DevOps and QA for effective & efficient testing.

✨ Experience with consumer internet applications is strongly desired.

#SomosNaranjaX y nos une el propósito de trabajar por la inclusión y la educación financiera de millones de personas. Más de 9.5 millones de clientes nos eligen cada día porque confían en Naranja X para alcanzar sus sueños.

Estamos creando un ecosistema de soluciones tecnológicas financieras que se diferencia por ofrecer la mejor experiencia y facilidad en el acceso.

¿Querés ser protagonista de esta historia e impulsar la transformación financiera de millones de personas? ¡Súmate!

¿Qué desafíos vas a encontrar en esta posición?



-  Diseñar y crear aplicaciones robustas y escalables con tecnologías Cloud (AWS) utilizando Node.js y TypeScript.
-  Colaborar activamente con el equipo de arquitectura en la definición y refactorización de arquitecturas para optimizar el rendimiento.
-  Identificar y brindar soluciones a problemas complejos, asegurando la calidad del código mediante pruebas unitarias y de integración.
-  Trabajar en equipos multidisciplinarios, participando del diseño de nuevos productos bajo metodología scrum.

¿Qué buscamos?



-  Sólida experiencia en Node.js y TypeScript
-  Experiencia desarrollando sistemas de alta disponibilidad y baja latencia
-  Experiencia trabajando con arquitectura de microservicios y orientadas a eventos
-  Experiencia en despliegues, CI/CD, pipelines
-  Experiencia trabajando con AWS (EKS, EC2, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, API Gateway, herramientas de DMS)
-  Experiencia implementando pruebas unitarias y de integración
-  Experiencia en construcción de APIs REST
-  Conocimientos en metodologías ágiles (Scrum y Kanban)
-  Uso fluido de agentes de IA y asistentes de desarrollo (GitHub Copilot, etc.) para optimizar el ciclo de vida del software

Sumarte a La Experiencia NX Es

📍 Modo Flex: Creemos en la presencia más que en la presencialidad. Trabajá de manera híbrida y flexible: desde casa, oficina o mixto.

🌍 #WorkFromAnywhere: desde cualquier parte del país o el mundo.

🌴 Más días de descanso: Además de vacaciones, tenés días libres NX desde el inicio para elegir cuando quieras.

💸 Ajustes de sueldo periódicos que acompañan el contexto económico.

💻 Reintegros por gastos de internet y servicios.

🍔 Reintegro en compras de supermercado y restaurantes

🤩 Programas de capacitación constante y plataformas de E-learning (Udemy) para potenciar tu desarrollo.

👶 Licencia extendida y flexibilidad al regreso para gestantes y no gestantes. + Licencias especiales para el cuidado de tu familia.

🥰Y una propuesta de valor mucho más amplia pensada para acompañarte en cada momento y desarrollar todo tu potencial.

En Naranja X promovemos un espacio de trabajo seguro e inclusivo, donde podés desplegar tu talento, tus ideas y tu magia.

Nuestras búsquedas son abiertas y equitativas para todas las personas: teniendo en cuenta diversidad de género, etaria, de religiones, ideas y opiniones, nacionalidad, personas con discapacidad, LGBTIQ+. ¡Mientras más diversos sean nuestros equipos, mayor será nuestra capacidad de agregar valor a las finanzas de las personas!

descriptionHtml:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

Monks has an open position for a talented production designer who wants to further their skills in digital asset and content design at our Buenos Aires office.

In this middle-level role, you will join a dedicated global team in producing top quality content for the product interfaces of one of the world’s most recognizable brands.

Role & Responsibilities


  • In this role, you’ll specialize in the design of static visuals for a wide variety of channels, including product interfaces, social media, and display advertising.
  • You work as part of a dedicated global team of designers, illustrators, animators, editors, and art directors that produces world-class work across time zones.
  • The job is about harmonizing speed, style, and scale to produce loads of good-looking assets at a steady pace.
  • Pixel-perfection is important. You safeguard quality at all times and work together with QA testers.
  • In addition to making images look so good you'll want to lick them, you make sure that designs adhere to guidelines and are consistent across ad formats, dimensions, and languages.
  • You will work together directly with art directors on the client side, representing Monks from a design POV.


Please be attentive to the requirements for this role and accompany your portfolio with a short cover letter detailing why you’re the right person for the job.

Requirements


  • For this role, we’re looking for a designer with around 3/4 years of experience crafting digital ads and assets.
  • You have solid Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma skills.
  • Mastering the art of silhouetting and retouching is a plus.
  • You know how to keep your files, layers, and folders super-organized, even if you’re a creative mess outside of Photoshop.
  • You can take charge of small tasks independently and take on bigger jobs with little supervision.
  • You can contribute to different stages of the production process, from setting styles and layouts to cutting formats and language versioning.
  • Creating balanced and beautiful layouts is your second nature.
  • You are always on the lookout for process efficiencies—if you’re AI-savvy and love automation, even better.
  • You can handle repetitive tasks and stay focused.
  • Advanced English, production tricks, and cat videos.
  • You are a clear communicator and are happy to work with designers from all over the world.
  • You will be expected to adhere to a high level of confidentiality.


About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.

This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

Radio Mitre y La 100 se encuentran en la búsqueda de un/a Ejecutivo/a Comercial para sumarse a su equipo de Ventas.

Buscamos un perfil con fuerte orientación comercial, conocimiento del mercado publicitario y capacidad para desarrollar propuestas que integren las distintas plataformas y formatos de nuestras marcas.

🎧 ¿Qué tareas vas a realizar?

  • Analizar audiencias, tendencias de mercado, información comercial y métricas de performance para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento.

  • Participar en la definición de estrategias comerciales, pricing y monetización de productos publicitarios

  • Comercializar espacios publicitarios y soluciones de comunicación en Radio Mitre y La 100, tanto en aire como en sus plataformas digitales.

  • Desarrollar propuestas comerciales multiplataforma, integrando radio, web, redes sociales, YouTube, streaming, podcasts y otros formatos digitales.

  • Detectar oportunidades de negocio y generar propuestas a medida de las necesidades y objetivos de cada anunciante.

  • Desarrollar y comercializar contenidos brandeados, acciones especiales, menciones, PNT, experiencias y proyectos de contenido asociados a marcas.

  • Gestionar y desarrollar una cartera de clientes compuesta por anunciantes directos, agencias de publicidad y centrales de medios.

  • Trabajar en conjunto con las áreas de Contenidos, Marketing, Digital y Producción para desarrollar soluciones creativas e innovadoras para los anunciantes.

  • Realizar seguimiento de las campañas y acciones comerciales implementadas, asegurando el cumplimiento de los acuerdos establecidos.

  • Cumplir con los objetivos comerciales mensuales y anuales.

💡 Nos gustaría conocerte si contas con…

  • Experiencia comercial en medios, publicidad o agencias.

  • Conocimientos en análisis de audiencias con herramientas como Kantar IBOPE, Comscore, Google Analytics o similares, métricas comerciales, research de mercado e inteligencia de negocios.

  • Capacidad para interpretar datos y transformarlos en propuestas comerciales y estrategias de crecimiento.

  • Experiencia en desarrollo de presentaciones comerciales, armado de propuestas de valor y negociación con clientes.

  • Conocimientos de pricing, valorización de inventario publicitario y monetización de productos.

📥Si cumplís con los requisitos y te interesa formar parte de un entorno dinámico y profesional, ¡esperamos tu postulación!

descriptionHtml:
Sobre Nosotros: Noventiq (Noventiq Holdings PLC) es un proveedor global líder de soluciones de transformación digital y ciberseguridad de vanguardia, con sede en Londres. Empoderamos a las empresas para que prosperen en la era digital, conectándolas con proveedores de IT de primer nivel y ofreciendo nuestros propios servicios innovadores y soluciones patentadas.

¿Por qué Noventiq? Nuestro éxito se basa en una sólida estrategia tridimensional enfocada en expandir nuestra presencia en el mercado, diversificar nuestro portafolio de productos y mejorar nuestros canales de ventas. A través de actividades estratégicas de fusiones y adquisiciones, estamos listos para capitalizar la consolidación de la industria y lograr un crecimiento sin precedentes. Con un equipo dinámico de aproximadamente 6,400 colaboradores operando en alrededor de 60 países, tenemos una presencia significativa en regiones con un enorme potencial de crecimiento, incluyendo América Latina, EMEA, APAC y una notable presencia en India.

Tu Oportunidad: Únete a una organización reconocida a nivel mundial, galardonada en múltiples ocasiones con premios "Great Place to Work". En Noventiq, tus ideas importan. Fomentamos un entorno donde la innovación prospera y la colaboración es una piedra angular. Sé parte de nuestro viaje para impulsar la transformación digital en todo el mundo.

¿Listo para Hacer un Impacto? Si te apasiona dar forma al futuro de la transformación digital y la ciberseguridad, te queremos en nuestro equipo. Únete a nosotros y sé parte de una organización global donde tus contribuciones son valoradas y tu potencial es ilimitado.

Lo Que Harás

  • Cumplir y superar los objetivos de ventas de soluciones tecnológicas a través de la venta consultiva.
  • Identificar las necesidades del cliente para generar oportunidades de proyectos y servicios gestionados.
  • Recopilar información de la infraestructura tecnológica del cliente y proponer soluciones adecuadas.
  • Presentar y posicionar el portafolio de soluciones Cloud y servicios de la compañía.
  • Elaborar, presentar y validar propuestas técnico-comerciales junto con el equipo de preventa y delivery.
  • Desarrollar e implementar estrategias de generación de demanda en el territorio asignado.
  • Adquirir, fidelizar y expandir la relación con clientes estratégicos.
  • Mantenerse actualizado en tendencias principalmente de Microsoft y otras marcas (Seguridad, IA, Copilot, Fabric, Power Platform).
  • Liderar workshops para clientes y desempeñarse como speaker en eventos estratégicos.

Sobre Ti

  • Mínimo 5 años de experiencia comprobada en preventa, venta y consultoría de soluciones Cloud (idealmente Microsoft, Google y AWS).
  • Experiencia en la venta de infraestructura y nube (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
  • Experiencia en venta consultiva de proyectos de migración cloud, modernización y seguridad.
  • Proactividad y habilidades de negociación.
  • Fuertes habilidades comerciales con capacidad para identificar y cerrar oportunidades.
  • Capacidad de trabajar autónomamente y en equipo.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación (ejecutiva y técnica).
  • Orientación a resultados y cumplimiento de objetivos.
  • Capacidad de conectar el valor de negocio con las soluciones técnicas Microsoft, Google y AWS.

Join Nortal for your next big adventure. We are seeking Senior AI Agentic Engineer to join our team, grow with us, and teach us a few things along the way.

Why join Nortal

  • Say Goodbye to Micromanagement: We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.
  • Outcomes Over Hours: We believe in a work model focused on impact, providing you with the flexibility to balance your professional success with your personal well-being.
  • Vibrant Community: Join our close-knit LATAM remote team and connect through tech talks, virtual coffee breaks, and team-building activities.
  • Support from Day One: Our People Care team is here to support you throughout your journey, from wellness check-ins to professional growth.

Our benefits ✨

  • Competitive USD salary.
  • 100% remote work: While you can work from anywhere, you’re always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM.
  • Paid time off & national holidays: Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations while receiving your full salary.
  • Sick leave: Focus on your health without stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.
  • Annual credit: Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance.
  • Team-building activities: Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community.
  • Birthday off: Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family.

About The Project

We're looking for a senior engineer to help a US client build secure enterprise applications and AI agents that do real work. You'll design agentic workflows that connect AI to the client's data and tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and you'll make sure they hold up in production: secure, tested, monitored, and easy for other teams to reuse.

This is a self-directed role. You'll work closely with domain experts and product managers, help shape technical direction across teams, and mentor other engineers along the way.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build secure enterprise applications with React, TypeScript, Python, and API services.
  • Build agentic workflows and MCP integrations that connect AI applications to enterprise data and tools.
  • Implement structured outputs, workflow state management, human approval steps, and error recovery.
  • Build authentication, authorization, role-based access control (RBAC), and audit logging.
  • Set up AI evaluation, guardrails, tracing, and monitoring to track quality, safety, performance, and cost.
  • Work with domain experts and product managers to turn requirements into solutions that scale.
  • Design reusable, configuration-driven components that other teams can pick up and use.
  • Own your code in production, including tests and documentation.
  • Mentor other engineers and help guide technical direction across teams.
  • Take part in Nortal's Technical Interviewer Program, conducting technical interviews for your account and other accounts to help build the teams behind Nortal's growth.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related STEM field.
  • Five or more years of software development experience, including five or more years with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages.
  • Strong skills in React, API development, application architecture, automated testing, and CI/CD.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted applications, agentic workflows, or tool-calling solutions.
  • Experience with MCP, structured outputs, context management, or comparable frameworks.
  • Experience with authentication, authorization, RBAC, and secure coding practices.
  • Full lifecycle experience, from requirements and architecture to deployment and production support.
  • Bonus if you've worked with Databricks, Unity Catalog, or data lakes; GitLab CI/CD; policy-as-code or infrastructure-as-code; data marketplaces, governance platforms, or internal developer platforms; or privacy, security, and AI governance controls in regulated environments.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻

THIS JOB IS HYBRID IN BUENOS AIRES :) Relocation assistance available for the right candidate.

Sunflower is hiring an AI SEO Lead in our Buenos Aires, Argentina office to own organic search for our clinic website across traditional search and AI discovery. Build the content people trust and the answers AI cites.


Learn more about the Sunflower Clinic here: https://sunflowerclinic.com/


You need to be able to create best in class written content yourself, recruit & manage contributors, leverage AI tools/processes, build backlinks, and earn placements in the citations AI uses as references. This is the MOST IMPORTANT ROLE we will be hiring over these next 12 months and will directly be responsible for $1M - $10M+ of annual revenue. 🌻


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Execute our SEO and content strategy, from keyword research and editorial planning to publishing, distribution, and measurement.

• Create original content using aggregated data, insights, and consented stories from our user community.

• Partner with psychiatrists and industry experts to co-create authoritative, accurate articles and resources.

• Use AI to accelerate research, analysis, drafting, and content operations, with rigorous editing and source verification.

• Create useful content for Reddit and LinkedIn Articles, tailored to each community and platform.

• Identify the resources AI tools cite for relevant treatment queries, including naltrexone, and earn editorial placements and citations.

• Win quality backlinks through digital PR, outreach, partnerships, and link building.

• Own performance across rankings, qualified organic traffic, conversions, backlinks, and visibility in AI answers.


WHO YOU ARE

• An exceptional English writer and communicator, with recent work that proves it.

• Strong in SEO fundamentals: search intent, keyword research, on-page optimization, internal linking, content strategy, and analytics.

• Comfortable combining excellent content, AI tools, and hands-on distribution.

• Proven track record of earning backlinks and citations.

• Friendly, collaborative, and thoughtful with teammates, clinicians, and our audience.

• Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina (or willing to relocate).

Experience earning citations in AI answers is a strong plus. You don't need to have mastered every part of this role. Outstanding writing, strong judgment, initiative, and the ability to learn fast matter most.

Our general compensation philosophy is that base salary is heavily DOE & location (ex: SF vs Medellin). Performance compensation will be rewarded regardless of location or background.


HOW TO APPLY

Please email the following to Caitlin, Head of Growth at Sunflower (caitlin@sunflowersober.com):

• Resume

• 2–3 recent English writing samples, explaining your contribution and results.

• Backlinks or editorial placements you personally secured, if available, and how you earned them.

• Any examples of content cited by AI tools and how you measured it.

• A short explanation of how you use AI in your content and SEO workflow.


PROCESS

1. We'll review all applications

2. Initial phone screen

3. Takehome

4. Interview with CEO

5. Offer

descriptionHtml:
Desarrollador Senior .NET


Responsabilidades Técnicas


Desarrollo Frontend


• Frameworks: dominio sólido de Angular con TypeScript; capacidad de evaluar y definir cuándo usar React según el proyecto.

• Gestión de Estado: criterio para elegir y diseñar la estrategia de estado a nivel de aplicación (Redux, Context API, NgRx, servicios inyectados), no solo usarla.

• Consumo de Servicios: diseño de la capa de comunicación con el backend (interceptores, manejo centralizado de errores, refresh de tokens, estrategias de caching en cliente).

• Maquetado y Estilo: definición de sistemas de componentes reutilizables y librerías internas (Tailwind CSS o Bootstrap como base), con criterio de diseño escalable para múltiples equipos.

Desarrollo Backend

• Arquitectura de APIs: dominio experto de ASP.NET Core Web API, middleware custom, filtros, versionado de APIs y diseño de contratos (REST/GraphQL).

• Patrones de Arquitectura: dominio de Clean Architecture, DDD (Domain-Driven Design) y CQRS; capacidad de decidir qué patrón aplicar según el problema, no solo implementarlo.

• Manejo de Datos Pro: dominio avanzado de Entity Framework Core (Migrations, Shadow Properties, optimización de consultas, resolución de N+1) y criterio para saber cuándo bajar a SQL puro o Dapper por performance.

• Seguridad: diseño de esquemas de autenticación/autorización (JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect), gestión de CORS y validación de datos (FluentValidation) a nivel de arquitectura, no solo de implementación.

• Asincronismo y Concurrencia: uso avanzado de async/await, manejo de background jobs (Hangfire, Quartz), y resolución de problemas de concurrencia y bloqueos en sistemas de alta carga.


Arquitectura y Sistemas Distribuidos


• Liderar el diseño de arquitecturas escalables, mantenibles y desacopladas para múltiples equipos de desarrollo.

• Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas de microservicios: definición de bounded contexts, comunicación entre servicios (síncrona y asíncrona), patrones de resiliencia (circuit breaker, retry, bulkhead).

• Sistemas de mensajería y eventos: diseño de flujos con Kafka, RabbitMQ o Redis (pub/sub, colas, event sourcing cuando aplique).

• Definir el stack tecnológico del equipo y los estándares de arquitectura, documentando decisiones (ADRs) y trade-offs.

• Realizar code reviews con foco en arquitectura y deuda técnica, no solo en estilo de código.

DevOps y Calidad

• Diseñar y mantener pipelines de CI/CD, incluyendo estrategias de despliegue (blue-green, canary). • Acordar la estrategia de testing del equipo (unitarios, integración, end-to-end) y los criterios de cobertura.

• Diseñar la infraestructura de despliegue en entornos cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), con foco en escalabilidad y costos.

• Implementar observabilidad: logging estructurado, métricas, tracing distribuido, alertas proactivas ante degradación de performance.

Herramientas de desarrollo y Colaboración

• GitHub, GitLab (incluyendo definición de branching strategy)

• Postman

• Visual Studio Code / Visual Studio

• Docker y orquestación (Kubernetes deseable)

• SQL Server Management Studio, DBeaver

• APIs REST y GraphQL


Competencias Técnicas — Nivel Esperado


• Capacidad para liderar el diseño técnico de features y proyectos completos, no solo ejecutarlos. • Experiencia resolviendo problemas de performance y escalabilidad en sistemas productivos de alto tráfico.

• Dominio profundo de patrones de arquitectura, con criterio para elegir el patrón correcto según el contexto del negocio.

• Habilidad para diseñar esquemas de base de datos eficientes a nivel de sistema (no solo de una feature), considerando particionamiento y escalabilidad.

• Capacidad de detectar y resolver deuda técnica de forma proactiva.


Competencias Blandas Requeridas


Liderazgo Técnico y Trabajo en Equipo


• Liderazgo Técnico: guiar decisiones de arquitectura y stack, y ser referente técnico para el equipo.

• Comunicación Técnica: explicar trade-offs y decisiones técnicas complejas tanto a perfiles técnicos como no técnicos (negocio, PM).

• Mentoría: formar y acompañar a desarrolladores semi senior y junior de forma estructurada (pairing, revisiones de diseño).

• Colaboración: articular con múltiples equipos y stakeholders en proyectos cross-funcionales. • Adaptabilidad: manejar ambigüedad y cambios de prioridades en proyectos de mayor escala.

Mentalidad Ágil y Ownership

• Orientación a Resultados: balancear entrega de valor continuo con sostenibilidad técnica a mediano/largo plazo.

• Mejora Continua: impulsar mejoras de procesos y arquitectura a nivel de equipo, no solo de código propio. • Propiedad: responsabilidad end-to-end sobre sistemas completos, incluyendo su operación en producción. • Curiosidad: evaluar y proponer adopción de nuevas tecnologías con criterio de negocio.


Requisitos de Experiencia


Formación y Experiencia


• 9+ años de experiencia en desarrollo full stack, con al menos 3 años en roles de mayor responsabilidad técnica.

• Experiencia comprobable liderando el diseño de arquitecturas para proyectos de alta complejidad. • Experiencia mentoreando o liderando técnicamente a otros desarrolladores.

• Portfolio o ejemplos de código/arquitectura para revisar.

Deseables

• Experiencia con serverless architectures.

• Experiencia con sistemas de mensajería (Kafka/RabbitMQ/Redis) en producción. • Titulación universitaria en Sistemas o campos relacionados.

• Certificaciones cloud (Huawei/AWS) deseables.


Cómo postular

Enviar CV (y opcionalmente, repositorios o ejemplos de trabajo) a:

📩 rrhh@encodesa.com.ar

Colabora con 3Mers innovadores alrededor del mundo

Como Gerente Regional de Cuentas Claves desempeñarás un rol clave desarrollando las estrategias y manejo comercial de los usuarios finales priorizados en la división de Abrasivos Industriales en Sur de América.

En este rol podrás contribuir con el crecimiento acelerado de nuestra compañía, superando los objetivos de ventas, rentabilidad y capital de trabajo de tu área de responsabilidad; trabajando en el crecimiento y desarrollo de nuestros principales clientes conectando con el equipo de ventas de usuario final de la región.

  • Identificar y definir oportunidades de mercado/producto para cumplir y superar los objetivos de ventas y crecimiento.
  • Interactuar efectiva y proactivamente con otras áreas contribuyendo con las operaciones e iniciativas de la compañía para incrementar el nivel de servicio a nuestros clientes y la productividad de nuestra organización.

  • Excel Avanzado
  • Disponibilidad para viajar al interior de Argentina 2 semanas al mes.
  • Idioma Inglés intermedio.


Experiencia y habilidades adicionales que podrían ayudarte a tener aún más éxito en este rol:


  • Liderazgo de equipo directo o por influencia

  • Deseable contar con un una Maestría en Negocios o especialidades afines


Localización De Trabajo


  • Localización de trabajo: Este rol sigue un modelo de trabajo remoto, reportando a las oficinas ubicadas en Buenos Aires, Argentina.
  • Viajes: Puede incluir hasta 1 semana al mes.

Chevron Global Business Services (GBS), located in Buenos Aires (Puerto Madero), Argentina, is accepting online applications for the position of Senior Software Engineer (Power Platform & Automation). Successful candidates will join the IT Company which is part of a successful multifunction service center with a workforce of more than 1800 employees delivering business services and solutions across the globe.

The Senior Software Engineer (Power Platform & Automation) role involves designing, developing, and supporting low-code, automation, integration, and data solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, Azure services, and associated Microsoft technologies. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders to identify opportunities, evaluate technology options, modernize existing processes and applications, and deliver scalable, secure, and efficient solutions that generate business value.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain applications using Power Apps (Canvas & Model-driven).
  • Automate workflows, business processes, and integrations using Power Automate, Azure services, and SharePoint.

descriptionHtml:
Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Jefe/a de Business Intelligence para incorporarse a una reconocida compañía multinacional con fuerte presencia en Latinoamérica. La posición formará parte del área de Desarrollo, con alcance regional, y tendrá un rol clave en la génesis del negocio: participar en las decisiones sobre dónde y cómo crecer, estimar las ventas y la inversión de nuevos proyectos y hacer el seguimiento de sus resultados.

Principales responsabilidades

  • Desarrollar análisis y productos analíticos de punta a punta: estimaciones de venta, retorno de inversiones, potencial de mercado, competencia y performance del portfolio.
  • Definir KPIs y hacer el seguimiento integrado de los indicadores regionales del área, con controles cruzados y accountability de los reportes.
  • Gestionar un portfolio de proyectos analíticos, definiendo alcance, hitos, dependencias y entregables.
  • Liderar automatizaciones y casos de uso de IA generativa y agentes aplicados al negocio.
  • Coordinar proyectos transversales con analistas, equipos de distintos países y otras áreas de la compañía, sin autoridad formal.
  • Actuar como business partner de Expansión, Planning & Performance y Asset Management, traduciendo sus necesidades en soluciones analíticas.
  • Trabajar junto con Data & IT en la industrialización, documentación y continuidad de las soluciones.


Requisitos

  • Título universitario en Ingeniería Industrial, Economía, Administración, Estadística, Sistemas o carreras afines.
  • Al menos 3 años de experiencia en control de gestión, business analytics, performance o BI, con foco en definición de KPIs, seguimiento de proyectos y reporting ejecutivo.
  • Excel avanzado y Power BI.
  • Experiencia práctica o fuerte interés en IA generativa (Copilot, agentes, automatizaciones).
  • Inglés intermedio-avanzado.


Se valorará

  • Conocimientos de Power Query, Power Automate, SQL, Python o Alteryx (no es un rol de programación).
  • Experiencia en gastronomía, retail, consumo masivo o negocios multi-sucursal.
  • Experiencia liderando proyectos transversales o regionales.
  • Portugués.
  • Pensamiento analítico, capacidad resolutiva, autonomía y facilidad para comunicar hallazgos a perfiles ejecutivos.


Modalidad de trabajo

Jornada full-time | Esquema híbrido: 4 días presenciales y 1 remoto | GBA Zona Norte

descriptionHtml:
About Chainlink

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

About The Role

As a Software Engineer in Data Growth, you will help transform how web3 customers discover, onboard, and adopt products by building scalable automation, self-service experiences, and intelligent workflows. This role exists to reduce operational complexity, accelerate customer onboarding, and improve the efficiency of growth-related processes through modern software engineering, AI-enabled solutions, and systems thinking.

Your Impact

  • Design and build automation capabilities that reduce manual effort across customer onboarding and operational workflows.
  • Develop self-service experiences that enable customers to onboard, configure, and access products with minimal human intervention.
  • Improve customer growth outcomes by reducing onboarding cycle times and increasing process scalability.
  • Re-architect systems and workflows to support efficient provisioning, data sourcing, and customer enablement.
  • Apply AI technologies and modern engineering practices to identify opportunities for process transformation and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate across technical and business teams to solve complex problems and create sustainable, scalable solutions.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying bottlenecks, eliminating friction, and improving end-to-end customer experiences.

Requirements

  • Experience building software products or platforms using TypeScript.
  • Experience leveraging AI technologies, tools, or frameworks to improve products, workflows, or operational processes.
  • Exposure to Web3 technologies, ecosystems, or decentralized applications, or experience in electronic trading environments.
  • Strong systems-thinking capabilities with the ability to understand complex interconnected processes and architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, analyze, and solve complex technical and operational problems.
  • Experience designing and implementing automation solutions that improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders and functions.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience developing applications or services using Golang.
  • Experience building self-service platforms, onboarding systems, or workflow automation products.
  • Familiarity with customer growth, onboarding, provisioning, or operational excellence initiatives.
  • Experience improving data sourcing, data quality, or data integration processes.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems, APIs, and cloud-native architectures.

All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST).

We carefully review all applications and aim to provide a response to every candidate within two weeks after the job posting closes. The closing date is listed on the job advert, so we encourage you to take the time to thoughtfully prepare your application. We want to fully consider your experience and skills, and you will hear from us regarding the status of your application shortly after the closing date.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Chainlink Labs is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us via this form.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Information collected and processed as part of your Chainlink Labs Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to our Recruiting Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

IMG is a leading global sports marketing agency, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, strategic consulting, digital services, and event management. It powers growth of revenues, fanbases and IP for more than 250 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the National Football League, English Premier League, International Olympic Committee, National Hockey League, Major League Soccer, ATP and WTA Tours, the AELTC (Wimbledon), Euroleague Basketball, CONMEBOL, World Rugby, DP World Tour, and The R&A, as well as UFC, WWE, and PBR. IMG is a subsidiary of TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO), a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

The Media Account Manager will represent the Media team in IMG’s Buenos Aires office, working closely with the wider Media team, CONMEBOL and relevant media rights holders and partners across the region. The role will have a strong focus on the international distribution of CONMEBOL Club Competitions media rights, supporting sales across international territories and managing relationships and contractual matters with existing rights holders.

The Media Account Manager will also act as a key point of contact for rights holders across the SSLA region, while supporting the Media team on media intelligence, anti-piracy matters and other strategic and day-to-day projects. Based in Buenos Aires, the position will serve as the Media team’s representative within the local IMG office, supporting IMG leadership on Media-related matters and representing the department in relevant meetings and discussions in Argentina.

IMG works with CONMEBOL to drive commercial growth and deliver innovative development strategies for its club competitions. The Media team supports the global distribution and commercial development of media rights across CONMEBOL Libertadores, Sudamericana and Recopa, helping connect South American club football with audiences around the world.

IMG’s team works across key markets in Latin America and internationally, collaborating closely with CONMEBOL, broadcasters, streaming platforms and other media partners to support the continued growth and distribution of CONMEBOL Club Competitions.

Above all else is our love of football and belief that South American football represents the very best there is on offer. Our job is to bring that brand of football to the world, connecting a greater global audience than ever before.

Here is what you can expect from working at IMG

  • A stimulating, fast-paced environment.
  • A passionate, close-knit team with a collaborative ethos.
  • Involvement in high-profile football decision making
  • The chance to bring South American football to fans all over the globe in new and innovative ways.

Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities

Sales and Account Management at CONMEBOL.

  • International Media Rights Sales: support and manage the sales of CONMEBOL Club Competitions media rights across international territories, including commercial negotiations, proposals and deal execution.
  • International Contract Management: manage international media rights agreements throughout their lifecycle, coordinating with relevant internal teams and following up on key contractual and commercial matters.
  • SSLA Account Management: act as a key point of contact for media rights holders across the SSLA region, managing day-to-day relationships, contractual matters and ongoing commercial discussions.
  • Media Intelligence: lead ratings and audience reports for CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana, providing relevant data and insights to internal departments and CONMEBOL when required.
  • Support the relationship with IMG’s anti-piracy partner and coordinate relevant matters with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Act as a focal point for the Media team in Buenos Aires, representing the department in relevant in-person meetings, activities and discussions in Argentina, including whenever the VP of Media is not present.
  • Support IMG’s leadership in Buenos Aires on all Media-related matters and contribute to broader Media team projects and day-to-day activities as required.

Knowledge And Experience

  • Previous experience in the Sports, Media and/or Broadcasting industry.
  • Experience in media rights sales, distribution and/or account management.
  • Strong commercial mindset, organizational skills, relationship management and customer service skills.\
  • Good understanding of the sports media landscape in Latin America and international media markets.
  • Fluent in Spanish and English; professional proficiency in Portuguese.
  • Previous experience with sports media rights, broadcasters, streaming platforms, audience measurement and/or TV/digital viewership data.
  • Availability to travel internationally, particularly within Latin America.

In addition, success at IMG is driven by four core competencies that apply to all employees:

  • Business Acumen – Understanding financial drivers, interpreting business data, aligning decisions to strategic outcomes
  • Operational Excellence – Driving efficiency, governance, and continuous improvement in delivery & operations
  • Innovation Mindset – Cultivating curiosity, experimentation, and forward-looking capability development
  • Leadership & Collaboration – Inspiring others, building trust, and enabling collaboration across teams

Working Conditions

  • This is a permanent position
  • May be required to attend (and travel to) locations, including other IMG buildings and meetings
  • Unsocial hours may be required, as dictated by the demands of the business schedule
  • Adapting to use of new systems and technology where appropriate

TKO makes employment decisions based on merit and qualifications, without considering an employee’s or applicant’s race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited under federal, state or local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the Company has facilities.
