IMG works with CONMEBOL to drive commercial growth and deliver innovative development strategies for its club competitions. The Media team supports the global distribution and commercial development of media rights across CONMEBOL Libertadores, Sudamericana and Recopa, helping connect South American club football with audiences around the world.

IMG’s team works across key markets in Latin America and internationally, collaborating closely with CONMEBOL, broadcasters, streaming platforms and other media partners to support the continued growth and distribution of CONMEBOL Club Competitions.

Above all else is our love of football and belief that South American football represents the very best there is on offer. Our job is to bring that brand of football to the world, connecting a greater global audience than ever before.

Here is what you can expect from working at IMG



- A stimulating, fast-paced environment. 
- A passionate, close-knit team with a collaborative ethos.
- Involvement in high-profile football decision making 
- The chance to bring South American football to fans all over the globe in new and innovative ways.

Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities

Sales and Account Management at CONMEBOL.



- International Media Rights Sales: support and manage the sales of CONMEBOL Club Competitions media rights across international territories, including commercial negotiations, proposals and deal execution.
- International Contract Management: manage international media rights agreements throughout their lifecycle, coordinating with relevant internal teams and following up on key contractual and commercial matters.
- SSLA Account Management: act as a key point of contact for media rights holders across the SSLA region, managing day-to-day relationships, contractual matters and ongoing commercial discussions.
- Media Intelligence: lead ratings and audience reports for CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana, providing relevant data and insights to internal departments and CONMEBOL when required.
- Support the relationship with IMG’s anti-piracy partner and coordinate relevant matters with internal and external stakeholders.
- Act as a focal point for the Media team in Buenos Aires, representing the department in relevant in-person meetings, activities and discussions in Argentina, including whenever the VP of Media is not present.
- Support IMG’s leadership in Buenos Aires on all Media-related matters and contribute to broader Media team projects and day-to-day activities as required.

Knowledge And Experience



- Previous experience in the Sports, Media and/or Broadcasting industry.
- Experience in media rights sales, distribution and/or account management.
- Strong commercial mindset, organizational skills, relationship management and customer service skills.\
- Good understanding of the sports media landscape in Latin America and international media markets.
- Fluent in Spanish and English; professional proficiency in Portuguese.
- Previous experience with sports media rights, broadcasters, streaming platforms, audience measurement and/or TV/digital viewership data.
- Availability to travel internationally, particularly within Latin America.

In addition, success at IMG is driven by four core competencies that apply to all employees:



- Business Acumen – Understanding financial drivers, interpreting business data, aligning decisions to strategic outcomes
- Operational Excellence – Driving efficiency, governance, and continuous improvement in delivery & operations
- Innovation Mindset – Cultivating curiosity, experimentation, and forward-looking capability development
- Leadership & Collaboration – Inspiring others, building trust, and enabling collaboration across teams

Working Conditions



- This is a permanent position
- May be required to attend (and travel to) locations, including other IMG buildings and meetings
- Unsocial hours may be required, as dictated by the demands of the business schedule 
- Adapting to use of new systems and technology where appropriate

Te proponemos:

  • Ser parte de una compañía con espíritu emprendedor en la que nos encanta pensar en grande y a largo plazo.

  • Compartir y aprender en equipo junto a grandes profesionales y especialistas.
  • Un excelente clima de trabajo, con todo lo necesario para que vivas una gran experiencia. :)

descriptionHtml:
Con 12.000 empleados en 35 países, COFCO International es la plataforma de negocios de agro de COFCO Corporation, la empresa más grande de alimentos y agro de China. COFCO International está focalizada en ser líder global en el suministro de cereales, granos, oleaginosas y azúcar, con activos en América, Europa y Asía Pacífico. La compañía comercializa con 50 naciones, mientras provee a los productores un acceso único y directo al mercado creciente de China. En 2018 COFCO International manejó cerca de 100 millones de toneladas de commodities con ganancias de $31 billones. La empresa está acelerando su crecimiento para crear una cadena de suministro internacional de primera línea, anclada en China y con alcance global.

📢 Búsqueda Laboral: Jefe de Mantenimiento

Para sumar al equipo de Mantenimiento de nuestra Terminal Portuaria Lima (Buenos Aires), nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Jefe de Mantenimiento.

Orientamos la búsqueda a profesionales con formación universitaria en Ingeniería Mecánica, que cuenten con al menos 5 años de experiencia en posiciones de liderazgo y sólidos conocimientos en gestión de mantenimiento industrial.

📌 Importante: Sugerimos leer atentamente los requisitos del puesto antes de postularse, ya que se priorizarán aquellos perfiles que mejor se ajusten a lo solicitado.

🎯 Misión del Rol

Planificar, Coordinar y Controlar la Gestión de Mantenimiento de las instalaciones que componen el establecimiento.

🛠️ Principales Responsabilidades

  • Planificar y controlar las rutinas preventivas/predictivas y los trabajos correctivos de los equipos de planta.
  • Analizar y gestionar la compra de repuestos. Administrar el stock del almacén de planta.
  • Administrar y controlar los gastos asociados a los trabajos de mantenimiento. Analizar la facturación de servicios del sector.
  • Desarrollar proveedores y contratar los servicios tercerizados.
  • Administrar el contrato de abastecimiento de energía eléctrica en planta.
  • Proponer e implementar mejoras al proceso. Coordinar y controlar los nuevos proyectos.
  • Gestionar y motivar los recursos humanos a cargo. Brindar soporte técnico. Identificar y planificar las necesidades de capacitación detectadas.
  • Organizar e implementar los procedimientos de gestión de calidad del sector y el plan de Seguridad, Higiene y Medio Ambiente de planta.

💡 Competencias que Valoramos

  • Capacidad de análisis.
  • Creatividad e iniciativa.
  • Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad al cambio.
  • Orientación a resultados.
  • Autonomía en la toma de decisiones.
  • Pensamiento estratégico.
  • Organización y planificación.
  • Comunicación oral y escrita efectiva.
  • Habilidades interpersonales.
  • Negociación.
  • Trabajo en equipo.
  • Liderazgo.

📚 Requisitos

  • Formación universitaria en Ingeniería Mecánica.
  • Experiencia mínima de 5 años en posiciones de liderazgo dentro de entornos industriales.
  • Conocimientos sólidos en gestión de mantenimiento industrial.

Planificar, Coordinar y Controlar la Gestión de Mantenimiento de las instalaciones que componen el establecimiento.

Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

Workday AMS HCM Consultant (Talent & Learning)

About The Role

As a Workday AMS HCM Lead Consultant (Talent & Learning) at Kainos, you’ll lead the ongoing support, configuration, and enhancement of Workday HCM solutions for our global clients. Specializing in Workday Talent and Learning, you’ll act as a subject matter expert within the AMS team. You will be enthusiastic to learn about upcoming changes related Sana for Learning.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to our customers, delivering tailored, strategic solutions that align with their evolving business needs. This role blends deep functional expertise, client advisory, hands-on configuration, and leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver expert configuration and support in Workday Talent & Learning
  • Act as a primary point of contact for clients, building relationships, offering strategic advice and ensuring high-quality, creative solutions.
  • Proactively advise on dependencies, cross-stream implications, and maintenance concerns.
  • Own the configuration of complex initiatives and guide clients to appropriately test.
  • Mentor junior consultants, promoting capability development across the team.
  • Manage competing priorities across multiple clients, proactively communicating about completion dates and blockers.
  • Provide suggestions to improve the configuration and user experience within Workday.

Minimum Requirements

  • Workday certification and/or significant hands-on experience configuring Talent and Learning, or related experience in another system, e.g. SuccessFactors or similar.
  • Solid understanding of related Workday functional areas beyond your core specialty.
  • Proven success in a client-facing consulting role or client-side HRIS team.
  • Strong customer engagement and communication skills, including experience presenting to senior stakeholders.
  • Commercial awareness and understanding of consulting project dynamics.
  • Ability to manage service delivery risk and lead cross-functional workshops and strategic discussions.

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

About Grupo QuintoAndar

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. Guided by a shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we have a diversified portfolio of brands and solutions across different countries in Latin America, covering all phases of the housing journey. We also have a Technology Hub in Portugal. We develop technology and innovation to transform and enhance the overall living experience.

With the support of a world-class team of investors and advisors, including Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic, and SoftBank, Grupo QuintoAndar is currently valued at over USD 5.1 billion and continues to grow year over year.

Here, you will work with top professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration, and high performance. To learn more about our story, visit: https://grupoquintoandar.com/pt/.

Location & Remote Work for technology and remote-first roles

Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Argentina. We also offer the option of working from our Buenos Aires offices or partner coworking spaces, up to twice a week.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will act as a premier technical anchor and individual contributor for our engineering organization. Operating with a line-level and organization-wide scope of impact, you will own the technical strategy and architectural roadmap of complex, large-scale products or platforms that are critical to the company's long-term vision.

We believe that technology scales execution, but senior talent scales judgment. This is an advanced leadership role that requires navigating cross-team technical architecture, managing technical alignment with stakeholders, and handling organizational and product dynamics across multiple structures.

Key Responsibilities (What you will do):

  • Architectural direction & strategy: Set the core architectural direction for complex platform scopes. Identify and generate new org-wide technical opportunities, defining the technical strategy and roadmap required to execute them.
  • Simplifying complex challenges: Break down vague, unstructured, and highly ambiguous problems into execution-ready technical scope. Create simple, highly maintainable systems with clear documentation and well-defined interfaces that can be easily operated even by junior engineers.
  • Engineering excellence & trade-off ownership: Drive the technical quality for larger or complex team scopes by establishing engineering standards and best practices. Act as a technical advisor, defining policies and proactively mitigating obstacles for software, product, and data quality across multiple domains.
  • Team influence & mentorship: Act as an absolute reference in technical leadership within Engineering. Provide senior technical assessments to management to inform project strategy and composition. Actively mentor senior engineers (including B6 and B7 levels), accelerating their technical growth without relying on formal authority.
  • Guard the tech bar: Act as a lead interviewer for senior and principal technical roles, setting the bar during our hiring, sourcing, and internal allocation processes.

Position & technical challenges:

Because we are scaling multiple strategic fronts simultaneously, we run a unified hiring process for our Staff positions. Instead of locking you into a single team from day one, we focus on assessing your leadership, systemic thinking, and architectural skills first.

At the final stage of the process, we will present you with 2 or 3 of our most critical technical challenges across different products and platforms. Together, we will choose the allocation that best aligns your expertise and career aspirations with our highest-impact business needs.

Regardless of the final allocation, your day-to-day will deeply involve solving systemic issues where multiple services cannot be understood in isolation. You will step into environments requiring high-concurrency solutions, complex data consistency, and the decoupling of mission-critical systems.

What we are looking for (Requirements):

  • 10+ years of experience in software development, with a consolidated background leading the delivery of high-volume, high-concurrency, and mission-critical distributed systems.
  • Deep knowledge of modern software architecture paradigms, distributed data consistency, fault tolerance, and system optimization.
  • Proven ability to analyze and articulate engineering trade-offs concretely (e.g., simplicity vs. flexibility, velocity vs. reliability, build vs. buy).
  • Demonstrated capability to remove barriers to collaboration, conduct difficult structural conversations smoothly, build strategic roadmaps, and foster an inclusive engineering culture.
  • Experience designing systems that cross team boundaries and remain maintainable as teams and products scale.
  • Fluency in Spanish and excellent English skills (verbal and written) are mandatory, as we use English daily for code, architecture documentation, and global alignment.

Important

  • Our hiring process starts with the application! If you truly want to be part of our team, please complete this step of the process. We analyze all candidates individually and provide feedback to all applicants.
  • All communication will be conducted via email, so please stay tuned for our messages and release the domain @quintoandar.com.br to ensure our emails are not sent to spam.

Hiring Process Stages

The stages of our hiring processes aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:

  • Application
  • Technical CV screening
  • People Interview with Recruiters
  • Tech Screening with Engineering Team (Code AI live case)
  • Technicals Interviews (architecture live cases and tech leadership)
  • Offer

Benefits

  • Medical plan
  • Wellhub
  • Extended parental leave
  • Reinstatement of Guarderia
  • Telework expenses (monthly amount)
  • Discounts on day-to-day services
  • Free day for compleaños, Father's Day and Mother's Day

Diversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndar

We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals!

You'll notice there are some diversity questions in the application form. For affirmative action roles, this information may be used to verify your alignment with the target audience for the opportunity. In such cases, it may be used for elimination purposes. For non-affirmative action roles, this data will be used anonymously, exclusively to monitor and improve our inclusion practices in the hiring process, and will have no impact on your application.

Privacy and Data Protection

The Grupo QuintoAndar operates in compliance with privacy and data protection laws, including, but not limited to, the Brazilian General Personal Data Protection Law (LGPD) (Law No. 13,709/2018), and ensures the security of your data. To learn more, please access our Privacy Notice for Candidates. For questions or to exercise your rights as a data subject, please contact us through our Service Channel.

Objetivo del Puesto

Liderar integralmente la gestión comercial de la tienda, asegurando el cumplimiento del 100% de los objetivos de ventas y rentabilidad, mediante la conducción efectiva del equipo, el seguimiento del presupuesto, la atención personalizada a clientes estratégicos (profesionales y grandes cuentas) y la correcta ejecución de los estándares comerciales de Reino Cerámicos.

Responsabilidades Principales Gestión Comercial y de Resultados

  • Planificar, ejecutar y controlar el presupuesto de ventas mensual y anual de la tienda.
  • Analizar indicadores comerciales (ventas, ticket promedio, conversión, mix de productos, margen).
  • Proponer e implementar acciones comerciales para incrementar ventas y rentabilidad.
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas comerciales, precios y condiciones definidas por la compañía.

Liderazgo y Gestión del Equipo de Ventas

  • Liderar, motivar y desarrollar al equipo de vendedores de tienda.
  • Asignar objetivos individuales y realizar seguimiento permanente de desempeño.
  • Detectar necesidades de capacitación y brindar entrenamiento continuo en producto, técnicas de venta y abordaje al cliente.
  • Realizar feedbacks, acompañamiento en piso de ventas y evaluaciones de desempeño.
  • Promover un clima de trabajo alineado a los valores de Reino Cerámicos profesionalismo, respeto y trabajo en equipo.

Atención a Clientes Estratégicos

  • Brindar atención personalizada y asesoramiento comercial a arquitectos, diseñadores, desarrolladores, constructoras y grandes empresas.
  • Gestionar negociaciones especiales, presupuestos complejos y cierres de operaciones estratégicas.
  • Fidelizar clientes clave y generar relaciones comerciales de largo plazo.
  • Coordinar con áreas internas (logística, compras, administración) para asegurar una experiencia de cliente diferencial.

Gestión Operativa de la Tienda

  • Garantizar el correcto funcionamiento del showroom y la excelencia en la experiencia del cliente.
  • Supervisar exhibición de productos, orden, imagen comercial y cumplimiento de estándares de marca.
  • Coordinar horarios, turnos y cobertura del equipo de ventas.
  • Asegurar el correcto uso de sistemas de gestión (CRM / ERP – SAP B1, deseable).

Competencias Clave

  • Liderazgo y conducción de equipos comerciales.
  • Fuerte orientación a resultados y a objetivos.
  • Capacidad analítica y de planificación comercial.
  • Habilidades de negociación y comunicación efectiva.
  • Enfoque en el cliente y vocación de servicio.
  • Proactividad, toma de decisiones y autonomía.

Requisitos Requisitos del Puesto

  • Experiencia mínima de 3 a 5 años en posiciones de liderazgo comercial, preferentemente en retail, construcción, cerámicos o afines.
  • Experiencia comprobable en gestión de equipos de ventas y seguimiento de presupuestos.
  • Manejo de herramientas de gestión comercial y sistemas ERP (deseable SAP Business One).
  • Disponibilidad full time.

📢Somos una empresa Argentina en etapa de crecimiento exponencial y desarrollo. Vendemos Pisos, Revestimientos y Sanitarios, con 11 años de antigüedad, y que ya tiene 25 locales en GBA y CABA, y continuamos con el plan de Expansión 🚀 . Para esta etapa queremos profesionalizar las áreas, de esta forma generar eficiencia y así continuar con los grandes desafíos! 🎓

Description

Imaginative, curious, and adaptable you sweat the small stuff, because you know that great design is in the details.

You are creative, inspired, and driven to produce innovative design. You are self-motivated — you have a true passion coupled with the exceptional ability to translate the vision of our clients into high quality and impactful imagery. Such talent and ingenuity make you the right fit for this unique Sr Graphic Designer role with Boldsky.

This position provides critical day-to-day studio support for creative teams in the production of print and digital/interactive materials.

Responsibilities:

Senior Level Graphic Designer: Able to leads projects, involved from beginning to end, considered a subject matter expert. Seniors will take on more responsibilities that may include overseeing the work of the Junior and Mid-Level co-worker.

The position reports to the Discipline Lead for day-to-day project assignments but also collaborates with the Agency’s creative and creative services team members for implementation and direction.

  • Responsible for building production-ready files for print and digital tactics, making edits to existing layouts with some opportunities for initial design.
  • Prepare electronic mechanical print files according to vendor specifications and adhering to the brand style guides set by the clients.
  • Work closely with Agency account, creative and creative services departments as part of an integrated team.
  • Adhere to agency vision for quality and uphold the creative process while maintaining client style guidelines.
  • Work with project managers on schedule and hours requirements.
  • Maintain server structure and organization and oversee creative department personnel for file creation efficiencies and server organization.
  • Perform other duties as assigned, such as on-boarding of file organization and studio process for new employees.
  • Control tactical workflow within the brand, is the “go-to” person for agency creatives and is the keeper of brand assets and logos.
  • Self-motivated: Able to deliver a quality product on time and on budget (allocated hours).
  • Champion the studio and strive to improve processes.
  • Traditional graphic art and studio support, such as, building mock-ups and presentation materials.

Requirements:

  • Bachelors degree in Graphic Design or related field, creative studio and/or agency experience
  • 5-10 years’ experience in Graphic Design
  • In-depth knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat) as well as comprehensive knowledge of Macintosh computers
  • Experience with Sketch and/or Figma a plus
  • Experience with PPT, animation, digital and/or video applications a plus
  • Candidate should:
    • have good design skills and understand page layout: composition, hierarchy, color space, imagery, and typography
    • have good organizational skills
    • be a team player
    • complete work efficiently within deadlines and budget
    • have acute attention to detail
    • be capable of handling multiple tasks and projects.
  • Management experience a plus
  • Experience with email and task management applications, including electronic routing a plus
  • Experience working in Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems a plus

Should also:

  • Understand and Implement Direction: Can understand creative direction based on objectives and execute creative work effectively. Understands the concept of talent-to-task and communicates well with others on workload issues & needs, progress of work and results
  • Apply Knowledge to Industry: Pick up on technical things quickly; good at learning new industry, company, product, and/or technical developments of the client, as well as the agency business; possess the functional and technical knowledge and skills to do the job at a high level of accomplishment
  • Demonstrate Ownership and Proactivity: Demonstrates ownership of assigned Brand work by continually coming up with new ideas and solutions proactively. Ability and willingness to show ownership of Brand work from a visual standpoint.
  • Willing to be Flexible: work outside of job description as needed, be flexible for the team, and ultimately the work.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $X to $Y. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

At Syneos Health Communications, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

BoldSky Creative Studio supports more than 12+ Syneos Health marketing and communication agencies as well as direct-to-customer engagements. We function as the agencies’ creative execution and production arm, implementing their creative vision. As part of Syneos Health, our agencies — consisting of leading brands and experts in advertising, branding, public relations, managed markets and medical communications — are engaged in every point of influence in health, providing real-world insight into markets and audiences in ways that no other partner could.

We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, flexible paid time off (PTO). Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable national/federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Software Engineer, AI Developer Productivity (MTS)

Buenos Aires | Hybrid

Job Description

The AI Solutions team in Technology & Product builds internal products and platforms that help Salesforce engineers adopt AI-assisted development safely, effectively, and measurably. Our work spans developer experiences, AI usage and outcome intelligence, governance, telemetry, and integrations with coding tools and engineering systems.

As a Member of Technical Staff, you will build and operate full-stack product and platform capabilities across desktop applications, backend services, data pipelines, dashboards, and developer-facing integrations. Working with experienced engineers and product partners, you will turn product needs into reliable software, own well-defined areas end to end, and help thousands of Salesforce engineers get more value from AI every day.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Design, implement, test, and ship well-scoped full-stack features across internal developer-productivity products, including desktop experiences, backend services, data and analytics pipelines, dashboards, and integrations with AI coding tools.
  • Build backend APIs, data models, ingestion flows, dashboards, and user experiences that connect AI tool usage to outcomes engineers and leaders can act on.
  • Contribute to technical designs and turn product requirements into clear, incremental implementation plans with support from senior engineers when needed.
  • Own features and services in production by improving observability, reliability, performance, security, and supportability as part of the software development lifecycle.
  • Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow to deliver secure, optimized, and maintainable code.
  • Build AI-enabled and agentic workflows that fit naturally into how developers work, with appropriate evaluation, safeguards, and human oversight.
  • Contribute to shared system context - designs, constraints, standards, and operational knowledge - that helps both people and AI agents work accurately and reliably.
  • Review human- and AI-generated code for correctness, quality, security, and performance; participate actively in design and code reviews; and share what you learn with the team.

You're Our Person If...

  • 3+ years of professional experience building production software, including full-stack applications, backend services, developer tools, or internal platforms.
  • Strong programming fundamentals and proficiency in at least one modern language, with the ability to work across frontend, backend, APIs, data stores, and service boundaries.
  • Experience delivering well-defined features through design, implementation, testing, rollout, and production ownership.
  • A practical understanding of data structures, API design, automated testing, source control, CI/CD, and secure software development practices.
  • Ability to debug technical issues, use logs and metrics to understand system behavior, and make thoughtful tradeoffs with guidance when appropriate.
  • Clear communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to ask good questions, give and receive feedback, and work effectively with engineers and product partners.
  • A demonstrated AI-first approach to engineering - using tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Cursor to move faster while validating outputs and maintaining quality.
  • The ability to write precise, structured prompts and contribute the context, examples, and constraints that make AI-assisted development reliable and production-ready.
  • A related technical degree is required.

Even Better If...

  • Experience building developer tools, AI coding tool integrations, internal platforms, telemetry systems, or enterprise desktop applications.
  • Familiarity with React, TypeScript, Go, service APIs, event pipelines, analytics systems, or cloud- and Kubernetes-based services.
  • Experience building self-service experiences, dashboards, plugin systems, command-line tools, or reusable integration patterns for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM applications, agentic workflows, prompt evaluation, or safety and quality controls for AI-enabled features.
  • Interest in AI developer productivity and helping engineering teams adopt AI tools in ways that are measurable, trustworthy, and scalable.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

🏢 Gerente de Recursos Humanos- Zona Barracas Sobre la posición

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Gerente de Recursos Humanos para sumarse al equipo de una importante empresa líder ubicada en la zona de Barracas, CABA.

El objetivo principal del rol será liderar la administración de personal, coordinar la gestión de relaciones laborales y participar activamente en el diseño, armado y ejecución de las políticas estratégicas del área.

📋 Principales Responsabilidades

  • Relaciones Laborales Liderar la gestión del clima laboral, negociación y vínculo con representaciones sindicales, resolución de conflictos .
  • Administración de Personal Supervisar la liquidación de sueldos, novedades, control de ausentismo, sanciones disciplinarias y cumplimiento del marco legal laboral vigente.
  • Políticas y Procesos Diseñar, implementar y hacer cumplir las políticas de RRHH (evaluación de desempeño, capacitaciones, desarrollo, onboarding, comunicación interna).
  • Indicadores del Área Confeccionar y dar seguimiento a los KPI del sector (rotación, ausentismo, horas extras, costos laborales) presentándolos a la Gerencia/Dirección.
  • Asesoramiento Interno Acompañar a los líderes de las distintas áreas de la planta en la gestión cotidiana de sus equipos.

🎯 Requisitos del Perfil

  • Experiencia Mínima de 4 a 5 años en posiciones similares de Jefatura o Coordinación de RRHH, proveniente de empresas del rubro industrial, manufactura o logística (excluyente).
  • Formación Graduado/a universitario/a de carreras como Lic. en Recursos Humanos, Relaciones del Trabajo, Administración o afines.
  • Conocimientos Profundo manejo de legislación laboral argentina, convenios colectivos de trabajo industriales y gestión de relaciones sindicales.
  • Competencias clave Fuerte liderazgo, capacidad de negociación, visión estratégica, orientación a resultados y excelente manejo de relaciones interpersonales.

🎁 ¿Qué ofrece la empresa?

  • Pertenecer a una compañía líder en constante crecimiento.
  • Condiciones de contratación directa y desarrollo profesional.
  • Paquete de beneficios y remuneración competitiva acorde al mercado.
  • Lugar de trabajo Barracas, CABA (Presencial).

About The Role

As a Software Engineer (C++ / Python) – Code Review, you will ensure high-quality, reliable, and efficient code across large-scale systems, including AI-generated code. You will be a valued member of the engineering team with Google and work collaboratively with developers, reviewers, and cross-functional stakeholders to assess and improve code quality, standards, and performance

In This Role, You Will

  • Proficiency in C++ (strongly preferred)
  • Good to have experience in one of the following: Java / Python / GoLang / TypeScript
  • Review and evaluate code changes (CLs), including AI-generated code, to ensure correctness, performance, readability, and alignment with best practices
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve code quality and maintainability
  • Analyze AI-generated code changes to identify risks, inconsistencies, or inefficiencies
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to uphold coding standards and testing practices
  • Support continuous improvement of code review processes and tooling

Work model

This is a hybrid position requiring 2 days a week in a Cognizant office.

Shift

  • Monday to Friday
  • 9:00 to 18:00 or 10:00 to 19:00 (local time)

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

  • Proficiency in C++ and Python (strongly preferred)
  • Strong code review experience with the ability to assess code for quality, scalability, and adherence to standards
  • Experience reviewing AI-generated code and identifying potential issues
  • Solid understanding of unit testing, integration testing, and fuzz testing concepts
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • English level: Upper Intermediate or above
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to provide concise, constructive feedback

These Will Help You Stand Out

  • Experience with development tools such as Critique, Cider, Piper, or Buganizer
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, especially in the context of code generation and evaluation
  • Experience working in large-scale or distributed systems environments
  • Ability to quickly learn new tools and adapt to evolving engineering processes

descriptionHtml:
About ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

What You'll Do

  • Hire A - players: you will work with the co-founders and the executive team to calibrate roles and seniorities, hire the best talent in the world, and create hiring playbooks
  • Act like a founder: you will go beyond scope of work and priorities, it is in the DNA of ARQ to do whatever it takes to win. You love freedom, ownership, and are not afraid to get your hands dirty
  • Be data-driven: you will track pipelines, conversion rates, and use that data to continuously improve how we hire
  • Sell the vision: you will be one of the first impressions of ARQ, telling our story in a way that excites and converts top talent
  • Move with urgency: you understand that great candidates don’t wait, and you act fast without sacrificing quality
  • Design the system: you won’t just fill roles you’ll help us build scalable processes, tools, and rituals that turn our talent team into a world-class machine
  • Continuously improve: you are always iterating on outreach, interviews, and processes to get better every week

What You'll Need

  • Proven track record or hiring A players in a fast paced environment
  • Precise sourcing skills (we don't only rely on inbound applicants)
  • Resourcefulness, ability to leverage LinkedIn as well as the network of the current team to source potential candidates
  • Strong interpersonal skills, you will be able to connect and build lasting relationships with both stakeholders and candidates.
  • High EQ, being able to understand what drives candidates and assess cultural fit. You value candidates highly and provide them with a world-class experience throughout the process
  • Excellent organisation skills, being able to manage candidates funnel with maximum attention to detail and due diligence. We believe in providing a white glove experience for our candidates and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work well as part of a team, a relentless drive and a track record as proven closer

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits
  • Stock options, so you own part of what you build
  • Discretionary performance bonus
  • The latest tools and technology
  • A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills
  • The opportunity to help build the best fintech app in Latin America
  • Office Policy: 3-4 days a week in-office

Chevron is accepting online applications for the position Talent Acquisition Specialist through October 30 at 11:59 p.m.

Chevron Global Business Services, located in Buenos Aires (Puerto Madero), Argentina, is accepting online applications for the position of Talent Acquisition Specialist. Successful candidates will join the Human Resources team which is part of a successful multifunction service center with a workforce of more than 1000 employees delivering business services and solutions across the globe.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

  • Manage the full lifecycle recruitment process for diverse roles across U.S., U.K., and LATAM markets, ensuring a high-quality candidate experience.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to define role requirements and provide market insights. Responsible for extending official offers, managing salary negotiations, and ensuring a smooth transition to the onboarding phase.
  • Collaborate with HR and the business to understand their business strategy and talent requirements.
  • Develop and implement short and long-term hiring strategies to support business plans.
  • Leverage Workday and advanced recruiting and sourcing techniques and platforms to identify and secure top talent.
  • Identify trends and opportunity areas to increase efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • Adhere to global recruitment protocols and KPIs, ensuring all data is accurately tracked in the ATS

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor´s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration or related careers.
  • At least 4 years of experience managing the full cycle recruitment process preferably within a corporate multinational environment or a high-volume agency.
  • Must be highly proficient in English.
  • Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural and diverse environment.
  • Teamwork and customer service focus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with HR Information Systems, preferably Workday and Service Now.
  • US, regional or global experience and/or working in a Shared Service center.
  • Open to work on a flexible time and Holidays, as needed.

Relocation Options:

Relocation will not be considered.

International Considerations

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

Assist 365 es una empresa de servicios que brinda asistencia a personas que viajan a nivel internacional.

La misión de ASSIST 365 es proteger y acompañar a millones de viajeros, cuidando de su bienestar en los momentos más importantes de sus vidas. Son viajeros cuidando viajeros. Nos movemos con agilidad y nuestro canal natural son las redes sociales, manejando una voz nativa digital que le habla de forma directa y con entendimiento a cualquier persona que decide salir a explorar el mundo.

La compañía opera en distintos mercados de Latinoamérica, con especial foco en Argentina, México, Colombia, Chile y Uruguay.

SUMATE Y VIVI NUESTRO PROPOSITO!


Sobre la posición

Con reporte al Social & Brand Director, el Social Media Manager tiene mirada estratégica, fuerte capacidad de ejecución y profundo entendimiento del ecosistema de redes sociales para integrarse al equipo de Brand & Social Media Marketing y llevar la marca al siguiente nivel.

Este rol será clave y responsable de liderar el desarrollo estratégico, la planificación, ideación y gestión del contenido orgánico de redes sociales, transformando los lineamientos estratégicos y campañas de marketing en grillas de contenido concretas, creativas y orientadas a resultados.

Trabajará en equipo con un Community Manager y un diseñador, coordinando la producción de contenidos, detectando oportunidades de formatos y tendencias y asegurando el cumplimiento de voz y tono de la marca en las interacciones con la comunidad. Este rol tiene como objetivo consolidar las redes sociales de la marca como canal estratégico de crecimiento, posicionamiento y comunidad


Requisitos

● Formación en Comunicación, Marketing, Diseño, Publicidad y/o afines

● +4 años de experiencia gestionando redes sociales para marcas o agencias incluyendo:

❖ Detección de oportunidades e ideas creativas, planificación y gestión de grillas y contenido para Instagram, TikTok, Youtube y LinkedIn.

❖ Fuerte conocimiento de tendencias, formatos y dinámicas de contenido en redes sociales.

❖ Experiencia analizando métricas de redes sociales: construyendo dashboards de data (LookerStudio), utilizando herramientas como GA4 y optimizando contenido en base a resultados.

● Conocimientos de Inteligencia Artificial aplicada. Claude

● Pasión por el mundo digital, los viajes y la cultura de internet.


¿Qué ofrecen?

● Salario competitivo según experiencia y mercado.

● Trabajo híbrido, 1 dia presencial

● Participación en un entorno digital, dinámico y orientado a resultados.

About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Role Overview

The Strategic WFM Analyst lives in the Core Workforce Management (WFM) Planning & Operations Strategy team and is responsible for owning centralized forecast, capacity planning, workforce cost optimization, and strategic headcount trade-offs across all lines of business (LOBs). Moving beyond traditional scheduling and intraday monitoring, this role acts as a high-judgment governance function, translating complex demand forecasts into defensible FTE, BPO, and overtime spend strategies, modelling capacity risks, and aligning executive stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Operations. You are exceptionally strong in WFM maths and financial analytics, exhibit deep strategic curiosity, navigate messy raw data effortlessly, and communicate recommendations with executive-level clarity.

What You’ll Do

  • Translating multi-LOB demand forecasts into monthly and quarterly capacity, headcount, and budget requirements.
  • Modelling workforce and financial trade-offs across internal FTEs, BPO partners, overtime spend, bonus hours, productivity shifts, and shrinkage.
  • Analyzing demand-funnel changes (e.g., product feature roll outs, AI bot deflection shifts) and quantifying their exact capacity and dollar blast radius.
  • Partnering directly with Finance, Product, and Operations to validate baseline assumptions, enforce input SLAs, and align on staffing commitments.
  • Drafting concise, decision-ready executive memos and Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) for Directors and leadership.
  • Conducting deep-dive root-cause analyses whenever operational actuals deviate from capacity plans and establishing corrective action paths.
  • Standardizing capacity planning frameworks, modeling templates, and operating standards across LOBs.
  • Maintaining deep forecasting competency to audit models, challenge underlying assumptions, and provide seamless coverage across the broader central WFM engine.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strategic WFM Maths: Exceptionally strong quantitative background with deep expertise in WFM fundamentals (capacity modelling, Erlang, shrinkage, AHT, SLA/ASA trade-offs) and advanced proficiency in Google Sheets, SQL, or Python.
  • Business & Financial Judgement: Demonstrated ability to connect operational queue dynamics directly to dollar exposure, hiring velocity, BPO costs, and SLA risk.
  • Executive Communication: Superior strategic writing skills with a natural instinct to distil complex, multi-variable workforce analytics into scannable, 1-2 page decision memos.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to establish governance frameworks, challenge bad assumptions with back tested data, and align Finance, Product, and Operations leadership without formal authority.
  • Blank-Page Ownership: High comfort operating in ambiguous environments with incomplete data, verifiably isolating what materially matters without requiring step-by-step direction.
  • WFM Analyst Profile: Strong core WFM domain expertise with a strategic/Ops spike, not a generalist and not a passive traditional scheduler.

Hiring Process

  • Application
  • Diagnostic Case Study
  • Case Study Interview - Technical & Capacity Interview
  • Executive Judgement & Strategic Interview
  • Culture Interview (People Ops)
  • Offer

Quick Note On Scammers

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

Compensation Range: $50K - $110K

About the Role


We are looking for a Senior AI Security Engineer to join a high-growth technology team building AI-native products. This is not an offensive security role — we are looking for a defensive security engineer with a strong AppSec background (70%) and cloud security experience (30%), who is excited about applying their skills to the fast-evolving world of AI systems, LLMs, and autonomous agents.


You will be embedded in an engineering organization where AI is at the core of the product, working closely with engineering, product, and infrastructure teams to ensure that every AI integration, agent workflow, and LLM-powered feature is designed and deployed securely.


Key Responsibilities


Review AI architectures and integrations end to end — LLMs, AI agents, tool chains, APIs, and external connectors — identifying security risks before they reach production

Lead threat modeling sessions and security architecture reviews across the stack

Design, implement, and automate security checks and controls for AI systems, including input/output validation, guardrails, and runtime monitoring

Research and stay current on AI-specific attack vectors — prompt injection, model abuse, data exfiltration, jailbreaking — and translate findings into actionable mitigations

Enforce OAuth, IAM policies, and least privilege principles across cloud and AI integrations

Build and maintain security automation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows

Collaborate with developers on secure coding practices and security requirements for AI features

Contribute to internal security documentation, policies, and awareness


Requirements


5+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity — excluyente

Strong AppSec background: secure code review, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, secrets management

Experience conducting threat modeling or security architecture reviews — excluyente

Solid understanding of OAuth, IAM, and least privilege design patterns — excluyente

Ability to read code and write scripts, ideally in Python — excluyente

Cloud Security experience (GCP preferred)

Advanced English — written and spoken

Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina — Mandatory


Nice to Have


Formal experience in AI Security (a plus, not required — we will invest in your growth)

Familiarity with OWASP LLM Top 10

Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions

Fintech background — PCI DSS, SOC 2

Knowledge of Product Security practices


What We Are NOT Looking For


Offensive security profiles (no pentesting or red team roles)

Specialists with no generalist security foundation

Candidates outside Buenos Aires, Argentina

descriptionHtml:
Innovid is the leading independent omnichannel ad tech platform, empowering marketers to create, deliver, measure, and optimize ad-supported experiences that people love. In 2025, Innovid and Flashtalking merged to create a transparent, scalable alternative to big-tech, walled-gardens, and point solutions across CTV, digital, linear, and social channels. As part of Mediaocean, Innovid is tied into the industry’s core ad infrastructure for omnichannel planning, buying, and billing. We are proud to lead the industry with our innovation, intelligence, and independence as the company best-suited to power the future of advertising.


We're looking for a top-notch, passionate senior developer to be part of our world-class Social Media team. You will play a pivotal role in the design, development, and maintenance of our core systems. You will be responsible for building robust, scalable, and high-performance applications that power our critical business operations. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. We have a developer centric culture, practice continuous deployment and no code ownership, and deal daily with the most advanced technologies and methodologies in software development, high scalability, and big data.


The Impact You'll Make:

  • Carry out full stack, end to end development
  • Participate in designing and developing Innovid’s products in a multiple technologies, no code ownership environment
  • Design and develop modules for a high-end product that serves billions of transactions a day
  • Deploy your code to production
  • Be responsible for the well-being of your application in production
  • Work with product managers to define, prioritize and finalize features


What You'll Bring to Us:

  • +3 years of development experience in highly dynamic environments.
  • Experience in Python and/or React will be highly valued.
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, writing and listening)
  • A B.Sc. in computer science or a related discipline - Finished or at final years
  • Experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs.
  • li>Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues.
  • Strong knowledge of database design, optimization, and management (SQL and NoSQL).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor junior engineers (an advantage)


Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their services.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Contributions to open-source projects


What We'll Offer You:

  • Unlimited Vacations
  • Monthly Inflation updates
  • Lunch Credit
  • OSDE 410 as medical insurance
  • English lessons
  • Gym coverage
  • Internet coverage
  • 1 extra paid month for primary & secondary birthing caregivers
  • Learning & Development - Tools and Training
  • Hybrid & flexible working model - nice offices in Parque Chas with endless snacks & beverages
  • Pet friendly office
  • High visibility roles with a tremendous amount of growth potential
  • Global team and cross-company collaboration unlike anywhere else!


There is no such thing as the perfect resume, or someone that checks every box. At Innovid, we are generous with our time and knowledge, and always ready to teach. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day and add to Innovid.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Innovid is an equal opportunity employer, committed to our diversity and inclusiveness. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability or age. We strongly encourage women, people of color, members of the LGBTQIA community, people with disabilities and veterans to apply. We are actively working to be an anti-racist organization. We're committing to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace for all of our employees. You can read more about our commitment to DEI here.

Title: Talent Acquisition Specialist

Date: 10/6/26

Description:

Company Description

Innovid is the leading independent omnichannel ad tech platform, empowering marketers to create, deliver, measure, and optimize ad-supported experiences that people love. In 2025, Innovid and Flashtalking merged to create a transparent, scalable alternative to big-tech, walled-gardens, and point solutions across CTV, digital, linear, and social channels. As part of Mediaocean, Innovid is tied into the industry’s core ad infrastructure for omnichannel planning, buying, and billing. We are proud to lead the industry with our innovation, intelligence, and independence as the company best-suited to power the future of advertising.

Job Description

We are looking for a highly motivated Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our Buenos Aires team! The ideal candidate will take charge of all facets of the recruiting process and will have a genuine passion for building exceptional teams. If you have a track record of success in recruiting within the Technology Industry in Argentina and thriving in fast-paced, international companies, we want to hear from you!The Impact You'll Make:

  • Conduct end-to-end hiring processes from leading kick-offs to extending the offer to the best-in-market candidate for the role.
  • Ensure we hire with high standards of quality, being mindful of our business, culture, technical needs, and our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
  • Handle multiple and diverse roles proactively developing ad-hoc solutions to reach the hiring goals
  • Drive a world-class candidate experience, making sure each touchpoint—from first outreach to final decision—is transparent, engaging, and human.
  • Build strong relationships with Hiring Managers to assess and understand their specific hiring needs and goals and provide them with regular progress updates
  • Collaborate with relevant HRBPs to ensure hiring aligns with business and team needs
  • Participate in special projects and recruiting initiatives related to AI, Employer Branding, DEI, Metrics, Sources, Documentation, etc.
  • Proactively propose improvements in hiring practices
  • Maintain and update recruitment records on the ATS to keep clear information and report on relevant Talent metrics
  • Utilize data to share hiring insights and market trends with Hiring Managers and drive process improvement
  • Leverage modern talent technologies, AI sourcing tools, and automation to streamline the hiring workflow, reduce friction, and elevate the candidate experience.

What You'll Bring To Us:

  • 4+ years in Full-Cycle tech recruiting with a proven track record sourcing and hiring a diversity of roles within fast-paced international tech companies.
  • High English proficiency (written and spoken) to comfortably collaborate with global stakeholders and candidates daily.
  • Comfortable navigating ATS environments (SmartRecruiters experience is a massive bonus) and leveraging metrics to tell a story.
  • High Ownership & Agility: You take initiative, thrive in ambiguity, and enjoy the challenges of a super dynamic environment.
  • Experience representing the company brand at job fairs, university events, and tech community meetups—actively networking to build long-term talent pipelines. - would be a plus
  • Track record of collaborating beyond day-to-day sourcing on strategic projects within People - would be a plus

What We'll Offer You:

  • Unlimited Vacations
  • Monthly Inflation updates
  • Lunch Credit
  • OSDE 410 as medical assurance
  • English lessons
  • Gym coverage
  • Internet coverage
  • 1 extra paid month for primary & secondary birthing caregivers
  • Learning & Development - Tools and Training
  • Hybrid & flexible working model - nice offices in CABA with endless snacks & beverages
  • High visibility roles with a tremendous amount of growth potential
  • Global team and cross-company collaboration unlike anywhere else!

Additional Information

There is no such thing as the perfect resume, or someone that checks every box. At Innovid, we are generous with our time and knowledge, and always ready to teach. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day and add to Innovid.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Innovid is an equal opportunity employer, committed to our diversity and inclusiveness. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability or age. We strongly encourage women, people of color, members of the LGBTQIA community, people with disabilities and veterans to apply. We are actively working to be an anti-racist organization. We're committing to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace for all of our employees. You can read more about our commitment to DEI here.

If you are located within the EEA and subject to GDPR or are a California resident subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act, click here to understand how Innovid processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.

 Apply now

descriptionHtml:
Meta seeks a senior public policy professional to coordinate economic policy across Latin America. In this regional role, you will help shape Meta's positions on key digital economy issues and bridge local country teams with the global economic policy organization.Given Latin America's dynamic policy landscape, you will focus on a range of economic policy matters, with a focus on payments/competition.Operating with broad independence on emerging issues, you will drive cross-team and cross-country alignment through expertise and collaboration.

Public Policy Manager, Economic Policy — Latin America Responsibilities:

  • Develop unified regional policy positions on economic policy matters, with a focus on payments/competition across Latin America
  • Act as the primary link between global economic policy teams and regional context, tracking priorities, timelines, and consultations
  • Align local policy leads on priorities and strategy
  • In close cross-functional coordination with central and regional teams, represent Meta with governments, regulators and multilateral institutions
  • Analyze regulatory trends and economic impacts to ground policy positions
  • Partner across internal functions to ensure positions match business priorities
  • Advise regional leadership on economic policy trends

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Extensive senior-level experience in public policy, government affairs or regulatory affairs
  • Demonstrated depth in payments and financial regulation policy, including direct experience on payments or digital financial services files with regulators or policymakers
  • Expertise in two or more of the following areas — fraud prevention, competition, tax, digital trade, telecommunications and infrastructure — with the ability to build working depth across the remaining areas
  • Experience managing policy issues and direct engagement across multiple Latin American markets
  • Proven track record leading complex policy issues from analysis through external engagement
  • Ability to align cross-functional regional teams and advise executives on policy risk
  • Full professional fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, required for engaging directly with regulators, policymakers, and stakeholders across Portuguese- and Spanish-speaking Latin American markets
  • Ability to travel regularly across the region

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Recognized regional economic policy expertise through active institutional participation
  • Experience providing technical input to legislative or regulatory processes (e.g., consultations, working groups)
  • Experience managing a regional/multi-country economic policy portfolio across markets
  • Background in payments or financial regulation in the public sector or regulated institutions
  • Advanced degree in economics, law, public policy, international relations, or a related field

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

Tenemos activas 3 posiciones: Una para Zona Norte, otra para Zona Oeste y otra para Capital Federal,

  • Prospectar y contactar comercios gastronómicos a través de canales digitales (redes sociales y WhatsApp) y llamadas salientes.
  • Realizar venta de campo / presencial en zonas comerciales para cerrar la incorporación de comercios cuando la gestión lo requiera.
  • Presentar la propuesta de valor de la plataforma y acompañar al comercio en el proceso de alta y primer uso.

  • Experiencia previa en ventas salientes, captación de clientes, telemarketing / call center comercial o venta en vía pública (excluyente).

  • Manejo ágil de redes sociales (Instagram, WhatsApp) como canal de venta.
  • Actitud resolutiva, independencia para buscar soluciones y marcada orientación a objetivos.
  • Disponibilidad para realizar trabajo mixto (gestión remota desde oficina/casa y gestión en calle según demanda comercial).

  • Jornada de lunes a viernes de 9 a 18hs.

  • Contrato por tiempo indeterminado.
  • Contrato a través de Convenio de Comercio.
  • Herramientas de trabajo: computadora y celular laboral

La posición tendrá participación en proyectos end-to-end, desde el análisis y relevamiento de requerimientos hasta el desarrollo, testing, documentación y puesta en producción.

  • Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones utilizando Microsoft Power Platform.

  • Documentar soluciones, desarrollos y procesos implementados.
  • Participar en el ciclo completo de desarrollo, desde el relevamiento hasta el despliegue productivo.
  • Trabajar sobre soluciones utilizadas por grandes volúmenes de usuarios.

  • Experiencia comprobable en desarrollo con Power Apps.
  • Experiencia con Power Automate.

  • Resto del país: modalidad 100% remota.

  • Plan de carrera y desarrollo profesional.
  • Día de cumpleaños libre.

  • Descuentos y convenios con diferentes empresas.

descriptionHtml:
Responsable de Finanzas - Empresa de turismo y transporte de pasajeros


Nuestro cliente, una empresa argentina con más de 50 años de trayectoria en la industria del turismo. Con presencia en Buenos Aires, Ushuaia y El Calafate, combina servicios turísticos, transporte de pasajeros y rentadora de vehículos, trabajando con agencias de turismo nacionales e internacionales.

En un contexto de profesionalización y fortalecimiento de su gestión financiera, busca incorporar un/a Responsable de Finanzas que pueda tomar ownership sobre la planificación y el seguimiento financiero del negocio.


El principal desafío de la posición será transformar la información disponible en proyecciones y decisiones concretas, anticipando necesidades financieras y acompañando a la Dirección y al equipo administrativo-contable en una gestión cada vez más planificada. Se trata de una posición de nueva creación, con fuerte exposición al negocio y contacto directo con la Gerencia General.


Sus principales responsabilidades serán:

  • Desarrollar, gestionar y dar seguimiento al cash flow y las proyecciones financieras, anticipando necesidades y posibles desvíos.
  • Planificar el flujo de fondos considerando la estacionalidad del negocio, ingresos proyectados y compromisos financieros.
  • Dar seguimiento a deudas, créditos, vencimientos y obligaciones, contribuyendo a una administración eficiente de los recursos.
  • Participar en la elaboración y seguimiento del presupuesto anual, analizando desvíos y proponiendo acciones.
  • Analizar costos, gastos de estructura y rentabilidad.
  • Definir y monitorear presupuestos de gastos, detectando oportunidades de optimización y eficiencia.
  • Acompañar el análisis económico-financiero para la formación de precios y tarifas futuras.
  • Integrar información proveniente de distintas áreas y sistemas para generar reportes, alertas y recomendaciones para la toma de decisiones.

As our hiring team is international, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English to ensure it can be reviewed by all stakeholders.

Work where work matters.

We are a global technology group built for what's next, offering high calibre professionals the platform for high stakes work, the kind of work that defines an entire career. When you join us, you're not just taking on projects, you're solving problems that don't even have answers yet.

You will join an exclusive roster of talent that global leaders, including Google, Snap, Diageo, PayPal, and Jaguar Land Rover call when deadlines seem impossible, when others have already tried and failed, and when the solution absolutely has to work.  

Forget routine consultancy. You will operate where technology, design, and human behaviour meet to deliver tangible outcomes, fast. This is work that leaves a mark, work you'll be proud to tell your friends about.

We are looking for a Senior Experience Designer to join our delivery center in Buenos Aires. 

We look for people who embody:

Innovation to solve the hardest problems.

‍Accountability for every result.

‍Integrity always.

About The Role



Role Overview


We're seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Experience Designer to join our growing creative team. The successful candidate will be involved in all experience design activities across the project lifecycle, driving the underlying UX structures and strategies that help teams bring the work to life.

You'll be shaping a range of customer surfaces — from marketing platforms and products to next-generation, multimodal, and agentic experiences — translating complex business challenges into simple, human-first solutions. From strategy and research through to concept to delivery, you'll combine design thinking, craft, collaboration, and commercial impact to create work that is visionary, award-winning, and outcome-driven.

Above all, you're an awesome human who loves being surrounded by — and collaborating with — smart, talented folks in a fun, fast-paced environment.

Role Responsibilities

  • Plan, design and conduct user research utilising a variety of methodologies, including both quantitative and qualitative research. You will use this knowledge to inform all parts of your process including developing personas and user journeys.
  • Translate user needs and business goals into static designs and interactive mockups to provide a clear, working reference for other designers, engineers and stakeholders.
  • Apply creative problem-solving and human-centered design thinking to all tasks.
  • Create compelling presentations and communicate the reasoning behind your work to all audiences.
  • Collaborate across disciplines to refine designs, address technical trade-offs, and ensure a high-quality, polished launch..
  • Intimate knowledge of working with Figma and other collaboration tools to build a single source of truth, allowing for real-time feedback and direct access to design specs.

What Success Looks Like


  • 5+ years of experience in UX/experience design (agency or in-house).
  • Excellent UX thinking and design system skills, complemented by an understanding of how to translate these into beautiful, effective designs.
  • Understanding of AI concepts, including conversational surfaces, multimodal interfaces, agentic systems, and responsible AI.
  • Proven ability to translate business challenges, user insights, and UX best practices into human-first, commercially valuable designs.
  • Experience participating in pitches and inspiring clients with visionary, yet credible, design solutions is desirable.

Benefits

We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. Here's how we invest in you:

  • Work from Home Allowance
  • Private Medical Insurance for family group
  • Birthday leave
  • 10 paid learning days per year
  • Bonusly 100 points per month to recognise colleagues

Diversity and Inclusion

At Beyond we champion diversity and inclusion. We believe that a career in IT should be open to everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability or neurotype. We value the unique talents and perspectives that each individual brings to our team, and we strive to create a fair and accessible hiring process for all.

descriptionHtml:
Ejecutivo de Desarrollo de Negocios B2B

Importante empresa multinacional del sector tecnológico y de soluciones para la gestión de la información busca incorporar un talento clave para su equipo comercial en Buenos Aires, Argentina. Estamos en la búsqueda de un perfil apasionado por la venta consultiva de servicios digitales y soluciones de software, con un marcado enfoque en el crecimiento y la apertura de nuevos negocios.

En esta posición, tu principal objetivo será expandir nuestra presencia en el mercado, desarrollando proyectos a la medida y realizando estrategias de venta cruzada en una sólida cartera de clientes corporativos.


Principales responsabilidades:

  • Diseñar y ejecutar estrategias comerciales para identificar y captar nuevas oportunidades de negocio en grandes cuentas corporativas (B2B), con especial foco en industrias complejas como banca, seguros, minería y salud.
  • Construir y mantener un relacionamiento estratégico con tomadores de decisión (C-Level), alineando nuestras soluciones tecnológicas con sus objetivos de optimización de procesos.
  • Administrar de principio a fin el ciclo de venta consultiva, abarcando la prospección, calificación de oportunidades, manejo de pronósticos (forecast), y la participación en licitaciones.
  • Trabajar en sinergia con las áreas internas de finanzas, preventa y operaciones para estructurar propuestas comerciales sólidas, rentables y de alto impacto.
  • Realizar presentaciones ejecutivas demostrando el valor agregado de los servicios para la atracción constante de nuevos proyectos.

Perfil profesional requerido:

  • Mínimo de 5 años de experiencia comprobable en ventas consultivas B2B, comercializando proyectos de tecnología, servicios digitales o software.
  • Formación universitaria completada (Titulado/a).
  • Experiencia previa deseable en empresas integradoras de tecnología, telecomunicaciones o corporaciones transnacionales, con capacidad para gestionar ciclos de venta corporativos complejos.
  • Dominio en el uso de plataformas CRM para la administración diaria del pipeline y análisis de métricas de ventas.
  • Fuerte orientación a resultados, con el empuje necesario para maximizar los ingresos a través de un esquema de compensación que incluye un atractivo componente variable.
  • Habilidades superiores de negociación, comunicación asertiva, presencia ejecutiva y alta tolerancia a la frustración.
  • Nivel de inglés intermedio (deseable) para interactuar en un entorno global y facilitar planes de desarrollo profesional a futuro.
