descriptionHtml:
Betty is an innovative entertainment company pioneering at the intersection of real-money online casinos and casual mobile gaming.

Our mission is to redefine the online casino experience by offering a uniquely transparent environment where players can relax, unwind, and enjoy themselves safely.


We are committed to accessibility, fairness, and inclusivity, fostering a community of like-minded individuals who value ethical gaming practices and prioritize our players´ safety and enjoyment above everything else.


Our Values:

  • We are honest - we value honesty in all aspects.
  • Bring the Olives - we offer premium customer experience.
  • Think Big - we believe in always striving for more.


About the role:


  • Own the full-cycle recruitment process, from intake call to offer and onboarding handoff.
  • Partner with hiring managers and leadership across regions (LATAM, Canada, Bulgaria, UK) to define profiles, scope and hiring strategy.
  • Design and run sourcing strategies: Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals and market mapping for hard-to-fill roles.
  • Run structured screenings that assess skills, English level and cultural fit.
  • Deliver an excellent candidate experience, including clear and constructive feedback at every stage.
  • Track and report recruiting metrics: time-to-fill, funnel conversion, rejection reasons and market insights.
  • Maintain our ATS and trackers, document processes, and support or guide junior recruiters as the team grows.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience, including senior, specialized and hard-to-fill roles.
  • Advanced English (C1+), written and spoken, to work with international teams.
  • Strong sourcing skills and hands-on experience with an ATS.
  • Consultative approach with stakeholders: able to challenge requirements and align expectations with market reality.
  • Data-driven mindset, comfortable presenting metrics and insights to leadership.
  • Autonomy, ownership and comfort with ambiguity in a founding-team environment.
  • Availability to work on-site in a hybrid scheme at our offices in Vicente López.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in iGaming or other regulated industries.
  • Multi-market recruitment experience across LATAM.
  • Experience with employer branding and referral programs.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary paid in US dollars.
  • 21 days PTO: paid time off to rest and recharge.
  • Wellness and health: wellness and health insurance allowance.

descriptionHtml:
En Sinteplast buscamos un Jefe de Créditos y Cobranzas para liderar la estrategia integral de administración del crédito y gestión de cobranzas de nuestra cartera de clientes, con base en nuestras oficinas administrativas de Planta Ezeiza (C. Spegazzini).

Su principal desafío será liderar la gestión integral de Créditos y Cobranzas, asegurando una adecuada administración del riesgo crediticio, la optimización de los plazos de cobro y la generación de flujo de fondos, contribuyendo al crecimiento sustentable del negocio.

Buscamos profesionales con visión de negocio y fuerte orientación a resultados, capaces de construir relaciones cercanas con clientes y equipos comerciales. Tendrá un rol clave en la gestión de cuentas corrientes, la mitigación de riesgos crediticios, la reducción de días de cobranza, la liberación estratégica de pedidos y el soporte permanente a la fuerza de ventas para acompañar las oportunidades comerciales de nuestros segmentos de Pinturerías, Corralones, Distribuidores y Empresas.

Entre sus principales responsabilidades se encuentran

  • Reportar a la Gerencia de Finanzas.
  • Asegurar el análisis y control de las cobranzas ingresadas y las cuentas corrientes de los clientes de la compañía.
  • Elaborar informes de gestión.
  • Gestionar las cuentas corrientes, el análisis de riesgo crediticio y la liberación de pedidos.
  • Minimizar contingencias crediticias y optimizar el ingreso de cobranzas por las ventas efectuadas.
  • Gestionar, coordinar y realizar visitas a clientes.
  • Supervisar, controlar y dar soporte al personal a cargo.
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de DSO definidos por la compañía.


Requisitos


  • Disponibilidad para realizar viajes para visita a clientes.
  • Orientamos la búsqueda a profesionales graduados en las carreras Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Contador Público o carreras afines y que cuenten con sólida experiencia en empresas industriales o productivas con clientes en puntos de venta.
  • Buscamos personas con marcado perfil de liderazgo, buena predisposición, capacidad resolutiva y habilidades de negociación y comunicación. Orientación a resultados.
  • Manejo avanzado de Excel y Power BI.
  • Manejo de MS Project y SAP.
  • Manejo de Ingles (nivel intermedio) – Deseable Portugués.
  • Al menos 5 años de experiencia en posiciones de Créditos y Cobranzas liderando equipos.

Beneficios

Se ofrecen muy buenas condiciones de contratación en relación de dependencia y beneficios propios de una empresa de primera línea como es el Grupo Sinteplast, en un excelente clima laboral.

Somos una Compañía argentina líder en el mercado de nuestro país con 68 años de trayectoria. Fabricamos y comercializamos pinturas decorativas, indistriales, aerosoles, para repintado automotor y también incursionamos en los productos cementicios.

Contamos con Plantas en Carlos Spegazzini (Pcia. de Buenos Aires), San Luis y Córdoba y con más de 7000 artículos que se distribuyen a lo largo de todo el país.

En la región tenemos Plantas productivas en Bolivia, Paraguay, Uruguay y Brasil. Somos, en total, más de 1500 personas las que trabajamos a diario.

La búsqueda constante de crecimiento, y la innovación son nuestras cartas de presentación

  • Un excelente clima de trabajo, con todo lo necesario para que vivas una gran experiencia. :)

descriptionHtml:
SOBRE NOSOTROS

SC Johnson lleva 140 años liderando con propósito, desarrollando productos de alta calidad y marcas icónicas presentes en hogares, escuelas y empresas en prácticamente todos los países del mundo, entre ellas OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Ziploc®, Baygon®, Mr Músculo®, Pato®, Lysoform® y muchas más. Las 13.000 personas que forman parte de nuestra compañía familiar global, actualmente en su quinta generación, están comprometidas con hacer del mundo un lugar mejor, hoy y para las futuras generaciones.

SOBRE EL ROL

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Sr. Analyst, Marketing Commercialization para formar parte del equipo de Marketing de Cono Sur —Argentina, Chile, Uruguay y Paraguay—. En este rol vas a contribuir al crecimiento de las marcas Blem y Mr. Músculo, ayudando a convertir la estrategia de la marca en iniciativas concretas que fortalezcan su relevancia para los consumidores y su desempeño en el mercado.

Vas a trabajar de manera cercana con equipos multifuncionales y partners externos, combinando entendimiento del consumidor, análisis de negocio, innovación, comunicación y excelencia en la ejecución.

Tendrás la oportunidad de tomar ownership sobre proyectos de las marcas, participar activamente en lanzamientos e iniciativas de crecimiento y desarrollar recomendaciones que ayuden a fortalecer el posicionamiento y la performance en la región.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Analizar el mercado, el consumidor y la competencia, identificando insights, tendencias y oportunidades de crecimiento para la marca.
  • Transformar información de consumidor y negocio en recomendaciones accionables, contribuyendo a la toma de decisiones de Marketing.
  • Co-liderar lanzamientos de nuevos productos e iniciativas de marca, acompañando su desarrollo, planificación, implementación y seguimiento en los mercados de Cono Sur.
  • Impulsar la ejecución de las prioridades de las marcas, coordinando proyectos y asegurando su implementación en tiempo y forma.
  • Realizar análisis de competencia, precios, mercado y performance, trabajando junto a partners externos y equipos multifuncionales.
  • Contribuir al desarrollo de campañas de comunicación y activación de Blem y Mr. Músculo, desde la construcción de briefings hasta la implementación de iniciativas con agencias, eventos, influencers y otros partners.
  • Gestionar y co-liderar la relación con las agencias de la marca, asegurando que los planes de comunicación y activación estén alineados con sus objetivos estratégicos.
  • Colaborar activamente con equipos multifuncionales, conectando las necesidades del consumidor, las prioridades de Blem y Mr Músculo y la ejecución en el mercado.

EXPERIENCIA REQUERIDA

  • Graduado/a de las carreras de Administración de Empresas, Marketing, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial o afines.
  • Al menos 2 años de experiencia relevante en Marketing o áreas Comerciales, idealmente en compañías de Consumo Masivo.
  • Experiencia o exposición a proyectos de Brand Marketing, Commercialization, innovación, lanzamientos, análisis de negocio o áreas relacionadas será valorada.
  • Dominio avanzado del idioma inglés.
  • Dominio del paquete Office.

EXPERIENCIA Y COMPETENCIAS DESEADAS

  • Pensamiento analítico y Consumer Centricity: capacidad para comprender al consumidor, interpretar datos, identificar oportunidades y generar insights accionables para el negocio.
  • Ownership, proactividad y adaptabilidad: iniciativa para liderar proyectos, anticiparse a necesidades y desenvolverse en entornos dinámicos.
  • Project Management: capacidad de organización, planificación y priorización de múltiples iniciativas y stakeholders.
  • Colaboración cross-functional, comunicación e influencia: habilidad para trabajar con distintas áreas, comunicar ideas con claridad y movilizar equipos hacia objetivos comunes.

REQUISITOS

  • Full-Time (Tiempo Completo)
  • Trabajo remoto de una vez por semana para empleados eligibles
  • Contrato por tiempo indeterminado
  • Este puesto no es eligible para Relocalización

BENEFICIOS

Súmate a SC Johnson y forma parte de una de las mejores empresas para trabajar de Latinoamérica con:

  • Innovadoras oficinas y plantas productivas certificadas como LEED, diseñadas con espacios abiertos que inspirarán tu creatividad, equipadas con las herramientas necesarias para que disfrutes tu día a día.
  • Oportunidades de desarrollo que potenciarán tu carrera profesional en un entorno laboral dinámico, donde podrás desplegar tu potencial en una empresa global, líder en consumo masivo.
  • Días adicionales de descanso para que puedas recargar energías.
  • Acceso a un programa integral de beneficios con foco en el bienestar personal, familiar y económico de cada colaborador que promueve el equilibrio entre la vida personal y laboral.

Inclusion & Diversity

We’re a global business, with people from every culture, ethnicity, race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age and ability. We recognize the breadth of human experience, and we work to celebrate it. It is our goal to build a diverse, inclusive and supportive work environment where all people can thrive.

We’re committed to ongoing efforts that help us attract, hire, and retain diverse talent who want to build a positive, inclusive environment. Read more about our ongoing initiatives at https://jobs.scjohnson.com/inclusion.

descriptionHtml:
Trinetix is looking for a skilled Customer Ops Success Manager / Service Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for enabling customers to achieve intended business outcomes by driving service performance, operational alignment, and continuous improvement across the customer lifecycle.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in telecommunications, service management, customer success, or customer operations.
  • Solid technical understanding of telecom services and supporting technologies, including IP, WDM, fiber, and related service assurance concepts.
  • Strong analytical, reporting, documentation, and presentation skills.
  • Experience using analytics and reporting tools such as Qlik or similar platforms.
  • Strong customer focus and business mindset.
  • Ability to work effectively with both operational and executive stakeholders in a global, multicultural environment.
  • University degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Fluent written and spoken English is required.

Nice-to-haves

  • ITIL certification.
  • Knowledge of service management frameworks.
  • Knowledge of additional major customer languages.

Main Accountabilities

  • Customer success and service value realization across assigned strategic customer relationships.
  • Customer-facing service performance, service review outcomes, and improvement follow-up.
  • Operational alignment between customer expectations, product capabilities, support processes, and service assurance delivery.
  • Customer feedback, portal adoption, and service experience insights translated into improvements.
  • Customer-facing problem management and recurring issue resolution in collaboration with operational teams.
  • Reliable documentation, reporting, and governance input for customer-facing service management activities.

Core Responsibilities

  • Build trusted customer relationships and act as the customer voice within Customer Operations.
  • Lead structured service reviews, including preparation, presentation, feedback capture, and follow-up of agreed actions.
  • Own and coordinate follow-up on customer issues, complaints, outage credits, RFOs, and incident-related reports within the service management scope.
  • Collaborate with Sales during pre-sales and customer engagement phases to align operational commitments and expectations.
  • Represent customer requirements in customer portals, SLA measurement, reporting, and supporting system development initiatives.
  • Plan, conduct, and analyze customer feedback activities, including NPS and other service experience inputs.
  • Trigger and drive customer-facing problem management for recurring or high-impact issues, ensuring improvement actions are progressed.
  • Maintain and improve customer-facing service documentation such as customer handbooks, support guidance, and service communication materials.
  • Use data, insights, and service performance reporting to identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve ways of working.

What We Offer

  • Continuous learning and career growth opportunities
  • Professional training and English/Spanish language classes
  • Comprehensive medical insurance
  • Mental health support
  • Specialized benefits program with compensation for fitness activities, hobbies, pet care, and more
  • Flexible working hours
  • Inclusive and supportive culture

About Us

Established in 2011, Trinetix is a dynamic tech service provider supporting enterprise clients around the world.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, we have a global team of over 1,000 professionals and delivery centers across Europe, the United States, and Argentina. We partner with leading global brands, delivering innovative digital solutions across Fintech, Professional Services, Logistics, Healthcare, and Agriculture.

Our operations are driven by a strong business vision, a people-first culture, and a commitment to responsible growth. We actively give back to the community through various CSR activities and adhere to international principles for sustainable development and business ethics.

To learn more about how we collect, process, and store your personal data, please review our Privacy Notice: https://www.trinetix.com/corporate-policies/privacy-notice

About Dialpad

Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.

Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.

Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.

Being a Dialer

At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.

We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.

We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits: Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic.

Your role

As an SEO Specialist: AI Search, you'll work closely with the Sr. Manager, SEO, to implement tactics that increase Dialpad's visibility in AI search, also known as GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) or AEO (Answer Engine Optimization). You'll implement tactics directly on our website and partner with cross-functional teams to increase visibility on external sites, with the goal of getting Dialpad mentioned and cited in AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. You'll grow your skills in SEO and GEO/AEO, gaining hands-on experience with an exciting marketing discipline as people change how they search from Google to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and other LLMs.

This position reports to our Sr. Manager, SEO, and has the opportunity to be based in our Buenos Aires office.

What You’ll Do

  • Implement GEO/AEO/SEO tactics as assigned to accelerate Dialpad’s AI search results and visibility, and increase leads and pipeline from organic search and LLMs.
  • Using AI tools, generate and edit content for GEO/AEO, then publish it to our website.
  • Work with design to update existing images and create new visuals for content.
  • Implement GEO tests, and may support CRO testing.
  • Support efforts to grow external visibility on the Web, including outreach/backlinking, and partnering with PR and Social teams, including engagement on channels like Reddit.
  • Use AI tools and platforms (e.g. LLMs, Ahrefs, AI visibility tools) to support the work mentioned above, which could include keyword/prompt research, competitive analysis of SERPs/prompt responses, and monitoring of rankings/mentions/citations.
  • Stay current on GEO/AEO best practices and tools as the discipline evolves.

Skills You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, English, Psychology, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of SEO experience or marketing communications experience.
  • Experience writing, editing, and publishing website content.
  • Skilled in using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.).
  • Experience working with a B2B SaaS company is desirable.

Why Join Dialpad

  • Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications
  • Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate
  • Join a team where AI amplifies every employee’s impact
  • Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth

We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. We have designed our offices to be inclusive, offering a vibrant environment to cultivate collaboration and connection. Our exceptional culture, repeatedly recognized as a Great Place to Work, ensures that every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role and possess the fundamental traits, drive, and strong ambition we seek, but your experience doesn’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

Dialpad is an equal-opportunity employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment.

About ROGII

Get ready to buckle up and meet the powerhouse that's revolutionizing the Oil & Gas industry – ROGII!

We're a dynamic team of tech enthusiasts who are not afraid to take risks and bring innovation to the forefront with our comprehensive software solutions. Here at ROGII, we’re all about optimizing well operations and streamlining workflows for clients all over the world. And we’ve been smashing that goal out of the park with products that have been adopted by over 350 clients worldwide! But hey, we're not your average team.


We're made up of ROGII Stars – creative, out-of-the-box thinkers who are always developing and improving our products with our users in mind, and you can find us all around the world. With each new day, we're pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and having a blast while we do it.


Now, here's your chance to join our team and help us continue being the unparalleled leader in our field. Join the revolution and let us help you lead the digital transformation for the Oil & Gas industry. We're seeking our next ROGII Star who can help us scale towards that goal


Let's ROGII and lead the digital transformation for the Oil & Gas industry together! Are you ready to embrace the future with us?


About the Role : GEOSTEERING GEOLOGIST


  • 24/7 Well Monitoring and Geosteering: Supervise, organize, and direct well geosteering in continuous operations to ensure precise placement within the geological target—whether on-site, at Rogii's offices, at client offices, or remotely.
  • Real-Time Data Interpretation: Analyze and interpret real-time LWD and MWD data to support immediate operational decisions during drilling.
  • Technical Support in Planning and Execution: Provide technical support in analyzing the planning, execution, and post-drilling activities of geosteering projects, proposing adjustments and improvements as appropriate.
  • Coordination and Communication: Maintain continuous and effective communication with project specialists and the team lead during operations, adhering to the chain of command and internal protocols.
  • Data and Reporting Management: Prepare and maintain the daily well reporting system and ensure the collection, organization, and availability of data using all Rogii applications (Data Manager, SoloCloud, etc.).
  • User and Client Support: Provide technical assistance to users via phone, email, or any channel required by the client, including availability for off-hours calls (nights and weekends) when project needs dictate.
  • Technical Presentations: Prepare and deliver technical reports and presentations to clients, both in-person and virtually, explaining results, recommendations, and scope of work.
  • Other Related Duties: Perform additional tasks linked to the above responsibilities based on internal project needs or client requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Petroleum Engineering, Geophysics, or a related Geoscience discipline.
  • Experience in wellsite operations, geosteering, or operations geology
  • Strong understanding of directional drilling, structural geology, stratigraphy, and log interpretation (LWD/MWD).
  • Experience with industry-standard geology/petrophysics software
  • Hands-on experience using data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, R, Power BI, SQL) to clean, manipulate, and visualize geological and subsurface datasets, automate workflows, or develop custom analytical scripts.
  • Willingness and capability to work in 24/7 rotational operational shifts (including night shifts, weekends, and holidays).
  • Ability to work in-office (Rogii or client premises).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Spanish to effectively collaborate with directional drillers, company men, and office teams while following established chains of command.
  • Ability to make fast, accurate, and critical technical decisions under high-pressure drilling environments.
  • Must be based and residing in Buenos Aires, Argentina.


At ROGII, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth and development. If you are passionate about accounting and want to be part of a dynamic team that is revolutionizing the Oil & Gas industry, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.


Please note a background check will be performed on the successful candidate.

We are seeking a highly motivated Tax Senior Analyst to join our Latin American Statutory and Tax accounting team. This role will focus on indirect and direct tax compliance and accounting, corporate income tax reporting, relationships and interactions with authorities. This Senior Tax Analyst role will be working in this Team supporting Argentina & Uruguay tax activities in Buenos Aires office.

What You Will Do

  • Work with the team in the Indirect Tax compliance including data validation, tax return filings, payments and related accounting work and submissions such as VAT or any other local indirect tax applicable in the country. Using this information, you will assist in the likely outsource of VAT compliance and onboarding of all other VAT related work to the COE.
  • Work with the external advisors in the Direct Tax compliance including data validation, tax return filings, payments and related accounting work and submissions such as Corporate Income Tax or any other local direct tax applicable in the country.
  • Assist with the income tax accounting for both US GAAP and statutory accounts for the legal entities in the country.
  • Assist with the accurate completion of annual income tax returns by ensuring accurate data is provided and coordinating the review of final income tax returns for the country in scope, all in coordination with external audit firm.
  • Assist with the statutory financial statement process including the external auditor requests, filing with local authorities and the audit firm related to US GAAP accounts.
  • Work with ERP system/s of the country.
  • Support efforts to leverage technology, automation and standardization related to all aspects in scope as far as processes and controls are concerned
  • Report to COE Manager

Minimum Qualifications

  • Analyst-level role with 4+ years of experience in relevant role
  • English Fluency
  • Experience in Taxes with fundamental tax principles, processes, accounting and terminology
  • Experience in Income tax return
  • Analytical skills for providing insights
  • Verbal and written communications and experience interacting with internal / external stakeholders
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools, technologies, and processes in a dynamic business environment
  • Collaborative teammate

Preferred Qualifications

  • Statutory accounting experience
  • Flexible to changes
  • Problem Solving Mindset

Ecolab está comprometido con el trato justo e igualitario de todas las personas colaboradoras y postulantes, y con la promoción de los principios de igualdad de oportunidades en el empleo. Desde MV Recursos Humanos nos encontramos acompañando a Phoenix Global Resources en la búsqueda de un/a Geomecánico/a Sr., para integrarse a su equipo multidisciplinario de Subsuelo.

 

La posición tendrá un rol clave en el modelado y análisis geomecánico de reservorios no convencionales, brindando soporte técnico a las operaciones de perforación y estimulación, con foco en la seguridad, eficiencia y optimización de los pozos.

 

Principales responsabilidades:

-Desarrollar, calibrar y actualizar modelos geomecánicos 1D, 3D y 4D, integrando información geológica, geofísica y de pozos.

-Definir ventanas operativas de perforación, brindar soporte en tiempo real y analizar eventos de tiempos no productivos (NPT).

-Contribuir al diseño y optimización de fracturas hidráulicas, evaluando esfuerzos, geometría, espaciamiento e interferencia entre pozos.

-Interpretar datos de campo, ensayos y registros para fortalecer los modelos geomecánicos y reducir incertidumbres.

-Definir programas de adquisición de datos y ensayos de mecánica de rocas, asegurando la calidad y trazabilidad de la información.

 

Requisitos:

-Formación universitaria en Ingeniería, Geología o Geofísica. Se valorará posgrado en Geomecánica.

-Más de 8 años de experiencia en geomecánica aplicada a Oil & Gas, con trayectoria en reservorios no convencionales (shale/tight).

-Experiencia en operaciones de campo y soporte técnico en tiempo real.

-Conocimiento de software de modelado geomecánico 1D y 3D (IP, DecisionSpace, TNav).

-Inglés intermedio/avanzado.

-Disponibilidad para realizar viajes vinculados con operaciones y reuniones de trabajo.

 

Se ofrece la oportunidad de incorporarse a Phoenix Global Resources, participando en proyectos de alta complejidad técnica y trabajando junto a equipos multidisciplinarios en el desarrollo de reservorios no convencionales.

Drive revenue growth by identifying, qualifying, and pursuing new business opportunities, and serving as a subject matter expert for sales development best practices, processes, and tools.

  • Monitor and manage all sales opportunities within the assigned territory using Salesforce (SFDC), ensuring accurate reporting and timely updates.

  • Deliver technical and commercial presentations to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Travel across Argentina, Uruguay, and Paraguay (up to 50%) to meet clients, conduct presentations, and support sales initiatives.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Industrial, Electromechanical Engineering or related fields.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar sales development role.
  • Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Strong command of Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Salesforce (SFDC).
  • Experience with Power BI is a plus.

  • Deep understanding of the electrical products market, especially within the utilities sector.

Sales & Business Development Skills

  • Skilled in sales tactics, negotiation, and closing deals.

Soft Skills

  • Strong organizational and planning abilities.

  • Capable of working independently and collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
  • Able to deliver clear and concise updates to senior management.

Competencies

Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar



Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina. Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven, creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal, reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones.

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

  • Gestión y Diseño Ecommerce: Diseño y actualización de banners y piezas graáficas en las plataformas ecommerce (Tiendanube soporte/gestión en Mercado Libre).
  • Gestión de Creadores de Contenido (UGC / Influencers): Mapeo, selección y coordinación con creadores alineados a la marca. Armado de briefs, seguimiento de entregables y análisis de rendimiento.
  • Estrategia y Producción de Contenido: Seleccionar e identificar tendencias de moda en redes (TikTok, Instagram), armar el calendario editorial y producir piezas ágiles (Reels, TikToks, stories) con una estética muy cuidada.
  • Análisis Básico: Monitoreo de métricas clave de conversión en tienda y performance de los contenidos.
  • Planificación y ejecución de la grilla de contenidos para todos los canales digitales.
  • Creación, filmación y edición ágil de video corto (Reels / TikToks / UGC) mostrando producto, uso y tendencias.
  • Redacción de copies atractivos, persuasivos y alineados al tono de la marca.
  • Gestión de historias interactivas diarias y moderación básica de interacciones/consultas.
  • Coordinación y scouting de creadoras de contenido / colaboraciones.


🔍 ¿Qué buscamos?

  • 🎓 Educación: Estudiantes avanzados o graduados/as de Marketing Digital, Comunicación Social, Publicidad, Diseño de Indumentaria / Moda, Relaciones Públicas o carreras afines.
  • 💼 Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años en posiciones similares de marketing digital, e-commerce o creación de contenido para marcas (excluyente).
  • 💻 Plataformas: Manejo fluido y avanzado de Tiendanube (excluyente). Se valorará especialmente la experiencia gestionando Mercado Libre.
  • 👠 Perfil & Estilo: Pasión por la moda, excelente sentido estético y curiosidad nata por consumir y aplicar tendencias digitales.
  • 🎬 Herramientas: Dominio de apps/programas ágiles de edición de video y diseño (CapCut, Canva, etc.).
  • 🧠 Habilidades blandas: Autonomía, excelente criterio de priorización y capacidad para coordinar con terceros (creadores y marcas).
  • 📍 Modalidad: Disponibilidad para trabajo 100% presencial.


🎁 ¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Sumarte a un equipo dinámico con espacio para proponer, innovar y liderar proyectos visuales.
  • Descuentos exclusivos en las marcas con las que trabajamos.
  • Gran clima de trabajo y desarrollo constante.

Join the World’s Most Iconic Beverage Brand

Shape the future of Modern Trade across LATAM by building a unified Customer Strategy agenda that connects channel strategy, customer value creation, category leadership, RGM, execution excellence, digital commerce, and bottler alignment.

Position Overview

As Senior Director of Modern Trade and Customer Strategy for LATAM, you will lead the regional agenda to scale Modern Trade as a profitable growth engine, aligning KO, bottlers, hubs, key customers, and cross-functional partners around a common strategy.

The role translates LATAM business priorities into actionable channel playbooks, multi-year customer plans, category management capabilities, performance-based investment models, and execution standards that can scale across markets.

The objective is to accelerate sustainable, profitable growth by making Modern Trade more strategic, data-led, customer-centric, and execution-focused across priority formats and customers.

Function-Related Activities / Key Responsibilities

  • Define and deploy the LATAM Modern Trade strategy, aligning channel ambition, priority formats, growth platforms, and profitability objectives across markets and bottlers.
  • Build integrated commercial plans that connect shopper insights, customer needs, brand strategy, portfolio, RGM, service models, and execution standards.
  • Lead customer strategy and value creation frameworks for priority accounts, enabling stronger JBPs, segmentation, scorecards, and partnership models.
  • Align senior stakeholders across Franchise, Customers, RGM, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Digital Commerce, Capabilities, and bottling partners.
  • Codify and scale best practices across LATAM through hubs, franchise teams, bottlers, customer teams, and capability experts.
  • Use data-led insights to size opportunities, prioritize initiatives, build business cases, track value creation, and improve decision-making routines.

Focus, Scope & Impact

  • Regional agenda: Set the strategic direction for Modern Trade across LATAM, defining where to play, how to win, and which capabilities to scale.
  • Customer value creation: Strengthen long-term partnerships with strategic customers through segmentation, differentiated value propositions, JBPs, and mutual growth roadmaps.
  • Category and shopper leadership: Translate shopper, channel, and occasion insights into category visions, assortment priorities, activation principles, and customer-facing stories.
  • Execution excellence: Define scalable standards that improve availability, visibility, incidence, conversion, equipment productivity, digital shelf quality, and in-store performance.
  • RGM and investment: Connect customer plans with portfolio, pricing, pack architecture, trade investment, and system economics to ensure profitable growth.
  • System alignment: Orchestrate KO, bottlers, franchise teams, customers, finance, marketing, supply chain, and digital commerce through common tools and routines.
  • Performance management: Track NSR growth, value share, margin expansion, customer performance, execution quality, and capability adoption through clear scorecards and governance.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Senior leadership experience in modern trade, customer strategy, commercial planning, RGM, category management, or related commercial functions.
  • Strong analytical capability to translate data, shopper insights, and customer performance into actionable strategies.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, align the system, and drive profitable growth across markets and bottling partners.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and storytelling skills with internal and external senior audiences.
  • Experience using digital tools, customer insights, and capability programs to strengthen execution and decision making.

Key Success Parameters

Experience

  • 10+ years of leadership experience in commercial planning, customer strategy, channel strategy, RGM, segmentation, VTM, innovation, key accounts, or portfolio strategy.
  • Proven strategic, analytical, and influencing skills, with the ability to connect planning, execution, system economics, and brand priorities.
  • Bottler, franchise, customer management, or multi-market operating experience preferred.

Work Focus

  • Requires strong system perspective, business fundamentals, and the ability to make complex commercial concepts simple, compelling, and actionable for multi-functional teams.
  • Combines analytical and strategic thinking with consumer/customer understanding, hands-on execution, ICE process knowledge, modern trade capabilities, category management, and customer value creation.
  • Works through a networked model with senior leaders, operating units, marketing, categories, finance, platform services, franchise teams, and bottling partners.

Communication Focus

  • Communicate channel opportunities, priorities, plans, and performance to OU leadership, senior management, bottling partners, and key customers.
  • Align internal, system, and external stakeholders around strategic initiatives, business drivers, customer collaboration, and growth priorities.

Required

Key Knowledge Requirements

  • Commercial Planning
  • RGM, Segmentation, OBPPC
  • System Economics

Good to Have

  • Shopper Marketing
  • System Planning
  • Category Management
  • Supply Chain
  • Value to Market
  • Customer Management

Skills

Influencing, stakeholder management, strategic storytelling, system economics, customer partnership, commercial planning, and cross-market execution leadership.

🎯 El desafío: transformar números en decisiones.

  • Identificando desvíos, entendiendo sus causas y proponiendo soluciones sostenibles.
  • Actuando como Business Partner de cada Unidad de Negocio, con una mirada integral y cercana a la operación.

Porque vas a tener la oportunidad de ampliar tu mirada de negocio, interactuar con diferentes unidades, participar activamente en la gestión y contribuir con propuestas que generen un impacto concreto en los resultados y los procesos.

Buscamos Community Manager Senior

BOND · Palermo, CABA · Full time · Modalidad híbrida (home office + presencialidad semanal en el shopping)


El rol

Buscamos a alguien con seniority real, que no solo ejecute sino que proponga, lidere y se haga cargo de la comunidad de un shopping muy importante en Instagram y TikTok. Vas a ser la voz del shopping, la persona que entiende qué pasa en la cultura digital y lo traduce en contenido que enamora, y la que sostiene una agenda intensa con decenas de locales, lanzamientos y activaciones.

Vas a trabajar desde BOND, con el equipo de la agencia y en contacto directo con el cliente.

Qué vas a hacer:

  • Gestionar y hacer crecer la comunidad en Instagram y TikTok: responder, moderar, conversar y detectar oportunidades en tiempo real.
  • Proponer ideas de contenido originales, alineadas al tono de marca y a las tendencias del momento (formatos, audios, memes, challenges), con foco en lograr viralidad en TikTok.
  • Producir contenido en el shopping: reels, stories, TikToks, fotos y videos, tanto con celular como coordinando con producción cuando el proyecto lo requiera.
  • Realizar coberturas presenciales semanales: lanzamientos, aperturas, eventos, colecciones y novedades de los locales.
  • Llevar la agenda de contenidos y el calendario editorial, balanceando moda, gastronomía y belleza, y dando visibilidad equilibrada a una oferta muy variada de locales.
  • Medir resultados, analizar métricas y presentar reportes con aprendizajes y propuestas de mejora.
  • Participar de las calls semanales con el equipo de BOND y con el cliente para planificar, compartir novedades y alinear prioridades.
  • Cuidar la reputación de marca: manejo de consultas, comentarios sensibles y situaciones de crisis con criterio.
  • Trabajar con creators e influencers cuando sea necesario: sumar ideas, coordinar y acompañar colaboraciones.


Qué buscamos en vos

Experiencia y seniority


  • Mínimo 4 a 5 años de experiencia como Community Manager o en roles de social media, idealmente en marcas de consumo, moda, retail, gastronomía o lifestyle.
  • Experiencia comprobable manejando cuentas con alto volumen de contenido e interacción.
  • Portfolio o casos que demuestren resultados reales en Instagram y TikTok.
  • Experiencia en agencia o trabajando con clientes (valorable).

Skills clave

  • Entendés qué significa ser community manager: escuchar, conversar y construir comunidad, no solo publicar.
  • Dominio profundo de Instagram y TikTok: algoritmo, formatos, tendencias, hooks, retención y storytelling.
  • Capacidad creativa: generás ideas sin esperar a que te las pidan.
  • Escritura con humor, ritmo y tono adecuado.
  • Habilidad para grabar y editar desde el celular con buena calidad.
  • Buen ojo estético y sensibilidad por la moda, la gastronomía y la belleza.
  • Organización y responsabilidad: manejo de calendarios editoriales, tiempos y prioridiades con múltiples stakeholders.
  • Manejo de herramientas de planificación y métricas (Meta Business Suite, TikTok Analytics)
  • Proactividad, criterio propio y autonomía para trabajar de forma híbrida.
  • Excelente comunicación con equipos internos, clientes, locales y proveedores.

Suma

  • Conocimiento del universo retail y shopping.
  • Experiencia en cobertura de eventos y contenido en vivo.
  • Nociones de diseño (Canva, Figma) y fotografía.
  • Experiencia trabajando con influencers y creators.

Modalidad

  • Full time
  • Híbrido: home office + coberturas semanales
  • Calls semanales con el equipo de BOND y el cliente

Cómo postularte

Enviá tu CV junto con tu portfolio, perfiles de redes que hayas gestionado o links a contenidos propios que quieras destacar.

[info@holabond.com]

Asunto: CM Senior | BOND

About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Great brands help make Pinners’ inspirations a reality, and we’re looking for a Client Account Manager II to help lead the way.

In this role, you will support one of Pinterest’s most strategic businesses in LATAM, partnering closely on the Mercado Libre business across Hispanic markets. You will help advertisers get the most out of Pinterest by driving strong campaign execution, performance optimization, measurement rigor, and clear client communication. You’ll collaborate closely with sales and cross-functional teams while helping bring structure, insights, and momentum to a complex regional account.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and nurture strong relationships with partners by proactively communicating on campaign performance, optimizations, updates, and growth opportunities
  • Partner closely with the Client Partner to support a complex regional business across multiple Hispanic LATAM markets
  • Ensure partner objectives and requirements are met by coordinating effectively with internal teams including Measurement, Product Marketing, Creative Strategy, Performance Solutions, and others
  • Gain a deep understanding of partner business goals and turn data into compelling stories and actionable recommendations
  • Own the “how” conversation with advertisers by advising on targeting, bidding, creative, measurement, pacing, and optimization approaches
  • Become an expert in Pinterest campaign best practices and performance solutions, and act as a trusted resource on performance-related opportunities
  • Ensure campaign setup and execution are strong, monitor results closely, troubleshoot issues, and take action to course-correct when needed
  • Interpret and communicate campaign results clearly so that partners understand impact, opportunity, and next steps
  • Support QBRs, performance recaps, and other business reviews with strong analysis and clear recommendations
  • Actively participate in client meetings, helping explain complex solutions in a simple, credible, and commercially relevant way
  • Handle resistance, objections, and product questions thoughtfully and professionally
  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities that can contribute to account growth and team revenue goals
  • Maintain strong fluency in Pinterest ad products, performance solutions, and evolving roadmap updates
  • Partner efficiently with cross-functional teams to resolve issues, answer technical questions, and support business growth
  • Pitch new performance products and best practices at scale where relevant


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in digital advertising, account management, or media with responsibility for campaign performance and client communication
  • Strong track record of turning data into compelling recommendations and business actions
  • Experience managing complex workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines with strong attention to detail
  • Strong understanding of campaign optimization, performance measurement, attribution, and analytical problem-solving
  • Experience with technical and performance-oriented media solutions, including areas such as tagging, measurement, analytics, shopping, search, display, paid social, or lower-funnel advertising
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in person, on the phone, and in writing
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and follow-through
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity and shifting priorities
  • Experience managing sophisticated client or agency relationships is strongly preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as math, economics, marketing, business, engineering, or equivalent experience.


Relocation Statement:

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.


In-Office Requirement Statement

  • We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
  • Candidates must be based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. This role will require occasional travel to a Pinterest office for in-person collaboration 1–2 times every 6 months.


Our Commitment To Inclusion

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support.

By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.

descriptionHtml:
ON.energy is setting the standard for large load interconnection. ON’s patented AI UPS™ is a medium-voltage UPS that serves as a firewall, protecting the data center from the grid, and the grid from the data center. With multiple gigawatts currently under construction, we are enabling grid-safe data centers. 

Key Responsibilities 
  • The multi-account security foundation. AWS Organizations structure, SCPs, guardrails, a security tooling account, centralized logging, and secure baselines — delivered as infrastructure as code, not console clicks.
  • Security standards and review gates. You can mandate controls and block deploys that introduce unacceptable risk, through review gates on identity and network changes, a documented exception path, and a defined escalation route.
  • AWS identity and access. IAM Identity Center as the single front door, federated with Entra ID in partnership with IT, who own Entra as the source of truth. Role and group model mapping job functions to permissions; joiner/mover/leaver; privileged and break-glass access; workload identity; recurring access reviews. Hands-on at first, progressively automated so it stops being manual work.
  • Cloud-to-site connectivity and segmentation — the defining part of this role. Every plant, BESS site, and remote asset that reaches our cloud does so over a path you design and defend: site-to-cloud VPN and private connectivity, hard segmentation between IT and OT zones, DMZ and broker patterns for site telemetry, certificate and device identity for field gateways, remote vendor access to sites, and strict control over what may initiate traffic in each direction. You own the cloud side of that boundary and share the path itself with the OT security owner.
  • Threat detection, monitoring, and mitigation. You are expected to know how attacks actually run — credential and token abuse, cross-account privilege escalation, exposed control and management interfaces, lateral movement from a compromised site network into cloud, supply-chain and dependency compromise, ransomware staging — and to build the monitoring that catches them. GuardDuty, Security Hub, Detective, Inspector, Config, and CloudTrail tuned for real signal-to-noise, detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and ATT&CK for ICS, runbooks the wider team can execute, and the mitigations driven to done.
  • Vulnerability management. Scanning coverage across workloads, images, and dependencies; risk-based triage and prioritization; remediation SLAs and exception handling; posture reporting. You identify and prioritize; the AWS engineers remediate in the workloads they own.

 

Key Requirements
  • 5+ years in cloud security, security-focused infrastructure, or cloud operations, with deep hands-on AWS.
  • Production experience in multi-account AWS environments.
  • Demonstrable command of attacker techniques and the detections and mitigations that counter them — you can walk an intrusion path end to end and explain how you would catch it, contain it, and close it.
  • Hybrid and site-to-cloud network security: segmentation, VPN, private connectivity, firewalls, routing, DNS, CIDR and subnetting — securing connections between cloud and physical facilities.
  • Strong AWS identity: roles, policies, permission sets, MFA, least privilege, access reviews; IAM Identity Center federated with an external IdP, ideally Microsoft Entra ID.
  • AWS-native security services: GuardDuty, Detective, Security Hub, Inspector, Config, CloudTrail, KMS, WAF.
  • Infrastructure as code — CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform. You build controls, you don't click them.
  • Advanced English (B2–C1) for daily work with English-speaking teams and written security documentation.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Security experience in OT- or ICS-adjacent environments: IT/OT segmentation, Purdue-model zoning, secure remote access to field sites, and protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, or MQTT crossing into cloud.
  • Detection engineering and SIEM work; threat modelling; incident response you have personally run.
  • Regulated or compliance-driven environments where access control, monitoring, and audit evidence are held to an external standard.
  • Turning scanner output and audit findings into prioritized, actionable work for engineers who do not report to you.
  • Troubleshooting security, identity, networking, and infrastructure issues across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Landing zones, Control Tower, and security account patterns.
  • IEC 62443 or NIST SP 800-82 familiarity.
  • Containers and serverless workloads.
  • Energy, utilities, or other mission-critical environments.
  • Wazuh, Datadog, Grafana, or similar.
  • Security documentation and ADRs.
Certifications

Valued as a signal, not a substitute for experience: AWS Certified Security – Specialty; AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty; AWS Certified Solutions Architect; GICSP or GIAC GRID; CISSP; CCSP; Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate.

 

For US-based roles - What you’ll get:

  • Competitive salary + annual performance-based bonus eligibility
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and company holidays 

For Mexico-based roles - What you’ll get:

  • Competitive salary + annual performance bonus eligibility
  • Christmas Bonus (Aguinaldo): 30 days
  • Major medical expenses and life insurance
  • Paid time off and holidays (per local policy)

For all roles:

  • Professional development and growth opportunities
  • Opportunity to grow with a mission-driven team shaping the future of clean energy
  • Equal Opportunity: ON.energy is committed to equal employment opportunity and to maintaining a work environment free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.
  • Benefits vary by role and location and are subject to change.

Agency Notice: ON.energy does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters. Resumes submitted without a fully executed Master Services Agreement (MSA) and a written request from an authorized member of our Talent Acquisition team will be considered the property of ON.energy. No placement fees or compensation will be paid for unsolicited candidate submissions.

Como Financial Accountant gestionarás tareas financieras para un equipo de 10 colegas. Tu rol es clave para brindar soporte administrativo en contabilidad y finanzas. Crecerás profesional y personalmente en un entorno saludable en Rijk Zwaan Argentina.

Tu trabajo en Rijk Zwaan

Como Financial Accountant, reportará a los directores de Rijk Zwaan Argentina y será co-responsable de la contabilidad general de la empresa, que incluye:

  • Mantener registros y estados contables para asegurar que las transacciones queden registradas con precisión.
  • Valuación y control de Stock y Preparación para auditorías.
  • Realizar inventario trimestral de stock junto con Soporte de Ventas
  • Preparar informes contables; preparar declaraciones de IVA, documentación de reintegros de IVA y otras; procesar y dar seguimiento a los pagos;
  • Realizar informes periódicos a organismos oficiales (p. ej., estadísticas nacionales);
  • Realizar validación y registros de declaración de gastos.
  • Dar seguimiento a la cobranza de deudores y gestionar pagos;
  • Mantener contacto estrecho con el/la Especialista de Soporte de Ventas, el departamento Comercial, otros departamentos internos y proveedores respecto de los asuntos diarios.
  • Preparar reportes de la operación comercial, analizar e interpretar datos y reportar a la Dirección.
  • Contabilidad - Extraer datos del sistema contable y realizar cálculos, identificar y analizar anomalías y explicar diferencias.
  • Preparar declaraciones, mensuales y anuales de impuestos, y declaraciones mensuales de impuestos de importación/exportación.
  • Otras tareas operativas y de back office.

Además, trabajarás en diversos proyectos financieros, o prestarás apoyo a tus compañeros con algunas tareas administrativas.

Tu aporte

Buscamos un/a Contador/a Financiero/a con:

  • Título universitario (Lic./BSc.) en Contabilidad, Economía/Administración o Finanzas;
  • Al menos 3 años de experiencia relevante en un área/departamento de Contabilidad;
  • Habilidades sólidas y comprobables en finanzas y contabilidad;
  • Conocimiento de normas contables, laborales y tributarias de acuerdo con la legislación argentina;
  • Nivel de inglés al menos intermedio (laboral);
  • Experiencia de trabajo en entorno M365 será una ventaja adicional.

Además:

Si tú residencia es en CABA / AMBA.

Ser una persona honesta y confiable, en quien tus colegas pueden apoyarse.

Te entusiasma el desafío de formar parte de una empresa internacional.

Sos alguien “hands on”, con interés amplio en funciones administrativas, y que te guste trabajar de manera independiente y autónoma en un equipo chico dentro de la oficina.

Con buenas habilidades analíticas, meticuloso/a y buena comunicación.

Que te guste colaborar y coordinar con colegas en un entorno internacional para lograr el mejor resultado.

descriptionHtml:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

Design is foundational to our product and our company. As a Product Designer at Profound, you will work on our core data visualization and content workflow tools. This is an opportunity to have deep ownership over our product and ship fast and ship often, while continuing to craft the experience for our users.

What you’ll do

  • Design core product experiences end to end, from early exploration through launch and iteration
  • Work closely with product managers and engineers to translate strategy and ambiguous problems into clear, thoughtful solutions
  • Explore multiple directions quickly through sketches, flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs
  • Sweat the details and fine tune layout shifts, typography, spacing, motion, and interactions
  • Balance building good product focused on user needs, technical constraints, and business goals while keeping a high bar for craft
  • Use user feedback, qualitative insights, and product intuition to refine and improve the product over time
  • Contribute to and help evolve Profound’s design language, systems, and product vision
  • Participate in Tuesday and Thursday design critiques to give and receive feedback on in-progress design work

Who you are

  • You have 3 or more years of experience designing digital products, ideally in a startup or fast-moving product company
  • You are a strong generalist with taste and are comfortable owning the full stack of design assets, from flows to pixels to final product
  • You care deeply about craft and believe great design is defined by clarity, simplicity, and execution
  • You bring an entrepreneurial and product-thinking mindset to design
  • You like to experiment with AI, new tools, and ways of working, whether through new Figma plugins or tools such as v0, Cursor, or other prototyping tools
  • You are good at collaborating with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to solve problems
  • You have a portfolio that shows thoughtful problem-solving and high-quality visual design
  • Experience working on a data visualization or B2B marketing product
  • Enjoy prototyping directly in code and shipping directly to production using git and GitHub
  • Blur the lines between where design ends and product or engineering work begins
  • You can just do things

Note from our co-founder

In the evolving landscape of product development, exceptional design is not merely a nice-to-have, it is foundational. As software engineering becomes increasingly accessible, it is taste, creativity, and thoughtful execution that differentiate outstanding products from the rest.

I believe deeply that design sits at the core of our success. At Profound, my goal is to build a design team renowned for setting a new standard of excellence, crafting experiences so compelling they become benchmarks in our industry.

If you are someone who believes in the transformative power of great design and wants to create work that genuinely shapes the future, join us. Let’s redefine what’s possible together.

Dylan Babbs, Co-founder & CTO

Location

This is an on-site role based in our NYC, SF or Buenos Aires office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

For this role, the expected base salary range is $120,000 to $250,000 (NYC and SF). Comp may vary by location. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

descriptionHtml:
At AlixPartners, we tackle complex challenges by transforming insights into innovative solutions, delivering lasting value for businesses, their people, and the communities they serve. Our products are designed to drive meaningful impact, ensuring sustainable growth and success. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity of thoughts and experiences bring to our firm, and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.

AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person and remote working. Our products are designed to drive meaningful impact for our clients and stakeholders. This role follows a different cadence to traditional consulting or on-site client presence - it follows a traditional product development cadence, while being expected to engage our users in the appropriate situations such as business conferences and in-person workshops.

What You’ll Do

Build and lead a top-talented engineering hub in Buenos Aires that delivers scalable, secure, and reliable software for our products portfolio.

Create scalable, reliable, and high-performing software solutions that multiply our clients’ results and drive business growth.

Build and ship LLM-driven product features (RAG, document Q&A, intelligent workflows) that drive user growth and revenue.

Take a hands-on role, both at the architecture and code level in advancing our technical goals, while being a steward of the local engineering team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the BA engineering hub for new and existing platforms and applications.
  • Accountable for delivering thought leadership, strategic direction, and technology guidance to achieve business outcomes.
  • Maintain clear, recurring communication with the Global Head of Engineering and provide actionable guidance to local Technical Leads.
  • Select, onboard, and manage local vendors and contractors aligned to global strategy; monitor delivery, quality, cost, and compliance.
  • Define and refine KRs with stakeholders and drive delivery according to business outcomes.
  • Foster close communication with stakeholders and product owners to improve transparency and SLAs.
  • Accelerate delivery of AI product features, tying engineering work to measurable user and business outcomes.
  • Drive adoption of modern software engineering principles, tools, and technologies to maximize efficiency and productivity.
  • Advance the maturity of the engineering guild through technical leadership and best practices.
  • Provide mentorship and promote continuous learning for Platforms engineers.
  • Lead technical decisions on AI-powered, user-facing products and connect engineering outcomes to business impact

What you’ll need

  • 15+ combined experience working as a Software Engineer, Software Architect, Technical Lead, Technical Manager, or similar technical field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in software frameworks, technologies, and development.
  • A proven track record of collaborating on technical projects with cross-functional teams.
  • Deep experience in hands-on development work to stand up an architecture and drive the adoption within an organization.
  • Experience working in accordance with DevSecOps principles, and familiarity with industry deployment best practices using CI/CD tools and IaC (Infrastructure as Code).
  • Proven engineering leadership skills, including leading engineering teams and inspiring and motivating cross-functional teams towards a common goal.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to craft innovative solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse stakeholders and influence decision-making; adept at translating complex technical details to diverse audiences.
  • Management skills, including experience with OKRs and Agile methodologies.
  • Business fluency in English and Spanish.

Additional qualifications

  • Developed software supporting business consulting fields or enterprise SaaS solutions.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-driven features in production (e.g. RAG, document intelligence, conversational AI)
  • Contributions to open-source projects or active involvement in tech communities.
  • Demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to mentor and uplift junior team members or peers.

This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities. AlixPartners is a results-driven global consulting firm that specializes in helping businesses successfully address their most complex and critical challenges. You can learn more about our Culture and Career Development opportunities.

The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritise their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning. The benefit type and level differ per location.

AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, or disability.

Job Description


Americas Growth & Strategy will help drive the strategic direction for Accenture’s largest Market. We will serve as trusted advisors to the Americas business and leadership team, with a range of responsibilities including developing the Americas growth strategy, business strategies, operational strategies, V&A agenda, and investment strategy. We will also serve as a strategic consulting function for the Americas, solving critical complex problems for the business across industries, reinvention partners, reinvention engines, and market units.

The Americas G&S Manager will play a key role in helping to deliver our Americas G&S projects, including:


  • Helping to identify and structuring the problem
  • Testing hypothesis
  • Owning research and analysis
  • Interacting with stakeholders
  • Interviewing SMEs
  • Presenting recommendations to the team and leadership
  • Implementing interventions and monitoring progress


    • Must have: Structured problem solving; data fluency; strong analytical capabilities, ability to work independently; strong relationship management skills; ability to interact effectively with leadership; project management skills; ability to structure and drive research activities; ability to develop and defend a point of view; strong understanding of business drivers and value chains; ability to collaborate and team across multiple entities and stakeholders


  • Analytical approach; structured thinker
  • Ability to work with leadership in a trusted advisor capacity
  • Problem identification, structuring, and analysis skills
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Understanding of industry dynamics, value creation opportunities, and use of technology for competitive advantage
  • An aptitude for creative problem solving
  • Demonstrated teamwork and collaboration in a professional setting
  • Ability to work independently and manage consulting teams


    • Optional Skills

    Good to have: an understanding of Accenture’s business and end to end offerings; an understanding of Accenture’s economics and operating principles

    Education

    Must have: B.A. or B.S. in Business, Finance, Economics or other relevant focus area

    Good to have: Minimum of 4+ years in a strategy or consulting role; MBA

    Language: English (Advanced Level)

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Director, Fraud Product Management

What a Director, Fraud Product Management do at Fiserv?

At Fiserv, this leader drives the fraud and security product strategy for the Argentina market, connecting local customer needs with global capabilities to deliver measurable value. The role partners closely with cross-functional teams to develop scalable, secure, and outcome-driven solutions. This individual also promotes innovation, trust, and excellence in the delivery of products that strengthen customer experiences and support business growth. With strong market insight and a focus on execution, they transform data and industry trends into product decisions that generate tangible business impact.

What You Will Do

  • Define the vision, strategy, and market positioning of fraud and security products for Argentina.
  • Identify customer needs, local regulatory requirements, and market trends related to fraud prevention.
  • Prioritize the product roadmap by balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and business objectives.
  • Lead collaboration with technology, data, compliance, commercial, and user experience teams.
  • Monitor product performance metrics and adjust priorities based on results and emerging opportunities.
  • Support go-to-market strategies, value proposition development, sales enablement, and solution adoption.
  • Incorporate customer and stakeholder feedback to continuously enhance the product portfolio.
  • Drive product decisions focused on scalability, security, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth.

What You Will Need To Have

  • Strong experience in digital product management within fintech, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Solid knowledge of fraud prevention and detection, financial risk management, and digital product security.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to define metrics, monitor performance, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Experience building and prioritizing product roadmaps in complex, cross-functional environments.
  • Proven ability to align multiple stakeholders and lead initiatives using agile methodologies.

What Would Be Great To Have (Preferred)

  • Experience integrating solutions through APIs and partner ecosystems.
  • Knowledge of scoring models, predictive analytics, or machine learning applications for fraud prevention.
  • Experience within acquiring, issuing, banking, or digital financial services platforms.
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements and reporting practices applicable to the Argentine market.
  • Experience with pricing strategies, portfolio expansion, and regional scalability initiatives.

Our Culture

  • Our aspiration is to move money and information in a way that moves the world.
  • Our purpose is to deliver superior value to our clients through leading technology, targeted innovation, and excellence in everything we do.

Our Values

  • Earn Customer Trust Every Day
  • Create with Purpose
  • Inspire and Achieve Excellence
  • Do the Right Thing
  • Deliver on the Promise of One Fiserv
  • Our culture, rooted in collective pride and recognition of individual achievements, is visible every day through our shared #FISVProud social media posts.

Beneficios

  • Reintegro por almuerzo.
  • Plan médico de primer nivel.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Reintegro de gastos por guardería.
  • Kit escolar.
  • Día libre por cumpleaños.
  • Capacitación continua.
  • Programa interno de reconocimiento.
  • Programa de bienestar y asistencia al empleado.
  • WellHub (Gympass).

Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please

  • Apply using your legal name
  • Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

Note To Agencies

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

Warning About Fake Job Posts

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.
