Únete a Dahua Technology Argentina!

¡Únete a nuestro equipo! Dahua Technology es un fabricante global con más de 20,000 empleados alrededor del mundo. Sé parte de un equipo de profesionales altamente calificados y con experiencia de todas partes del mundo.


Business Development Manager (CCTV/Electronic Security)

Buscamos un BDM (Hunter) con experiencia en Seguridad Electrónica para liderar los proyectos de Gobierno (B2G). Quien será responsable de la venta consultiva de soluciones integrales, orquestando proyectos de gran dimension (Safe City, ITS, Infraestructura crítica, etc.). Su misión principal es transformar las necesidades de seguridad pública en propuestas tecnológicas de valor, articulando nuestros productos y servicios dentro de los pliegos de licitación para asegurar el cierre de proyectos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de penetración en el sector público (Nacional, Provincial y Municipal) para proyectos de seguridad.
  • Gestionar el ciclo completo de licitaciones públicas, desde la detección temprana y el lobby ético hasta la especificación técnica en pliegos y el cierre.
  • Identificar y desarrollar oportunidades en verticales clave: Municipios (Smart City), Transporte y Energía.
  • Fortalecer la relación comercial con Grandes Integradores de Sistemas y Partners estratégicos que atienden al gobierno.
  • Realizar presentaciones técnicas y comerciales de alto nivel ante los tomadores de decisiones.
  • Elaborar reportes de pipeline y pronósticos de venta precisos (Forecast) para la gerencia regional.


Requisitos:

  • Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería (Electrónica, Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas), Administración o afines.
  • Experiencia de mínimo 5 años vendiendo soluciones de Seguridad Electrónica (CCTV, Control de Acceso) al Sector Gobierno.
  • Conocimiento avanzado del portafolio de videovigilancia (Cámaras, VMS, Analíticas, Tráfico/LPR).
  • Cartera activa de contactos con integradores de gobierno y decisores en organismos públicos (Municipios/Ministerios).
  • Historial comprobable de cumplimiento de cuotas de venta en proyectos de gran escala.
  • Perfil 100% "Hunter", orientado a resultados inmediatos y con capacidad de trabajar con autonomía desde el primer día.
  • Excelentes habilidades de negociación, cierre comercial y manejo de tiempos de licitación.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar dentro de Argentina.
  • Inglés conversacional.



¡Si cumples con los requisitos y estás interesado(a) en unirte a un líder en tecnología de seguridad, te invitamos a postularte!

descriptionHtml:
Brief del rol

Como Senior Growth Marketing Specialist, serás la referencia técnica y estratégica para el desarrollo, optimización y escala de la pauta digital de nuestros clientes. Tu rol combinará una visión integral de negocio con un alto dominio técnico en medios digitales, arquitectura de datos y estrategias omnicanal.

Buscamos un perfil con liderazgo operativo para guiar a talentos Jr. y Ssr., capacidad crítica para diagnosticar y resolver crisis técnicas complejas, y habilidad consultiva para exponer diagnósticos y resultados complejos de forma clara y convincente frente al cliente. Además, esperamos que incorpores herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para potenciar tus análisis y agilizar la toma de decisiones.


En este rol vas a:

  • Liderar la performance multicanal: Planificar, ejecutar y optimizar de manera integral estrategias de pauta digital en Google Ads, Meta Ads y demás plataformas relevantes, orientando cada acción a los objetivos reales de negocio.
  • Gestionar la inversión y presupuestos: Definir y proyectar la asignación presupuestaria, redistribuyendo la inversión multicanal de forma ágil para maximizar el retorno sobre la inversión (ROI/ROAS).
  • Desplegar estrategias avanzadas de datos y Programmatic: Diseñar e implementar iniciativas basadas en first-party data, feeds de datos complejos y ecosistemas omnicanal (CTV, DOOH, Audio), analizando y leyendo modelos de atribución multitouch.
  • Asegurar la calidad técnica y mentoring: Realizar el control de calidad (QA) de la operación diaria del equipo y brindar acompañamiento, tutoría y desarrollo técnico a perfiles Semi Senior y Junior a cargo.
  • Gestionar crisis técnicas de alto impacto: Actuar con rapidez y precisión ante situaciones críticas como caídas drásticas de rendimiento, suspensiones de cuenta o fallas graves en la infraestructura de tracking.
  • Ser la voz técnica frente al cliente: Liderar la exposición y defensa técnica ante los clientes, traduciendo diagnósticos de causa raíz, arquitecturas de medición y resultados estratégicos en conversaciones claras y de alto valor.
  • Potenciar la operación mediante IA: Integrar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial en tus flujos de trabajo diarios para agilizar diagnósticos, análisis predictivos y optimización de contenido.


Para este rol esperamos que:

  • Cuentes con 4+ años de experiencia en la gestión de estrategias de Paid Media, media planning y liderazgo técnico de cuentas en agencias o entornos ágiles.
  • Poseas dominio avanzado e implementación estratégica en Google Ads y Meta Ads, sumado al manejo de plataformas programáticas y formatos omnicanal (CTV, DOOH, Audio).
  • Tengas experiencia práctica trabajando con first-party data, segmentaciones avanzadas y gestión de feeds de catálogo/productos complejos.
  • Tengas un sólido conocimiento en analítica digital (GA4), herramientas de etiquetado (GTM) y lectura/evaluación de modelos de atribución para diagnosticar e implementar mediciones correctas.
  • Demuestres capacidad probada en gestión de crisis técnicas: resolución de cuentas suspendidas, auditoría de errores de pixeles/eventos y análisis de variaciones bruscas en métricas clave.
  • Tengas experiencia orientando, formando y haciendo mentoring a especialistas de nivel Junior y Semi Senior.
  • Destques por tu capacidad de comunicación técnica y consultiva frente a clientes y stakeholders, simplificando conceptos complejos con solidez argumentativa.
  • Mantengas una actitud curiosa e innovadora, utilizando herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial de forma activa en tus tareas cotidianas de análisis y producción.


Nuestros beneficios

  • Medicina Prepaga OSDE 260 para vos y tu grupo familiar.
  • Gympass.
  • Días de descanso extra.
  • Remote First Policy (política de teletrabajo).
  • Regalo de cumpleaños y momentos especiales.
  • Día off por cumpleaños.
  • Plataforma de beneficios Maslow.
  • Acceso a capacitaciones regulares.


Modalidad de contratación: Híbrida.

descriptionHtml:
En Tsoft seguimos creciendo y buscamos sumar Territory Marketing Analyst para impulsar la estrategia de Marketing de los territorios asignados, trabajando de forma cercana con los equipos comerciales para identificar oportunidades, generar demanda y contribuir al crecimiento del negocio.

Buscamos una persona con visión estratégica, orientación digital y fuerte capacidad de ejecución, capaz de transformar desafíos comerciales en campañas e iniciativas de Marketing medibles y de impacto.


¿Cuáles serán tus desafíos?


Estrategia y planificación

  • Diseñar y ejecutar planes de Marketing alineados con los objetivos comerciales y regionales.
  • Trabajar junto a los equipos de Sales para identificar oportunidades, segmentos y necesidades del mercado.
  • Proponer iniciativas que potencien la generación de demanda, el posicionamiento y el crecimiento del negocio.
  • Analizar tendencias de mercado, competencia y nuevas oportunidades.


Demand Generation & Digital Marketing

  • Liderar campañas de generación de demanda para los mercados asignados.
  • Definir junto al equipo de Marketing Digital audiencias, canales, mensajes, objetivos y KPIs.
  • Analizar métricas y resultados para optimizar el rendimiento de las campañas.
  • Gestionar y dar seguimiento a leads y oportunidades mediante herramientas digitales y CRM.


Eventos y activaciones

  • Planificar y ejecutar eventos, webinars, ferias y activaciones.
  • Integrar estas iniciativas dentro de campañas de Marketing más amplias.
  • Medir resultados, impacto y retorno de inversión (ROI).


Trabajo con Sales

Description

Imaginative, curious, and adaptable — you sweat the small stuff, because you know that great design is in the details.

You are creative, inspired, and driven to produce innovative design. You are self-motivated — you have a true passion coupled with the exceptional ability to translate the vision of our clients into high quality and impactful imagery. Such talent and ingenuity make you the right fit for this unique Graphic Design Digital Designer role with Boldsky.

Mid-Level Graphic Designer: Core contributor to projects, owns bigger pieces and proficient at adhering to brand standards. They work with all the information at their disposal and use their skill set and knowledge to solve problems.

Mid-Level Digital Designer: To shape the product development process with a user-centric mentality. You will help create visual elements for websites, mobile apps and other formats, lead user research, brainstorm ideas to inform the product development process and work with internal and external tech teams for implementation.

Responsibilities:

  • Understand and implement direction from the art/copy and development teams.
  • As a Designer you will switch gears, successfully juggle responsibilities, and move across multiple projects while ensuring that files are built correctly.
  • Demonstrate ownership of assigned Brand work by continually coming up with new ideas proactively. Ability and willingness to show ownership of Brand work from a visual standpoint.
  • Work within InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator (using Adobe CC suite) to create stand-out work.
  • Must be proficient at Figma, Sketch, and Adobe XD
  • Social media content
  • Website design
  • Interactive/digital content
  • Booth/Congress multimedia interfaces
  • Understanding of information architecture

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design or related field, with agency/studio experience.
  • 5–10 years’ experience in Graphic Design.
  • Expertise in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat).
  • Extensive prepress knowledge including formats, resolution, and four-color printing.
  • Excellent communication and direction-giving skills.
  • Strong design sense: layout, composition, hierarchy, typography, and color.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Team player with ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently under deadlines.
  • 3-7 years’ experience creating mid to large scale corporate and campaign websites
  • Excellence at designing a brand experience across multiple channels, including web and mobile
  • Experience designing for healthcare and pharma
  • Expertise in developing wireframes and prototypes
  • Prototyping tools like Sketch, Figma and Adobe XD, along with Adobe Creative Suite, Jira, and MS Office Suite a plus
  • You have a high-level understanding of SEO and ability to speak to it a plus.

Should also be:

  • Conceptually Creative: Ability to think in abstract terms; make connections between unrelated notions; formulate innovative ideas where others cannot; seen as original and value-added in brainstorming sessions
  • Able to Understand and Implement Direction: Can understand creative direction based on objectives and execute creative work effectively. Understands the concept of talent-to-task and communicates well with others on workload issues & needs, progress of work and results
  • Industry Application: Picks up on technical things quickly; is good at learning new industry, company, product, and/or technical knowledge developments of the client's business as well as the agency business; has the functional and technical knowledge and skills to do the job at a high level of accomplishment
  • Demonstrating Ownership and Proactivity: Demonstrates ownership of assigned Brand work by continually coming up with new ideas proactively. Ability and willingness to show ownership of Brand work from a visual standpoint
  • Willingness to be Flexible: Willing to work outside of job description as needed, be flexible for the team, and ultimately the work.

At Syneos Health Communications, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

BoldSky Creative Studio supports more than 12+ Syneos Health marketing and communication agencies as well as direct-to-customer engagements. We function as the agencies' creative execution and production arm, implementing their creative vision. As part of Syneos Health, our agencies — consisting of leading brands and experts in advertising, branding, public relations, managed markets and medical communications — are engaged in every point of influence in health, providing real-world insight into markets and audiences in ways that no other partner could.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, flexible paid time off (PTO). Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable national/federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

Job Description

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Language requirement: Fluent English (spoken and written)

We are seeking a Cybersecurity IAM Engineer to design, implement, and optimize identity and access solutions across our global infrastructure. This role plays a key part in securing user and system identities across Okta, Azure AD, Active Directory, and AWS IAM, enabling secure digital operations while enforcing Zero Trust and least privilege at scale.

As an IAM Engineer, you'll go beyond processing tickets—you'll build automations, optimize SSO and federation integrations, enforce policy controls through scripting, and work with cross-functional teams to secure identity lifecycles across IT and OT environments. Come and join a great team who are driving tomorrow’s cybersecurity.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain IAM solutions across Okta, Azure AD, Active Directory, and AWS IAM
  • Integrate and manage SSO and MFA for cloud and on-prem applications using SAML, OAuth, WS-Federation, and SCIM
  • Automate identity workflows, group assignments, access revocations, and certification campaigns using tools like PowerShell, Python, or Okta Workflows
  • Enforce access controls aligned to Zero Trust, RBAC, and JML (Joiner-Mover-Leaver) lifecycle policies
  • Harden IAM configurations in hybrid environments (e.g., password policies, conditional access, privileged account handling)
  • Participate in the evaluation and integration of IAM-related technologies and security enhancements
  • Collaborate with IT, cloud, HRIS, and security engineering teams to embed identity governance in enterprise systems
  • Assist with privileged access management (PAM), identity federation design, and directory service integrations
  • Support audit and compliance efforts by maintaining evidence, resolving control gaps, and improving access visibility
  • Other duties as assigned by organization leadership

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 4–8 years of professional experience.
  • Possess strong communications and interpersonal skills in English
  • Self-directed, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Strong ability to work collaboratively with others, to influence based on knowledge and experience
  • Strong experience with identity platforms: Okta, Azure AD, Active Directory, AWS IAM
  • Hands-on knowledge of authentication standards: SAML, OAuth, OIDC, WS-Federation
  • Proficiency in scripting or automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash)
  • Experience with identity lifecycle automation, group policy management, and access governance tooling
  • Working knowledge of federated identity, MFA, conditional access, and directory sync processes
  • Familiarity with IAM-related components of frameworks like NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications: Okta, Azure, CompTIA Security+, or similar
  • Experience with identity governance platforms
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or SOX
  • Experience with identity governance platforms and PAM solutions
  • Familiarity with AI or LLM tooling for identity analytics, automation, or anomaly detection

Why NOV?

  • Build identity security controls at global scale for a diversified energy and technology leader
  • Be part of a security team driving Zero Trust transformation across IT and OT
  • Use modern IAM platforms with the freedom to innovate and automate

About NOV

NOV delivers technology-driven solutions to empower the global energy industry. For more than 150 years, NOV has pioneered innovations that enable its customers to safely produce abundant energy while minimizing environmental impact. The energy industry depends on NOV’s deep expertise and technology to continually improve oilfield operations and assist in efforts to advance the energy transition towards a more sustainable future.

At NOV, we are a globally diverse happy family, driven to power the people who power the world.

🔥 BÚSQUEDA URGENTE | TÉCNICOS DE INSTALACIONES FIJAS CONTRA INCENDIO


Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de 4 Técnicos de Instalaciones Fijas Contra Incendio para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de trabajo.


🛠️ ¿Qué buscamos?


Buscamos perfiles técnicos, responsables y comprometidos, con experiencia y conocimientos en mantenimiento de sistemas contra incendio.


Orientamos la búsqueda a Técnicos Electromecánicos, Electrónicos, Mecánicos o con formación afín, con conocimientos y/o experiencia en:


- Sistemas de detección de incendios.

- Funcionamiento y prueba de centrales de detección.

- Detectores y avisadores manuales.

- Sistemas de extinción.

- Bombas de incendio.

- Rociadores automáticos.

- Gabinetes de hidrantes.

- Estaciones de control y alarma.

- Mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de instalaciones fijas contra incendio.


👉 Será especialmente valorada la experiencia en programación de centrales de detección.


🔧 Principales responsabilidades


- Ejecutar servicios técnicos diarios en la cartera de clientes.

- Realizar mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de los sistemas contra incendio.

- Verificar el correcto funcionamiento y operatividad de los equipos e instalaciones.

- Detectar y resolver fallas.

- Realizar pruebas y controles de los sistemas.

- Mantener las instalaciones existentes en condiciones operativas.

- Cumplir con los cronogramas de trabajo establecidos.

- Elaborar informes y completar/firma de registros técnicos correspondientes.

- Cumplir con los procedimientos y estándares de calidad de la organización.

- Atender a los clientes con profesionalismo y excelente trato.

- Cumplir con los requerimientos establecidos por los coordinadores del área.


📋 Requisitos excluyentes


- Experiencia y/o conocimientos comprobables en instalaciones fijas contra incendio.

- Registro de conducir vigente.

- Manejo de herramientas manuales, máquinas y herramientas.

- Buena predisposición para realizar tareas de mantenimiento en obra y en instalaciones de clientes.

- Destreza para la manipulación de equipos y extintores.

- Indicar remuneración pretendida (excluyente).


💪 ¿Qué valoramos?


Buscamos personas:


- Responsables y comprometidas con las tareas realizadas.

- Con iniciativa y autonomía.

- Con interés en incorporar nuevos conocimientos.

- Con marcada orientación al cliente interno y externo.

- Con capacidad para trabajar en equipo.

- Con buenas relaciones interpersonales.

- Con facilidad para adaptarse a diferentes contextos y necesidades.

- Con vocación de servicio y orientación a la calidad.


🚀 ¿Qué ofrecemos?


- Capacitación permanente.

- Desarrollo y crecimiento profesional.

- Posibilidad de poner en práctica y ampliar tus conocimientos técnicos.

- Incorporación a un equipo especializado en protección contra incendios.


📍 Lugar de trabajo: Munro


🕐 Jornada: Completa


📩 Postulate enviando tu CV e indicando remuneración pretendida.


Si tenés experiencia en mantenimiento de sistemas contra incendio y querés formar parte de nuestro equipo, ¡te estamos buscando!

#SomosNaranjaX y nos une el propósito de trabajar por la inclusión y la educación financiera de millones de personas. Más de 9.5 millones de clientes nos eligen cada día porque confían en Naranja X para alcanzar sus sueños.

Estamos creando un ecosistema de soluciones tecnológicas financieras que se diferencia por ofrecer la mejor experiencia y facilidad en el acceso.

¿Querés ser protagonista de esta historia e impulsar la transformación financiera de millones de personas? ¡Súmate!

Resumen del Rol

Como Product Manager del squad de Embargos y Oficios Judiciales, serás responsable de transformar y automatizar un proceso crítico de cumplimiento regulatorio y legal, convirtiendo un flujo tradicionalmente reactivo y manual en una solución digital de alto impacto, eficiente y alineada con los estándares de la industria fintech.

¿Cómo lo hacemos?

Funcionamos como un one team. Entregamos valor continuo, iterativo e incremental. Colaboramos en equipo con flexibilidad y confianza. Decidimos con autonomía alineada. Medimos para aprender y mejorar en ciclos cortos. Somos hands on y nos apoyamos en la AI para acelerar nuestras decisiones y ejecuciones.

¿Qué desafíos vas a encontrar en esta posición?

  • Construir un producto excepcional, único y desafiante basado en un negocio sustentable dentro de dominios de alto impacto en la vida de millones de personas a través de la inclusión y educación financiera.
  • Crear la visión one team del squad junto al TL y al líder de UX.
  • Definir, gestionar y hacer seguimiento de los KRS del squad; así como también del armado y priorización del backlog
  • Velar por la calidad del producto, definiendo, monitoreando y gestionando métricas críticas como: time to impact, calidad y resolución.
  • Priorizar y repriorizar de manera rápida y ágil el backlog, producto de la iteración y los insights y métricas que genera constantemente.
  • Liderar el equipo, generar conversaciones de feedback 360° y dirigidas a todos los miembros del squad.
  • Atraer, fidelizar y potenciar el desarrollo del talento necesario para su squad

¿Qué buscamos?

  • Experiencia: al menos 4 años de experiencia como Product Manager en entornos digitales o fintech.
  • Uso de herramientas de AI: principales LLMs, N8N, Codex/Claude Code.
  • Sólidos conocimientos y experiencia en la definición funcional, especificación de requerimientos e integración de Model Context Protocol (MCP) para sistemas de IA.
  • Personas apasionadas por la tecnología, por crear y competir en equipo, que estén convencidos de que aprendiendo con otros llegamos al lugar donde queremos estar.
  • Personas que necesiten ser desafiadas, que quieran ser parte de un equipo de alto rendimiento en evolución constante y que encuentren un espacio seguro para arriesgarse.
  • Interés por trabajar buscando velocidad, impacto y eficiencia.
  • Goal oriented-mindset
  • Liderazgo, pensamiento sistémico y problem solving skills.
  • Conocimiento y experiencia liderando equipos en la creación, implementación y evolución continua de desarrollo de productos digitales.
  • Entendimiento de metodologías ágiles, de implementación de mejora continua, para agregar valor sprint a sprint.
  • Experiencia en Data Analytics y tools relacionadas a la explotación y análisis de datos.
  • Conocimiento de tecnología
  • Deseable (No Excluyente): Conocimiento o experiencia previa en procesos legales, regulación bancaria o embargos. (Priorizamos el mindset, capacidad de ejecución y foco en AI sobre el conocimiento de dominio específico).

Sumarte a La Experiencia NX Es

📍 Modo Flex: Creemos en la presencia más que en la presencialidad. Trabajá de manera híbrida y flexible: desde casa, oficina o mixto.

🌍 #WorkFromAnywhere: desde cualquier parte del país o el mundo.

🌴 Más días de descanso: Además de vacaciones, tenés días libres NX desde el inicio para elegir cuando quieras.

💸 Ajustes de sueldo periódicos que acompañan el contexto económico.

💻 Reintegros por gastos de internet y servicios.

🍔 Reintegro en compras de supermercado y restaurantes

🤩 Programas de capacitación constante y plataformas de E-learning (Udemy) para potenciar tu desarrollo.

👶 Licencia extendida y flexibilidad al regreso para gestantes y no gestantes. + Licencias especiales para el cuidado de tu familia.

🥰Y una propuesta de valor mucho más amplia pensada para acompañarte en cada momento y desarrollar todo tu potencial.

En Naranja X promovemos un espacio de trabajo seguro e inclusivo, donde podés desplegar tu talento, tus ideas y tu magia.

Nuestras búsquedas son abiertas y equitativas para todas las personas: teniendo en cuenta diversidad de género, etaria, de religiones, ideas y opiniones, nacionalidad, personas con discapacidad, LGBTIQ+. ¡Mientras más diversos sean nuestros equipos, mayor será nuestra capacidad de agregar valor a las finanzas de las personas!

descriptionHtml:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.

At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.

Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Project Manager with experience managing technical projects to work as a consultant out of our Brazil or Argentina office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we are starting work with a new client, and this hire will shape the client's first impression of Pyyne.

A successful candidate in this role will manage delivery for the client's data strategy and analytics team and build trust with stakeholders through clear communication, honest reporting, and reliable follow-through.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own delivery planning and execution for the client's data strategy and analytics team, including scope, roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and risks.
  • Turn business priorities from client stakeholders into a prioritized backlog and clear work for the team, and keep priorities aligned as they change.
  • Build trust with client leaders from the first weeks by communicating clearly, reporting risks early and honestly, and following through on every commitment.
  • Run planning, review, and retrospective ceremonies and keep progress visible through regular status updates to the client and to Pyyne.
  • Identify blockers and cross-team dependencies early, and escalate them with options and a recommendation.
  • Manage scope, expectations, and change requests with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Represent Pyyne in client meetings and surface opportunities to expand the engagement.

Must Have Skills:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project or delivery management.
  • Demonstrated experience building trust with senior business stakeholders in a client-facing or consulting setting.
  • Experience running Agile delivery and managing backlogs, roadmaps, and status reporting for a technical team.
  • Working knowledge of data and analytics concepts (such as data pipelines, reporting, and dashboards), enough to plan work and question estimates.
  • Very strong written and verbal English, for daily collaboration with client stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Prior experience as a consultant or embedded in client teams through staff augmentation.
  • Experience managing data or data platform teams, or with data strategy, governance, or BI initiatives.
  • Project management or Agile certification (for example PMP or CSM).
  • Experience in retail, e-commerce, or manufacturing environments.
  • Experience managing delivery for distributed teams across time zones.

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Apply anyway! At our core, we value growth, adaptability, and passion just as much as a checklist of skills. If you are excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every tech requirement, we still encourage you to apply. The only non-negotiable for us is fluent English, as you'll be collaborating daily with global teams. If you’ve got the language skills and the drive to learn, you might be exactly who we are looking for to bring a fresh perspective to our team!

descriptionHtml:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.

As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.

We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.

If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.

Let’s build what’s next, together.

What This Role Is All About

As an Account Executive, you will drive new business growth by selling Infobip’s solutions to Tier 1 clients within your assigned territory. You will identify new opportunities across existing and prospective customers, manage complex sales cycles, and build long-term client relationships focused on growth and account health. This is a highly consultative role that combines strategic prospecting, solution selling, negotiation, and customer ownership during the first 12 months of the client lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage and grow a target account list within your assigned territory
  • Sell Infobip solutions directly or through partners to Tier 1 customers
  • Identify new business opportunities and proactively recommend tailored solutions
  • Build solution proposals and value propositions aligned with customer needs
  • Manage sales activities including forecasting, account planning, and resource coordination
  • Negotiate pricing and contractual agreements to close new business
  • Support end-to-end client relationships during the first 12 months, including retention, cross-sell, upsell, and expansion activities
  • Build trusted relationships with customers and maintain strong account health
  • Keep CRM data accurate and up to date throughout the sales cycle
  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to secure new business and customer growth
  • Provide guidance and mentoring to other team members when needed

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • 5+ years of experience in sales or account management roles
  • Experience in software, SaaS, or technology sales environments
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills with experience managing complex sales cycles
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strategic and consultative sales approach with strong customer focus
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong organizational skills and CRM discipline
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel and PowerPoint
  • Fluent English, spoken and written

Why you'll love it here

  • Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
  • Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.
  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
  • Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
  • Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path. 
  • Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
  • International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection

Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.

Read more about our hiring process.

As our hiring team is international, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English to ensure it can be reviewed by all stakeholders.

Work where work matters.

We are a global technology group built for what's next, offering high calibre professionals the platform for high stakes work, the kind of work that defines an entire career. When you join us, you're not just taking on projects, you're solving problems that don't even have answers yet.

You will join an exclusive roster of talent that global leaders, including Google, Snap, Diageo, PayPal, and Jaguar Land Rover call when deadlines seem impossible, when others have already tried and failed, and when the solution absolutely has to work.  

Forget routine consultancy. You will operate where technology, design, and human behaviour meet to deliver tangible outcomes, fast. This is work that leaves a mark, work you'll be proud to tell your friends about.

We are looking for a Lead Experience Designer to join our delivery center in Buenos Aires. 

We look for people who embody:

Innovation to solve the hardest problems.

‍Accountability for every result.

‍Integrity always.

About The Role



Role Overview


We're looking for a Lead Experience Designer to join our growing creative team. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to lead and influence all experience design activities across the lifecycle of a project — from running client workshops and conducting user interviews, through to partnering on concepts and bringing prototypes to life.

While this is primarily a maker role that will see you heavily involved in the work, you'll have regular opportunities to partner closely with CDs and ACDs, be a leading voice in the day-to-day of projects, and gain skills and experience that will set you up the next step in your creative career.

Above all, you're an awesome human who loves being surrounded by — and collaborating with — smart, talented folks in a fun, fast-paced environment.

Role Responsibilities

  • Support CDs/ACDs in guiding multidisciplinary teams to define products, services, and experiences end-to-end, from information architecture and research, through to user journeys and prototype, and finally interaction and branding.
  • Partner with user researchers to plan, design and conduct user research utilising a variety of methodologies, including both quantitative and qualitative research. You will use this knowledge to inform all parts of your process including developing personas and user journeys.
  • Facilitate workshops to align teams on user goals, building a foundation of trust and shared responsibility for the final product. Ensure UX plays a critical role in solution design, user flows, and overall product strategy, not just front-end deliverables.
  • Translate user needs and business goals into static designs and interactive mockups to provide a clear, working reference for engineers and stakeholders.
  • Create compelling presentations and communicate the reasoning behind your work to all audiences.
  • Collaborate across disciplines to refine designs, address technical trade-offs, and ensure a high-quality, polished launch..
  • Intimate knowledge of working with Figma and other collaboration tools to build a single source of truth, allowing for real-time feedback and direct access to design specs.

What Success Looks Like


  • 8+ years of experience in UX/experience design (agency or in-house).
  • Excellent UX thinking and design system skills, complemented by an understanding of how to translate these into beautiful, effective designs.
  • Understanding of AI concepts, including conversational surfaces, multimodal interfaces, agentic systems, and responsible AI.
  • Proven ability to translate business challenges, user insights, and UX best practices into human-first, commercially valuable designs.
  • Experience participating in pitches and inspiring clients with visionary, yet credible, design solutions is desirable.
  • Experience guiding/mentoring other creatives to ensure your vision/research/strategy is understood and can be creatively acted upon is a big plus.

Benefits

We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. Here's how we invest in you:

  • Work from Home Allowance
  • Private Medical Insurance for family group
  • Birthday leave
  • 10 paid learning days per year
  • Bonusly 100 points per month to recognise colleagues

Diversity and Inclusion

At Beyond we champion diversity and inclusion. We believe that a career in IT should be open to everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability or neurotype. We value the unique talents and perspectives that each individual brings to our team, and we strive to create a fair and accessible hiring process for all.

About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The Role:

The Senior Interactive Project Manager (SPM) works closely with the Clients Interactive Producers to implement campaigns in the assigned region. The SPM is expected to lead and manage digital projects while bringing together a multi-disciplinary team comprising of internal and external resources as required. He/she needs to provide an optimum interactive solution for the client that answers the brief within all the necessary specified style and technical guidelines. 

This person will work closely with Front-End Developers, Production Designers and QA Engineers on a day-to-day basis and will also need to engage with other cross-functional teams of project managers to ensure work is delivered on time, on quality and within budget.

The Senior Interactive PM’s primary task is to lead his/her team and that includes creating structure and processes that support the development of excellent work. He/She will manage quarterly planning efforts to align resources and funding, to prioritize, manage budgets, distribute workload, and personnel management.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set and manage client expectations while coordinating and ensuring all parties follow the agreed workflows
  • Build strong, trusting relationships with all key stakeholders, function leads, cross-functional project managers, senior managers, and third-party vendors that are directly involved with the work
  • Manage the approval of quarterly budgets, flagging important budget fluctuations to the client and line manager
  • Draft, prepare and present timelines, documents, and presentations and reports both to the client and to the team
  • Ensure that the line manager is always aware of all client issues and proposed solutions (including potential delays) to ensure swift resolution and avoid further escalation
  • Ensure your account consistently delivers against all contractual obligations including SLAs and KPIs
  • Act as a brand QC/Guardian – always ensure brand guidelines, QC checklists and procedures are followed
  • Keep the Head of interactive and the Project Director informed of any circumstances which would positively or negatively affect forecasts
  • Organize teamwork, create balanced work schedule and ensure people are able to deliver results
  • Identify training requirements for team members to ensure their adherence to processes and workflow
  • Plan resources for overseas projects and inform talent manager and line manager of new recruitment needs
  • Plan, prepare and implement the induction of new starters

Requirements:

  • A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 8 years solid Project Management experience in a similar capacity
  • Very high competence in project management software such as Microsoft Project and Omniplan
  • Extensive experience in costing, quotations and project scope definition
  • Excellent communication skills to different target groups within the project team, management and clients
  • Ensure understanding of the contractual obligations, commercial arrangements and SLAs of the accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the wider team where relevant
  • Analytical and detailed in project documentation, accountability and tracking
  • Pragmatic, team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Understanding of brands and brand challenges
  • The ability to function productively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
  • High level of IT literacy, including use of spreadsheets
  • Strong numeracy skills
  • Support HOI/PD and FD in revenue forecasting on an ongoing basis
  • Keep HOI/PD and FD informed of any circumstances which would positively or negatively affect forecasts
  • Ensure full compliance with all financial procedure and policies
  • Prioritization, time management, and attention to detail
  • Resilience and ability to work under pressure
  • Excellent communication skills, written and verbal English
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Highly organized, detail oriented, customer focused, and proactive
  • Possess technical understanding of mobile and web technologies necessary to run projects and convey details. Examples would be:
  • iOS and Android development
  • Cloud computing
  • HTML5/CSS/JavaScript
  • eCommerce/Shopping Carts
  • Social Media Strategies/Platforms
  • Familiarity with creative production and development tools is always an advantage. Such software includes Adobe Creative Suite, BBEdit, SVN, Github, Esclipse, DreamWeaver, Final Cut Pro and others. In addition, familiarity with mobile and web platforms and ecosystems would also be advantageous
  • Must be able to work on-site full-time as required, sometimes for several weeks at a time

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.

Responsabilidades

  • Cierre contable y reportes
  • Participar en el cierre mensual: provisiones, devengos, amortizaciones y diferencias de cambio.
  • Preparar papeles de trabajo trazables a cada comprobante como soporte del balance y del estado de resultados.

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.


We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.


Job Summary:

Toptal is looking for a Marketing Analyst to build and own the marketing data infrastructure to support new businesses and companies we acquire through M&A. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. You will track paid advertising performance and translate it into metrics such as LTV and ROAS that inform budget allocation and channel strategy, from structuring the underlying data pipelines to developing the reports that help marketing and business leaders make data-driven decisions.


Are you passionate about bringing rigor to how early-stage businesses measure and optimize acquisition spend from day one? If so, we encourage you to apply! This person will define the metrics that matter, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports that drive decisions. They will also build models, forecast outcomes, run experiments, and perform in-depth diagnostic analysis.


Ultimate success goes beyond data-related activities, you’ll be delivering the “so what” that drives decisions and real business impact. It is imperative to fully understand each business (processes, objectives, organization, performance drivers, barriers), and connect the dots between paid acquisition data, marketing strategy, and financial and operational effectiveness. This role partners closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions, ensuring marketing performance insights are integrated with the broader business and revenue picture. We expect that we not only answer the question asked, but also the question that was not.


This Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude.


This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.


Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions.
  • Build, own, and maintain the marketing data infrastructure, from ad impression and click through lead acquisition to revenue, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other paid advertising platforms as required.
  • Rapidly assess and integrate the marketing data of newly acquired (M&A) companies, establishing tracking, attribution, and reporting so their acquisition spend is measured with the same rigor as the rest of Toptal.
  • Measure and diagnose paid advertising performance across channels and businesses—analyzing spend efficiency, CAC, funnel conversion, lead value, ROAS, and LTV—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy.
  • Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives, including consistent definitions of LTV, ROAS, and payback across businesses.
  • Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders and business owners.
  • Partner closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions to connect marketing performance with revenue, unit economics, and the broader business picture.
  • Map marketing processes and channel journeys to their corresponding data flows across acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Technology to lead a high-performing engineering team within the Tax & Accounting area. This leader will be responsible for driving business results through strong technical leadership, operational excellence, and close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. The role requires a leader who can combine strategic thinking, technical depth, and people leadership to help evolve the organization’s technology capabilities. The ideal candidate will bring experience leading teams through modern software engineering transformation, including cloud adoption, AI-enabled ways of working, and scalable engineering practices, while maintaining a strong focus on customer value, delivery quality, and team performance.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the Technology team to achieve business outcomes and deliver value aligned with organizational priorities. Drive the adoption and evolution of modern software engineering practices, cloud architecture, and Generative AI capabilities. Provide strong technical leadership by guiding the team on how to execute effectively in technology, being hands-on when necessary. Contribute to the roadmap and execution strategy for Tax & Accounting products. Promote a transformation mindset, challenging the status quo and helping the organization evolve toward more efficient and scalable ways of working. Ensure high-quality, high-speed software delivery with a strong focus on customer experience and business impact. Establish and reinforce modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Testing, Trunk-Based Development, Progressive Delivery, Visual Management, WIP Control, and Small Batch Delivery. Drive both effectiveness and efficiency. Build a benchmark technology operation focused on consistency, quality, and speed. Lead the implementation and continuous evolution of a loosely coupled cloud architecture. Promote and strengthen engineering standards across cloud-native development, FinOps practices, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), monitoring and observability, incident management, capacity planning, security and resilience. Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of approximately 10 to 15 professionals. Foster an environment of accountability, ownership, psychological safety, belonging and retention, learning and continuous improvement, and clear communication. Drive active mentoring and talent development with emphasis on building future leaders. Build strong, lasting partnerships with key stakeholders across Product, Business, Customer Support, and other Technology Business Units. Navigate a complex stakeholder environment and ensure technology efforts remain aligned with business priorities. Act as a trusted technology partner capable of influencing decisions and driving alignment. Drive continuous optimization of processes, team capacity, and delivery models. Ensure smart resource allocation and maximize return on investment. Promote a practical, results-oriented mindset focused on achieving more with less without compromising quality or team health.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Professional English proficiency. Significant experience in technology leadership roles managing engineering teams. Strong background in software development and solution architecture. Demonstrated experience with modern software engineering practices and engineering transformation. Experience leading teams in environments that have adopted or are scaling AI-enabled practices. Strong experience with cloud technologies and modern distributed systems. Proven ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders and partner effectively with business and product leaders. Experience leading teams in fast-changing, ambiguous, or evolving environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in Tax & Accounting, enterprise platforms, or similarly complex product environments. Exposure to GenAI adoption, engineering productivity transformation, and operational scale initiatives. Experience implementing or leading FinOps, SRE, and engineering efficiency programs.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido: Hemos adoptado un entorno de trabajo híbrido y flexible para nuestros roles en oficina, ofreciendo una experiencia fluida que está conectada digital y físicamente.
  • Flexibilidad y Equilibrio entre Trabajo y Vida Personal: "Flex My Way" Consiste en un conjunto de políticas de apoyo en el entorno laboral, diseñadas para facilitar la gestión de las responsabilidades personales y profesionales, ya sea atendiendo a la familia, participando en actividades comunitarias o dedicando tiempo al descanso y la renovación personal. Estas políticas se basan en nuestro enfoque flexible de trabajo, que permite a los empleados trabajar desde cualquier lugar hasta 8 semanas al año, promoviendo así un equilibrio ideal entre sus compromisos laborales y personales.
  • Desarrollo y Crecimiento Profesional: Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de habilidades, preparando a nuestro talento para enfrentar los desafíos del futuro y ofrecer soluciones reales. Nuestro programa "Grow My Way" y el enfoque en habilidades garantizan que tengas las herramientas y conocimientos para crecer, liderar y prosperar en un futuro habilitado por la inteligencia artificial.
  • Beneficios Competitivos del Sector: Ofrecemos planes de beneficios integrales que incluyen seguros de gastos médicos, dos días de descanso por salud mental a nivel de la empresa, programas de incentivos para empleados y recursos para el bienestar mental, físico y financiero.
  • Cultura: Reconocida globalmente con una reputación premiada por inclusión y pertenencia, flexibilidad, equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal, y más. Vivimos nuestros valores: Obsesión por nuestros Clientes, Competir para Ganar, Desafiar nuestro Pensamiento, Actuar Rápido / Aprender Rápido, y Más Fuertes Juntos.
  • Impacto Social: Genera un impacto en tu comunidad con nuestro Instituto de Impacto Social. Ofrecemos a los empleados dos días de voluntariado pagados anualmente y oportunidades para involucrarse en proyectos de consultoría pro bono e iniciativas de Medio Ambiente, Sociales y de Gobernanza (ESG).
  • Haciendo un Impacto Real en el Mundo: Somos una de las pocas compañías a nivel global que asiste a sus clientes en la búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Trabajando en conjunto con los profesionales e instituciones a los que servimos, contribuimos a sostener el estado de derecho, fomentar el comercio, detectar a los infractores, informar sobre los hechos y ofrecer información confiable e imparcial a personas en todo el mundo.

Quiénes somos

Thomson Reuters marca el camino hacia el futuro al reunir contenido confiable y la tecnología que las personas y organizaciones necesitan para tomar decisiones correctas. Servimos a profesionales en los sectores legal, fiscal, contable, de cumplimiento, gubernamental y de medios. Nuestros productos combinan software altamente especializado e información para capacitar a los profesionales con los datos, inteligencia y soluciones necesarias para tomar decisiones informadas y ayudar a las instituciones en su búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Reuters, parte de Thomson Reuters, es un proveedor líder mundial de periodismo y noticias confiables.

Contamos con el talento de 26,000 colaboradores en más de 70 países, donde todos tienen la oportunidad de contribuir y crecer profesionalmente en entornos de trabajo flexibles. En un momento en el que la objetividad, precisión, equidad y transparencia están bajo ataque, nos comprometemos a buscarlos. ¿Suena emocionante? Forma parte de nuestro equipo y contribuye a moldear las industrias que impulsan el progreso de la sociedad.

Como empresa global, confiamos en los antecedentes únicos, perspectivas y experiencias de todos los empleados para cumplir con nuestros objetivos comerciales. Para asegurarnos de poder hacerlo, buscamos colaboradores talentosos y calificados en todas nuestras operaciones alrededor del mundo, sin importar raza, color, sexo/género, incluyendo embarazo, identidad y expresión de género, origen nacional, religión, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad, estado civil, estado de ciudadanía, condición de veterano u otra clasificación protegida bajo la ley aplicable. Thomson Reuters se enorgullece de ser un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades laborales, proporcionando un ambiente de trabajo libre de drogas.

Asimismo, ofrecemos adaptaciones razonables para personas calificadas con discapacidades y para aquellas con creencias religiosas sinceras, conforme a la legislación vigente. Puedes encontrar más información sobre cómo solicitar una adaptación aquí.

Descubre cómo protegerte de anuncios de empleo fraudulentos aquí. Para obtener más información sobre Thomson Reuters, visita nuestro sitio web en thomsonreuters.com

descriptionHtml:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking a Sales Operations Data Analyst who will play a pivotal role in shaping our sales strategy by providing reporting and valuable insights on sales data and activities. You will directly support sales leadership while driving the development and implementation of our sales analytics and data strategy, while identifying trends and recommend solutions or processes to drive sales effectiveness.

How You'll Contribute:

  • Creation, analysis, and distribution of reports and dashboards for Sales
  • Create ad-hoc reports and analysis as needed
  • Problem-solving and troubleshooting data reporting inaccuracies
  • Assist in creating, maintaining, and optimizing analytic models
  • Follow and develop reporting best practices
  • Transform data into actionable insights and visualize it effectively using tools like Looker
  • Demonstrate a passion for working with data and the ability to turn raw data into actionable insights
  • Serve as a liaison between our data needs and what is currently available, guiding data cleansing efforts when necessary
  • Possess the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders with data-driven insights

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a relevant discipline. Master's degree preferred
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst or Business Analyst, preferably with a focus on sales analytics
  • Advanced in SQL and Looker (not Looker Studio), and preferably LookML
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate complex findings and insights to non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to independently source and assess data for relevance
  • Familiarity with data cleansing processes and experience in data cleaning is a plus
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders.
  • Able to solve complex problems and successfully manage ambiguity and unexpected change
  • Nice to have experience using: Snowflake, Salesforce, dbt (data build tool), GitHub, Excel
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Please submit your resume in English

#Promoted

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

descriptionHtml:
About us:

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

We’re building the agentic OS for marketing. We aren't just using integrating generative AI; we are building the machine that makes it professional, brand-safe, and scalable. We’re moving beyond simple text-in/text-out interfaces toward complex multi-agent architectures that can handle the nuanced demands of global brands and the agility of small businesses.

We are looking for an Agent Architect who thinks in systems, not just sentences. You will be responsible for the "brain" of Pencil—designing the agent logic, tool-calling structures, and evaluation loops that power our core creative engine and bespoke client solutions.

The Role: Architecting the Creative Brain

You won’t just be "prompting"; you will be engineering behavior. You will bridge the gap between creative intent and machine execution, ensuring that our agents are robust, predictable, and capable of high-fidelity output across text, image, and video. This is a client-facing technical role: you’ll spend as much time in rooms with brand and agency stakeholders as you will in the system. You need to be able to lead a discovery conversation with a non-technical client, decompose their problem into an agent architecture, and explain your design choices in plain language.

Your work will fall into two high-impact pillars:

  • Core Systems: Designing and scaling the foundational agents that power the Pencil SaaS platform.
  • Client Solutions: Architecting custom workflows for world-class brands that require specific "brand DNA" and complex creative logic.

Key responsibilities:

  • Agent Architecture: Design and implement multi-agent workflows, including task decomposition, state management, and tool-use (RAG, API integration, etc.).
  • Systematic Optimization: Move beyond "vibe-based" testing. Implement rigorous evaluation frameworks (e.g., using LLM-as-a-judge, promptfoo, or DSPy) to measure and improve agent performance at scale.
  • Scalable Frameworks: Develop reusable agents and prompt libraries that allow the platform to serve 1,000+ brands with unique voices simultaneously.
  • Cross-Functional Engineering: Partner with AI Engineering and Product teams to determine which behaviors should be handled via prompting, RAG, or fine-tuning.
  • Client Architecture: Act as the technical lead for complex client deployments. Run structured discovery sessions with clients, decompose ambiguous business problems into buildable agent workflows, and present trade-offs (cost, latency, reliability) to non-technical stakeholders in plain terms.

Your background:

  • 3+ Years of Direct GenAI Experience: You have a deep, intuitive, and technical understanding of LLMs (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini) and multimodal models (Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, Video Gen).
  • Systems Thinking: You don’t just write a prompt; you think about the latent space, the context window, and how one agent's output becomes another’s input.
  • Technical Literacy: While this isn't a "Software Engineer" role, you should be comfortable with Python, JSON structures, and API documentation. Experience with agent orchestration patterns (task decomposition, tool use, state management) matters more than any specific framework.
  • Evaluation Obsession: You believe that if you can’t measure a prompt’s performance, you shouldn’t ship it. You are familiar with benchmarking and A/B testing AI outputs.
  • The "Creative/Technical" Bridge: You can sit in a room with a Creative Director and translate "make it feel more punchy" into a concrete change to the system. You are comfortable being the face of the technology in client meetings, not just the person behind it.
  • Client-Facing Problem Decomposition: Demonstrated experience leading discovery with customers or stakeholders and turning vague briefs into scoped technical solutions. Solutions architecture, forward-deployed engineering, or technical consulting backgrounds fit well here.
  • Plain-Language Communication: You can explain agent failure modes, eval results, and architectural trade-offs to a CMO without jargon, and you enjoy doing it.
  • You’ll Thrive Here If...
    • You find "hallucinations" to be a logic puzzle to be solved, not just a bug.
    • You are excited by the challenge of making an AI follow a 50-page brand book with 100% fidelity.
    • You want to build the infrastructure that defines how the next generation of advertising is created.
    • You’d rather sit with a confused client and untangle their problem than receive a perfect spec.
KPI & Success Measures

  • System Reliability: Reducing the "failure rate" of complex agent workflows.
  • Architectural Efficiency: Minimizing token usage/latency while increasing output quality.
  • Brand Alignment: Scoring of agent outputs against specific brand guidelines using automated evaluation tools.
  • Adoption at Scale: Core agents adopted and retained across the Pencil user base, not just shipped to it.
  • Client Deployment Success: Custom client workflows delivered on time and adopted by the client, measured from brief to live, not build complete.
  • Stakeholder Trust: Clients and internal partners come back to you to scope the next problem. Repeat engagement on strategic accounts and positive feedback on clarity of communication.

Benefits:

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme
  • Health insurance / private medical cover
  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development
  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country
  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy
  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees
  • Flexible working hours
