descriptionHtml:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About The Role

Halter is heading to South America. Argentina and Uruguay are two of the most exciting cattle markets in the world, and we're starting from scratch: no customers, no pipeline and no local processes yet. That's exactly why this role matters.

As our first Revenue Operations Manager in region, you'll lay the foundations the whole market will grow on. That means working out how deals actually move from first conversation to installed customer, getting the market set up properly in Salesforce, and shaping local pricing and deal desk with our Global Pricing & Packaging Manager. You'll also bring our first sales hires up to speed and build the reporting that tells us how the launch is going. Once things are up and running, the job shifts to keeping the market on plan and helping it grow.

You'll sit in our Revenue Operations & Enablement team, reporting into Auckland, with plenty of room to make your own calls. You'll quickly become someone senior leaders lean on, not just in sales and customer, but in finance, supply chain and right across the business

What your day could look like

As we get set up, your tasks may look different to when the market is fully established. Initially, it could look like…

  • Working out how a deal will realistically move from first conversation to installed customer in Argentina and Uruguay, and ensure our globalised funnel stages and handover processes align with what is needed in region.
  • Setting up the market in Salesforce with our Ecosystem team, including territories, currency, quoting and reports.
  • Working with our Global Pricing & Packaging Manager on local pricing and discount rules, taking currency and inflation into account
  • Starting weekly pipeline reviews and forecast calls with the first sales hires, and agreeing what each stage means
  • Training new sales team members on our tools and processes as they join
  • Making sure launch and support are ready before the first customer signs, with our Customer Revenue Operations Manager
  • Letting the team in New Zealand know what's different about this market and where our current approach needs to change

Then, once things are up and running your day could look like…

  • Running pipeline reviews with sales leaders and checking deals and stages are accurate
  • Looking into why conversion drops between stages and fixing the cause
  • Building reports that give leadership a clear view of the market without them having to ask
  • Supporting with the sales teams adoption of new tooling, or a feature that our Ecosystem team have just launched.
  • Writing up what you've built so the next market launch has something to start from
  • Feeding structured commercial intelligence back to HQ: what's working, what's not, what the market needs that our current playbook doesn't address

What we're looking for

Your background matters less than how you work. You might have come from sales or business operations, consulting or a customer-facing role, or been the person at a startup who kept everything running.

You may have built something from scratch before, whether that's a new market, team or function. You can move quickly without leaving a mess behind, and you set things up for scale, with the intention of giving these processes away when they are operationalised.

You care about data quality and the processes that drive it. In a new market, the habits set in the first few months are the ones we live with for years, so getting it right early matters to you. When something doesn't look right (whether it’s numbers or a customer experience), you look into it, find the root cause, resolve it, and reviewed that the fix actually worked.

People come to you for your opinion. You'll be a trusted partner to senior leaders across sales and customer, and well beyond them too, including finance, supply chain and other key parts of the business. You form a clear view, back it up with data, and help people make better decisions.

You're comfortable working autonomously, a long way from the rest of the team. Auckland is many hours ahead, so you'll sometimes need to make calls on your own from first principles.

You communicate clearly in Spanish and English with everyone from Territory Managers on farm to our Vice President of Sales, and you're happy to be direct.

You'll crush this role if you

  • Enjoy starting from nothing. There's no funnel, data or habits yet, and you find that exciting
  • Set things up to scale. What you build should work at 10 customers and at 10,000
  • Hold people to the plan. You'll push back when execution drifts from it
  • Spot where revenue is slipping before it shows up clearly in the data
  • Get good habits in early. It's much easier than fixing bad ones later
  • Share what you're learning. You give the team in New Zealand clear, useful insight about the market
  • Write things down. You document as you go so others can reuse your work
  • Already use AI day to day and keep looking for new ways it can help
  • Can influence people you don't manage. A lot of what you need sits with other teams, so you get things done through relationships and good insight

Bonus points if

  • You've launched a new market, region or business unit for a scaling company
  • You've worked in agriculture, ag-tech, SaaS, or hardware-led businesses where the sales motion is complex
  • You've operated in a multi-market or remote-from-headquarters setup before
  • You've worked with pricing or deal approvals in a high-inflation or multi-currency environment

Our Benefits

  • Delicious snacks and drinks are available for your daily flow.
  • Healthy body, healthy mind. We're partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.
  • We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.
  • Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.
  • Our time to recharge is valued, we're offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.
  • Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Our Office First Approach

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.
  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.
  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.
  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At EY, we’re more than just a professional services firm. We’re a global network united by a shared purpose to build a better working world. We empower our people to challenge the status quo, embrace innovation, and deliver lasting impact for our clients and communities.

CT Tech Activation brings together capabilities that help EY identify market demand, shape and commercialize technology offerings, support product delivery, and strengthen customer adoption and outcomes.

You will find a culture that prioritizes learning, collaboration and growth, providing you with the tools, support and freedom to thrive and shape your career.

The Opportunity

The Program Manager will provide dedicated support to the CTO helping translate strategic priorities into coordinated execution across the organization. The role will manage key operational requirements, coordinate cross-functional priorities, drive follow-through, and support the effective delivery of strategic initiatives and organizational capabilities.

This role requires a proactive, highly organized and strategically minded individual who can operate with discretion, work effectively with senior stakeholders, and bring structure and clarity to complex priorities. The Program Manager will serve as an integrator, advisor and execution partner, connecting work across teams, establishing effective operating rhythms, identifying risks and dependencies, and ensuring commitments progress from decision through execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Anticipate priorities and translate leadership direction into clear actions, owners, timelines and expected outcomes.
  • Manage key operational requirements and establish effective operating rhythms, including leadership agendas, business reviews, decision forums, planning cycles and follow-up mechanisms.
  • Coordinate cross-functional priorities and dependencies to support integrated execution across the organization.
  • Ideate and drive strategic initiatives from planning through implementation, maintaining visibility into milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions and outcomes.
  • Prepare executive briefings, presentations, talking points, reports and analysis to support effective leadership discussions and decision-making.
  • Capture key decisions and stakeholder inputs, track commitments and actions, raise barriers and ensure timely follow-through and accountability.
  • Support the development and implementation of organizational capabilities, governance, processes, tools and ways of working that improve effectiveness.
  • Partner with Finance, Talent, Operations, Communications and other enabling functions to coordinate business and organizational requirements.
  • Provide clear visibility into progress against strategic priorities, including risks, dependencies, capacity requirements and matters requiring leadership attention.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, coordination and operational efficiency.
  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the CTO bringing perspective, insight and constructive challenge to support stronger outcomes.

Skills & Attributes For Success

  • Strong program management and organizational skills, with demonstrated ability to move complex priorities from strategy through execution.
  • Strong strategy, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights, recommendations and actions -ability to translate vision into execution
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and the ability to engage and influence executives and senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities within a fast-paced and highly matrixed environment.
  • Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to maintain a broader strategic and organizational perspective.
  • Demonstrated discretion and ability to manage sensitive and confidential information.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across diverse teams, cultures and working styles.
  • High degree of accountability, adaptability and follow-through.
  • Confidence to appropriately challenge assumptions and surface issues requiring leadership attention.
  • Demonstrates and maintains the technical and functional proficiency required for the role and takes ownership of continuous learning and upskilling to keep skills current and aligned with evolving technology, role and business requirements.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement and effective use of AI and technology to improve productivity and effectiveness.

Ideally, the Candidate Will Have

  • Significant experience in program or portfolio management, business operations, strategy, transformation or a related discipline.
  • Have a passion and love for transformation and innovation
  • Experience supporting a senior executive and coordinating priorities across a complex, global and matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated success establishing governance and operating rhythms, managing interdependent workstreams, and driving execution against strategic priorities.
  • Experience preparing executive briefings, reports, presentations and decision-support materials.
  • Experience within technology delivery, commercialization, innovation, customer success or a professional services environment is preferred.
  • Ability to quickly learn EY’s operating structure, strategic priorities and leadership dynamics.

Job Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.

Experience

  • Approximately 8–10 years of experience in a medium to large environment, performing business analysis, business development and project management.
  • Direct experience managing medium to complex activities, such as business development and application development or deployment.
  • Project management training and practical application, along with business analysis, business development or relationship management experience, are preferred.

Certification Requirements

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is strongly preferred

descriptionHtml:
Somos PAE


Somos protagonistas del sector energético regional en empleo, producción, exportación e inversión privada.

Queremos acompañarte en tu desarrollo para que tu camino no tenga límites. Te proponemos ser integrante de un equipo de trabajo diverso que genera la energía que mueve al país.


Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Geocientista para sumarse al equipo de Exploración y Nuevos Proyectos en CABA. Buscamos profesionales con una fuerte base geofísica y sólida experiencia en interpretación sísmica, integración de datos de subsuelo, caracterización avanzada de reservorios y trabajo en equipos multidisciplinarios.


Los desafíos con los que te vas a encontrar en esta posición serán:

  • Interpretar y analizar información sísmica 2D y 3D para la caracterización de reservorios convencionales y/o no convencionales.
  • Calibración de pozos y generación de modelos de velocidad
  • Desarrollar modelos estructurales y estratigráficos integrados.
  • Realizar análisis de atributos sísmicos, inversiones sísmicas y estudios cuantitativos de reservorios.
  • Integrar información geológica, petrofísica, geomecánica, de producción y completación para mejorar el entendimiento del subsuelo.
  • Identificar sweet spots y apoyar la definición de estrategias de desarrollo de los activos.
  • Brindar soporte geofísico a la planificación y perforación de pozos.
  • Participar en la construcción y actualización de modelos estáticos de reservorio.
  • Colaborar estrechamente con geólogos, ingenieros de reservorios, perforación y completación.
  • Comunicar resultados, recomendaciones y riesgos técnicos a distintos niveles de la organización.


Para este puesto es requisito:

  • Título universitario en Geofísica, Geología o carreras afines.
  • Experiencia comprobable en proyectos de reservorios no convencionales (shale oil, shale gas o tight reservoirs).
  • Amplios conocimientos en interpretación sísmica y caracterización integrada de reservorios.
  • Experiencia en análisis de atributos sísmicos, inversiones, AVO y otras herramientas de interpretación cuantitativa.
  • Capacidad para trabajar en equipos multidisciplinarios y gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente.
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas, de comunicación y presentación.
  • Nivel avanzado de inglés, oral y escrito.

Se valorará especialmente:

  • Estudios de posgrado (Maestría o Doctorado) en Geociencias.
  • Experiencia en activos de la Cuenca Neuquina y/o desarrollos de Vaca Muerta
  • Conocimientos de geomecánica y caracterización de fracturas.
  • Experiencia en análisis de datos y programación (Python u otras herramientas).
  • Participación en proyectos de adquisición y procesamiento sísmico, y de sísmica de pozos.



En Pan American Energy creemos que la energía que nos impulsa se potencia con el talento diverso. Por eso, promovemos procesos de selección inclusivos y equitativos, donde cada persona pueda sentirse bienvenida, valorada y respetada.

descriptionHtml:
Estamos en búsqueda de un/a Chef Ejecutivo para sumarse al equipo de una cadena de Café de Especialidad.


Desafío del Rol

Tu misión principal será conceptualizar, diseñar y desarrollar la evolución de las cartas, manteniendo una propuesta muy conectada con los clientes y con la evolución de la gastronómía inspirándote en ideas dentro y fuera del país.

A su vez, velarás por la excelencia en la ejecución en las cocinas: garantizarás que la estrategia creada se replique con consistencia, rentabilidad y bajo altos estándares de higiene y procesos en cada uno de los locales.


Principales Responsabilidades

·       Investigar, analizar y adaptar las últimas tendencias gastronómicas internacionales a la identidad de la marca.

·       Realizar viajes de prospección, análisis de mercado y benchmarking.

·       Aportar conceptos frescos, técnicas innovadoras y presentaciones de vanguardia.

·       Liderar el diseño, prueba y lanzamiento de nuevos productos y rediseños integrales de cartas.

·       Desarrollar fichas técnicas detalladas (ingredientes, gramajes, costeo, procedimientos de elaboración).

·       Trabajar en conjunto con Compras y con la Planta de Producción para la homologación de materia prima de alta calidad y la negociación con proveedores.

·       Velar por la estricta implementación y cumplimiento de las normas de inocuidad alimentaria, BPM y POES en todas las cocinas de los locales.

·       Hacer ajustes y mejoras en los procedimientos operativos para optimizar tiempos, reducir mermas y garantizar la rentabilidad del P&L gastronómico.

·       Acompañar el despliegue de los nuevos lanzamientos capacitando activamente a los Jefes de Cocina, cocineros y personal de despacho.

·       Transmitir la pasión, la historia y la técnica detrás de cada plato para alinear a los equipos operativos con la visión de la marca.


¿Qué perfil buscamos?

·       Graduado/a profesional en Gastronomía o carreras afines.

·       Experiencia comprobable ocupando posiciones como Chef Ejecutivo, Chef Corporativo en cadenas de restaurantes, grupos gastronómicos o empresas de desarrollo alimentario.

·       Experiencia en ingeniería de menú, fichas técnicas, costos (CMV), inocuidad alimentaria (BPM/POES) y reingeniería de procesos operativos.

·       Flexibilidad para viajar y recorrer periódicamente la red de locales.

 

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Atractivo paquete de compensaciones.
  • Medicina prepaga
  • Modalidad y horario: presencial principalmente en CABA, en horario diurno.

Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.


We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.


Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers. We get things done with urgency and focus, driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego, fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious—always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.


About the Role


As the Senior Product Manager for Geo, you will be the architect of our growth beyond our established borders. You will own the end-to-end user experience of fast-growing markets and/or lead corridor expansion (opening new markets). Your mission is simple but challenging: Design, coordinate and launch new market. Identify where we are failing to provide a "magical experience" in specific regions and solve for it.

This is a high-stakes strategic role. You won’t just be building features; you will be navigating the complexity of product-market fit across multiple cultures simultaneously. You will be responsible for making critical trade-offs, deciding which market gets resources first, and why. You will bridge the gap between local nuances and global scalability, ensuring that as Félix grows across Latin America, we maintain the speed and quality that our users deserve. We need a strategist who can think in systems and an executor who isn't afraid to get on a call with a user in a remote town to understand their specific financial pain points.


Responsibilities


  • New Market Roadmap: Propose, drive, and maintain the product roadmap for our emerging markets, ensuring every feature accelerates our foothold in new territories.
  • Squad Leadership: Propose quarterly OKRs for your squad and lead cross-functional teams (Eng, Design, Data) to ship high-impact features with urgency.
  • KPI Ownership: Take full accountability for funnels and North Star metrics in your assigned markets, specifically driving improvements in CVR (Conversion Rate), MAU (Monthly Active Users), and Retention.
  • Strategic Alignment: Act as the primary point of contact for new market performance, aligning with regional stakeholders and leadership on priorities and resource allocation.
  • Data-Driven Experimentation: Establish a culture of rigorous testing. Launch experiments, analyze results, and iterate fast based on market-specific data and local behaviors.
  • Cultural Mentorship: Collaborate with the broader product team to share best practices on local optimization and how to build for diverse LatAm user bases.


Requirements


  • Strategic Trade-offs: Exceptional ability to allocate resources across different markets, understanding the complex balance between local "magic" and global scalability.
  • Product Expertise: Proven experience in Product Strategy, Roadmapping, and the full product lifecycle within a fast-paced environment.
  • Analytical Rigor: Strong data analysis and experimentation skills (SQL, A/B testing, funnel optimization). You let the data lead the way.
  • User Obsession & Cultural Fluency: Expert in Market Research. You know how to ask the right questions to uncover local nuances and translate "trust" into product features.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Ability to lead and influence Engineering, Design, Data and Ops teams without formal authority.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of the LatAm market and experience in Fintech or Payments is highly preferred.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to distill complex regional trade-offs into clear narratives for leadership.
  • Language: Advanced English level


These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.


What We Offer


  • Competitive salary
  • Initial stock options grant
  • Annual performance bonus
  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Work model: currently fully remote, with a future transition to a hybrid set up
  • Continuous learning opportunities
  • Unlimited PTO

Description

Imaginative, curious, and adaptable — you sweat the small stuff, because you know that great design is in the details.

You are creative, inspired, and driven to produce innovative design. You are self-motivated — you have a true passion coupled with the exceptional ability to translate the vision of our clients into high quality and impactful imagery. Such talent and ingenuity make you the right fit for this unique Graphic Design Digital Designer role with Boldsky.

Mid-Level Graphic Designer: Core contributor to projects, owns bigger pieces and proficient at adhering to brand standards. They work with all the information at their disposal and use their skill set and knowledge to solve problems.

Mid-Level Digital Designer: To shape the product development process with a user-centric mentality. You will help create visual elements for websites, mobile apps and other formats, lead user research, brainstorm ideas to inform the product development process and work with internal and external tech teams for implementation.

Responsibilities:

  • Understand and implement direction from the art/copy and development teams.
  • As a Designer you will switch gears, successfully juggle responsibilities, and move across multiple projects while ensuring that files are built correctly.
  • Demonstrate ownership of assigned Brand work by continually coming up with new ideas proactively. Ability and willingness to show ownership of Brand work from a visual standpoint.
  • Work within InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator (using Adobe CC suite) to create stand-out work.
  • Must be proficient at Figma, Sketch, and Adobe XD
  • Social media content
  • Website design
  • Interactive/digital content
  • Booth/Congress multimedia interfaces
  • Understanding of information architecture

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design or related field, with agency/studio experience.
  • 5–10 years’ experience in Graphic Design.
  • Expertise in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat).
  • Extensive prepress knowledge including formats, resolution, and four-color printing.
  • Excellent communication and direction-giving skills.
  • Strong design sense: layout, composition, hierarchy, typography, and color.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Team player with ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently under deadlines.
  • 3-7 years’ experience creating mid to large scale corporate and campaign websites
  • Excellence at designing a brand experience across multiple channels, including web and mobile
  • Experience designing for healthcare and pharma
  • Expertise in developing wireframes and prototypes
  • Prototyping tools like Sketch, Figma and Adobe XD, along with Adobe Creative Suite, Jira, and MS Office Suite a plus
  • You have a high-level understanding of SEO and ability to speak to it a plus.

Should also be:

  • Conceptually Creative: Ability to think in abstract terms; make connections between unrelated notions; formulate innovative ideas where others cannot; seen as original and value-added in brainstorming sessions
  • Able to Understand and Implement Direction: Can understand creative direction based on objectives and execute creative work effectively. Understands the concept of talent-to-task and communicates well with others on workload issues & needs, progress of work and results
  • Industry Application: Picks up on technical things quickly; is good at learning new industry, company, product, and/or technical knowledge developments of the client's business as well as the agency business; has the functional and technical knowledge and skills to do the job at a high level of accomplishment
  • Demonstrating Ownership and Proactivity: Demonstrates ownership of assigned Brand work by continually coming up with new ideas proactively. Ability and willingness to show ownership of Brand work from a visual standpoint
  • Willingness to be Flexible: Willing to work outside of job description as needed, be flexible for the team, and ultimately the work.

At Syneos Health Communications, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

BoldSky Creative Studio supports more than 12+ Syneos Health marketing and communication agencies as well as direct-to-customer engagements. We function as the agencies' creative execution and production arm, implementing their creative vision. As part of Syneos Health, our agencies — consisting of leading brands and experts in advertising, branding, public relations, managed markets and medical communications — are engaged in every point of influence in health, providing real-world insight into markets and audiences in ways that no other partner could.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, flexible paid time off (PTO). Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable national/federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

JOB TITLE: Sales Team Leader – B2B Travel (Argentina)

Location: [Buenos Aires, hybrid / Remote – Argentina]  |  Type: Full-time


Travel can do more than move people around. We believe it should leave places better than it found them.


Onesixth Expeditions is a purpose-driven, Certified B Corp destination management company. We create journeys through Argentina for travel agents and tour operators worldwide, working closely with local people and places so that travellers experience the country as it really is. We believe tourism should help keep local traditions alive and share its benefits with the communities that make each trip special.


We're a small, close-knit team, and we're looking for a Sales Team Leader to help us grow, without losing what makes us different.


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Our sales team is where purpose meets business. Each quote that turns into a booking means work for a local guide, a night in a family-owned estancia, a table at a neighbourhood restaurant. You'll lead a team of passionate travel designers, helping them keep delivering highly tailored trips for some of the most demanding travel companies around the world.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead, coach and grow a team of travel designers: one-to-ones, targets, training and destination knowledge.

• Own the pipeline: make sure every enquiry gets a fast, thoughtful reply and that no deal is forgotten.

• Review proposals and quotes for quality, pricing and margin before they reach our partners.

• Manage and grow key accounts with agents and tour operators in the UK, Europe, North America and beyond.

• Work closely with our market representatives and marketing team on campaigns and partner communications.

• Forecast and report on sales, conversion and margin, and turn the numbers into decisions.

• Make sure confirmed bookings hand over smoothly to operations, and use client and sales data to drive continuous improvement.

• Help shape how we sell: our playbook, our CRM and new technologies such as AI, and how we talk about impact honestly.


WHO YOU ARE

• 4+ years in travel sales, ideally B2B with a DMC, tour operator or luxury travel company.

• Experienced team leaders are very welcome, as are rising stars ready for their first leadership role: someone who can lead an amazing team to greatness.

• Deep knowledge of Argentina and a real love for it; experience with neighbouring South American destinations is a plus.

• Fluent in English; other languages are a plus.

• Confident using CRM systems and eager to embrace new technologies, including AI, to work smarter.

• Organised, commercially sharp and calm under pressure in high season.

• You care about responsible travel and want your work to make a difference.


WHAT WE OFFER

• A role with real impact, in a company that measures success by more than revenue.

• [Competitive salary + bonus scheme]

• [Hybrid / remote working and flexible hours]

• Familiarisation trips across Argentina.

• Training and room to grow with a small, international team.

• [Other benefits: are also available.


HOW TO APPLY

Send us your CV and a few lines (no formal cover letter needed) telling us about a trip or a place in Argentina that changed the way you see travel. Apply here on LinkedIn or write to daniel@onesixthexpeditions.com


We believe a diverse team designs better journeys. We welcome applications from everyone, whatever your background, and we especially encourage people from the communities we work with.

Role Title: GDS Microsoft Campaign Activation Specialist

Alliance: Microsoft

Competency: Operations

Function: GDS ES Growth & Innovation

Skill Level: HighRank: Assistant Director

Sub Function: GDS Alliances Prog.Ops CoE

Reports to: GDS MSFT Campaign Activation LeadThe OpportunityThe Microsoft Campaign Activation Specialist will manage the structured activation of Microsoft alliance campaigns across priority markets, translating approved alliance, campaign and go-to-market priorities into executable activation plans, coordinated workstreams and measurable outcomes. Operating at EY Specialist level, aligned to Assistant Director / Manager expectations, the role acts as the manager-level execution counterpart to the Campaign Activation Strategist for the Microsoft Functional Alliance Director team, ensuring campaign priorities are operationalized consistently across regions, stakeholders and delivery channels.The role works closely with the Microsoft Functional Alliance Directors as their primary stakeholders,Microsoft Alliance Leadership, Campaign Activation Strategists, Alliance Operations, Brand, Marketing & Communications (BMC), Go-to-Market (GTM), Service Lines, Sector and Area teams, Business Development, Client Technology and Microsoft-facing stakeholders to coordinate campaign planning inputs, regional readiness, enablement requirements, execution cadences, issue tracking and performance reporting.The successful candidate will convert defined campaign strategies, target account priorities and regional activation needs into practical execution plans, action trackers, stakeholder routines and progress updates. The role will maintain visibility across workstreams, monitor campaign milestones and key performance indicators, escalate risks or blockers through agreed governance channels, and provide concise insights that support leadership review, adoption tracking and pipeline awareness.Leveraging automation, analytics and AI-enabled productivity tools, the Microsoft Campaign Activation Specialist will improve campaign reporting quality, strengthen operational visibility, increase execution efficiency and support continuous improvement of activation processes. Through disciplined program management, stakeholder follow-through and attention to detail, the role will help increase the consistency, transparency and impact of EY’s Microsoft alliance campaign activation efforts.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Translate approved Microsoft alliance, campaign and GTM priorities into executable activation plans, workstream milestones, owners, dependencies and delivery actions within agreed strategic guardrails.
  • Partner with Campaign Activation Strategists, Microsoft Alliance Leadership, Alliance Relationship Directors and Alliance Operations teams to operationalize campaign requirements, governance rhythms, dependencies and execution alignment.
  • Activate target account and priority market plans defined by Global Microsoft Alliance, GTM, Sector, Field of Play and regional leadership teams, ensuring clear ownership, readiness, cadence and follow-through.
  • Coordinate with alliance, GTM and marketing stakeholders to adapt campaign messaging, value propositions and activation narratives into usable regional enablement and execution materials.
  • Partner with Brand, Marketing & Communications (BMC) to coordinate marketing plans, sales collateral, enablement content and communication assets required for campaign launch and regional adoption.
  • Coordinate with Client Technology, Alliance Practice, Sector and Microsoft partner teams to support readiness and deployment of technical campaign assets, demos, solution showcases and enablement materials.
  • Manage day-to-day campaign activation across regions by coordinating launch activities, awareness sessions, enablement briefings, readiness checkpoints and in-market execution support.
  • Engage Area GTM leaders and regional stakeholders to confirm ownership, identify activation gaps and enable EY and Microsoft partner teams to execute defined sales motions in market.
  • Support sales motion execution by coordinating campaign activities, account cadence, enablement follow-through and execution support with Alliance Client Executives and regional teams.
  • Identify and resolve practical activation issues, adoption gaps, dependency risks and stakeholder follow-through challenges across priority accounts and regions.
  • Run regional cadence meetings, maintain action trackers, monitor progress against milestones and escalate risks, blockers or decision points through established governance channels.
  • Maintain campaign governance, reporting and performance discipline, including campaign stand-up, pipeline visibility, financial tracking, KPI reporting, account cadence support and leadership-ready status updates.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Strong campaign activation and program management skills, with the ability to convert approved Microsoft alliance, campaign and priority account plans into clear activation workstreams, milestones, owners, dependencies and execution cadences.
  • Manager-level judgment in coordinating complex, cross-functional campaign execution across regions, sectors, competencies and stakeholder groups while operating within approved strategy, governance standards and decision frameworks.
  • Ability to assess campaign readiness, identify activation gaps, prioritize issues, evaluate execution risks and recommend practical adjustments or escalations that protect timelines, quality and business outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the credibility to align Campaign Activation Strategists, Microsoft Alliance Leadership, BMC, GTM, Service Line, Sector, Area, Business Development and Microsoft-facing teams around shared campaign priorities.
  • Practical understanding of technology alliances, Microsoft ecosystem priorities, campaign activation models and professional services go-to-market motions, with the ability to apply this knowledge to enablement, adoption and in-market execution.
  • Experienced in outcome-based marketing of Microsoft technologies related to Azure, Security or AI Business SolutionsStrong analytical orientation, with the ability to monitor campaign progress, pipeline visibility, KPI movement, stakeholder follow-through and operational performance, and convert data points into concise, leadership-ready insights.
  • Ability to balance campaign enablement, regional readiness and sales motion support, ensuring activation activities remain focused on agreed objectives, target accounts, priority markets and measurable adoption outcomes.
  • Strong communication and executive writing skills, including the ability to prepare concise status updates, governance materials, issue summaries, action trackers, decision notes and campaign performance narratives for senior stakeholders.
  • High degree of ownership, follow-through and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple activation workstreams, drive action closure, maintain operating rhythms and sustain execution discipline in a matrixed environment.

Desde Lumina Consultora nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Account Executive con perfil 100% hunter y más de 3 años de experiencia en ventas corporativas de soluciones tecnológicas.


El desafío será desarrollar nuevas cuentas en el sector público y privado, convertir oportunidades en negocios y construir relaciones comerciales a largo plazo con los clientes captados, con foco en el mercado peruano.


Principales responsabilidades

  • Identificar, prospectar y captar nuevas cuentas, generando oportunidades de negocio desde cero.
  • Contactar a gerentes, directores y decisores clave para comprender sus necesidades y ofrecer soluciones de valor.
  • Gestionar el ciclo comercial completo: prospección, diagnóstico, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Diseñar y ejecutar un plan comercial de apertura de cuentas, con objetivos y acciones de seguimiento.
  • Aplicar una metodología de venta consultiva de soluciones tecnológicas.
  • Gestionar el pipeline comercial, mantener actualizado el CRM y elaborar proyecciones de ventas.
  • Cumplir los objetivos comerciales y de facturación.
  • Realizar reuniones y visitas comerciales, incluyendo viajes a Perú según las necesidades del negocio.
  • Desarrollar relaciones duraderas con las cuentas captadas, detectando oportunidades de fidelización y expansión.
  • Elaborar propuestas y cotizaciones, y participar en procesos de licitación junto con las áreas involucradas.

Requisitos

  • Experiencia mínima de 5 años en ventas corporativas B2B de servicios o soluciones tecnológicas.
  • Experiencia comprobable en prospección, apertura de nuevas cuentas y cierre de negocios.
  • Formación universitaria o terciaria, completa o avanzada, en Comercialización, Administración, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Telecomunicaciones o carreras afines.
  • Habilidades de comunicación, negociación y construcción de relaciones comerciales.
  • Autonomía, iniciativa, organización y orientación a resultados.
  • Manejo de CRM y herramientas de prospección y seguimiento comercial.
  • Conocimientos de inglés técnico.

📍 Es requisito residir en Buenos Aires, cercanía en nuestras oficinas ubicadas en Capital Federal y contar con disponibilidad para viajar a Perú.


Será valorado

  • Experiencia comercial con el mercado peruano y conocimiento de su dinámica de negocios.
  • Experiencia en ventas al sector público y participación en licitaciones gubernamentales.
  • Conocimiento de soluciones de comunicación masiva y omnicanalidad.


Modalidad y jornada

  • Modalidad híbrida: 2 días presenciales y 3 remotos.
  • Horario: lunes a viernes de 9 a 18 h.
  • Disponibilidad para viajes comerciales a Perú.


Beneficios

👩🏼 💻 Capacitaciones técnicas y clases de inglés.

🚀 Desarrollo profesional en una compañía con presencia regional.

Semana adicional de vacaciones, día de cumpleaños libre y más.

Postulate a través de este aviso con tu CV actualizado.

Reporting to the Workforce Strategy and Design Leader, you'll lead a workstream to drive complex strategy work while partnering across various stakeholders to connect strategic direction with evolution and execution.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of workforce strategy, analytics, and enterprise transformation.

What You’ll Do

Shape Workforce Strategy and Models

  • Identify and frame strategic workforce questions, synthesize internal and external perspectives, and develop recommendations aligned with firm ambitions
  • Help translate shifts in business models, technology, AI, and service delivery into implications for future roles, skills, capacity, and talent models
  • Support the development of future workforce models through aligning business needs to future role definitions, career pathways and skills frameworks
  • Use quantitative and qualitative analysis to clarify trade-offs and prepare concise, executive-ready recommendations

Enable Enterprise Alignment

  • Maintain consistent contact with Service Line Integration Leaders to understand the strategic priorities of each Service Line to ensure perspectives across the business are captured throughout the strategy development process
  • Influence senior stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization while incorporating diverse perspectives into the work

Connect Strategy to Execution

  • Partner with Talent Evolution, Workforce Operations, analytics, technology, and data teams to help translate strategy into sequenced initiatives and measurable outcomes
  • Identify practical implementation requirements, roadmaps, governance approaches and potential risks to help push strategic priorities forward

Drive Delivery

  • Set objectives, manage scope, priorities, risks, and timelines, and coach team members to deliver high-quality outputs
  • Build reusable frameworks, methodologies, and knowledge assets that strengthen the consistency and impact of workforce strategy work
  • Identify responsible opportunities to use approved AI tools to improve analysis, decision-making, quality, and productivity

What We're Looking For

Qualifications

  • Experience in workforce strategy, corporate strategy, talent transformation, organization design, workforce planning, or professional services transformation
  • Proven ability to structure ambiguous problems and translate complex analysis into practical recommendations
  • Experience leading complex projects or workstreams across multiple senior stakeholders in a matrixed organization
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, including the ability to synthesize data, research, and stakeholder input
  • Executive-level communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences
  • Understanding of professional services workforce dynamics and the impact of AI, automation, and emerging technologies on talent models
  • Experience managing priorities, risks, deliverables, and team contributions while maintaining quality and objectivity

Key Skills

  • Strategic Workforce Planning & Future Workforce Design
  • Enterprise Strategy & Transformation
  • Executive Insights & Decision Support
  • Stakeholder Alignment & Facilitation
  • Quantitative & Qualitative Analysis
  • Project Leadership & Team Development
  • AI-Enabled Strategy & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop clear, actionable workforce strategies connected to firm and business priorities
  • Build senior stakeholder alignment on future workforce assumptions, choices, and strategic direction
  • Deliver high-quality executive recommendations within agreed timelines
  • Translate strategy into prioritized initiatives, roadmaps, and implementation requirements
  • Increase the use of data, scenarios, and AI-enabled insights in workforce decisions
  • Strengthen the team’s workforce strategy methods, knowledge assets, and delivery capability

  • Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
  • Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and stay long enough to make it survive contact with production.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are diagnosing why retrieval quality collapsed after a data refresh. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is data, retrieval, and model behavior: you make agents trustworthy by getting the data, context, and evaluation right.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

  • Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.
  • Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.
  • Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.
  • Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch.

  • Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes.
  • Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually.
  • Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two.
  • Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success.
  • Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better.
  • Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology.

What You'll Do

  • Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business, data, and engineering stakeholders. Assess data readiness honestly. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume.
  • Structure the process and the spec. For any business process being automated, map the current state, decision points, data inputs, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably.
  • Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end with emphasis on context and retrieval architecture — data sourcing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, permissions-aware retrieval, knowledge graphs where warranted — plus orchestration, MCP/tool integration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
  • Build. Ship working systems — agents, retrieval services, evaluation tooling, and the data flows that feed them. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware.
  • Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build, extended to AI: prompt and context versioning, eval suites that run in the pipeline and gate releases.
  • Operate (Day 2). Own what happens after launch — eval harnesses, groundedness and retrieval metrics, observability and tracing, cost and latency management, drift, and the handoff that lets the client’s team run it without you.
  • Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, CDOs, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one mainstream production stack (Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Java, C#/.NET, or Go).
  • 1 - 4 years of professional experience shipping agentic AI solutions, LLM workflows, and RAG architectures in production environments.
  • Advanced English is required.
  • Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
  • Hands-on experience with frontier AI developer tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex.
  • Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls, asking "why" before "how" to decompose unstructured business problems.
  • Solid understanding of architecture paradigms such as RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems.
  • Well-versed in agentic orchestration tools and frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain, N8N, or direct Model Context Protocol (MCP) and LLM APIs.
  • Skilled at exercising end-to-end delivery ownership and managing project scope without requiring product manager supervision.
  • Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
  • Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
  • Forensic attention to detail.
  • A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
  • Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.
  • Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
  • Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
  • Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Strong Plus

  • Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems.
  • Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases.
  • Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing).
  • Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense.
  • Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background.
  • Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system.
  • Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts.

Work Authorization Requirements

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
  • FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay.
  • 100% remote work.
  • The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
  • Continuing education opportunities.
  • Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and stay long enough to make it survive contact with production.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are diagnosing why retrieval quality collapsed after a data refresh. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is data, retrieval, and model behavior: you make agents trustworthy by getting the data, context, and evaluation right.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

  • Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.
  • Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.
  • Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.
  • Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch.

  • Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes.
  • Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually.
  • Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two.
  • Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success.
  • Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better.
  • Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology.

What You'll Do

  • Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business, data, and engineering stakeholders. Assess data readiness honestly. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume.
  • Structure the process and the spec. For any business process being automated, map the current state, decision points, data inputs, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably.
  • Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end with emphasis on context and retrieval architecture — data sourcing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, permissions-aware retrieval, knowledge graphs where warranted — plus orchestration, MCP/tool integration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
  • Build. Ship working systems — agents, retrieval services, evaluation tooling, and the data flows that feed them. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware.
  • Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build, extended to AI: prompt and context versioning, eval suites that run in the pipeline and gate releases.
  • Operate (Day 2). Own what happens after launch — eval harnesses, groundedness and retrieval metrics, observability and tracing, cost and latency management, drift, and the handoff that lets the client’s team run it without you.
  • Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, CDOs, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it.

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one mainstream production stack (Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Java, C#/.NET, or Go).
  • 1 - 4 years of professional experience shipping agentic AI solutions, LLM workflows, and RAG architectures in production environments.

  • Hands-on experience with frontier AI developer tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex.

Strong Plus

  • Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems.
  • Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases.

descriptionHtml:
KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work - building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.

We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta, so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.

The mission of this role

Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.

Who are we?

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

  • Better Everyday - keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round
  • Speed Is King - move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day
  • Work Smart - AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts
  • Overdeliver - catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told

If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.

Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

  • Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands - measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)
  • Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert - CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)
  • Continuous improvement across the website - tests live every week; winners shipped
  • AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise - AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)
  • No conversion drop goes unnoticed - drops caught and raised the same day

Key Objectives

  • Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first
  • Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells
  • Brief, QA and launch tests every week - then call results honestly and ship the winners
  • Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor
  • Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix
  • Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house
  • Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

Requirements

  • Fully remote, full-time
  • Fluent in English
  • CRO Experience: 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must
  • Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV - with the data to back it up
  • Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages
  • Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help
  • Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency
  • Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule
  • Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
  • Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder
  • Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience

Accountabilities

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

  • CRO test plan and backlog - Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next
  • Funnels - Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV
  • Build, QA and launch tests - Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week
  • Results, winners and conversion monitoring - Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day
  • CRO agency - Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house
  • CRO reporting and meetings - Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

  • Application + Screening
  • Test Project
  • Technical Interview
  • Culture Fit Interview

Salary Expectation

USD $4,000 - $6,000+ per month (based on experience and expertise).

Competency: Frontier Innovation

Function: GDS ES Growth & Innovation

Skill Level: High

Rank: Associate Director

Sub Function: GDS Alliances Program Ops CoE

Reports to: GDS Microsoft Operations Lead

The opportunity

We are seeking a Client Experience Strategist to support the Microsoft Alliance Frontier Innovation team, working directly with EY’s Microsoft Client Experience Director, in bringing EY's transformation experience (“Client Zero”) and client success to life for senior audiences. With Microsoft at the center of EY's All In strategy, this role helps translate real-world impact into compelling, industry-relevant narratives and high-value executive experiences. Working closely with account teams, EY transformation leaders, sector leaders, solution owners, alliance stakeholders and Microsoft, the individual will help develop and maintain executive narratives and proof assets, coordinate the executive briefing program, and support the systems and governance that keep EY's transformation story current, accessible and aligned to evolving alliance priorities.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain the narratives and materials that tell EY’s own transformation story (“Client Zero”), translating internal achievements into clear, executive-ready proof.
  • Curate approved client success stories into executive-ready briefing materials and reference packs for use in EY-Microsoft executive briefings.
  • Own the systems, governance, and refresh cadence that keep EY’s Client Zero materials a structured, continuously refreshed and reliable library, evolving them as priorities and content grow.
  • Support the delivery and continuous improvement of a repeatable model for joint EY-Microsoft executive briefings, including intake, planning, content preparation, stakeholder coordination, logistics and follow-through.
  • Support EY executive briefings by capturing key insights, documenting actions and recommendations, and coordinating follow-up activities with relevant stakeholders.
  • Keep the library and briefing content current, well-organized and aligned to evolving priorities, applying consistent standards and quality checks.
  • Contribute to process automation, AI-enabled content and insight generation using approved EY tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Power BI and Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Manage multiple priorities, identify execution risks early, escalate issues appropriately and support delivery aligned with KPIs and regional priorities.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Strong storytelling and executive-communication instincts – with the ability to shape Client Zero and client proof into concise, credible, industry-relevant narratives.
  • Proven ability to build trusted stakeholder relationships across account teams, alliance teams, regional teams and enabling functions.
  • Strong client-service mindset, with the ability to understand stakeholder needs, follow through on commitments and contribute to a consistently high-quality standard.
  • Ability to synthesize complex technical and business content, connect insights to executive priorities and communicate findings in a clear, practical and action-oriented manner.
  • Strong coordination, project management and follow-up discipline, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and maintain momentum across priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise updates, discussion materials and leadership-ready reporting for diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Ability to influence and support teams without direct authority, helping drive adoption of consistent ways of working across the briefing and proof program in a matrixed environment.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving, innovation-led environment, and running repeatable systems rather than one-offs.
  • Hands-on capability with working knowledge of data visualization and productivity tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Exposure to co-innovation ecosystems, alliance-led innovation programs, solution development, go-to-market motions or technology-led client pursuits will be an advantage.
  • Awareness of AI-enabled productivity tools, with the ability to use them responsibly to accelerate the development of narratives, materials and reporting.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • A University Graduate or Post Graduate Degree, or equivalent professional experience in business, marketing, technology, operations, consulting or a related discipline.
  • 15+ years’ experience, including experience in executive storytelling, program coordination, alliance operations, business operations, consulting or stakeholder management.
  • Experience developing executive-grade narratives, case studies, credentials or briefing materials for senior audiences.
  • Experience project managing programs or events involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a large, global and matrixed organization, with the ability to navigate competing priorities and collaborate across functions, regions and teams.
  • Proven ability to build trusted stakeholder relationships, communicate clearly and maintain strong delivery discipline in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and reporting tools, with the ability to convert content and data into compelling, executive-ready material.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Experience supporting technology alliances, co-innovation programs, solution area initiatives or alliance-led go-to-market activities.
  • A commercial and client-centric mindset, with the ability to connect content to executive engagement objectives and alliance priorities.
  • Growing fluency in priority sector themes (built over time) and familiarity with executive functional roles (e.g., CFO, CHRO, CRO).
  • Ability to use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to summarize, structure and package content efficiency.

Technologies and Tools

  • Strong hands-on capability with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI and Microsoft 365 productivity tools for developing narratives and materials, coordination, and stakeholder communications.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Copilot or other approved AI-enabled tools for drafting, summarization, insight generation and productivity improvement will be preferred.
  • Familiarity with shared trackers, dashboards, workflow tools and structured reporting mechanisms used in global delivery or matrixed environments.

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network that plays a vital role in advancing EY’s growth strategy. Working across locations including Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK, GDS teams collaborate with EY service lines, geographies and sectors to deliver high-quality work for clients around the world. In GDS, you will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, collaborate with diverse teams and build capabilities across an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, technology and insights that will support your career growth.

  • Continuous learning: Develop the mindset, skills and confidence to adapt, grow and navigate what comes next.
  • Success, as defined by you: Access the tools, flexibility and support to make a meaningful impact in the way that works best for you.
  • Transformative leadership: Gain insights, coaching and experiences that help you grow into the leader the world needs.
  • Diverse and inclusive culture: Be valued for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers to the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, we encourage you to apply and explore how you can contribute to this opportunity.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.
