descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about turning complex building systems into smarter, more efficient environments?

We are looking for a Building Automation Programmer to join our team and work on challenging automation projects across environments such as data centers, hospitals, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, universities, schools, and high-rise buildings.

In this role, you will develop and deliver complete programming solutions for commercial HVAC and building automation systems, working closely with engineering, design, graphics, and field commissioning teams.

What You'll Do

  • Program complex commercial HVAC and building automation applications using graphical/block programming, including the Desigo PXC controller platform.
  • Develop control strategies and sequences of operation based on project requirements.
  • Test and validate programs before release to ensure quality and functionality.
  • Create functional testing documentation to support field commissioning.
  • Collaborate with engineering and design teams to review specifications, identify discrepancies, and resolve technical requirements.
  • Support graphics development by providing the required dynamic point information.
  • Provide technical support and programming expertise throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Share technical knowledge and support the development of other team members.
  • Work independently while collaborating with a distributed technical team.

What You'll Need

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience programming commercial HVAC or Building Automation Systems (BAS/BMS).
  • Experience developing HVAC control strategies and sequences of operation.
  • Hands-on experience with graphical/block programming for building automation controllers.
  • Ability to read and understand electrical, mechanical, design, and construction documentation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote and collaborative environment.
  • Availability to travel occasionally, up to 10%.
  • Legal authorization to work permanently in the United States without company sponsorship.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!

We value your unique identity and perspective, recognizing that our strength comes from the diverse experiences and perspectives of our team. We are committed to equal opportunity and to building a work environment that reflects the diversity of society. We support your personal and professional growth by providing the resources you need to thrive. Come as you are and help us build a better tomorrow.

It is our commitment to protect the environment, promote health, and ensure that all our activities are carried out under safe conditions.

descriptionHtml:
En Claro promovemos una cultura de respeto e igualdad de oportunidades. Seleccionamos a nuestros talentos basándonos en el valor que pueden agregar a nuestro negocio. Buscamos personas que impulsen resultados con foco en la satisfacción de nuestros clientes con impacto en el negocio, manteniendo altos estándares de calidad y actuando con integridad en cada decisión.

Tu Rol será:

Liderar el diseño, desarrollo e implementación del portafolio de productos y servicios dentro del ecosistema IoT para los verticales Industria, Energía, Utilities, Agro y Minería, siendo responsable de su evolución y mantenimiento a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida. Se enfocará en construir las capacidades de Datos & Analítica, IA, Automatización y Ciberseguridad sobre las bases de la conectividad gestionada.

Tus principales desafíos serán:

  • Construir las capacidades de aplicación e inteligencia sobre la base de dispositivos, conectividad y edge computing.
  • Garantizar el ajuste solución-industria y la viabilidad comercial de cada vertical bajo su responsabilidad. Especialmente sobre las verticales Oil & Gas / Minería y Smart Metering
  • Analizar necesidades y viabilidad de mercado, competencia, usabilidad, viabilidad técnica y de negocio, para ampliar nuestro porfolio de productos IoT.
  • Diseñar, planificar e implementar el roadmap de productos y servicios del ecosistema IoT priorizando las necesidades del negocio con el objetivo de lanzar y mantener productos actualizados y en permanente evolución.
  • Coordinar la implementación de nuevos productos desarrollados internamente o con alianzas con terceros, involucrando áreas, definiendo y consensuando roles, funciones, alcances y procesos de manera conjunta, manteniendo el foco en el logro de los objetivos de tiempos, calidad y recursos asignados.
  • Definir la oferta comercial y coordinar e implementar el go to market de nuevos servicios y/o funcionalidades gestionando el ABM de oferta comercial, comisiones, promociones y alianzas.

¿Que necesitamos de vos?

  • Formación universitaria o terciaria en carreras Informáticas, Telecomunicaciones, Marketing o afines.
  • Experiencia mínima de 2 a 3 años en áreas de desarrollo de producto y gestión de proyectos OT para las verticales Oil & Gas / Minería y Smart Metering (excluyente).
  • Inglés escrito y oral avanzado.
  • Poseer excelentes habilidades comunicacionales e iniciativa para impulsar proyectos.
  • Capacidad de gestionar eficazmente el conflicto entre las partes interesadas.

¿Que esperamos de vos?

Orientación a Resultados: Que orientes tu gestión y tus esfuerzos al logro de los objetivos del negocio, manteniendo un compromiso permanente con la calidad del servicio y la satisfacción de los clientes.

Que impulses el avance de tu gestión definiendo prioridades y haciéndote responsable por los resultados alcanzados, buscando permanentemente oportunidades para generar valor y mejorar la experiencia de nuestros clientes.

Excelencia: Que trabajes con altos estándares de calidad.

Que planifiques tus acciones con precisión, realizando el seguimiento necesario para asegurar resultados sostenibles promoviendo la mejora continua de procesos.

Integridad: que actúes con honestidad y coherencia, cumpliendo compromisos y haciéndote responsable por las decisiones y acciones que asumas.

El puesto tiene sede en CABA - Paseo Colón

About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

  • Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
  • Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
  • Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
  • Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
  • Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a QA Automation Engineer (Playwright & AI).

  • You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience with QA automation.
  • Advanced English is required.
  • Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
  • Has designed, built, and maintained automated test suites in production using Playwright.
  • Has integrated AI tools or frameworks (e.g., GitHub Copilot, test generation tools, or LLM APIs) into a production QA workflow.
  • Has owned automated end-to-end (E2E) and regression test suites for web applications.
  • Well-versed in defect tracking, bug lifecycle management, and core software QA methodologies.
  • Proficient in automated testing principles for web platforms.
  • Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
  • Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
  • Forensic attention to detail.
  • A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
  • Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
  • Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
  • Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

  • Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.
  • Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
  • FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay.
  • 100% remote work.
  • The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
  • Continuing education opportunities.
  • Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Nuestro propósito es construir un mejor mundo de negocios para nuestra gente, para nuestros clientes y para nuestras comunidades. EY cree en la igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por motivos de género, edad, estado civil, credo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico u origen nacional, discapacidad o características físicas.

Nuestro propósito es construir un mejor mundo de negocios para nuestra gente, para nuestros clientes y para nuestras comunidades.

Sobre el rol

Buscamos un AI Transformation Manager para liderar la ejecución de nuestra agenda de transformación en Inteligencia Artificial, impulsando iniciativas estratégicas que aceleren la adopción de IA, desarrollen nuevas capacidades y generen valor sostenible para el negocio.

La persona ideal combinará pensamiento estratégico con una fuerte capacidad de ejecución, comprendiendo el potencial de la Inteligencia Artificial desde la perspectiva de clientes, mercado, crecimiento y generación de valor.

About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

  • Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
  • Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
  • Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
  • Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
  • Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a DevOps Engineer (AWS).

  • You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional DevOps or Systems Engineering experience.
  • Advanced English is required.
  • Successful completion of a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering.
  • Solid background in Linux-based infrastructure, shell scripting, server maintenance, patching, security, and integrating Linux servers into Microsoft AD domains.
  • Hands-on experience with database configuration, management, and troubleshooting (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
  • Skilled in scripting languages such as Python or Bash.
  • Practical experience building and running Java applications using Maven, Gradle, and Spring tooling, alongside knowledge of Node.js environments.
  • Deep knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, Puppet, or Chef across cloud and local datacenters.
  • Proven experience with containerization (Docker), artifact management (Artifactory), and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab Pipelines).
  • Demonstrated experience with monitoring and logging utilities such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or equivalent tools.
  • Strong history of process-oriented documentation, version control using Git, and continuous delivery practices.
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
  • Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
  • Forensic attention to detail.
  • A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
  • Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
  • Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
  • Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

  • Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.
  • Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
  • FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay.
  • 100% remote work.
  • The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
  • Continuing education opportunities.
  • Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

Join our close-knit LATAM remote team: Connect through fun activities like coffee breaks, tech talks, and games with your team-mates and management.

Say goodbye to micromanagement! We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.

Your well-being matters: Our People Care team is here from day one to support you with everything from time-off requests to wellness check-ins.

Plus, our Accounts Management team ensures smooth, effective client relationships, so you can focus on what you do best.

Ready to grow with us? 🚀

Here's what we offer you by joining us!

Competitive USD salary – We value your skills and contributions!

100% remote work – While you can work from anywhere, you're always welcome to connect with teammates and grow your network at our coworking spaces across LATAM!

Paid time off – Take the time you need according to your country's regulations, all while receiving your full salary. Rest, recharge, and come back stronger!

National Holidays celebrated – Take time off to celebrate important events and traditions with loved ones, fully embracing your culture.

Sick leave – Focus on your health without the stress. Take the necessary time to recover and feel better.

Refundable Annual Credit – Spend it on the perks you love to enhance your work-life balance!

Team-building activities – Join us for coffee breaks, tech talks, and after-work gatherings to bond with your Nortal family and feel part of our vibrant community.

Birthday day off – Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family!

About The Project

At Nortal, we know great talent doesn't wait for job openings. That's why we're building a community of passionate professionals for future opportunities.

These proactive searches align with the profiles our trusted clients seek regularly. Join our "Future Talent" network to be among the first considered when the right opportunity arises.

With over 160 new hires every year, we are constantly expanding our team with passionate and skilled professionals who want to make an impact.

As a member of a data engineering team, you will be responsible for the design, development, integration, delivery, maintenance and support of data pipelines and applications. You'll bring experience managing and supporting Postgres and SQL Server databases, along with experience building data ingestion pipelines on the Databricks platform. We're looking for a self-motivated professional with experience designing and architecting technical solutions and the ability to quickly learn new technologies and programming languages. You will propose, develop, and support customer-facing applications, delivering hands-on solutions that meet or exceed customer expectations.

How Your Day-to-day Work Will Look Like

  • Architect, design, and deliver high-quality code independently, following industry best practices.
  • Understand and make well-reasoned design decisions and tradeoffs in your work.

KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work - building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.

We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta, so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.

The mission of this role

Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.

Who are we?

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

  • Better Everyday - keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round
  • Speed Is King - move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day
  • Work Smart - AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts
  • Overdeliver - catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told

If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.

Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

  • Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands - measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)
  • Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert - CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)
  • Continuous improvement across the website - tests live every week; winners shipped
  • AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise - AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)
  • No conversion drop goes unnoticed - drops caught and raised the same day

Key Objectives

  • Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first
  • Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells
  • Brief, QA and launch tests every week - then call results honestly and ship the winners
  • Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor
  • Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix
  • Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house
  • Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

Requirements

  • Fully remote, full-time
  • Fluent in English
  • CRO Experience: 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must
  • Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV - with the data to back it up
  • Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages
  • Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help
  • Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency
  • Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule
  • Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
  • Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder
  • Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience

Accountabilities

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

  • CRO test plan and backlog - Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next
  • Funnels - Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV
  • Build, QA and launch tests - Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week
  • Results, winners and conversion monitoring - Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day
  • CRO agency - Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house
  • CRO reporting and meetings - Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

  • Application + Screening
  • Test Project
  • Technical Interview
  • Culture Fit Interview

Salary Expectation

USD $4,000 - $6,000+ per month (based on experience and expertise).

EY GDS – Rewards Senior Consultant

In today's rapidly changing and complex global workforce environment, managing human resources effectively is increasingly challenging. As a member of our Rewards practice, you will be part of a team that supports clients in aligning their HR functions with organizational strategies while prioritizing employee experience. Joining us means gaining cross-functional, multi-industry, and truly global work experience to advance your career.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Consultant with expertise in Total Rewards to join our Rewards team. This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a leading global professional services organization and play a pivotal role in the growth of our Rewards practice.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Leverage your experience in Rewards advisory services to enhance our practice at EY.
  • Deliver high-quality work on global client projects as part of our global distribution team.
  • Ensure the quality, timeliness, and accuracy of all work outputs.
  • Establish yourself as a subject matter expert in areas such as Compensation pay band design, market intelligence, benefits design, incentive pay design, job evaluation & grading, gender pay gap, annual compensation and incentive reviews.
  • Identify trends, derive market insights, and conduct research and analysis to uncover potential compliance issues and opportunities for performance improvement.
  • Collaborate with broader teams to upskill resources, lead smaller projects, and conduct surveys within defined scopes.
  • Adapt to a dynamic and ambiguous environment while managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Drive effective client communication and build strong relationships with clients and project team members across global locations.
  • Strive to receive excellent feedback from clients and global project counterparts.

Skills and Attributes for Success:

  • High integrity and commitment to working in a challenging environment.
  • Proactive thinking and a growth mindset that fosters efficient processes and solutions.
  • Ability to manage ambiguity and think on your feet.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity.
  • High energy levels, agility, teamwork, and adaptability.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have:

  • 4-8 years of experience in Total Rewards or consulting
  • A Master’s degree in HR, a full-time MBA, or an equivalent postgraduate degree.
  • Experience in Total Rewards transformation programs and working as part of a global distributed team.
  • Strong background in compensation & rewards benchmarking, rewards strategy, and annual incentive/benefits design.
  • Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI dashboards, and other analytical tools.
  • Strong communication and analytical skills with the ability to create insightful reports.
  • Additionally, familiarity with the latest in-demand skills such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), prompt engineering, data analytics, and digital transformation will enhance your candidacy.

Ideally, You’ll Also Have:

  • Comprehensive knowledge of end-to-end Total Rewards processes.
  • Strong technical expertise in the complete Rewards process.
  • Analytical skills and proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Active involvement in end-to-end Rewards transformation programs, particularly those enabled by technology, and experience leading or participating in multi-workstream transformation initiatives.
  • Experience in policy review, current state assessments, vendor selection, and designing global rewards processes and strategies.
  • Rewards-related certifications are a plus.
  • What We Look For:
  • Independent, self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented professionals who can deliver high levels of customer satisfaction through world-class support services.
  • Engage in strategic planning to grow the team.
  • Technical experts with commercial acumen, relevant experience, and a strong enthusiasm for adapting and learning in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professionals eager to work in an environment of continuous professional development, willing to take on new responsibilities and projects, and collaborate with clients across various geographies.

What Working at EY Offers:

At EY, we are committed to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do is as diverse as they are. You will engage in inspiring and meaningful projects, with a focus on education and coaching alongside practical experience to support your personal development. We value our employees and empower you to take control of your growth with an individual progression plan. You will quickly assume a responsible role with challenging assignments and be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Additionally, we offer:

  • Support, coaching, and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues.
  • Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
  • The freedom and flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you best.

About EY:

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction, and advisory services, we leverage our finance products, expertise, and systems to build a better working world. This begins with a culture that prioritizes training, opportunities, and creative freedom. Regardless of when you join or how long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. With a commitment to hiring and developing passionate individuals, we aim to be the best employer.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us.

Join us in building a better working world.

At Globant, we work to make the world a better place, one step at a time. We help organizations evolve their business and enterprise solutions to prepare for a digital future. The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Associate to support the Workforce Strategy and Design team in advancing the firm’s workforce evolution agenda. This individual will contribute to the development of strategic workforce initiatives, organization and role design efforts, and cross-functional analyses that help the firm better define, structure, and deploy talent in line with changing business needs.

This role will work across both strategic priorities to help shape future workforce models, support organizational design activities, synthesize data and insights, and coordinate deliverables that inform leadership decisions. The successful candidate will collaborate with team members across talent, business, and transformation functions to support a more integrated and future-focused approach to workforce planning and design.

What You’ll Do

Support team strategy priorities

  • Contribute to the development of materials, analyses, and recommendations that support enterprise workforce priorities
  • Support role design, organization structure analysis, career architecture, and related design activities that help define how work and talent should be organized
  • Act as a thought partner to the Workforce Strategy and Design Assistant Director to challenge assumptions, surface risks, and enable innovative thinking
  • Build relationships across the Digital Talent and Transformation Office to enable effective coordination across all Office efforts

Drive analysis and deliverables

  • Gather and analyze qualitative and quantitative inputs to identify trends, inform hypotheses, and support recommendations for leadership and project teams
  • Create clear, structured materials including presentations, summaries, trackers, and working documents to support team priorities and stakeholder discussions
  • Maintain a strong eye for detail to deliver high-quality materials and build trust with stakeholders

Project management

  • Help manage workstream actions, follow-ups, and milestones across multiple stakeholders to keep initiatives moving forward effectively
  • Prepare content and inputs for meetings, reviews, and decision-making forums by distilling complex information into actionable takeaways

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of experience in workforce strategy, organization design, talent transformation, consulting, or a related field
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and structured thinking skills
  • Experience developing presentations, summaries, and project materials for diverse stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, team-based environment
  • Comfort working across ambiguity and contributing to evolving strategic priorities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Interest in the future of work, workforce transformation, and evolving talent models

Key Skills

  • Proactive and dependable, with strong attention to detail
  • Collaborative and eager to learn from cross-functional partners
  • Structured thinker who can translate complexity into clarity
  • Adaptable and comfortable supporting evolving priorities
  • Highly organized and detail oriented

Success in This Role

Within your first 12–24 months, you will:

  • Effectively support the Strategy and Design team through accurate and insightful analyses and materials
  • Help the Strategy and Design pillar meet tight deadlines through strong project management and organizational skills
  • Coordinate and build relationships across different Talent functions
  • Develop actionable insights that support innovative thinking and delivery

Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

The Role

We are seeking a BI Analyst to help design, build, and evolve scalable data solutions for digital marketing and advertising use cases. Working closely with our Media and Solutions Engineering teams, you will be responsible for end-to-end business intelligence activities—from conducting data discovery and maintaining ETL pipelines to supporting reporting solutions for our clients.

This is a hybrid client-facing and internal delivery role, working with the regional Monks team and various international clients.

Key responsibilities


  • Design, build and maintain robust dashboards, reports and visualizations that track media campaign performance and KPIs.
  • Analyze complex data sets in-depth to identify trends, callout issues, and gather insights.
  • Maintain integration pipelines (ETL/ELT) in cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure) that integrate marketing and advertising data across DSPs, ad servers, and third-party platforms to create reporting solutions for Media teams
  • Data Quality & Governance: Implement auditing, data validation rules, security protocols, and compliance frameworks to maintain data integrity. Establish QA frameworks and build internal/external tools for automated data validation and proactive monitoring.
  • Work directly with clients and internal teams to understand their measurement needs, configure reports, and present findings that support data-driven decisions.
  • Document data solutions to ensure transparency with our clients and reproducibility
  • Drive continuous improvements in reporting processes, templates and automation to scale delivery and reduce manual effort.
  • Research, evaluate, and adopt emerging tools, technologies, and industry best practices in data analytics to drive innovation and efficiency.


Tools

We are looking for someone experienced with (or familiar with) the following tools and technologies:


  • BI/visualization tools such as Google Data Studio, Tableau, Power BI.
  • Experience with SQL databases
  • Cloud platforms such as Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Data modeling and transformation tools (ETL/ELT), such as DBT


Experience working with data connectors (e.g., Supermetrics, Funnel, Tracer, etc) is a plusKnowledge of media reporting UIs / APIs (e.g., DV360, SA360, Meta) is a plusGitHub and GitHub Actions (CI/CD processes) is a plusPython is a plusKnowledge of cloud infrastructure (Dataform, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, Dataflow, BigQuery Data Transfer Service, Storage Transfer Service) is a plusExposure to AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex) for accelerating implementation is a plus

What we’re looking for


  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in industrial engineering, informatic engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related quantitative field—or equivalent work experience.
  • 2+ years of experience with any combination of analytics, marketing analytics, and analytical techniques for marketing, customer, and business applications.
  • Hands-on experience with BI/visualization tools such as Google Data Studio, Tableau, Power BI.
  • Strong SQL skills, including experience with regular expression functions, CASE expressions, and common table expressions (CTEs).
  • Hands on experience with Cloud infrastructure such as Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
  • Self-starter with strong time and project management skills, and high attention to detail
  • Excellent problem-solving skills including the ability to analyze and resolve complex problems using data
  • Strong communication skills — you can explain technical implementation details to non-technical stakeholders and document your work clearly
  • Advanced English. This will be tested during the selection process


About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.

This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

Chevron’s Global Business Services (GBS) organization located in Buenos Aires, is accepting applications for the position of Project Manager. Successful candidates will join the IT Organization, which is part of a multifunction service center with a workforce of more than 1800 employees that deliver business services and solutions to the corporation across the globe.

We are seeking passionate individuals who exemplify high-performing behaviors and share our vision of bringing innovative solutions and efficient project management practices to our organization. The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and finalizing projects in the SAP landscape according to strict deadlines and within budget. This role requires a strategic thinker who can manage multiple projects, coordinate team members, and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

  • Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
  • Allocate tasks and coordinate team members.
  • Estimate costs and ensure the project stays within budget.
  • Identify issues and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Keep stakeholders informed with regular updates and reports.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet required standards.
  • Complete project documentation and evaluations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in an IT or business-related discipline.
  • 5 -10 years of project management experience. Preferably with ERP implementation and support experience
  • Current PMP Certification or similar.  
  • Proficient use of project management tools such as Microsoft Project or ADO.
  • Strong facilitation, and stakeholder engagement experience.
  • Highly proficient in English.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Organizational and problem-solving skills to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and adapt to changing project conditions. 
  • Ability to work in a multicultural and diverse environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree preferred.
  • Agile certification(s).
  • Strong understanding of Agile frameworks.

Relocation Options:

Relocation may be considered.

International Considerations

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

Solutions 2GO Inc.

Solutions 2 GO INC. es un distribuidor global líder de productos de videojuegos, con operaciones en 19 países de Norteamérica, Centroamérica y Sudamérica, y alianzas estratégicas que amplían nuestro alcance a Europa, África, Australia y Asia. Representamos empresas editoras de videojuegose de la industria en el mercado canadiense, ofrecemos una red de distribución de costa a costa en Estados Unidos y somos el socio exclusivo de distribución de Sony PlayStation en Latinoamérica. Nuestro liderazgo, experiencia, procesos y alianzas estratégicas nos han consolidado como un referente global en soluciones de distribución flexibles, dinámicas y adaptadas a las necesidades de publishers, fabricantes y retailers alrededor del mundo.Buscamos personas con iniciativa, orientación a resultados y ganas de generar un impacto real. Profesionales que disfruten asumir nuevos desafíos, trabajar de manera colaborativa y contribuir tanto al crecimiento del negocio como a la construcción de una cultura donde las personas puedan desarrollarse y alcanzar su máximo potencial.

Si te identificas con esta forma de trabajar y quieres ser parte de nuestro crecimiento, queremos conocerte!

Trade Marketing Analyst.

Resumen De La Posición

El/la Trade Marketing Analyst de Nintendo es responsable de desarrollar, implementar y hacer seguimiento de las estrategias de trade marketing de Nintendo, Roku y los publishers (EA, Take-Two, Capcom) en Argentina, asegurando una ejecución efectiva en el punto de venta, fuerte visibilidad de marca y alineación con los objetivos comerciales.

Es el nexo entre Marketing y Ventas para maximizar el impacto en los 8 recursos de campo asignados a la marca, asumiendo además la gestión directa de ese equipo de field force. Sin esta posición, Nintendo y sus marcas asociadas quedan sin la misma profundidad de cobertura que PlayStation.

Principales Responsabilidades

Planificación y Ejecución de Trade Marketing

  • Planificar y ejecutar acciones de trade marketing por canal y cliente.
  • Coordinar lanzamientos de producto, promociones y campañas de visibilidad en el punto de venta (POS).
  • Desarrollar y supervisar la producción de materiales POP, asegurando su correcta implementación.

Análisis y Seguimiento

  • Analizar la performance de las campañas y proponer mejoras continuas.
  • Hacer seguimiento de KPIs de ejecución y medir el ROI de las iniciativas de trade.

Coordinación Interna y con Proveedores

  • Coordinar con agencias de merchandising y proveedores.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de ventas, marketing y comercial para alinear estrategias.
  • Dar soporte a acciones digitales vinculadas a la actividad en el punto de venta.
  • Supervisar el mantenimiento de displays, señalética de vidriera y demás activos en el punto de venta.

Gestión de Field Force

  • Definir la rutina semanal de objetivos, ruteo y cobertura de los 8 recursos de promotoría de Nintendo/Roku/Publishers.
  • Capacitar al equipo de campo y controlar la carga de evidencias y ejecución vía app.
  • Monitorear quiebres, distribución física y pricing en el punto de venta.

Requisitos y Competencias

  • Estudiante o graduado/a reciente en Marketing, Administración de Empresas o Comercialización.
  • Idealmente con inglés avanzado.
  • Residencia en CABA o zona norte del GBA.
  • Movilidad propia.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar dentro del país.
  • Mínimo 3-4 años de experiencia en roles similares.
  • Sólido conocimiento de trade marketing y canales retail.
  • Mentalidad analítica y orientada a resultados.
  • Perfil proactivo, autónomo y con excelente gestión del tiempo.
  • Manejo sólido de Excel y PowerPoint.
  • Experiencia en tecnología / electrónica de consumo, un plus.

La persona seleccionada recibirá una oferta de empleo condicional, sujeta a la finalización satisfactoria de una verificación de antecedentes realizada por un proveedor externo contratado por la compañía. Los requisitos específicos de verificación podrán variar según la posición y pueden incluir uno o más de los siguientes: verificación de antecedentes penales, verificación crediticia, validación de experiencia laboral, verificación de estudios académicos y revisión del historial de conducción.

Si tienes alguna pregunta durante el proceso, no dudes en consultarnos.

For more information on Solutions 2 GO Inc., please visit our website at: www.solutions2go.ca

  • Ejecutar y controlar los cierres contables mensuales y anuales.
  • Realizar conciliaciones y análisis de cuentas patrimoniales y de resultados, identificando desvíos y riesgos.

  • Proponer mejoras en los procesos contables, los controles internos y el reporting.


Requisitos

  • Contador/a Público/a graduado/a o estudiante avanzado/a.
  • Experiencia en posiciones contables, con sólidos conocimientos de contabilidad general y procesos de cierre.
  • Experiencia en ajuste por inflación contable y reporting bajo IFRS.
  • Manejo de SAP.
  • Excel avanzado.
  • Inglés intermedio-avanzado.

  • Experiencia en SAP FI/CO.
  • Experiencia en compañías multinacionales o con estándares corporativos de reporting.
  • Conocimientos de impuestos.
  • Autonomía, criterio profesional y capacidad para desafiar el statu quo.
  • Pensamiento analítico, atención al detalle y comunicación clara.

Jornada full-time | Esquema híbrido: 3 días presenciales y 2 remotos | CABA

Job Description

As a Paid Media Analyst, you will be the technical engine behind our digital campaign execution. You will support media strategy leads by translating client briefs into actionable digital plans, with a mandatory requirement for hands-on implementation within Google Ads and Meta Business Suite.

Success in this role requires a high level of technical organization and a passion for the "why" behind the numbers. You will ensure that every digital touchpoint—from naming conventions to budget pacing—is executed with precision. You will act as a collaborative bridge between strategy and production to ensure our digital presence is seamless and optimized.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Implementation & Activation


  • Meta Ads Execution: Direct, hands-on setup of campaigns within Meta Ads Manager, including audience building (Lookalike/Custom), creative testing, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Google Ads Management: Implementation and daily management of Search, Display, and Video (YouTube) campaigns.
  • Taxonomy & Tracking: Responsible for checking naming conventions and UTM structures to ensure clean data across all platforms.
  • Digital Quality Control: Review all digital assets (specs, formats, copies) to ensure they meet the specific technical requirements of Google and Meta before launch.
  • Asset Management: Coordinate with production teams to ensure all creative materials are received and formatted correctly for digital delivery.


Planning & Tactical Support


  • Digital Strategy Support: Participate in developing digital tactical plans, using tools like Google Keyword Planner and Meta Audience Insights for simulations.
  • Performance Estimation: Assist in projecting digital KPIs (CTR, CPC, CPA) based on historical platform data and current market benchmarks.
  • Benchmarking: Assist in research and general benchmarking of digital trends to support new campaign ideas.


Reporting & Optimization


  • Data Extraction: Perform daily data extraction directly from Meta Business Suite and Google Ads.
  • Optimization: Monitor live campaigns and proactively recommend bidding adjustments, creative swaps, or audience pivots to improve results.
  • Insight Organization: Help "tell the story" of the data by organizing platform results into clear, actionable client-facing slides.


Qualifications


  • Experience: 1-2 years of experience in digital media.
  • Core Technical Requirement: Proven hands-on experience setting up and managing campaigns within Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
  • Detail-Oriented: High attention to detail regarding tracking codes, platform-specific specs, and budget pacing.
  • Proactive Mindset: Ability to identify potential campaign issues before they arise and suggest technical solutions.


Preferred (Nice To Have)


  • AdTech: Knowledge or exposure to Campaign Manager 360 and Display & Video 360.
  • Analytics: Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
  • Certifications: Google Ads (Search/Video) or Meta Blueprint certifications.

descriptionHtml:
Chevron Global Business Services (GBS), located in Buenos Aires (Puerto Madero), Argentina, is accepting online applications for the position of Full Stack Software Engineer. Successful candidates will join the IT Company which is part of a successful multifunction service center with a workforce of more than 1800 employees delivering business services and solutions across the globe.

This position plays an active role in the software development lifecycle by designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software solutions using Microsoft Azure services.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver complex software features and components with high quality and minimal supervision.
  • Allocate effort across development, bug fixing, refactoring, and technical improvements.
  • Take ownership of assigned technical tasks from design through implementation and support.
  • Balance feature delivery with technical debt reduction and code quality improvements.
  • Contribute to sprint planning by estimating, sizing, and committing to work items.
  • Prioritize work to meet sprint goals, release timelines, and production stability.
  • Support production issues and participate in root cause analysis when required.
  • Leverage and advocate within SCRUM development team use of AI advances such as Github Copilot to accelerate delivery of value to the business.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • C#/.NET (Framework and .NET Core/.NET 8+) with 5+ years of experience.
  • Typescript and frontend frameworks (Angular and/or React) with 3+ years of experience.
  • Relational Databases (SQL, DML, DDL, data modeling) at least 2 years
  • Cloud Platforms (Azure, CI/CD) at least 2 years
  • REST APIs (building & consuming) at least 3 years
  • Software Design Principles (clean code, refactoring, debugging) at least 3 years

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with ansible
  • Experience with NoSQL databases
  • Experience with automated testing (unit and integration)
  • Expertise with Azure cloud services, including App Services, Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault, Storage, and Application Insights.
  • Experience integrating Generative AI, LLM, Azure OpenAI, or AI-enabled engineering solutions into enterprise applications.
  • Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), containerization (Docker), and cloud-native architectures.

Relocation Options:

Relocation could be considered.

International Considerations

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

The Technology Business Management (TBM) Office Lead is responsible for driving the adoption and strategic use of IBM’s Apptio platform to optimize technology investments and enhance business value. This role provides leadership in implementing TBM methodologies and tools, driving transparency in technology spending, and enabling data-driven decision-making across IT and finance teams. The TBM Office Leader acts as a product owner, change agent, championing transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in technology financial management.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the TBM Office, overseeing the deployment and ongoing management of Apptio solutions to track, analyze, and optimize IT costs and investments.
  • Collaborate with IT, finance, and the business office to establish and maintain a TBM framework that drives transparency and aligns technology spending with strategic objectives.
  • Develop and deliver actionable insights using Apptio dashboards and reports, enabling executive stakeholders to make informed decisions on technology portfolios and investments.
  • Data Integration & Quality: Connect Apptio with other tools (e.g., Finance, Talent, Procurement contracts) for automated data loading, cleaning, and validation to ensure accurate reporting.
  • Drive adoption of TBM best practices and Apptio platform capabilities, facilitating training, change management initiatives across the organization, and acting as the overall evangelist and subject matter expert in this regard. Educate and train stakeholders on Apptio data to enable decision-making, while bridging gaps between IT, finance, and the business office.
  • Monitor and measure performance metrics, identifying opportunities for cost optimization, improved resource allocation, and increased ROI on technology initiatives.
  • Financial Analysis & Planning: Support budgeting, forecasting, TCO (Total Cost of Ownership), and chargeback/show back reporting.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the organization and IBM Apptio support, ensuring platform updates, troubleshooting, and enhancements meet business needs.
  • Change Management: Lead initiatives to mature the organization's use of TBM / Apptio data and foster accountability across the company.
  • Stay current with industry trends and regulatory requirements, adapting TBM strategies to ensure compliance, operational excellence, scalability and alignment to EY Finance and Business Office requirements and strategic objectives.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Extensive experience in technology business management, IT financial management, or related fields.
  • Domain knowledge: Strong knowledge of TBM methodology and detailed knowledge of IBM Apptio platform capabilities, configurations and operations (IT Planning and Cost Transparency)
  • Proficiency in data analysis, data modeling, and IT service management. Analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data to drive business insights.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence executive decision-making, and drive organizational change.
  • Communication: Proven ability to present actionable insights to cross-functional executive-level stakeholders, influence decision making and bring clarity to what would otherwise be considered complex topics.
  • Experience in project management, process improvement, and technology portfolio optimization.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen to align technology investments with organizational goals.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for interpreting complex financial and IT data.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities to foster collaboration between IT, finance, and business units.
  • Proficiency with Apptio or similar TBM platforms, including dashboard and reporting capabilities.
  • Leadership qualities to drive change, champion transparency, and promote accountability in technology financial management.
  • Adaptability and continuous improvement mindset to respond to evolving business needs and technology landscapes.
  • Solid Project management skills, including the ability to oversee complex initiatives and ensure timely delivery.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline (master’s preferred).
  • Relevant experience in project management, process improvement, and technology portfolio optimization.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen to align technology investments with organizational objectives.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities to facilitate collaboration across IT, finance, and business units.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • TBMA certification is desired but not required for this role.

What We Look For

Qualities of top performers include a continuous improvement mindset, good analytical / problem solving / reverse engineering skills, and strong customer service and organizational skills.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy, and transactions. Fuelled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Global Information Security Strategist

Summary:

The Global Information Security Strategist is a senior role responsible for shaping and implementing the long-term information security strategy of the firm. This individual will work closely with the Global Lead for Information Security Strategy and Research to ensure that security initiatives not only protect the firm’s assets and reputation but also enable business objectives. The strategist will combine deep knowledge of emerging technologies and threats with strong business acumen to drive security programs that align with the company’s global strategy and operational needs. This role involves high-level collaboration, strategic planning, and leadership to keep the Information Security program a step ahead of evolving business demands and cyber risks.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Program Development: Define and drive the development of long-term information security program strategies that support the firm’s business objectives. Ensure security goals, processes, and resources are aligned with overall corporate strategy and priorities, with clear targets for success.
  • Business & Leadership Consulting: Collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to understand short- and long-range business plans. Recommend security strategies and solutions that anticipate future changes in services, technologies, and client requirements, ensuring the security program stays ahead of the curve.
  • Stakeholder Alignment & Adoption: Work across global business and technology teams to build awareness on security initiatives. Rationalize and present recommendations to stakeholders and champion the security strategy across the organization. Drive organization-wide adoption of strategic security initiatives, resulting in consistent risk reduction and improved security posture.
  • Program Evaluation & Improvement: Analyze the Information Security program’s operational effectiveness, processes, and stakeholder feedback. Identify areas for improvement and optimize processes to increase program effectiveness and agility, ensuring the security program remains a competitive advantage for the firm.
  • Research & Trend Analysis: Monitor and evaluate emerging security technologies, industry trends, and evolving threat landscapes. Determine how these developments could impact the firm and its security posture. Use these insights to proactively adapt and evolve the security strategy, so the program is prepared for future threats and business needs.
  • Innovation & Initiative Planning: Identify strategic opportunities for innovation within the security program. Plan and propose research initiatives or pilot projects to explore new security solutions, architectures, or processes that could strengthen the program. This includes developing business cases for new investments or approaches.
  • Early Engagement in Technology Projects: Partner with teams in Information Security, Enterprise Technology, and Client Technology. As new capabilities are conceived and adopted, work with these teams to develop approaches that address security and business needs from the outset.
  • Executive Reporting & Guidance: Support and guide senior executive decision-making. Prepare and present high-level analyses, strategic plans, and roadmaps to executive leadership. Provide clear recommendations for the adoption of new capabilities or approaches, backing them with data-driven insights and projections.
  • Subject Matter Expertise and Education: Serve as a subject matter expert in information security. Maintain a deep understanding of the firm’s technology portfolio, security architecture, and the business operations of the firm, including how different service lines function. Use this expertise to educate business units on the Information Security program’s strategic direction and to ensure security strategies are well understood and embraced across the organization.
  • External Awareness & Partnership: Build and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external partners to stay informed about potential strategic shifts in technology, security, and business operations. Leverage these relationships to inform the firm’s security strategy and ensure that architecture, engineering, and operations teams are prepared for changes impacting the industry.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience: Minimum 10+ years of experience in roles involving strategy development, organizational change, or business process improvement, with a strong track record of driving business impact. At least 10 years of experience in Information Security or Information Technology domains, demonstrating increasing responsibility and breadth of scope.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience will also be considered.
  • Strategic Leadership: Exceptional program leadership and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in a global organization, aligning diverse teams (security, IT, and business) through influence and relationship-building rather than formal authority.
  • Business Acumen: Strong business acumen with the ability to understand the company’s business model and industry (including consulting and audit/assurance services). Capable of translating business needs into security program requirements and articulating the value of security initiatives in business terms.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills. Able to effectively convey complex concepts and strategies to both technical teams and non-technical executive audiences. Advanced English writing skills are required for clear documentation and strategic plan writing.
  • Technical Depth: Broad and deep knowledge of information security domains and technologies – including cybersecurity architecture, risk management, identity and access management (IAM), incident response, and emerging threat mitigation techniques. Able to dive into technical details and also abstract them into high-level insights for decision-makers.
  • Results Orientation: Demonstrated track record of delivering results in complex, matrixed environments. Able to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously, meet deadlines, and drive projects to completion. Experience in driving adoption of new processes or capabilities across an organization is essential.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Global/Enterprise Experience: Experience working in a large multinational company, with exposure to global teams and an understanding of how to navigate a complex enterprise environment. Experience collaborating across different regions and time zones is a plus.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with professional services businesses, such as consulting or assurance (audit). Understanding the dynamics of a partnership or client-serving organization can help in aligning security strategies to such environments.
  • Standards & Frameworks: Knowledge of and experience with common information security frameworks and standards (e.g., ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CSA, CIS Controls, etc).
  • Certifications: Relevant security certifications are a plus, such as CISSP, SABSA, or other industry-recognized credentials, demonstrating a commitment to professional development and expertise in security strategy/architecture.
  • Product Security Lifecycle: Experience with product management or secure development lifecycle (SDLC) practices. For example, having worked on integrating security into the product or software development process.

About the Role:

In this role, the Global Information Security Strategist will join a high-performing team dedicated to advancing the firm’s security posture in alignment with business goals. Success in this position means you will effectively bridge business strategy with deep cybersecurity insight, ensuring that the company not only defends against current and future threats but also enables secure innovation and growth. You will be expected to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders and act as a change agent, guiding the organization toward a resilience-focused, forward-looking security program. This is a challenging and influential position, ideal for a strategic thinker with a passion for cybersecurity and the ability to drive organizational change.

Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar



Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina. Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven, creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal, reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones.

Lidermos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo de Marketing trabaja bajo el modelo híbrido, combinando la flexibilidad del trabajo remoto con el intercambio presencial en nuestra oficina de Buenos Aires, Argentona, 2 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

Como Marketing Manager (Unidad de Operaciones de Marketing) para Argentina, serás el responsable de la ejecución de marketing en el país de principio a fin. Liderarás tanto el Trade Marketing como la ejecución de Branding local, actuando como el socio estratégico de marketing unificado para los equipos comerciales locales con el fin de acelerar la relación con los clientes, impulsar la preferencia de marca entre los usuarios y respaldar el crecimiento general del negocio.

Tus Responsabilidades

  • Alineación comercial y eventos: Actuar como el principal punto de contacto (SPOC) de marketing para el liderazgo de ventas local en Argentina, liderando eventos propios de alto impacto (talleres, seminarios web, almuerzos/cenas de networking) y patrocinio de eventos del sector para construir relaciones sólidas con agencias inmobiliarias y corredores (brokers).
  • Ejecución de branding y despliegue en medios: Implementar campañas regionales de Branding a nivel local para atraer usuarios (Seekers), gestionando adaptaciones creativas, entregables de producción y la ejecución de planes de medios multicanal (OOH/vía pública, radio, streaming, TV y digital).
  • Liderazgo de equipo: Gestionar directamente, tutorar y potenciar al equipo local de Operaciones de Marketing, fomentando un entorno de alto rendimiento con objetivos operativos claros.
  • Presupuesto y operaciones: Ejecutar, realizar el seguimiento y reportar el presupuesto local de Gastos Directos de Marketing (DME), garantizando la precisión financiera, la entrega oportuna de informes y el cumplimiento por parte de las agencias.

Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)

  • Experiencia demostrable en marketing corporativo (client side) dentro de empresas de alto crecimiento o entornos tecnológicos.
  • Sólida trayectoria en iniciativas de Trade Marketing, producción de eventos para clientes y construcción de relaciones a largo plazo con socios de la industria.
  • Experiencia práctica ejecutando campañas de marca 360°, gestionando la adaptación de piezas locales y planes de medios.
  • Gran autonomía, sentido de pertenencia (ownership) y capacidad de organización para gestionar múltiples tareas operativas en simultáneo.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestión de partes interesadas (stakeholders), con éxito demostrado al colaborar con los líderes del equipo de ventas.
  • Experiencia liderando, orientando o gestionando personal a cargo o equipos multidisciplinarios.
  • Inglés avanzado; español nativo; portugués deseable.

¿Cómo es nuestro Proceso de Selección?

Diseñamos un proceso transparente, directo y enfocado en evaluar tu potencial técnico y comportamental, dándote la oportunidad de conocer a nuestros equipos y rutas de carrera:

  • Postulación y Revisión de Perfil.
  • Entrevista de Alineación (Equipo de Reclutamiento).
  • Evaluación Técnica (Caso Práctico, Desafío o Evaluación de Código).
  • Entrevista de Encaje Cultural y Liderazgo.
  • Propuesta y ¡Bienvenido/a!

Importante: Evaluamos todas las postulaciones de manera individual y garantizamos respuesta para todas las personas. Toda la comunicación se realiza por correo electrónico, así que asegúrate de revisar tu bandeja de entrada y permitir los correos del dominio @quintoandar.com.br.

Beneficios

  • Plan médico.
  • Wellhub.
  • Licencia parental extendida.
  • Reintegro de Guardería.
  • Gastos de teletrabajo (monto mensual).
  • Descuentos en servicios del día a día.
  • Día libre por cumpleaños, Día del Padre y Día de la Madre.

Diversidad e Inclusión en Grupo QuintoAndar

Durante la inscripción, verás algunas preguntas sobre diversidad. Estas son confidenciales y tienen como objetivo apoyar nuestras acciones de diversidad e inclusión. En vacantes afirmativas, la información podrá ser utilizada para verificar el alineamiento con el público objetivo de la oportunidad y, en estos casos, podría tener carácter eliminatorio. Para vacantes no afirmativas, esta información no afecta tu postulación y se utiliza únicamente para ayudarnos a mejorar continuamente nuestras prácticas e iniciativas de inclusión a lo largo de tu trayectoria con nosotros.

Privacidad y Protección de Datos

El Grupo QuintoAndar actúa de conformidad con las leyes de privacidad y protección de datos, y garante la seguridad de sus datos personales. Para saber más, consulte nuestro Aviso de Privacidad para Personas Candidatas. Si tiene dudas o desea ejercer sus derechos como titular de los datos, póngase en contacto con nosotros a través de nuestro Canal de Atención.
