descriptionHtml:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

Our Programmatic Managers are our resident experts in programmatic and direct buying. You are responsible for keeping on top of industry-wide trends and best practices, putting them to optimal use for each client’s initiatives. You will be part of a cross-functional team including Paid Search, Paid Social, Ad Operations, and Data Strategy, ensuring client needs are anticipated and met. From negotiating direct deals to building stellar full-funnel media plans, you move with precision to drive growth for our most ambitious brands.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Strategic Planning: Design and execute programmatic strategies across Display, Video, CTV, and Audio that align with client business objectives.
  • Campaign Management: Manage mid-to-high level budgets, ensuring optimal allocation across tactics and inventory to maximize ROI.
  • Deal Negotiation: Lead the negotiation and management of Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) and Private Marketplace (PMP) deals with premium publishers.
  • Data-Driven Optimization: Translate complex programmatic data into actionable insights for client presentations, moving beyond the "what" to the "why."
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Integrated Planning and Data Strategy teams to ensure programmatic activity is a cohesive part of the total media mix.
  • Technical Oversight: Oversee the technical quality of campaigns, ensuring brand safety standards and 3rd-party verification (IAS, DV) are strictly maintained.


WHAT YOU BRING:

  • 2-4 years of hands-on experience in programmatic media buying, specifically within DSPs like DV360, The Trade Desk, or Amazon DSP.
  • Deep understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including identity solutions, real-time bidding, and the evolving cookie-less landscape.
  • Proven ability to manage full-funnel campaigns, moving from broad awareness to performance-based conversion.
  • Proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools; you can find the "story" within the spreadsheet.
  • Experience with ad servers (Google Campaign Manager 360) and 3rd party verification tools (IAS, DoubleVerify, MOAT).
  • Exceptional communication skills—you can explain the complexities of programmatic to clients in a clear and compelling way.
  • A "better together" spirit and a relentless curiosity to test new platforms and inventory sources.


TAKE INTO ACCOUNT:

  • You will have to communicate with your team members abroad, therefore fluency in English and excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) are a must for this role.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?

  • We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!
  • Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members
  • Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases
  • Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses
  • Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes
  • 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub
  • Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda
  • A flexible vacation policy


WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

Title: Software Engineer - Insights

Date: 10/6/26

Description:

Company Description

Innovid is the leading independent omnichannel ad tech platform, empowering marketers to create, deliver, measure, and optimize ad-supported experiences that people love. In 2025, Innovid and Flashtalking merged to create a transparent, scalable alternative to big-tech, walled-gardens, and point solutions across CTV, digital, linear, and social channels. As part of Mediaocean, Innovid is tied into the industry’s core ad infrastructure for omnichannel planning, buying, and billing. We are proud to lead the industry with our innovation, intelligence, and independence as the company best-suited to power the future of advertising.

Job Description

We're looking for a top-notch, passionate senior developer to be part of our world-class Social Media team. You will play a pivotal role in the design, development, and maintenance of our core systems. You will be responsible for building robust, scalable, and high-performance applications that power our critical business operations. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. We have a developer centric culture, practice continuous deployment and no code ownership, and deal daily with the most advanced technologies and methodologies in software development, high scalability, and big data.

The Impact You'll Make:

  • Carry out full stack, end to end development
  • Participate in designing and developing Innovid’s products in a multiple technologies, no code ownership environment
  • Design and develop modules for a high-end product that serves billions of transactions a day
  • Deploy your code to production
  • Be responsible for the well-being of your application in production
  • Work with product managers to define, prioritize and finalize features

What You'll Bring To Us:

  • +3 years of development experience in highly dynamic environments.
  • Experience in Python and/or React will be highly valued.
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, writing and listening)
  • A B.Sc. in computer science or a related discipline - Finished or at final years
  • Experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs.
  • li>Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues.
  • Strong knowledge of database design, optimization, and management (SQL and NoSQL).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor junior engineers (an advantage)

Nice To Have:

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their services.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Contributions to open-source projects

What We'll Offer You:

  • Unlimited Vacations
  • Monthly Inflation updates
  • Lunch Credit
  • OSDE 410 as medical insurance
  • English lessons
  • Gym coverage
  • Internet coverage
  • 1 extra paid month for primary & secondary birthing caregivers
  • Learning & Development - Tools and Training
  • Hybrid & flexible working model - nice offices in Parque Chas with endless snacks & beverages
  • Pet friendly office
  • High visibility roles with a tremendous amount of growth potential
  • Global team and cross-company collaboration unlike anywhere else!

Additional Information

There is no such thing as the perfect resume, or someone that checks every box. At Innovid, we are generous with our time and knowledge, and always ready to teach. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day and add to Innovid.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Innovid is an equal opportunity employer, committed to our diversity and inclusiveness. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability or age. We strongly encourage women, people of color, members of the LGBTQIA community, people with disabilities and veterans to apply. We are actively working to be an anti-racist organization. We're committing to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace for all of our employees. You can read more about our commitment to DEI here.

If you are located within the EEA and subject to GDPR or are a California resident subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act, click here to understand how Innovid processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.

Talent Attraction Recruiter, Supervising Associate

Everything we do for our clients comes down to having the right business, technical knowledge, and leadership for every occasion. Our colleagues across the business look to our Talent Attraction & Acquisition (TA2) team to consistently provide the most promising talent to our world-class organization. As a Talent Attraction Recruiter, you’ll be right at the heart of that goal, directly engaging with business leaders, colleagues, and candidates from a diverse array of backgrounds.

As a Talent Attraction Recruiter, Supervising Associate, you’ll own recruiting responsibilities aligned to a specific service line and/or region of EY. You may partner with an Experienced Hire Recruiter to manage the talent pipeline by identifying top contractor and/or full-time talent and converting prospects into active candidates. As part of a high-performing team, you’ll serve as a trusted business advisor to our Leaders, Talent Team, and hiring managers by overseeing all external candidate engagement and driving talent to EY. You’ll ensure an exceptional candidate experience for every candidate, so our reputation for quality and innovation will be in your hands. In return, you’ll have the support of a network of highly knowledgeable colleagues and the opportunity to make a significant impact on your team and EY.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver recruiting strategies to attract contractor and/or experienced hires and serve as a key contact to client groups and external candidates. Developing sound business relationships with key stakeholders to achieve hiring goals.
  • Driving the sourcing strategy to identify, attract, and build a talent pipeline as well as making assessments and recommendations on talent in the market.
  • Ensuring all appropriate sourcing strategies are utilized, including inclusiveness initiatives and other creative sourcing techniques.
  • Providing operational and process knowledge to ensure a quality candidate experience.
  • Recommending and coordinating local and national recruiting initiatives and special events to support the service line.
  • Integrating EY's brand strategy into all recruitment activity and leverage social media platforms to promote job openings and attract potential candidates.
  • Acting as a change agent for new technology, tools, and processes that are rolled out to the broader recruiting community.
  • Staying abreast of talent and labor market insights and ensure all recruiting activities comply with local legal and organizational policies and regulations.
  • Leveraging AI tools and technologies to enhance the recruitment process, including AI-driven candidate sourcing, screening, and matching to ensure the best fit for the roles.
  • Utilizing analytics to gain insights into recruitment trends, candidate behaviors, and market demands to make data-driven decisions.

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 plus years of experience in recruiting and/or sourcing in professional/financial services, corporate and/or agency environment preferred
  • Demonstrated knowledge and prior experience in attracting and engaging contractor and/or experienced hires while leveraging a variety of recruitment resources.
  • Strategic-thinking skills and ability to collaborate with team members on best practices.
  • Consultative approach with clients, serving as a talent advisor on the external pipeline of prospective candidates.
  • Knowledge and experience in creative sourcing techniques of contractor and/or experienced hires and an aptitude for understanding IT and technology related roles
  • Adhere to SLA requirements of 24-48 hours to deliver sourced candidate profiles to hiring team.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and knowledge and experience working with applicant tracking software.
  • Experience with AI-driven tools and platforms.
  • Experience in working with North American talent markets in a professional services environment.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with numerous projects happening simultaneously.
  • Strong reporting and data analytical skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred
  • Fluency in English, verbally and written

Chevron’s Global Business Services (GBS) organization located in Buenos Aires, is accepting applications for the position of Java Developer - Hybris - SAP Commerce Cloud. Successful candidates will join the IT Organization, which is part of a multifunction service center with a workforce of more than 1800 employees that deliver business services and solutions to the corporation across the globe.

This role is responsible for delivering solutions in Chevron B2B and B2C Customer portals utilizing SAP Hybris Commerce Cloud technologies. The software engineer will deliver innovative and complete solutions, driving them through design, planning, development, deployment and support that simplify business processes and workflows to drive business value.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

  • Uses computer science engineering principles and software languages to design and develop complex software solutions specifically with the use of SAP Hybris and Java
  • Actively participates in an agile DevOps team and performs the coding, automated testing, documentation (via wikis, READMEs, and code comments) and configuration changes to build, run, and maintain solutions using modern patterns, technology standards and best practices.
  • Interest in and ability to learn new technologies and techniques.
  • Puts learning into action by modernizing applications through re-platforming, re-architecting, re-engineering, and automation.
  • May help troubleshoot incidents to identify root causes and solutions, resolve problems, design, and implement configuration changes and monitor performance.
  • Monitors interfaces/data loads, administer security, and provide feedback/solutions on application performance.
  • Identifies areas for improvement through understanding of technical and business requirements. Partner with the platform and the business to address tactical and strategic issues.

Required Qualifications

  • Has in-depth knowledges and experience working on SAP Hybris products and functionalities for B2B and B2C (SAP Hybris version 1811, 1905, 1911, 2005, 2105 and/or Hybris Cloud CCV2)
  • Proficiency in developing and maintaining e-commerce/web platforms
  • SAP Certified Development Professional: SAP Commerce Cloud preferred
  • Strong technical skills in Java, JavaScript, Spring, JSP, HTML5, Angular, React, CSS, SQL/Oracle Database, SOLR Query, Azure Integration Services Microsoft Cloud
  • Knowledge of security/access control, scalability, high availability, concurrency, online diagnoses, deployment, upgrade/migration, internationalization, production support and other SaaS enterprise software issues.
  • Understanding of customer service center business processes and technologies preferred
  • Proficient analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to engage difficulties with persistence.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to communicate with business to understand, gather, and document requirements.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Must be a self-starter, can adapt to the use of new technology, able to multi-task, and able to work independently.
  • Has a keen eye for good architecture and the ability to develop new architecture and frameworks
  • Must have a disciplined, methodical, minimalist approach to designing and constructing layered software components that can be embedded within larger frameworks or applications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Agile methodologies.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps (ADO) and API integrations.
  • Experience with SaaS applications.

Professional Competencies

  • Analytical Thinking
  • Business Acumen
  • Learning Agility

Relocation Options:

Relocation could be considered.

International Considerations

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

descriptionHtml:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

Our Programmatic Managers are our resident experts in programmatic and direct buying. You are responsible for keeping on top of industry-wide trends and best practices, putting them to optimal use for each client’s initiatives. You will be part of a cross-functional team including Paid Search, Paid Social, Ad Operations, and Data Strategy, ensuring client needs are anticipated and met. From negotiating direct deals to building stellar full-funnel media plans, you move with precision to drive growth for our most ambitious brands.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Strategic Planning: Design and execute programmatic strategies across Display, Video, CTV, and Audio that align with client business objectives.
  • Campaign Management: Manage mid-to-high level budgets, ensuring optimal allocation across tactics and inventory to maximize ROI.
  • Deal Negotiation: Lead the negotiation and management of Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) and Private Marketplace (PMP) deals with premium publishers.
  • Data-Driven Optimization: Translate complex programmatic data into actionable insights for client presentations, moving beyond the "what" to the "why."
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Integrated Planning and Data Strategy teams to ensure programmatic activity is a cohesive part of the total media mix.
  • Technical Oversight: Oversee the technical quality of campaigns, ensuring brand safety standards and 3rd-party verification (IAS, DV) are strictly maintained.


WHAT YOU BRING:

  • 2-4 years of hands-on experience in programmatic media buying, specifically within DSPs like DV360, The Trade Desk, or Amazon DSP.
  • Deep understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including identity solutions, real-time bidding, and the evolving cookie-less landscape.
  • Proven ability to manage full-funnel campaigns, moving from broad awareness to performance-based conversion.
  • Proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools; you can find the "story" within the spreadsheet.
  • Experience with ad servers (Google Campaign Manager 360) and 3rd party verification tools (IAS, DoubleVerify, MOAT).
  • Exceptional communication skills—you can explain the complexities of programmatic to clients in a clear and compelling way.
  • A "better together" spirit and a relentless curiosity to test new platforms and inventory sources.


TAKE INTO ACCOUNT:

  • You will have to communicate with your team members abroad, therefore fluency in English and excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) are a must for this role.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?

  • We enjoy spending time together, working closely with other local colleagues, and getting to know one another. Our Buenos Aires offices (Villa Crespo or Mar del Plata) are fully equipped with refreshments and great common spaces!
  • Premium healthcare through OSDE for the employee and their immediate family members
  • Mendel prepaid card with a monthly allowance for grocery purchases
  • Monthly reimbursements for Wi-Fi/electricity expenses
  • Monthly reimbursements for training/English classes
  • 100% covered “Plan Total” membership at Sportclub
  • Access to a our benefits platform through Bonda
  • A flexible vacation policy


WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

FAAS Manager – Finance Optimization

EY focuses on high-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

When our clients are facing complex finance and controllership issues, they look to us to set it right. Whether a system conversion has been miscalculated, or they simply don't have the knowledge in the right area of accounting, we provide the answers to the big questions nobody else can.

Overview: We are seeking a motivated FAAS Manager specializing in controllership process improvements to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in accounting and finance, with experience in enhancing controllership processes through innovative solutions and technology.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the FAAS team in executing one or more Finance Transformation solutions including the following:
  • End to end process study, identify gaps in current process and identify recommendations.
  • Process design skills – able to critically review existing processes; make recommendations for rationalisation and improvement.
  • Define and develop a finance target operating model. Design business and process models, and help define finance technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap.
  • Execute technology led enterprise transformation projects for our clients
  • Knowledge of SAP and other leading ERPs, reporting tools like Blackline, Trintech, Hyperion etc
  • Knowledge of consolidation, reporting, inter-company and ERP data structures
  • Supporting Process and Control; or should be an expert in driving Financial Statement Close Process, Procure to Pay and Order to Cash, Inventory, Fixed Assets, PPE & Intangible assets processes (along with experience in Risk management)
  • Understand fundamentals of data preparation/data modelling necessary for the visualization purpose.
  • Capture reporting requirements from various stakeholders, architect the solution/report, understand/analyze the source data and deliver the reports in timely manner
  • Strong expertise in designing intuitive and interactive reports/dashboards using Power BI for data driven decisions.
  • Participating in development of proposals related to our offerings
  • Supporting projects that ensure high quality consulting services to major clients, preferably with a practical approach as learned during working in the business
  • Contributing to the creation of new services, tools and materials to be more successful on the market
  • Active participation in the creation and maintenance of an environment that enables the team to deliver effectively and achieve the highest quality
  • Support in developing our offerings and assets
  • Support in maintaining relationships with the client's management in order to deliver the expectations of service
  • Supporting development of new service offerings and go-to-market strategies
  • Build trust and relationships across EY’s service lines and with external clients.
  • Mentor, coach, and develop junior staff.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or equivalent certification required.
  • 5-7 years of experience in public accounting, financial advisory, industry, or a related field.
  • Thorough understanding of finance and accounting processes, including upstream business processes.
  • Operational accounting experience is a plus.
  • Strong PowerPoint, Excel, and presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and proficiency in data analysis.
  • Familiarity with AI, automation, and dashboarding tools and their application in accounting and finance.
  • Knowledge and/or experience with digital technologies and their impact on the record to report process including analytical tools, close and reporting tools, and ERP systems.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Proactive attitude and willingness to take initiative, lead, and think outside the box.
  • The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary.
  • Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver's license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations.

Ideally, you'll also have

  • A master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or complementary discipline such as data analytics.

We are seeking a highly motivated Tax Senior Analyst to join our Latin American Statutory and Tax accounting team. This role will focus on indirect and direct tax compliance and accounting, corporate income tax reporting, relationships and interactions with authorities. This Senior Tax Analyst role will be working in this Team supporting Argentina & Uruguay tax activities in Buenos Aires office.

What You Will Do

  • Work with the team in the Indirect Tax compliance including data validation, tax return filings, payments and related accounting work and submissions such as VAT or any other local indirect tax applicable in the country. Using this information, you will assist in the likely outsource of VAT compliance and onboarding of all other VAT related work to the COE.
  • Work with the external advisors in the Direct Tax compliance including data validation, tax return filings, payments and related accounting work and submissions such as Corporate Income Tax or any other local direct tax applicable in the country.
  • Assist with the income tax accounting for both US GAAP and statutory accounts for the legal entities in the country.
  • Assist with the accurate completion of annual income tax returns by ensuring accurate data is provided and coordinating the review of final income tax returns for the country in scope, all in coordination with external audit firm.
  • Assist with the statutory financial statement process including the external auditor requests, filing with local authorities and the audit firm related to US GAAP accounts.
  • Work with ERP system/s of the country.
  • Support efforts to leverage technology, automation and standardization related to all aspects in scope as far as processes and controls are concerned
  • Report to COE Manager

Minimum Qualifications

  • Analyst-level role with 4+ years of experience in relevant role
  • English Fluency
  • Experience in Taxes with fundamental tax principles, processes, accounting and terminology
  • Experience in Income tax return
  • Analytical skills for providing insights
  • Verbal and written communications and experience interacting with internal / external stakeholders
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools, technologies, and processes in a dynamic business environment
  • Collaborative teammate

Preferred Qualifications

  • Statutory accounting experience
  • Flexible to changes
  • Problem Solving Mindset

About the Company


Graphora is the AI-native operating system for private capital, connecting capital, companies, expertise and relationships to help investors and founders discover opportunities and create value. Founded by Trevor Silver, Chairman & CEO, and developed within the DTACap venture studio, Graphora is built on a simple belief: the right capital brings more than money. An investor’s knowledge, connections and operating experience can help companies grow.


Our platform brings together:


  • AI-native intelligence connecting people, companies and strategic opportunities.
  • Private-market investment strategies for eligible investors.
  • Agora, our member community built around shared interests, expertise and strategic fit.
  • Optional consideration for advisory, board and operating roles.
  • Education on participating in private markets through eligible retirement accounts.
  • ANDE, our intelligence layer for exploring public information and navigating Graphora.


Join Graphora at the intersection of venture capital, artificial intelligence, technical diligence, company building and relationship intelligence.


About the Role


Evaluate companies, technologies, investors, advisors and strategic partners—then turn complex evidence into actionable private-capital intelligence.


Responsibilities


  • Identify and evaluate private companies, funds and strategic investment opportunities.
  • Analyze teams, technology, markets, business models, competition, financing needs and key risks.
  • Research investors, executives, physicians, scientists, engineers, founders and operators relevant to each opportunity.
  • Prepare evidence-based recommendations explaining who to engage, why the fit matters and why now.
  • Create company profiles, market maps, investment memoranda and strategic-engagement plans.
  • Help founders connect with customers, partners, talent, advisors, board members and strategic capital.
  • Work with Graphora's product, data and AI teams to improve scoring, matching and explainable intelligence.


Qualifications


Preferred background:


  • Engineering, bioengineering, biomedical engineering, computer science, AI, data science or another quantitative discipline.
  • Experience evaluating companies, technologies, products, scientific research or investment opportunities.
  • Ability to connect technical evidence with commercial and investment implications.
  • Strong research, analytical, financial-modeling and presentation skills.
  • Knowledge of Buenos Aires and Argentina's venture capital, startup, healthcare, technology, engineering and academic ecosystem.
  • Connect Argentine and Latin American companies, technical talent and strategic partners with international private-market opportunities.
  • Clear, concise communication with founders, investors, physicians, executives, scientists and engineers.


Required Skills


  • Ability to connect technical evidence with commercial and investment implications.
  • Strong research, analytical, financial-modeling and presentation skills.
  • Clear, concise communication with founders, investors, physicians, executives, scientists and engineers.


Preferred Skills


Bring meaningful expertise in one or more of these areas. Depth matters more than the number selected.


  • Healthcare and medicine
  • Venture capital and private equity
  • Healthcare startups and entrepreneurship
  • Health systems and healthcare operations
  • Digital health and artificial intelligence
  • Biotechnology
  • Medical devices
  • Life sciences


What will distinguish you:


  • Deep applied expertise in at least one specialty area.
  • Something meaningful you built, launched, researched, commercialized, operated or evaluated.
  • Direct venture capital, private equity, diligence, investment research or startup experience.
  • Evidence of independent thinking through memos, models, code, research, publications, products or entrepreneurial work.
  • A specific understanding of Graphora and how AI and relationship intelligence can improve private-capital outcomes.

descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Manager, Customer Success

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

As a Regional Customer Success Manager for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. The candidate will focus on ensuring the priority customers and segments they work with experience positive change through more effective use of Services network products. The Manager will work closely with cross-functional teams including Network Services, Account Management, Sales, Product, Technical Account Managers and support/delivery teams to realize the full value proposition of Mastercard Network Products on behalf of the customer.

The three areas of primary responsibility include: 1) customer engagement, 2) growing the business, and 3) technical and program readiness.

Customer Engagement:

Cultivate a strong customer partnership through a deep understanding of their business and managing customer health and value realization during network product launch and post-sale

Identify optimization opportunities for customers with the goals of driving customer value and enhanced strategic goals through our products

Articulate key performance indicators related to cost, performance and optimization and the insights associated with them

Growing The Business:

Leverage Mastercard Services’ offerings to achieve customer goals and realize value propositions of Mastercard products

Identify opportunities for additional Mastercard products to create greater value potential for customers and enhance impact of Network Product offerings

Ability to evaluate business models, partnerships, and agreements ensuring product business cases are financially viable and supported by solid data

Technical & Program Readiness:

Develop training materials, thought leadership, and customer-facing playbooks that can be scaled internally and externally to support customer priorities and Customer Success value proposition

Translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner

Gather and report customer feedback on product gaps and pain points. Use stakeholder insights to refine value propositions and improve products

All About You:

Skilled at leveraging insights from market analysis, customer engagements, and identified opportunities to inform strategic decisions, drive innovation, and sustain competitive advantage

Knowledge and understanding of payments technology or cybersecurity (threat intelligence or risk management) and application of that knowledge to address customer/market needs in these areas are a plus

Experience using tools and technology to provide data analytics and business intelligence on cyber threats, fraud, risk and vulnerability

Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner

Proficient experience in analyzing customer metrics and leveraging data to drive customer success initiatives that contribute to mutual profitability and growth

Successful track record of identifying “next opportunity” for customers to further enhance the strength and value of the partnership for both parties

Experience in creative thinking and development of innovative solutions to complex customer challenges

Enthusiastic individual who works seamlessly with a diverse high performing team, nurtures a winning and inclusive culture, and a focus on development at the individual and team level

Advanced experience working with both large and emerging Technology, Financial Services, Acquirers/Processors, Service Providers, and/or digital platform partners

English, Spanish

Please submit your CV in English

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a DevOps Engineer (Data Services & Linux).

You will help clients to change industries, transform business models, and create competitive advantages.

  • Quantitative aptitude
  • Ability to take initiative and eagerness to break new ground, create opportunities for others, and take personal risks

  • Habilidades excepcionales para comunicarse de forma clara y persuasiva, tanto de forma oral como escrita, conectando con diferentes tipos de stakeholders.

La posición será responsable de idear, desarrollar, probar y documentar soluciones de software alineadas a las necesidades del negocio, transformando código en experiencias que impactan directamente en cómo funciona la salud para millones de personas.

Responsabilidades

  • Informar sobre el estado y la evolución de los proyectos en los que participa, con estimación aproximada de tiempos y recursos de implementación.
  • Idear la lógica de detalle y escribir el código fuente de los programas, según las necesidades especificadas por el líder técnico o el analista funcional, tanto en proyectos como en tareas de mantenimiento.
  • Realizar pruebas unitarias, de integración, técnicas y de regresión, y participar en pruebas funcionales y de aceptación de usuario para garantizar la calidad y estabilidad del producto.
  • Colaborar en la implantación de sistemas y/o en la configuración de funcionalidades según las necesidades de proyectos, del negocio o de mantenimiento.
  • Adaptar las soluciones de software a las necesidades de usuarios clave y usuarios en general, consensuándolas con el líder técnico y los analistas.
  • Colaborar en la elaboración de manuales de usuario y documentación complementaria (procedimientos, instructivos, capacitaciones, ayudas en línea) para facilitar el uso y la adopción de los sistemas.
  • Participar en la gestión del conocimiento, la gestión de configuración y la documentación de los sistemas existentes y desarrollados, controlando las relaciones entre sus componentes.
  • Trabajar en conjunto con proveedores y personal tercerizado en la implementación de proyectos y el mantenimiento de soluciones.


Requisitos


  • Conocimientos en lenguajes de programación Visual Basic 6, C# .NET y WebForms, y Web Services.
  • Conocimientos en T-SQL y bases de datos Sybase ASE y MS SQL Server.
  • Manejo de conceptos de metodologías ágiles.
  • Manejo de conceptos fundamentales de IA (LLM, Agents, Skills, MCP) y uso de herramientas como Cursor, Visual Studio con extensiones de IA o similares.

Beneficios

  • Gran oportunidad de desarrollo.
  • Prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar.
  • Días adicionales de vacaciones.
  • Beneficio de pago de conectividad.
  • Horario flexible y esquema híbrido de trabajo.
  • Licencias Udemy para capacitarte en lo que quieras.
  • Acceso preferencial en la contratación de productos y/o servicios como seguros de caución, hogar, automotor, retiro, vida y ahorro.
  • Campaña de vacunación gratuita.
  • Cobertura en gimnasios a través de la red Wellhub.
  • Descuentos corporativos en cines, teatros, viajes, restaurantes, spas y otros rubros.

Job Purpose

EY has been one of the leading global payroll organizations delivering seamless, compliant, and technology-enabled payroll services to clients across the globe. We support multinational clients with scalable solutions, operational excellence, and continuous innovation including AI-driven efficiencies Payroll is one of the speciality practices within the People Advisory Services (PAS) Sub Service line under TAX.

Global payroll implementation project manager at EY GDS is responsible to drive the payroll implementation projects for our global clients by working closely with client stakeholders, internal teams, technology partners, and the global program manager. The role requires prior relevant experience of project management, client management, payroll implementation, technology, business acumen and payroll transformation to successfully run large payroll projects across multiple geographies.

Responsibilities

Resumen del Puesto

Rol con foco en el proceso completo de Facturacion de todos los proyectos

Funciones y Responsabilidades Esenciales

  • Mantener los reportes operativos mensuales, participar en reuniones de revisión de proyectos y proyectos especiales según se solicite
  • Coordinar con el área de Revenue Operations en materia de Facturación de Servicios y Productos de Proyectos, asegurando la apertura y facturación oportuna de los proyectos
  • Gestionar las relaciones con clientes internos y externos para resolver problemas de facturación de proyectos, discrepancias en la facturación y consultas relacionadas con las cuentas, de manera oportuna y profesional
  • Reportar información financiera y brindar actualizaciones sobre proyectos no facturados y cuentas por cobrar de la sede
  • Apoyar el proceso de proyección de ingresos y facturación
  • Actuar como punto de contacto principal para las actividades de contabilidad de proyectos entre los equipos de Finanzas, Ventas y Operaciones (Project Managers)
  • Participar en las revisiones de proyectos junto con los Project Managers
  • Actualizar y comunicar los presupuestos de proyectos y el tiempo estimado para su finalización
  • Ingresar/enviar nuevos proyectos, órdenes de cambio, órdenes de venta, órdenes de compra a subcontratistas y/o RMA's
  • Mantener actualizada la documentación de los proyectos en la unidad de red compartida
  • Preparar y revisar la facturación por avance de obra según el porcentaje de finalización, hitos del proyecto o cronogramas contractuales de facturación, asegurando el cumplimiento de los contratos con clientes y las políticas de la compañía
  • Solicitar certificados de seguro, garantías de oferta (bid bonds) y/o garantías de cumplimiento (performance bonds) según sea necesario
  • Mantener informados a los Project Managers sobre el seguimiento de órdenes de compra, equipos y facturación
  • Coordinar con Cuentas a Pagar (AP) las facturas de subcontratistas

Otras tareas asignadas según se requiera.

Habilidades y Competencias

  • Capacidad para gestionar múltiples tareas con prioridades cambiantes
  • Capacidad para trabajar y pensar de manera independiente, cumpliendo con los plazos establecidos
  • Sólidas habilidades de organización y excelente atención al detalle
  • Habilidades de comunicación clara y profesional (escrita y oral), tanto interna como externamente
  • Comunicación e interacción efectiva con empleados, clientes y colegas, con capacidad para trabajar eficazmente con todos los niveles de la organización
  • Capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente con Project Managers, equipos de Ventas, clientes y subcontratistas respecto al desempeño financiero y temas de facturación de los proyectos
  • Enfoque demostrado en el servicio al cliente y habilidades de comunicación con clientes
  • Capacidad para manejar información sensible y confidencial
  • Se requiere experiencia en facturación por avance de obra, contabilidad por porcentaje de finalización, facturación por hitos y facturación de proyectos de construcción
  • Experiencia comprobada brindando soporte tanto a socios de negocio internos como a clientes externos en un entorno basado en proyectos

Educación y/o Experiencia

  • Título universitario en Contabilidad, Finanzas, Administración de Empresas o carrera afín (excluyente)
  • Mínimo 4 años de experiencia en contabilidad, preferentemente en entornos de construcción o contratación con el sector público
  • Se valorará experiencia en la industria de AV (Audiovisual)
  • Experiencia en Contabilidad de Proyectos, reconocimiento de ingresos, gestión de WIP (Work in Progress) y facturación por avance de obra en un entorno basado en proyectos
  • Nivel intermedio en aplicaciones de Microsoft (Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint)

¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una empresa tecnológica que abre el acceso a la energía en beneficio de todos. Como innovadores, esa ha sido nuestra misión durante casi un siglo. Hoy enfrentamos el imperativo global de crear un futuro con más energía, pero menos carbono. Nuestros diversos e innovadores agentes de cambio están enfocados en avanzar en la innovación e inventar las nuevas tecnologías energéticas que necesitamos para lograrlo.

SLB ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Las solicitudes son consideradas sin distinción de raza, color, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, origen nacional, edad, discapacidad u otras características protegidas por la ley.

Descripción del puesto

¡Tenemos una oportunidad para vos! Buscamos una persona para la posición de Project Manager, para liderar la ejecución de proyectos complejos de productos y servicios para clientes externos, asumiendo la responsabilidad del desempeño económico, los resultados de rentabilidad y la satisfacción del cliente.

Principales Desafíos

  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos del proyecto en cuanto a cronograma, calidad y costos.
  • Representar a la empresa ante el cliente, gestionando la relación contractual y administrativa.
  • Liderar y coordinar al equipo multidisciplinario del proyecto, promoviendo la colaboración entre áreas.
  • Gestionar el proyecto conforme a los procedimientos internos, implementando controles de gestión, identificando y mitigando riesgos y cambios de alcance.
  • Elaborar reportes periódicos de avance y resultados.
  • Impulsar la mejora continua y documentar lecciones aprendidas.

Requisitos Obligatorios

  • Título en Ingeniaría Industrial, petrolera, y afines.
  • Mínimo 10 años de experiencia en roles de Project Manager con certificación.
  • Experiencia obligatoria en proyectos del sector Oil & Gas y servicios digitales (producción, perforación y subsuelo.)
  • Dominio de metodologías de gestión de proyectos, incluyendo gestión contractual, de riesgos y de cambios

The Cost Control and Operational Excellence area is responsible for controlling and monitoring contract costs, supporting budget development, implementing control tools and review processes, justifying and preventing P&L deviations, among other tasks. It must guarantee and support the company's cost and revenue objectives at Latam South Level.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and monitor in detail of the hourly rate composition (by item),
  • Review and approval of every cost impacting the hourly rate account.
  • Follow up with finances of all the cost allocations.

  • Own the analysis and challenge the allocations charged to the contracts from the support departments (Supply Chain, Transport, Service Operations, Service Sales, etc)

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in Finance; focused on costs.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Advanced Power BI skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (Advanced Excel)

Competencies

  • Experience working with operations, finance, or performance management.
  • Strategic mindset with good stakeholder management skills.
  • Solid business and data analysis skills.
  • Ability to work according to procedures, deadlines, and schedules.
  • Leadership skills that enable effective communication with other teams, especially when managing remote teams.

  • Initiative, professionalism, and ability to handle changes in work procedures and new projects.

We offer an exciting job with great opportunities for professional and personal development within one of the leading wind energy companies. You will be part of a motivated team with the ability to contribute in the Latin American region.

At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

DEIB Statement

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is now seeking a Specialist, GSS Learning Projects to join our team at WHR Argentina in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Why Wyndham?

By joining Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, you will play an integral role in our mission to make hotel travel possible for all. You’ll be part of the largest hotel franchise company in the world, where we strive to deliver the best value to our owners and guests. Most importantly, you’ll be entrusted to live our unique Count on Me culture, set by our core values of integrity, accountability, inclusive, caring and fun. At Wyndham, we provide all team members the opportunity to grow through best-in-class training and career development, leadership training, mentorship opportunities and educational support.  Supporting our team members is a top priority, which is why we offer competitive compensation and benefits, vacation, team member appreciation days, workplace flexibility and much more.  At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we value and embrace a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion that supports team members of all backgrounds and experiences. We can’t wait to welcome you!

The Role

The Specialist independently manages assigned learning projects of varying complexity from initiation through implementation, with primary ownership of medium-complexity initiatives. The Specialist assumes day-to-day project ownership and coordinates timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and implementation readiness to support successful delivery.

The Specialist serves as a key connection point between project stakeholders and learning delivery teams, ensuring project requirements, decisions, timelines, and learner impacts are translated into clear and actionable plans.

The role operates with a moderate to high degree of independence, proactively managing project execution and stakeholder coordination while escalating strategic decisions, significant scope changes, high-risk matters, cross-project priority conflicts, and broader business impacts to leadership.

What You’ll Do

  • Own assigned learning projects of varying complexity, with primary responsibility for medium-complexity initiatives, independently driving project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and implementation readiness.
  • Serve as the primary project contact for assigned initiatives, coordinating with business stakeholders and cross-functional partners to support alignment, approvals, and execution.
  • Lead project coordination activities, including project meetings, action tracking, stakeholder follow-up, and communication of key decisions and dependencies.
  • Track the readiness of learning materials and coordinate required reviews and approvals with Legal, Communications, and other applicable stakeholders to support project timelines and implementation readiness.
  • Define and coordinate project-specific learner engagement and communication requirements in partnership with Learner Engagement, ensuring audiences, timelines, channels, dependencies, approvals, and required deliverables are clearly established and documented.
  • Identify and communicate learner-facing and operational impacts to ensure Learner Engagement, Learning Operations, Training Administration are prepared for project launches and related learning activities.
  • Provide project health, workload and risk visibility; escalate strategic decisions, major scope changes and capacity implications.

You’ll be successful if you have

  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build effective cross-functional relationships.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple learning projects of varying complexity in a fast-paced environment, with demonstrated capability to lead medium-complexity initiatives.
  • Ability to translate complex project information into clear, actionable plans and communications for different audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate risks, dependencies, and potential delivery challenges.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders, facilitate alignment, and drive accountability without direct authority.
  • Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and execution excellence.
  • Ability to navigate changing priorities and balance project demands within a broader learning portfolio.

Required Qualifications/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience in Learning & Development, project management, or related fields.
  • 4+ years of relevant experience, including demonstrated experience independently managing projects or initiatives of moderate complexity.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, deliverables, reviews, and approvals to support successful project execution.
  • Experience translating business or project requirements into actionable plans for delivery teams.
  • Experience identifying project risks and dependencies, coordinating mitigation actions, and escalating significant issues appropriately.
  • Experience supporting learning initiatives and/or working within Learning & Development strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based or global teams, or working in a Shared Services environment, strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management/tracking tools; experience with Smartsheet preferred.
  • Fluency in English (written and verbal) required.

Company Overview

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel franchise companies in the world by number of properties with approximately 8,400 hotels across over 95 countries on six continents. Through our network of approximately 869,000 rooms appealing to the everyday traveler, Wyndham commands a leading presence in the hospitality industry. Headquartered in Parsippany, N.J. with offices around the world in London, Shanghai, Buenos Aires, Dubai and more, Wyndham employs more than 2,000 corporate team members worldwide who are dedicated to the Company’s mission of making hotel travel possible for all. Supporting thousands of franchisees and a growing global portfolio of 25 hotel brands—think household names like Wyndham, La Quinta, Ramada, Days Inn and Super 8—Wyndham team members are a widespread group of individuals with diverse interests and backgrounds. Our unique Count on Me culture, commitment to flexibility and core values of Integrity, Accountability, Inclusivity, Caring and Fun are just part of what continues to make Wyndham an award-winning best place to work.

Job Location: WHR Argentina, Maipu 1300 piso 18, Buenos Aires, Argentina C1006ACT

Employment Status: Full-time

Employment Disclaimer

In some locations around the world, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts manages hotel properties on behalf of a third party owner. At many of those properties, the Hotel owner is the actual employer, and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts performs recruiting and hiring functions on behalf of the owner. I understand and agree that, by applying through this site, I may be applying for a position with a company other than Wyndham Hotels & Resorts where Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is serving only as the recruiter and will not be my actual employer.

descriptionHtml:
As part of Enterprise Technology function, we are seeking Senior Program Manager / Associate Director to drive measurable business value through the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional programs and transformation initiatives.

The role is responsible for end-to-end program leadership, governance, financial oversight, risk and dependency management, stakeholder alignment, and delivery assurance across business and technology environments. The position combines strategic thinking with practical execution, while leading teams and strengthening project and program management capability.

The opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Manager / Associate Director - Project & Program Management to lead strategic programs and enterprise transformation initiatives across the enablement services functions.

As a program leader, you will translate business priorities into practical roadmaps, integrated plans, governance structures, and measurable outcomes. You will work with senior stakeholders, clients, delivery teams, and partners to manage complexity, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain focus on value, quality, cost, and timelines.

The ideal candidate brings broad experience in program management, business transformation, service transitions, and managed services, together with strong financial, commercial, people leadership, and executive communication skills.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Lead complex, large-scale, cross-functional programs from initiation through execution, transition, and closure.
  • Translate strategic objectives into program roadmaps, integrated delivery plans, milestones, governance structures, and measurable outcomes.
  • Establish and strengthen PMO frameworks, delivery standards, executive reporting, decision forums, and delivery assurance mechanisms.
  • Oversee program budgets, forecasts, resource plans, cost performance, and progress against approved business cases.
  • Lead business transformation, operating model changes, process improvement, technology-enabled initiatives, service transitions, automation, and digital modernization.
  • Establish effective risk, issue, dependency, change, quality, and escalation management practices.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, clients, business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and strategic partners.
  • Lead steering committees and executive reviews, communicate program performance and trade-offs, and resolve complex stakeholder and delivery challenges.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop project managers, program managers, PMO professionals, workstream leads, and geographically distributed teams.
  • Drive operational readiness and the effective transition of solutions into managed services or business-as-usual operations where applicable.
  • Use project and portfolio platforms, analytics, automation, KPIs, and dashboards to improve transparency, decision-making, predictability, and benefits tracking.
  • Contribute to investment planning, commercial assessments, proposals, solutioning, and continuous improvement of delivery methods and reusable practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To qualify for the role you must have

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Science / Engineering, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Typically 18+ years of progressive experience in project and program management, PMO leadership, enterprise transformation, managed services, delivery or global operations.
  • Proven experience leading complex programs with multiple workstreams, dependencies, senior stakeholders, and geographically distributed teams.
  • Strong capability in program governance, integrated planning, financial management, resource planning, risk mitigation, delivery assurance, and executive reporting.
  • Experience delivering business transformation, operating model change, service transition, process improvement, automation, or technology modernization initiatives.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders, facilitate decisions, manage ambiguity, and resolve complex delivery challenges.
  • Experience leading and developing project managers, program managers, PMO professionals, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong business acumen, executive communication, negotiation, structured problem-solving, and change leadership skills.
  • Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches, with the judgment to select and tailor methods to program needs.
  • Experience using project and portfolio management tools such as Microsoft Project, Planview, Jira

Ideally, you will also have

  • PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, or an equivalent project, program, Agile, change, or service management certification.
  • Experience in professional services, consulting, IT services, global business services, regulated industries, or a large enterprise environment.
  • Experience contributing to business cases, commercial reviews, proposals, solutioning, or client development activities.
  • Experience establishing PMO or delivery governance capabilities and improving project management maturity.

What We Look For

A strategic and delivery-focused leader who can connect business objectives with practical execution. Someone who combines strong program management discipline with commercial awareness, transformation experience, and sound judgment; builds trusted relationships; develops high-performing teams; and remains accountable for measurable outcomes in complex and changing environments.

What Working At EY Offers

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland & the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies & sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills & insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform, and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax & transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Actualmente buscamos para nuestra unidad de negocio Newsan Food dedicada a la exportación de alimentos, una persona para cubrir el puesto de Analista Sr de Exportación, para trabajar de manera híbrida con base en nuestra oficina central ubicada en Saavedra - CABA.

El principal objetivo es ser el responsable por emisión control y seguimiento de documentación de exportación/importación.

Tus principales desafíos y responsabilidades serán

  • Prepara y controla facturas y B.L.s
  • Preparar y/o controlar Certificados de origen y sanitarios.
  • Mantener dialogo fluido con clientes para coordinar embarques y entrega de documentación.
  • Analizar las cartas de créditos y cobranzas y preparar documentos acorde con el medio de pago.
  • Velar por la legalidad de la operación.
  • Interactuar con proveedores y despachantes.
  • Interactuar con despachantes de importación.


Requisitos


  • Estudiantes avanzados/as o graduados/as de Comercio exterior, Administración o afínes. (Excluyente)
  • Experiencia en puestos de exportación.
  • Experiencia habiendo trabajado documentación con despachates o habiendo trabajado en exportadora del rubro alimenticio. (Excluyente)
  • Manejo intermedio de Inglés.
  • Manejo de Excel avanzado.

Beneficios

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Jornada laboral híbrida.
  • Medicina prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar directo.
  • Comedor en la oficina, frutas y bebidas calientes a disposición.
  • Licencia extendida por maternidad y para personas no gestantes.
  • Viernes flex y jornada de trabajo flexible.
  • Día de cumpleaños libre.
  • Vacaciones extendidas.
  • Acceso a descuentos en productos de la compañía.
  • Programa de bienestar.
  • … ¡Y más que nos encantará comentarte durante el proceso de selección!

En Newsan tenemos todo lo que se necesita para acercarle a la comunidad los mejores productos y servicios de electrónica de consumo. Disponemos de la mejor tecnología con una amplia red logística, un gran talento humano y la representación de más de 20 marcas nacionales e internacionales (propias, licenciadas y acuerdos comerciales). Entre las propias tenemos a NOBLEX, PHILCO, ATMA, SIAM, ALLURE. Gracias a la eficiencia y compromiso, somos un partner elegido por las principales compañías tecnológicas del mundo como LG y MOTOROLA.

Creemos que las compañías con un propósito claro perduran, las marcas con un propósito crecen y las personas con un propósito, trascienden. Somos más de 9.000 colaboradores, en oficinas centrales, 7 plantas productivas, 3 centros logísticos y una vasta operación pesquera en toda la Argentina, quienes hacemos de NEWSAN una de las compañías más relevantes de los sectores en los que participamos.

Position Title:Sr Business Partner DT Manufacturing & Operations LATAM

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 43875

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.

About The Role.

The DT Business Partner Manufacturing represents Manufacturing Technology across LATAM and serves as the key connection between business priorities and McCain’s Manufacturing Technology strategy. This role partners with senior stakeholders to shape demand, define technology roadmaps, gather and validate requirements, deploy manufacturing technology capabilities, drive business readiness and adoption, and deliver medium-to-high complexity business, process, data, and technology transformations that support the regional manufacturing agenda.

What You’ll Be Doing.

  • Build strong relationships with LATAM Manufacturing leaders, Digital Technology leadership teams, Global Technology Leaders, and Global Product Owners.
  • Shape business demand into a prioritized Manufacturing technology portfolio and maintain regional technology roadmaps.
  • Provide strategic technology advisory aligned with McCain’s global technology vision, standards, policies, and regional growth objectives.
  • Lead and support the deployment of Manufacturing technology products and capabilities across LATAM while promoting adoption of global solutions.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications and collaborate with technical teams to deliver solutions.
  • Facilitate feasibility assessments, testing, user acceptance activities, go-live readiness, and post-implementation support.
  • Drive business readiness activities, including stakeholder engagement, communications, and training planning.
  • Ensure effective delivery of Manufacturing Technology services while managing budgets, service levels, risks, and performance reviews.
  • Promote adoption of Manufacturing Data & Analytics products and help modernize reporting and decision-making capabilities.
  • Lead through influence, share knowledge, and support the development of technology teams, delivery partners, and stakeholders.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • English proficiency required; Spanish required; Portuguese desirable.
  • 5+ years of experience in technology leadership, business relationship management, major transformation programs, or related strategic technology roles.
  • Experience working with senior leadership teams and external service providers or outsourcing partners.
  • Strong understanding of digital product delivery, business analysis, change leadership, and technology-enabled transformation.
  • Hands-on knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP ERP Manufacturing Management, digital manufacturing technologies, data and analytics solutions, and product deployment methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, lead through matrix organizations, and build high-performing teams.
  • Professional certifications such as PMBOK, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, CBAP, or Six Sigma are considered an asset.

About The Team.

This role is part of the Digital Technology organization supporting Manufacturing across LATAM. Reporting to the Digital Technology Director, LATAM, the position works closely with regional manufacturing leaders, global technology teams, product owners, delivery partners, and cross-functional stakeholders. Depending on organizational structure, the role may directly manage up to six team members while providing broad leadership through influence across regional and global teams.

About McCain.

Click Here to learn more about McCain and how we provide opportunities to make an impact that matters.

Leadership principles.

At McCain, our leadership principles guide how we engage with customers, collaborate as a team, and achieve success. We focus on understanding customer needs, driving innovation, empowering people, and taking ownership to clear obstacles and deliver results.

AI & Digital Capabilities.

At McCain, AI and digital capabilities are part of how we work and innovate. We value curiosity toward emerging technologies and the thoughtful, responsible use of AI-enabled tools to improve outcomes as part of our future-ready culture.

The McCain Experience.

We are McCain. This statement is a testament to our collective strength and our individual value. Your contributions play a vital role in our success. Our winning culture is rooted in authenticity and trust, empowering us to bring out the best in one another. Here, you’ll find opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. Join us and experience why we’re better together.

Our purpose is grounded in building meaningful relationships. We’re big believers in the power of working together in person—it helps us stay connected, collaborate more effectively, and grow as a team. At the same time, we recognize the importance of flexibility. Most office-based roles follow a hybrid model, with the option to work remotely two days a week.   • Experiencia gestionando distribuidores o clientes B2B internacionales.
  • Disponibilidad para realizar viajes internacionales frecuentes.
  • Experiencia liderando equipos.
  • Buen manejo de herramientas de análisis y seguimiento comercial.

Muy valorado

  • Experiencia en industria veterinaria, farmacéutica, salud animal, agroindustria o industrias reguladas.
  • Experiencia con productos que requieren registros sanitarios.
  • Experiencia previa en Latinoamérica y otros mercados internacionales.

Competencias clave

  • Liderazgo y delegación efectiva.
  • Capacidad analítica, visión estratégica, pensamiento de largo plazo.
  • Habilidades de negociación y desarrollo de negocios.
  • Autonomía y proactividad y orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidad de adaptación a distintos contextos culturales y comerciales.

  • Cobertura médicina prepaga
  • Dia de cumpleaños libre
  • Posibilidades de crecimiento
