descriptionHtml:
OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE COORDINATOR

En Cabify creemos que una nueva forma de movilidad urbana es posible. Un ecosistema que permita tener menos coches privados en las calles, vehículos más sostenibles y rutas más eficientes.

Ciudades en las que sus calles estén pensadas por y para las personas, y no para los coches. Productos y servicios que, mediante alternativas de movilidad sostenibles y eficientes, generen valor económico, social y medioambiental.

Y no solo es que creamos en ello, sino que trabajamos la magia para hacerlo posible. Si compartes con nosotros el mismo propósito, sigue leyendo porque… ¡Este es tu sitio!

Sobre el puesto

Cómo Operational Excellence Coordinator tu rol será colaborar e impulsar la consecución de esta misión y objetivos para los mercados de Argentina y Uruguay, garantizando el mejor servicio y la mejor experiencia posible a los pasajeros particulares y a los clientes corporativos de Cabify, buscando su fidelización a largo plazo.

El puesto se encuentra dentro del equipo de Operational Excellence (OEX), el cual pertenece al área de Customer Operations (COPS). Dentro de COPS, los equipos de OEX y Customer Support tienen la misión de ser los garantes de los estándares de servicio por los cuales Cabify se destaca. El área de COPS es quizás el área más transversal de Cabify, teniendo que trabajar con todos los departamentos, lo que garantiza mucho aprendizaje, desafíos y diversión.

Liderarás el equipo de OEX para las audiencias de demanda —pasajeros particulares y clientes corporativos (B2B)—, consolidando bajo una misma mirada la experiencia de quien viaja y la rentabilidad de las operaciones que diseñamos para las empresas.

¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir con nuestra misión?

  • Siendo la principal referencia estratégica y operativa dentro del equipo de OEX para las audiencias de demanda (pasajeros particulares y clientes corporativos) y liderando este equipo.
  • Operativizando y controlando la propuesta de valor definida para pasajeros y empresas, con foco en garantizar un servicio seguro, fiable y superior a través de la optimización y control de procesos eficientes, confiables y sin desperdicios, teniendo la capacidad de transformarlos.
  • Detectando oportunidades de mejora en las distintas etapas del customer journey de nuestros pasajeros y clientes corporativos: desde que inician su registro para ser nuevos usuarios y durante toda su experiencia en viajes y posterior a los viajes en Cabify.
  • Entendiendo los principales puntos de fricción para cada uno de los procesos y estableciendo propuestas de mejora, basándose siempre en el análisis del valor de cada una para la toma de decisiones.
  • Liderando proyectos de mejora para el área, en la búsqueda continua de soluciones efectivas, escalables y eficientes.
  • Trabajando de la mano con equipos de soporte para asegurar la mejor calidad de servicio, desde el punto de vista de la atención al cliente.
  • Optimizando procesos críticos a través de la implementación de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (LLMs, Prompt Engineering, OCR, etc) y de la automatización de tareas para escalar las operaciones, en conjunto con equipos locales y globales.
  • Alineando directrices de proyectos globales para su eficiente implementación local y escalando necesidades del mercado hacia equipos globales mediante la documentación de requerimientos y evidencia cuantitativa.

¿Qué buscamos?

  • Profesional en Ingeniería o afín con experiencia de al menos 3 años en cargos de optimización de procesos, mejora continua o en posiciones similares en empresas de tecnología. Será considerado como un plus tener experiencia en estos roles dentro de empresas de tecnología.
  • Experiencia excluyente de al menos 2 a 3 años liderando y gestionando equipos de forma directa, preferentemente con perfiles analíticos o técnicos.
  • Manejo avanzado de herramienta Excel / Google Sheets (excluyente).
  • Manejo de herramientas de Business Intelligence (Tableau, Power BI, o Looker, etc) para consultas de bases de datos, armado de gráficos y desarrollo de tableros básicos, con demostrada capacidad para hacer análisis e interpretación de indicadores (excluyente).
  • Experiencia comprobable en la implementación de flujos con herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) con el fin de optimizar procesos operativos.
  • Capacidad de manejar muchos frentes simultáneamente y de dialogar con múltiples interlocutores, logrando mantener una agenda ordenada de trabajo por objetivos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, con capacidad para interactuar eficazmente con diversos stakeholders, escalar problemas, dar visibilidad a iniciativas y validar cursos de acción.
  • Personas proactivas, autónomas y con ganas de impulsar un cambio.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Somos un equipo repleto de gente feliz y motivada. Flexibilidad, buen ambiente, crecimiento e impacto ¡asegurados! Cabify viene cargado de beneficios para que los disfrutes en tu viaje junto a nosotros:

🏥 Plan de medicina prepaga OSDE 210

🤸 Horario flexible, teletrabajo y semanas full remote

🎟️ Beneficios y descuentos con Club LA NACIÓN

🔋 Recharge Day: el tercer viernes del mes ¡libre!

🏝️ Cabify days: Una semana extra de vacaciones

🎉 Eventos divertidos para disfrutar junto a tu equipo

🖥️ Equipo de trabajo para que desarrolles todo tu talento

Cabify se enorgullece de ser un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con crear un entorno inclusivo para todas las personas, independientemente de su origen, género, religión, orientación, edad o capacidad. ¡Únete a nosotros!

descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Pencil, we are building the AI Operating System for marketing - the only enterprise platform that aggregates every leading AI model, enforces enterprise-grade governance, and turns creative production savings into media growth. Our work moves brands like Diageo, L’Oréal and Unilever from creative brief to live, on-brand, performance-tested campaigns in minutes - across every market, channel and language - without sacrificing legal, IT or brand control.

Your mission

Bring the craft of advertising together with the speed of GenAI. You build and operate agentic and nodal creative workflows - connecting insight, concept, copy, imagery and video into scalable systems - so our creative teams and clients can move from idea to finished advertising faster, without losing quality or strategic grounding.

You work day-to-day under the direction of Art Directors and Creative Directors, bringing deep hands-on fluency in GenAI tools and workflows to their briefs. You're not setting creative vision - you're the person in the room who knows how to make the technology deliver on it.

This track is for people who go deep on the systems side - building, scaling, and governing the agents, workflows, and creative infrastructure that creative teams and clients rely on. Creative sensibility still matters (they need to understand what "good creative output" means to build for it), but the growth path is technical leadership and architecture, not creative direction.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery & Requirements

  • Meet with clients, creative teams, and stakeholders to understand workflows, challenges, and operational requirements
  • Facilitate workflow audits and capability assessments
  • Identify where GenAI, agents, or automation can meaningfully improve quality, efficiency, or scale
  • Translate operational challenges into technical implementation plans

Agent, Workflow & System Architecture

  • Design and build production-grade prompts, workflows, agents, and creative systems
  • Develop repeatable, scalable frameworks that support multiple brands, markets, and channels
  • Own workflow governance, quality control, and reliability of deployed systems
  • Establish technical standards and best practices for how agents and workflows are built and maintained

Enablement & Technical Adoption

  • Lead training, workshops, and office hours to help teams adopt new systems
  • Own technical documentation, playbooks, and guides for internal and client use
  • Support change management as new tools and workflows roll out
  • Act as the technical authority on GenAI capabilities, limitations, and constraints

Platform Evaluation & Technical Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging AI models, platforms, and tooling for technical fit and scalability
  • Stress-test new capabilities and provide structured, technical feedback to Product and Engineering
  • Identify architectural improvements to existing agents, workflows, and systems
  • Represent the technical roadmap for creative technology internally

What We’re Looking For

  • 2-3 years’ experience in advertising creative development
  • Experience with GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Gemini etc.
  • Experience with GenAI techniques such as model selection & prompting
  • Any experience using GenAI to deliver real-world advertising creative
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud
  • Good personal communication and management skills
  • Preference for candidates who have prior agency experience
  • Strong written English skills, allowing you to communicate effectively with clients and team
  • Access to a reliable computer with an internet connection exceeding 40 Mbps
  • A collaborative and team-oriented attitude with optimism about the role of GenAI in creativity

What Growth Looks Like

  • Art Director: owns creative direction across projects, sets visual/conceptual standards, mentors on craft.
  • Creative Director: sets creative vision across accounts or brands, owns creative quality at scale.
  • Head of Creative: sets the creative bar and point of view for the organization.

Your Benefits

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays
  • Remote-first, flexibility to work anywhere from your home country.
  • Health insurance / private medical cover
  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development
  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

descriptionHtml:
About The Job

Shalion is a data and insights-driven company that serves world-class manufacturers and brands globally. Through our Digital Shelf Optimization, Retail Media, and Food Service Aggregators solutions, we provide innovative tools for e-commerce monitoring.

At Shalion, we empower brands to make smarter business decisions in eCommerce by delivering actionable data and insights on online product prices, availability, share of search, and more. We operate across 1000+ e-retailers in 60+ countries, serving industry giants such as Heineken, Lego, Danone, Nestlé, and JDE.

As a leader in data intelligence, we specialize in gathering, analyzing, and applying proprietary artificial intelligence to deliver relevant data and monitoring tools, helping our clients maximize their e-commerce performance.

Our headquarters are in Barcelona, Spain, and we are expanding our team in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

The role

We are seeking a proactive specialist who enjoy finding out-of-the-box solutions for complex problems, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and you are comfortable with JavaScript, XPath. JQuery, Node.js. Android, who is eager to apply their skills in a challenging environment. This role requires a deep understanding of the HTTP protocol and network protocols and the ability to bypass anti-bot protections.

Main areas of responsibility:

  • Developing and maintaining web scraping scripts and tools using Node.js.
  • Researching and debugging web scraping-related issues.
  • Implementing techniques to bypass anti-bot measures and other web protections.
  • Collaborating with the team to improve scraping efficiency and success rates.
  • Ensuring the setup of data projects that allow the operations team to gain efficiency and proactivity in deliveries.
  • Understanding and analyzing Web/App pages, their functionality, and programming logic.
  • Designing, coding, and implementing high-quality Java applications.
  • Being proactive in diagnosing failures.

As our hiring team is international, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English to ensure it can be reviewed by all stakeholders.

Work where work matters.

We are a global technology group built for what's next, offering high calibre professionals the platform for high stakes work, the kind of work that defines an entire career. When you join us, you're not just taking on projects, you're solving problems that don't even have answers yet.

You will join an exclusive roster of talent that global leaders, including Google, Snap, Diageo, PayPal, and Jaguar Land Rover call when deadlines seem impossible, when others have already tried and failed, and when the solution absolutely has to work.  

Forget routine consultancy. You will operate where technology, design, and human behaviour meet to deliver tangible outcomes, fast. This is work that leaves a mark, work you'll be proud to tell your friends about.

We are looking for a Senior Visual Designer to join our delivery center in Buenos Aires. 

We look for people who embody:

Innovation to solve the hardest problems.

‍Accountability for every result.

‍Integrity always.

About The Role



Role Overview

We're seeking a curious and ambitious Senior Visual Designer who can help us push boundaries and set new standards for what exceptional design means in the AI era. You will deliver game-changing design for everyone from global clients to innovative start-ups and challenger brands, whilst helping us lead the industry in AI-native design.

You'll be shaping a range of customer surfaces — from marketing platforms and products to next-generation, multimodal, and agentic experiences — translating complex business challenges into simple, human-first solutions. From concept to delivery, you'll combine design thinking, craft, collaboration, and commercial impact to create work that is visionary, award-winning, and outcome-driven.

Above all, you're an awesome human who loves being surrounded by — and collaborating with — smart, talented folks in a fun, fast-paced environment.

Role Responsibilities

  • Help design beautiful, adaptive and intelligent experiences - translating complex business problems and goals into bold, differentiated ideas
  • Create world-class client-facing deliverables with a focus on UI design, AI-driven interaction patterns, responsive frameworks, prototypes, and visual design systems that span digital products, AI interfaces and agentic services, across devices such as desktops, mobile devices, wearables, and embedded surfaces
  • Craft high-quality concepts, visuals, UI, and prototypes across digital products, AI interfaces and agentic services.
  • Create compelling presentations that hero the work, and communicate thought and reasoning behind it to all audiences.
  • Collaborate fluidly with UX designers, strategists, engineers, data scientists, and copywriters.

What Success Looks Like

  • 5+ years of experience in digital/interactive design (agency or in-house).
  • Excellent visual design skills, underpinned by a strong knowledge of foundational UX principles and best practices.
  • Understanding of AI concepts, including conversational surfaces, multimodal interfaces, agentic systems, and responsible AI.
  • Proven ability to translate business challenges into human-first, commercially valuable design.
  • Ability to explain your vision to members of the design team, either verbally or in documentation/digitally.
  • Experience participating in pitches and inspiring clients with visionary, yet credible, design solutions is desirable.

Benefits

We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. Here's how we invest in you:

  • Work from Home Allowance
  • Private Medical Insurance for family group
  • Birthday leave
  • 10 paid learning days per year
  • Bonusly 100 points per month to recognise colleagues

Diversity and Inclusion

At Beyond we champion diversity and inclusion. We believe that a career in IT should be open to everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability or neurotype. We value the unique talents and perspectives that each individual brings to our team, and we strive to create a fair and accessible hiring process for all.

Misión

Brindar soporte analítico y operativo al programa de mejoramiento de maíz de la región Sur, participando en el diseño, ejecución y análisis de ensayos, selección de germoplasma y planificación de actividades de campo y contraestación.

Requisitos

  • Ingeniería Agronómica o carrera afín (excluyente).
  • Estudios de Maestría o Doctorado en Mejoramiento Genético (deseable).
  • Experiencia mínima de 3 años en mejoramiento genético o áreas relacionadas.
  • Conocimiento del cultivo de maíz (deseable).
  • Manejo de bases de datos y software especializados.
  • Conocimientos avanzados de estadística.
  • Inglés intermedio y portugués deseable.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipos multidisciplinarios.
  • Perfil autónomo, proactivo, innovador y con capacidad de influencia.
  • Flexibilidad, adaptabilidad y orientación a resultados.
  • Disponibilidad para realizar viajes frecuentes nacionales e internacionales durante temporada y contraestación.

Responsabilidades

  • Diseñar, configurar y planificar ensayos de breeding y rendimiento, coordinando su correcta implementación con las áreas involucradas.
  • Planificar, monitorear y liderar la generación, recolección y análisis de datos fenológicos, fenotípicos y sanitarios a campo.
  • Participar activamente en la evaluación y selección de híbridos y líneas de maíz mediante observaciones, análisis de datos y criterio técnico.
  • Coordinar actividades de contraestación dentro y fuera del país, asegurando el avance generacional y el cumplimiento de los objetivos del programa.
  • Gestionar inventarios de semillas, necesidades de reproducción y logística de envíos entre regiones.
  • Liderar la interacción con proveedores y áreas de soporte clave, incluyendo Analítica, Laboratorio y Tecnología.
  • Participar en reuniones técnicas y colaborar en la comunicación de resultados y avances del programa.
  • Colaborar con el Breeder en la planificación y seguimiento del presupuesto anual del programa de mejoramiento.

descriptionHtml:
📈 #SomosBYMA, la Bolsa de Valores líder de Argentina 🇦🇷
Trabajamos para transformar la inversión en trabajo y desarrollo, generamos el escenario y los productos para que todos los argentinos puedan canalizar sus ahorros y obtengan un rendimiento que les permita alcanzar sus metas. 🚀
📌 Tu objetivo será liderar la construcción y el control del P&L de la compañía, con foco en el análisis de costos y el diseño de los drivers que permitan distribuir de manera precisa los costos hacia los negocios, servicios y productos, generando visibilidad económica real para la toma de decisiones.
✏️ ¿Cuáles serán tus desafíos?
  • Construir y mantener el P&L por negocio, servicio y producto y cliente, asegurando la correcta asignación de ingresos y costos directos e indirectos.
  • Diseñar, calcular y evolucionar los drivers de distribución de costos indirectos (estructura, soporte, servicios compartidos) hacia las distintas unidades de negocio, garantizando criterios de asignación razonables, trazables y sostenibles en el tiempo.
  • Analizar la estructura de costos de la compañía, identificando su composición, comportamiento (fijo/variable) y principales palancas de eficiencia.
  • Participar en la elaboración, seguimiento y actualización del presupuesto anual y los forecast periódicos, con especial énfasis en la proyección de costos.
  • Realizar el análisis de desvíos entre real, presupuesto y forecast, identificando causas raíz e impacto en la rentabilidad por línea de negocio.
  • Desarrollar y mantener modelos de costeo y rentabilidad que permitan simular escenarios y evaluar el impacto económico de decisiones sobre la estructura de costos.
  • Actuar como business partner de los dominios, desafiando supuestos de costos y contribuyendo a mejorar la calidad de las decisiones sobre asignación de recursos.
  • Diseñar y evolucionar tableros de control que muestren la evolución de costos, drivers de asignación y rentabilidad por negocio/servicio/producto/cliente.
  • Elaborar reportes ejecutivos e insights accionables sobre el P&L para la dirección y los distintos equipos.
  • Impulsar iniciativas de automatización y mejora continua en los procesos de costeo, asignación y reporting.
⭐ Valoramos
  • Profesionales graduados en Ingeniería Industrial, Economía, Administración, .
  • Más de 4 años de experiencia en áreas de Costos, Planning, FP&A, Control de Gestión con fuerte orientación al análisis de costos, a la construcción de P&L y al análisis financiero.
  • Sólidos conocimientos de modelos de costeo y asignación de costos indirectos (costeo basado en actividades / full-cost) y de armado de P&L gerencial por negocio, servicio o producto.
  • Experiencia en construcción de presupuestos, forecast, análisis de desvíos.
  • Conocimientos de modelización financiera y análisis de rentabilidad.
  • Experiencia con SQL y herramientas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau o similares).
  • Capacidad para transformar datos en insights y recomendaciones de negocio, involucrándose en los negocios de la cia.
  • Perfil analítico, con visión estratégica, autonomía e influencia transversal.
🤩 ¡Nuestra propuesta de valor potencia tu desarrollo profesional y personal!
💻 Experiencia Flex: 3 días de trabajo remoto y 2 días de presencialidad por semana.
⏰ Horario de trabajo: 10 a 18:30hs.
🏖️Vacaciones Flex: Contás con 10 días hábiles de vacaciones y 14 días para trabajar online desde donde quieras, antes o después de tus vacaciones.
🌐 Reintegro por gastos de conectividad.
🎓 #BYMAEduca: becas para maestrías y convenios con universidades líderes (cursos ejecutivos, carreras de grado, ciclos complementarios, terciarios, posgrado, maestrías, incluso doctorados).
🤓 Inglés/Portugués y cursos gratuitos en BYMAEduca (¡vos y tus familiares pueden aprender a invertir!).
🍼 : Licencia por maternidad con regreso progresivo y Licencia por paternidad extendida. Sala de Lactancia en BYMA.
🩺#PrepagaDePrimerNivel: Cobertura de prepaga para el grupo familiar (OSDE), seguro de vida y campañas de vacunación.
💪🏻#GYMPass: Descuentos en redes de gimnasios (¡lo podés compartir con 3 personas!).
🍔#Viandas: Contamos con un sistema de viandas (para todas las elecciones alimentarias) en donde BYMA paga el 80% del valor de las mismas.
❤️ #AlianzasBYMA: Descuentos en Molinos Río de la Plata, Bimbo, Norton, Samshop (Samsung), y muchas más.
🎁 #ExperienciaBYMA: Regalos corporativos (cumpleaños, noche de bodas, nacimientos, fin de año, ¡entre otros!)
¿Qué estás esperando para ser parte de una compañía líder del Mercado de Capitales argentino?
📌Sumate a nuestra #CulturaBYMA que prioriza el bienestar, la igualdad, el desarrollo profesional y la inclusión. ¡Formá parte de un equipo de personas que trabajan por un gran propósito! 🎯

Descripción

If you're passionate about new challenges, apply to SNP Group and take your career to the next level!

We are a global company headquartered in Heidelberg, Germany, and a leader in digital transformation solutions and SAP consulting services. We partner with organizations worldwide to support their technology transformation journeys, helping them transform, migrate, and manage their SAP data in an agile, secure, and efficient way.

With a presence in more than 20 countries, over 3,000 clients worldwide, and more than 30 years of experience, we are a trusted strategic partner for organizations looking to accelerate their digital transformation and successfully navigate the challenges of the future.

We are always looking for people who show initiative and stand out for their commitment, skills and talent. If this sounds like you, then get involved as: SAP Project Manager.

As an SAP Project Manager, you will oversee and manage the end-to-end execution of SAP migration projects, ensuring successful delivery on time, within scope, and on budget. Your primary responsibilities will include managing ECC and S/4HANA migrations and working closely with a variety of DataManagement Software.

Responsabilidades

What will you do in this role?

  • Project Leadership: Lead and manage SAP projects from initiation through to completion.
  • Planning & Execution: Develop detailed project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, and timelines. Ensure adherence to project plans and make necessary adjustments as required.
  • Team Management: Assemble and manage project teams, including internal resources consultants. Provide leadership, direction, and support to team members.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, ensuring clear and effective communication throughout the project lifecycle. Manage expectations and address concerns promptly.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues, develop mitigation strategies, and implement solutions to minimize impact on project objectives.
  • Budget Management: Develop and manage project budgets, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial constraints.
  • Quality Assurance: Monitor and control project quality, ensuring deliverables meet the required standards and business requirements.
  • Reporting: Provide regular project status reports, including progress updates, risks, and issues.
  • Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying and implementing best practices and lessons learned from each project.

Requisitos

We're Looking For Professionals Who Have

  • Experience: Proven experience (5 + years) as SAP Project Manager.
  • Technical Expertise: In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP modules, and migration strategies. Familiarity with SAP tools and methodologies. Experience in RISE, ECC and S/4 HANA.
  • Brazilian taxes localization
  • Skills: Excellent project management, organizational, and leadership skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Budget Control
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, with a flexible and proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Experience with SAP products and technologies.
  • Multinational project experience or exposure to global SAP implementations.
  • Fluent English and Spanish.
  • Good background in SAP modules.

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Especialista Cloud para sumarse al equipo, en CABA, con modalidad híbrida (1 día presencial y 4 días remotos por semana) y horario de lunes a viernes de 09 00 a 18 00 hs. La posición liderará la operación y confiabilidad de la plataforma cloud e híbrida de la compañía, con foco en Operaciones (CloudOps), garantizando la disponibilidad, seguridad, capacidad y eficiencia de costos de los ambientes que sostienen los servicios de negocio, y estableciendo los procesos y controles necesarios para operar cada plataforma de forma segura y auditable.

Responsabilidades

  • Diseñar y evolucionar la estrategia de operación de la plataforma cloud e híbrida (hoy AWS, ROSA y OpenShift on-premise), llevando el aprovisionamiento y la configuración hacia modelos de Infraestructura como Código reproducibles, versionados y auditables.
  • Garantizar la disponibilidad, capacidad y performance de los clusters y servicios cloud, definiendo prácticas de escalado, upgrades y gestión de capacidad que minimicen el riesgo sobre los ambientes productivos.
  • Ser referente en la gestión de incidentes de infraestructura y plataforma (detección, diagnóstico, respuesta y análisis post-incidente), elevando la madurez de observabilidad y los runbooks operativos del equipo.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Arquitectura, Seguridad y Desarrollo para incorporar controles de hardening, gestión de identidades y accesos, y compliance en la operación diaria.
  • Impulsar la gestión y optimización de costos cloud (FinOps) visibilidad de gasto, tagging, right-sizing y mejora continua de la eficiencia.
  • Automatizar tareas operativas recurrentes (parcheo, rotación de credenciales, backups, recuperación ante desastres) para reducir la intervención manual.
  • Evaluar y administrar el ecosistema de herramientas de automatización, monitoreo y gestión de configuración, proponiendo mejoras o estandarizaciones.
  • Ser referente técnico y mentor del equipo en la operación de plataforma cloud.
  • Documentar y mantener actualizados los procesos, runbooks y estándares de operación.


Requisitos


  • Experiencia en Infraestructura como Código y automatización de configuración Terraform / Terragrunt, Ansible / AWX y Git; nociones de despliegue declarativo / GitOps (Argo, Helm, Kustomize).
  • Experiencia en OpenShift / ROSA y Kubernetes a nivel operación de cluster (upgrades, RBAC, redes, storage, capacidad).
  • Conocimiento avanzado de AWS a nivel operativo (IAM, redes, ECS/Fargate, EKS y servicios asociados), con foco en confiabilidad, seguridad y eficiencia de costos (FinOps).

Se valora

  • Conocimientos de Red Hat Stack (EAP, FUSE).
  • Observabilidad y confiabilidad (SRE) herramientas de monitoreo, logging y métricas, gestión de incidentes y definición de SLOs/SLIs.
  • Seguridad y compliance operativa hardening, gestión de identidades y accesos, parcheo, estrategias de backup y recuperación ante desastres.
  • Python y Bash/Shell; experiencia con Go.
  • Nociones operativas de bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL/Aurora, RDS, MongoDB/DocumentDB, Redis) administración, backup y alta disponibilidad.

Beneficios

Gran oportunidad de desarrollo.

  • Prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar.
  • Días adicionales de vacaciones.
  • Beneficio de pago de conectividad.
  • Horario flexible y esquema híbrido de trabajo.
  • Licencias Udemy para capacitarte en lo que quieras.
  • Acceso preferencial en la contratación de productos y/o servicios como seguros de caución, hogar, automotor, retiro, vida y ahorro.
  • Campaña de vacunación gratuita.
  • Cobertura en gimnasios a través de la red Wellhub.
  • Descuentos corporativos en cines, teatros, viajes, restaurantes, spas y otros rubros.

Importante Empresa del Rubro Salud, líder en la industria, y que quiere seguir impactando positivamente en la vida de más personas, busca sumar un Analista Funcional Senior SAP a la Dirección de Sistemas y Tecnología.

En este rol, vas a poder transformar procesos complejos en soluciones tecnológicas que ayuden a que toda la organización siga cuidando mejor a más personas.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

Make an Impact as an Associate Director, Therapeutic Area Quality Lead at Worldwide

Play a pivotal role in driving quality excellence across global clinical research programs. In this strategic Quality Assurance leadership role, you'll help ensure regulatory compliance, proactively manage quality risks, and support the successful delivery of clinical trials that advance patient outcomes worldwide.

As a trusted quality partner, you will collaborate with operational leaders, project teams, and sponsor quality counterparts to strengthen quality oversight, promote continuous improvement, and support inspection readiness across assigned therapeutic areas and sponsor portfolios.

Your expertise will help foster a culture of quality, enabling teams to identify risks early, resolve complex issues effectively, and maintain high standards throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.

Where You'll Work

This is a remote role open to candidates based in Argentina, Mexico, or Colombia. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.

Travel domestically and internationally up to 15% as needed.

What You'll Do

  • Provide strategic Quality Assurance oversight across assigned therapeutic areas and sponsor portfolios.
  • Partner with operational leadership, project teams, and sponsor quality counterparts to strengthen quality performance and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead quality governance activities and facilitate effective quality decision-making across clinical research programs.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate quality risks to support successful study execution and patient-focused outcomes.
  • Analyze quality metrics and trends to drive proactive improvements and enhance quality performance.
  • Support audits, regulatory inspections, and inspection-readiness initiatives across assigned areas.
  • Oversee CAPA development, implementation, and effectiveness reviews to ensure sustainable quality outcomes.
  • Promote the consistent application of quality standards and global regulatory requirements throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement across cross-functional teams.

Innovid is the leading independent omnichannel ad tech platform, empowering marketers to create, deliver, measure, and optimize ad-supported experiences that people love. In 2025, Innovid and Flashtalking merged to create a transparent, scalable alternative to big-tech, walled-gardens, and point solutions across CTV, digital, linear, and social channels. As part of Mediaocean, Innovid is tied into the industry’s core ad infrastructure for omnichannel planning, buying, and billing. We are proud to lead the industry with our innovation, intelligence, and independence as the company best-suited to power the future of advertising.


We're looking for a top-notch, passionate Sr Software Engineer to be part of our world-class R&D team. We're an advertising technology company that ingests roughly 1 billion (1000M) ad impressions per day — around 500GB of data daily — into a processing system that derives performance metrics for our clients. As part of this role, you need to understand and analyze heavy usage applications architecture and their performance including getting a deep understanding of the business workflows behind them. The next step after understanding the challenge's scope is to design, build (hands-on) the suggested solution, test and deploy it to production. All done in a continuous development and deployment environment. Now you will need to guide and help developers across multiple teams adopt your solution. If you think you can handle a wide range of technologies, play and lead an important role in the design and analysis of software projects, create new applications or improve existing ones, evaluate application technologies, develop product prototypes and implement it in different parts of our product, please contact us!


The Impact You’ll Make

  • Design and implement major aspects of the architecture of applications, including components such as infrastructure, backbone services and user interface
  • Lead by example the development of modules for a high-end product that processes over 1 billion transactions a day
  • Architect and evolve systems for high-throughput data ingestion and processing, handling several hundred gigabytes of data daily
  • Design and develop viable solutions for various systems and architectures to different types of Innovid business aspects
  • Deploy your solutions to production in a continuous manner
  • Be responsible for the well-being of Innovid applications in production
  • Work with R&D managers to define, prioritize and finalize development standards
  • Oversee the Design Process for Application Software
  • Provide technical training, support, and training to R&D developers



What You’ll Bring to Us

  • Bachelor in computer science or a related discipline - it´s a must
  • At least 4+ years with demonstrated large-scale system experience (5+ years preferred)
  • Experience processing large volumes of data in production systems
  • Solid understanding of load distribution, data storage strategies, and system architecture at scale
  • Strong analytical, creative, problem-solving and critical thinking skills
  • Understanding of design and production procedures and standards to create prototypes and finished products
  • Experience with large scale performance issues
  • Experience with Snowflake, PostgreSQL, MongoDB – an advantage
  • Experience with dataframes, map-reduce, Spark, Pandas, Polars – an advantage
  • Experience with workflow management tools like Argo/Airflow – an advantage
  • Experience in Python, TypeScript (React and Node.js) – an advantage
  • Experience with web server or client side development – an advantage
  • Must have a passion for technology and quality
  • Good analytical and communication skills


There is no such thing as the perfect resume, or someone that checks every box. At Innovid, we are generous with our time and knowledge, and always ready to teach. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day and add to Innovid.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Innovid is an equal opportunity employer, committed to our diversity and inclusiveness. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability or age. We strongly encourage women, people of color, members of the LGBTQIA community, people with disabilities and veterans to apply. We are actively working to be an anti-racist organization. We're committing to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace for all of our employees. You can read more about our commitment to DEI here.

If you are located within the EEA and subject to GDPR or are a California resident subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act, click here to understand how Innovid processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Technology to lead a high-performing engineering team within the Tax & Accounting area. This leader will be responsible for driving business results through strong technical leadership, operational excellence, and close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.

The role requires a leader who can combine strategic thinking, technical depth, and people leadership to help evolve the organization's technology capabilities. The ideal candidate will bring experience leading teams through modern software engineering transformation, including cloud adoption, AI-enabled ways of working, and scalable engineering practices, while maintaining a strong focus on customer value, delivery quality, and team performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic and Technical Leadership
  • Lead the Technology team to achieve business outcomes and deliver value aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Drive the adoption and evolution of modern software engineering practices, cloud architecture, and Generative AI capabilities.
  • Provide strong technical leadership by guiding the team on how to execute effectively in technology, being hands-on when necessary.
  • Contribute to the roadmap and execution strategy for Tax & Accounting products.
  • Promote a transformation mindset, challenging the status quo and helping the organization evolve toward more efficient and scalable ways of working.
  • Delivery Excellence
  • Ensure high-quality, high-speed software delivery with a strong focus on customer experience and business impact.
  • Establish and reinforce modern engineering practices such as:
    • Continuous Integration
    • Continuous Testing
    • Trunk-Based Development
    • Progressive Delivery
    • Visual Management
    • WIP Control
    • Small Batch Delivery
    • Drive both effectiveness (doing the right things) and efficiency (doing things the right way).
    • Build a benchmark technology operation focused on consistency, quality, and speed.
    • Technical Excellence
    • Lead the implementation and continuous evolution of a loosely coupled cloud architecture.
    • Promote and strengthen engineering standards across:
      • Cloud-native development
      • FinOps practices
      • Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
      • Monitoring and observability
      • Incident management
      • Capacity planning
      • Security and resilience
    • Ensure the team operates according to high technical standards and industry best practices.
    • High-Performance People Management
    • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of approximately 10 to 15 professionals.
    • Foster an environment of:
      • Accountability
      • Ownership
      • Psychological safety
      • Belonging and retention
      • Learning and continuous improvement
      • Clear communication
      • Active mentoring and talent development
    • Drive performance management and succession development, with an emphasis on building future leaders.
    • Cross-Departmental Collaboration
    • Build strong, lasting partnerships with key stakeholders across:
      • Product
      • Business
      • Customer Support / CS
      • Other Technology Business Units
    • Navigate a complex stakeholder environment and ensure technology efforts remain aligned with business priorities and customer needs.
    • Act as a trusted technology partner capable of influencing decisions and driving alignment across functions.
    • Focus on Operational Efficiency
    • Drive continuous optimization of processes, team capacity, and delivery models.
    • Ensure smart resource allocation and maximize return on investment.
    • Promote a practical, results-oriented mindset focused on "doing more with less" without compromising quality or team health.
    Required Qualifications

    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
    • Professional English proficiency is required.
    • Significant experience in technology leadership roles, including experience managing engineering teams.
    • Strong background in software development and solution architecture.
    • Demonstrated experience with modern software engineering practices and engineering transformation.
    • Experience leading teams in environments that have already adopted or are actively scaling AI-enabled practices.
    • Strong experience working with cloud technologies and modern distributed systems.
    • Proven ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders and partner effectively with business and product leaders.
    • Experience leading teams in fast-changing, ambiguous, or evolving environments.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience in Tax & Accounting, enterprise platforms, or similarly complex product environments.
    • Exposure to GenAI adoption, engineering productivity transformation, and operational scale initiatives.
    • Experience implementing or leading FinOps, SRE, and engineering efficiency programs.

    ¿Qué te ofrecemos?

    • Modelo de Trabajo Híbrido: Hemos adoptado un entorno de trabajo híbrido y flexible para nuestros roles en oficina, ofreciendo una experiencia fluida que está conectada digital y físicamente.
    • Flexibilidad y Equilibrio entre Trabajo y Vida Personal: "Flex My Way" Consiste en un conjunto de políticas de apoyo en el entorno laboral, diseñadas para facilitar la gestión de las responsabilidades personales y profesionales, ya sea atendiendo a la familia, participando en actividades comunitarias o dedicando tiempo al descanso y la renovación personal. Estas políticas se basan en nuestro enfoque flexible de trabajo, que permite a los empleados trabajar desde cualquier lugar hasta 8 semanas al año, promoviendo así un equilibrio ideal entre sus compromisos laborales y personales.
    • Desarrollo y Crecimiento Profesional: Fomentamos una cultura de aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de habilidades, preparando a nuestro talento para enfrentar los desafíos del futuro y ofrecer soluciones reales. Nuestro programa "Grow My Way" y el enfoque en habilidades garantizan que tengas las herramientas y conocimientos para crecer, liderar y prosperar en un futuro habilitado por la inteligencia artificial.
    • Beneficios Competitivos del Sector: Ofrecemos planes de beneficios integrales que incluyen seguros de gastos médicos, dos días de descanso por salud mental a nivel de la empresa, programas de incentivos para empleados y recursos para el bienestar mental, físico y financiero.
    • Cultura: Reconocida globalmente con una reputación premiada por inclusión y pertenencia, flexibilidad, equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal, y más. Vivimos nuestros valores: Obsesión por nuestros Clientes, Competir para Ganar, Desafiar nuestro Pensamiento, Actuar Rápido / Aprender Rápido, y Más Fuertes Juntos.
    • Impacto Social: Genera un impacto en tu comunidad con nuestro Instituto de Impacto Social. Ofrecemos a los empleados dos días de voluntariado pagados anualmente y oportunidades para involucrarse en proyectos de consultoría pro bono e iniciativas de Medio Ambiente, Sociales y de Gobernanza (ESG).
    • Haciendo un Impacto Real en el Mundo: Somos una de las pocas compañías a nivel global que asiste a sus clientes en la búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Trabajando en conjunto con los profesionales e instituciones a los que servimos, contribuimos a sostener el estado de derecho, fomentar el comercio, detectar a los infractores, informar sobre los hechos y ofrecer información confiable e imparcial a personas en todo el mundo.

    Quiénes somos

    Thomson Reuters marca el camino hacia el futuro al reunir contenido confiable y la tecnología que las personas y organizaciones necesitan para tomar decisiones correctas. Servimos a profesionales en los sectores legal, fiscal, contable, de cumplimiento, gubernamental y de medios. Nuestros productos combinan software altamente especializado e información para capacitar a los profesionales con los datos, inteligencia y soluciones necesarias para tomar decisiones informadas y ayudar a las instituciones en su búsqueda de justicia, verdad y transparencia. Reuters, parte de Thomson Reuters, es un proveedor líder mundial de periodismo y noticias confiables.

    Contamos con el talento de 26,000 colaboradores en más de 70 países, donde todos tienen la oportunidad de contribuir y crecer profesionalmente en entornos de trabajo flexibles. En un momento en el que la objetividad, precisión, equidad y transparencia están bajo ataque, nos comprometemos a buscarlos. ¿Suena emocionante? Forma parte de nuestro equipo y contribuye a moldear las industrias que impulsan el progreso de la sociedad.

    Como empresa global, confiamos en los antecedentes únicos, perspectivas y experiencias de todos los empleados para cumplir con nuestros objetivos comerciales. Para asegurarnos de poder hacerlo, buscamos colaboradores talentosos y calificados en todas nuestras operaciones alrededor del mundo, sin importar raza, color, sexo/género, incluyendo embarazo, identidad y expresión de género, origen nacional, religión, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad, estado civil, estado de ciudadanía, condición de veterano u otra clasificación protegida bajo la ley aplicable. Thomson Reuters se enorgullece de ser un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades laborales, proporcionando un ambiente de trabajo libre de drogas.

    Asimismo, ofrecemos adaptaciones razonables para personas calificadas con discapacidades y para aquellas con creencias religiosas sinceras, conforme a la legislación vigente. Puedes encontrar más información sobre cómo solicitar una adaptación aquí.

    Descubre cómo protegerte de anuncios de empleo fraudulentos aquí. Para obtener más información sobre Thomson Reuters, visita nuestro sitio web en thomsonreuters.com

Thomson Reuters marca el camino hacia el futuro al reunir contenido confiable y la tecnología que las personas y organizaciones necesitan para tomar decisiones correctas. Servimos a profesionales en los sectores legal, fiscal, contable, de cumplimiento, gubernamental y de medios. Description

You sweat the small stuff because you know that great design is in the details.

You are self-motivated — you have a true passion coupled with the exceptional ability to translate the vision of our clients into high quality and impactful deliverables. You would also be responsible for troubleshooting problems that may arise with a piece and coming up with creative solutions to make sure things happen the way they’re supposed to. Such talent and ingenuity make you the right fit for this unique Graphic Design Production Artist role with BoldSky.

Mid-Level Graphic Designer: Core contributor to projects, owns bigger pieces and is proficient at adhering to brand standards. They work with all the information at their disposal and use their skill set and knowledge to solve problems.

Mid-Level Production Artist: You assist teams in the production of graphic material, packaging, display, and advertising projects, and more. You collaborate with Art Directors, Designers, and other Graphic Designers to format artwork, ensure print quality standards are met, and often collect, process, and organize files.

Responsibilities:

  • Mid-Level Graphic Designer: Core contributor to projects, owns bigger pieces, and is proficient at adhering to brand standards.
  • Report to the Discipline Lead for project assignments; collaborate with creative teams for implementation and direction.
  • Layout files, make prescribed edits, and prepare print files per vendor specifications.
  • Must also be capable of developing scientific figure redraws (converting raw data into vector charts and graphs) for medical communication materials using adobe illustrator.
  • Work closely with account, creative, and creative services departments as part of an integrated team.
  • Adhere to agency vision and uphold client style guidelines.
  • Traditional studio support including mock-ups and presentation materials.
  • Deliver quality work on time and within budget.
  • Create production-ready files for print and digital, including edits to existing layouts.
  • Prepare mechanical print files according to vendor specs and brand style guides.
  • Coordinate with project managers on schedule and hours.
  • Maintain server structure and guide others on file organization.
  • Support onboarding for studio process and file structure.
  • Manage brand assets, logos, and workflow within the brand.
  • Champion BoldSky workflow and contribute to process improvements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design or related field, with agency/studio experience.
  • 5–10 years’ experience in Graphic Design.
  • Expertise in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat).
  • Extensive prepress knowledge including formats, resolution, and four-color printing.
  • Excellent communication and direction-giving skills.
  • Strong design sense: layout, composition, hierarchy, typography, and color.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Team player with ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently under deadlines.
  • Experience with Sketch and/or Figma a plus.
  • Experience with PowerPoint, animation, digital/video a plus.
  • Experience working in DAM systems a plus.

Should also be:

  • Able to Understand and Implement Direction: Can translate creative objectives into effective execution and communicate workload needs clearly.
  • Industry Application: Quick learner with strong functional and technical knowledge of both the client’s and agency’s businesses.
  • Demonstrating Ownership and Proactivity: Shows initiative and consistently offers new ideas, owning the brand from a visual standpoint.
  • Willingness to be Flexible: Open to stepping outside the formal job description to support the team and deliver high-quality work.

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

Boldsky Creative Studio supports more than 12+ Syneos Health marketing and communication agencies as well as direct-to-customer engagements. We function as the agencies' creative execution and production arm, implementing their creative vision. As part of Syneos Health, our agencies — consisting of leading brands and experts in advertising, branding, public relations, managed markets and medical communications — are engaged in every point of influence in health, providing real-world insight into markets and audiences in ways that no other partner could.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Prime Operations Assistant on the Custody Product Ops team within Institutional, you'll support the operational workflows that keep Coinbase's token management platform running for Prime customers. This team manages the full billing lifecycle, contract operations, customer onboarding, and token distributions for crypto-native teams, protocol foundations, and institutional clients. You'll execute established processes across revenue, contract, customer, and token operations, maintaining the accuracy and reliability that Prime customers depend on.

What you'll do:

  • Reconcile billing and subscription records, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate collections follow-up to maintain accurate revenue operations across the Prime customer base.
  • Manage MSA intake and agreement workflows through Ironclad, track signatures and renewals, and maintain complete contract records for all active accounts.
  • Coordinate TLS and Vesting Platform onboarding for new customers, triage Pylon inboxes, and deliver timely communications throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Prepare token distributions, support grant setup and M2M migrations, and execute controlled lockup coverage in accordance with documented approval requirements.
  • Maintain SOPs, reporting methodology, and canonical operational datasets, flagging opportunities for automation and escalating policy questions to designated owners.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 1+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, contract administration, or customer operations within financial services, fintech, or digital assets.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent workflows with consistent accuracy, including billing reconciliation, subscription tracking, and record maintenance.
  • Hands-on experience with operational tooling such as Ironclad, Pylon, CRM platforms, or subscription billing systems.
  • Familiarity with KPI tracking, data hygiene practices, and documented controls sufficient to maintain reporting across revenue and customer metrics.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Position Summary

This positions serves as a strategic finance leader responsible for financial operations, revenue assurance, financial controls, business process optimization, and systems integration across a complex service-delivery organization. This role partners with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Shared Services, Payroll, and senior business leaders to ensure financial accuracy, operational efficiency, compliance, and scalable business processes.

The position combines traditional finance responsibilities with operational leadership, financial systems expertise, and transformation initiatives to support business growth and organizational effectiveness.

Essential Functions

Financial Leadership

  • Lead monthly financial operational activities, reconciliations, and reporting processes.
  • Oversee complex account reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, and financial analyses.
  • Partner with business leaders to support financial decision-making and operating performance.
  • Monitor financial results and identify operational or financial risks requiring escalation.

Revenue Assurance & Financial Controls

  • Own revenue reconciliation processes between operational and financial reporting platforms.
  • Analyze billing, invoicing, and revenue variances and drive timely resolution.
  • Design and maintain internal controls supporting financial reporting integrity.
  • Support internal and external audits by ensuring appropriate documentation and control execution.
  • Lead root-cause analysis of financial discrepancies and recommend corrective actions.

Finance Operations

  • Oversee accounts payable governance, vendor onboarding support, payment tracking, and financial posting processes.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting requirements, and approval workflows.
  • Improve operational efficiency through standardization and process enhancements.
  • Maintain visibility over key operational finance metrics and performance indicators.

Business Process & Systems Leadership

  • Serve as the finance subject matter expert for SAP, PSA, workflow tools, and financial reporting solutions.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives focused on automation, controls, scalability, and efficiency.
  • Support acquisitions, legal entity integrations, and finance transformation projects.
  • Collaborate with technology teams to enhance reporting, data quality, and system functionality.

Knowledge Management & Training

  • Develop process documentation, training materials, operating procedures, and knowledge-transfer plans.
  • Train and mentor business users and finance personnel on financial processes and controls.
  • Ensure continuity of critical finance operations through effective documentation and cross-training.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Lead cross-functional projects involving Finance, Operations, Treasury, Payroll, and Shared Services.
  • Influence stakeholders at multiple management levels without direct reporting authority.
  • Drive organizational adoption of process improvements and operational best practices.
  • Provide direction and guidance to project teams and process owners.
  • Act as a trusted advisor for finance systems, controls, and operational governance matters.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
  • CPA, CMA, MBA, or equivalent advanced credential is a plus.

Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive finance, accounting, operational finance, or business transformation experience.
  • Experience supporting financial systems, operational processes, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience leading projects and influencing business stakeholders.
  • Experience with financial controls, audit support, and process improvement initiatives.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • SAP
  • Financial reporting and reconciliation processes
  • Professional Services Automation (PSA) platforms
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel
  • Power Query
  • Workflow management solutions
  • Financial analysis and variance investigation
  • Internal controls and audit support
  • HFM

Key Performance Indicators

  • Revenue reconciliation accuracy
  • Timeliness of month-end deliverables
  • Audit and compliance results
  • Vendor payment cycle performance
  • Reduction in manual processes
  • Automation adoption
  • Process documentation completeness
  • Stakeholder satisfaction
  • Successful completion of finance transformation initiatives

Diseñamos experiencias que transforman la manera en que las personas trabajan.

Por eso, cada proyecto que realizamos busca potenciar el talento, el bienestar y la productividad.

  • Vas a gestionar el funcionamiento integral del espacio, velando por el orden, la organización y el bienestar de colaboradores y clientes.
  • Coordinarás proveedores, gestionando presupuestos, seguimiento de servicios y desarrollo de relaciones a largo plazo.
  • Llevarás adelante la gestión de compras no productivas, garantizando disponibilidad y eficiencia en los recursos de la oficina.
  • Serás responsable de la recepción y atención de clientes, proveedores y nuevos ingresos, asegurando una experiencia cálida, ágil y profesional.
  • Acompañarás la habilitación de nuevos ingresos, facilitando su integración al espacio y asegurando que cuenten con todo lo necesario desde el primer día.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos internos para asegurar el correcto funcionamiento diario de la operación.
  • Gestionarás la organización y coordinación de eventos, asegurando su correcta planificación, ejecución y experiencia para los participantes.


¿Qué esperamos de ti?

  • Experiencia previa de 3 a 4 años en roles de Office Manager, Administración de Oficinas, Workplace Services, Hospitality o Facilities Management. (excluyente)
  • Capacidad de organización, autonomía y atención al detalle.
  • Excelente comunicación interpersonal y vocación de servicio.
  • Habilidad para gestionar múltiples tareas en simultáneo y resolver imprevistos con criterio.
  • Manejo de herramientas digitales (correo, calendario, Excel, etc.).
  • Cuentes con manejo de idioma inglés avanzado (excluyente) y de portugués intermedio (deseable)


¿Qué te va a hacer destacar?

  • Perfil proactivo, resolutivo y con fuerte orientación a la experiencia del cliente interno y externo.


¿Cuáles serán tus condiciones de trabajo?

  • Contrato bajo relación de dependencia
  • Jornada full time
  • Modalidad presencial


¿Con qué te vas a encontrar?

Con un equipo especializado, dinámico y muy colaborativo, donde el coraje, la pasión y el trabajo en equipo es parte de nuestro ADN. Donde la innovación está inserta en cada uno de nuestros proyectos.

¡Y no solo eso! Con nosotros tendrás la oportunidad de ser el dueño de tu propio desarrollo y vas a aprender de todo y de todos.

Si te sientes identificado con estas líneas…. ¡Te queremos en nuestro equipo!

descriptionHtml:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

About The Role

  • Own end-to-end delivery of Abacum implementation projects, from pre-sales scoping through kickoff and delivery, driving customers to success and value realization on the platform.
  • Partner with Sales during the pre-sales cycle to scope projects, size effort, and present and walk clients through the SOW, setting the right expectations before the deal closes.
  • Build project documents, sprint plans, budgets, and resource plans tailored to project and delivery model.
  • Manage implementations that involve both direct customer delivery and delivery through partners, holding partners to the same quality bar as internal delivery.
  • Manage scope, risk, and change control, escalating early using our governance processes.
  • Act as the trusted advisor to client stakeholders; not just running the plan, advising on process and org changes needed to get value from the platform.
  • Coordinate with Product, Support, Sales, Customer Success, and delivery partners to keep a single, coherent client experience.
  • Get hands-on with the product itself, deep enough to unblock the team on platform or FP&A concept questions without escalating.
  • Contribute directly to how we deliver: developing/deploying Ai to speed up delivery and enhance the customer experience, refining templates, sprint cadences, and design-phase practices as we continually evolve our methodology.
  • Mentor junior delivery team members and, where relevant, partner-side consultants on delivery standards and quality bar.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience implementing a financial planning/EPM platform; this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • Experience scoping projects pre-sale and presenting SOWs directly to clients, comfortable being in the room before the deal is signed, not just after handoff.
  • Direct experience managing implementations delivered through third-party partners or resellers, alongside those delivered directly to customers.
  • Working knowledge of FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, reporting, consolidation), enough to challenge a client's assumptions, not just document them.
  • Working knowledge of other planning use cases such as workforce planning and others is a bonus.
  • Track record managing multi-stakeholder, multi-workstream projects with both technical and change-management components.
  • Ability to read a scope document critically and flag risk before it becomes a delivery problem.
  • Proficiency with SaaS project tools and Agile/hybrid methodologies.
  • Excellent at client-facing communication, comfortable presenting to and influencing senior finance stakeholders.
  • Formal Project Management Qualifications are a plus, not a requirement.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation including equity package
  • Competitive vacation policy
  • Medical Insurance
  • L&D budget
  • Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)
  • Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

descriptionText:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

About The Role



- Own end-to-end delivery of Abacum implementation projects, from pre-sales scoping through kickoff and delivery, driving customers to success and value realization on the platform. 
- Partner with Sales during the pre-sales cycle to scope projects, size effort, and present and walk clients through the SOW, setting the right expectations before the deal closes. 
- Build project documents, sprint plans, budgets, and resource plans tailored to project and delivery model. 
- Manage implementations that involve both direct customer delivery and delivery through partners, holding partners to the same quality bar as internal delivery. 
- Manage scope, risk, and change control, escalating early using our governance processes. 
- Act as the trusted advisor to client stakeholders; not just running the plan, advising on process and org changes needed to get value from the platform. 
- Coordinate with Product, Support, Sales, Customer Success, and delivery partners to keep a single, coherent client experience. 
- Get hands-on with the product itself, deep enough to unblock the team on platform or FP&A concept questions without escalating. 
- Contribute directly to how we deliver: developing/deploying Ai to speed up delivery and enhance the customer experience, refining templates, sprint cadences, and design-phase practices as we continually evolve our methodology. 
- Mentor junior delivery team members and, where relevant, partner-side consultants on delivery standards and quality bar. 

What You Bring



- 4+ years of hands-on experience implementing a financial planning/EPM platform; this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. 
- Experience scoping projects pre-sale and presenting SOWs directly to clients, comfortable being in the room before the deal is signed, not just after handoff. 
- Direct experience managing implementations delivered through third-party partners or resellers, alongside those delivered directly to customers. 
- Working knowledge of FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, reporting, consolidation), enough to challenge a client's assumptions, not just document them. 
- Working knowledge of other planning use cases such as workforce planning and others is a bonus. 
- Track record managing multi-stakeholder, multi-workstream projects with both technical and change-management components. 
- Ability to read a scope document critically and flag risk before it becomes a delivery problem. 
- Proficiency with SaaS project tools and Agile/hybrid methodologies. 
- Excellent at client-facing communication, comfortable presenting to and influencing senior finance stakeholders. 
- Formal Project Management Qualifications are a plus, not a requirement. 

Benefits



- Competitive compensation including equity package
- Competitive vacation policy
- Medical Insurance
- L&D budget
- Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)
- Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.

Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.

About Us
At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living while reducing emissions. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower-emissions technologies.

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about our What and our Why and how we can work together.

Group information

Our Global Business Center (GBC) in Buenos Aires was established in 2004 and our diverse and multinational workforce of more than 2800 colleagues have been powering ExxonMobil’s global businesses ever since. We are proud to be part of an inclusive, safe, and vibrant work environment.

Job Role Description

The Tax Compliance Analyst (Associate) supports U.S. and Canadian tax compliance activities, ensuring accurate preparation, analysis, and filing of tax returns. This role combines technical tax knowledge, financial analysis, and process control, with a strong focus on innovation, automation, and continuous improvement through the use of new technologies.

We value our people over their jobs, looking for the best candidate, regardless of age, ethnicity, religion or gender identity. Each individual and their unique perspective is what makes us stronger and powerful.

¡Build a career with us and use your energy to change the world!

For more information, follow us on Instagram (@ExxonMobil_BA_GBC) and visit https://corporate.exxonmobil.com/Locations/Argentina

What you will do

  • Prepare and file U.S. and Canadian tax returns.
  • Perform analysis of various business transactions to determine the appropriate tax treatment.
  • Calculate and process tax payments.
  • Conduct account reconciliations and follow up on open items.
  • Apply new technologies to improve the tax process, with a strong focus on innovation.
  • Audit activities to ensure compliance with government regulations.
  • Collaborate for compliance matters and audits.

About You
  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting / Business Administration / Economics (or within 4 months of graduation).
  • Advanced English (Fluent).
  • Accounting and tax knowledge.
  • Knowledge of international taxation (preferred, not required).
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Excel proficiency.
  • Power BI knowledge.

Your Benefits

An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance, and life.

We offer you:

  • Competitive health coverage
  • Flexible working hours
  • 3 week vacation up to 5 years of service plus 1 personal day
  • Online training tools
  • Gym discounts and activities for sport and general well-being
  • A solid ergonomics program
  • Free vaccination campaigns
  • Medical assistance available in the offices
  • Equipped maternity rooms
  • Among others.

Requisitos

  • Título universitario en Ciencia de Datos, Ciencias de la Computación, IT, Ingeniería, Geociencias o una disciplina técnica afín.
  • Más de 7 años de experiencia en ventas técnicas, desarrollo de negocios, gestión de datos o soluciones digitales, preferentemente dentro de la industria de petróleo y gas.
  • Sólida experiencia en gestión de datos empresariales o de subsuelo, incluyendo gobernanza de datos, calidad, metadatos, seguridad y ciclo de vida de los datos.
  • Conocimientos de plataformas de datos en la nube, integración de sistemas, APIs, interoperabilidad y arquitecturas de datos OSDU o similares.

  • Nivel de inglés intermedio a avanzado, con capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma, proactiva y colaborativa con equipos técnicos y comerciales.
