descriptionHtml:
Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.



By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.



From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.



Job Description

Our Business Platforms team develops and manages integrated digital platforms that support various business functions, efficiency, connectivity, and innovation across the organization. They are experts in Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Marketing Automation, Content Management Systems (CMS), Information Technology Management Systems (ITMS), E-Commerce, Intranet, and InsurTech.

As a Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Team Lead at Endava, you will lead the technical design and delivery of business applications within the insurance industry, combining hands-on development with solution architecture and technical leadership. You will work with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform to build and integrate solutions with clients' existing systems, including ERP, intranet, and other enterprise platforms.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design and delivery of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions.

  • Facilitate requirements refinement and translate business needs into actionable technical stories.

  • Design and develop applications using Power Apps and Dataverse.

  • Lead form development using Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) controls.

  • Provide hands-on development using React and JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Design and oversee integrations between Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and other systems through Azure.

  • Establish development standards and ensure solution quality, maintainability, security, and performance.

  • Review solution designs and code, resolve technical issues, and guide the engineering team.

  • Support sprint planning, estimation, dependency management, and delivery.

  • Lead the onboarding and ramp-up of additional team members.

  • Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, business stakeholders, and delivery teams.

  • Lead initial requirements refinement, solution alignment, technical planning, and backlog preparation.

  • Establish a strong technical foundation while maintaining delivery momentum.



Qualifications

Required experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365.

  • Strong expertise in Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps and Dataverse.

  • Experience designing and developing PCF controls.

  • Proficiency in React and JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Strong experience delivering integrations through Microsoft Azure.

  • Experience leading technical teams while remaining actively involved in hands-on delivery.

  • Strong understanding of solution architecture, application lifecycle management, security, and deployment practices.

  • Ability to lead refinement sessions and convert complex requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred experience

  • Experience with Dynamics 365 Marketing.

  • Experience delivering technology solutions within the insurance industry.

  • Experience working in an Agile, sprint-based delivery environment.



Additional Information

Discover some of the global benefits that empower our people to become the best version of themselves:


  • Finance:
     Competitive salary package, share plan, company performance bonuses, value-based recognition awards, referral bonus;
  • Career Development:
    Career coaching, global career opportunities, non-linear career paths, internal development programmes for management and technical leadership;
  • Learning Opportunities:
    Complex projects, rotations, internal tech communities, training, certifications, coaching, online learning platforms subscriptions, pass-it-on sessions, workshops, conferences;
  • Work-Life Balance:
     Hybrid work and flexible working hours, employee assistance programme;
  • Health:
     Global internal wellbeing programme, access to wellbeing apps;
  • Community:
     Global internal tech communities, hobby clubs and interest groups, inclusion and diversity programmes, events and celebrations.

At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

descriptionHtml:
Description

You sweat the small stuff because you know that great design is in the details.

You are self-motivated — you have a true passion coupled with the exceptional ability to translate the vision of our clients into high quality and impactful deliverables. You would also be responsible for troubleshooting problems that may arise with a piece and coming up with creative solutions to make sure things happen the way they’re supposed to. Such talent and ingenuity make you the right fit for this unique Graphic Design Production Artist role with BoldSky.

Mid-Level Graphic Designer: Core contributor to projects, owns bigger pieces and is proficient at adhering to brand standards. They work with all the information at their disposal and use their skill set and knowledge to solve problems.

Mid-Level Production Artist: You assist teams in the production of graphic material, packaging, display, and advertising projects, and more. You collaborate with Art Directors, Designers, and other Graphic Designers to format artwork, ensure print quality standards are met, and often collect, process, and organize files.

Responsibilities:

  • Mid-Level Graphic Designer: Core contributor to projects, owns bigger pieces, and is proficient at adhering to brand standards.
  • Report to the Discipline Lead for project assignments; collaborate with creative teams for implementation and direction.
  • Layout files, make prescribed edits, and prepare print files per vendor specifications.
  • Must also be capable of developing scientific figure redraws (converting raw data into vector charts and graphs) for medical communication materials using adobe illustrator.
  • Work closely with account, creative, and creative services departments as part of an integrated team.
  • Adhere to agency vision and uphold client style guidelines.
  • Traditional studio support including mock-ups and presentation materials.
  • Deliver quality work on time and within budget.
  • Create production-ready files for print and digital, including edits to existing layouts.
  • Prepare mechanical print files according to vendor specs and brand style guides.
  • Coordinate with project managers on schedule and hours.
  • Maintain server structure and guide others on file organization.
  • Support onboarding for studio process and file structure.
  • Manage brand assets, logos, and workflow within the brand.
  • Champion BoldSky workflow and contribute to process improvements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design or related field, with agency/studio experience.
  • 5–10 years’ experience in Graphic Design.
  • Expertise in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat).
  • Extensive prepress knowledge including formats, resolution, and four-color printing.
  • Excellent communication and direction-giving skills.
  • Strong design sense: layout, composition, hierarchy, typography, and color.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Team player with ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently under deadlines.
  • Experience with Sketch and/or Figma a plus.
  • Experience with PowerPoint, animation, digital/video a plus.
  • Experience working in DAM systems a plus.

Should also be:

  • Able to Understand and Implement Direction: Can translate creative objectives into effective execution and communicate workload needs clearly.
  • Industry Application: Quick learner with strong functional and technical knowledge of both the client’s and agency’s businesses.
  • Demonstrating Ownership and Proactivity: Shows initiative and consistently offers new ideas, owning the brand from a visual standpoint.
  • Willingness to be Flexible: Open to stepping outside the formal job description to support the team and deliver high-quality work.

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

Boldsky Creative Studio supports more than 12+ Syneos Health marketing and communication agencies as well as direct-to-customer engagements. We function as the agencies' creative execution and production arm, implementing their creative vision. As part of Syneos Health, our agencies — consisting of leading brands and experts in advertising, branding, public relations, managed markets and medical communications — are engaged in every point of influence in health, providing real-world insight into markets and audiences in ways that no other partner could.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)

descriptionHtml:
graph8 is making revenue programmable. Our platform brings together CRM, outbound email, calling, scheduling, data and AI-powered workflows to help B2B companies build and run their go-to-market operations.


We’re looking for a client-facing marketer who can build strong customer relationships and give practical advice on how to grow. You’ll help customers decide whom to target, what to say and where to focus, then work with our execution team in Lahore to put those plans into action.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with ownership of customer accounts. It suits someone with experience in B2B marketing, agency account management or customer success who’s ready to take more responsibility.


What you’ll do

  • Lead onboarding and understand each customer’s business, offer, target audience, sales process and growth goals
  • Help customers clarify their ideal customer profile, target accounts and buyer roles
  • Recommend messaging, offers and campaign priorities that fit their goals, budget and resources
  • Lead regular customer conversations with clear recommendations, decisions and next steps
  • Interpret campaign and funnel performance, identify what needs attention and recommend improvements
  • Set realistic expectations and explain trade-offs honestly, including when results fall short
  • Turn agreed plans into clear briefs for our Lahore team, with owners, deadlines and success criteria
  • Review delivery, coordinate fixes and keep customers informed without waiting for the next scheduled call
  • Identify retention risks early and support renewals and relevant expansion opportunities
  • Use AI tools to improve research, preparation, analysis and follow-through while checking their output


How you’ll work with the team

You own the customer relationship, account plan and go-to-market recommendations. Our Lahore team handles campaign setup, production, operational execution and technical implementation.

Together, you’ll agree on achievable commitments, review results and improve performance. You should understand the work well enough to guide the customer, write a useful brief and recognize when a specialist is needed.

What we’re looking for

  • Around 2–4 years of relevant experience, or equivalent evidence of strong client work
  • Experience in a B2B marketing agency, lead-generation business, marketing-services company or customer-facing GTM role
  • Examples of advising customers on marketing decisions and explaining why you recommended a particular approach
  • Working knowledge of targeting, positioning, outbound campaigns, lead qualification and sales funnels
  • Confidence discussing campaign results and distinguishing activity from meaningful business outcomes
  • Excellent spoken and written English for leading US customer conversations
  • Good judgment, curiosity, organization and reliable follow-through
  • Comfort handling difficult conversations, challenging assumptions respectfully and asking for help when needed
  • Willingness to work from our office during agreed US customer-facing hours


Deep coding expertise or specialist-level knowledge of every marketing channel isn’t required. We care about your ability to understand the customer’s situation, recommend sensible next steps and get the right work done with the team.


What success looks like

  • Customers understand the plan, the results and what happens next
  • Recommendations reflect the customer’s business and the available evidence
  • The execution team receives clear, actionable priorities
  • Commitments are completed and problems are escalated early
  • Accounts make measurable progress toward agreed monthly goals
  • Customers see value in the relationship and choose to continue working with us

Estamos en búsqueda de la posición de Jefe Comercial/Trade Marketing para una importante cadena de Cafés con sus oficinas ubicadas en CABA, Argentina.


Propósito del Puesto

Impulsar el crecimiento orgánico de las ventas y la rentabilidad comercial de la red de locales, transformando el análisis de datos e insights del negocio en planes de acción, estrategias de pricing, promociones y campañas comerciales de alto impacto. Su función principal es planificar y ejecutar la estrategia comercial alineada al Plan Anual, liderando el desarrollo de forecasts y tableros de gestión, el diseño de programas de incentivos para la fuerza de venta y la coordinación transversal de iniciativas con las áreas operativas y franquiciadas, promoviendo el desarrollo de su equipo a cargo.


Principales Responsabilidades

  • Realizar el seguimiento integral de la facturación, tickets, ticket promedio, mix de productos y margen de rentabilidad por zona, tipología y segmento de sucursal.
  • Desarrollar forecasts de cierre de ventas, proyecciones de demanda y dashboards directivos en BI para detectar desvíos, oportunidades y tendencias de consumo de forma anticipada.
  • Diseñar campañas comerciales, promociones, activaciones y políticas de precios diferenciados definiendo targets, costos, rentabilidad esperada y mecánicas en los sistemas de gestión.
  • Evaluar la performance de las acciones y medir su retorno de inversión, implementando optimizaciones en tiempo real.
  • Definir, implementar y auditar el plan de incentivos comerciales dirigido a franquiciados, líderes de Operaciones y personal de sucursales (objetivos, premios y comunicación).
  • Desarrollar instructivos para Operaciones y franquicias que faciliten la captura de oportunidades de venta.
  • Liderar proyectos comerciales transversales desde la planificación hasta la medición final, coordinando con Operaciones, Supply, Producto y Marketing.
  • Monitorear la producción, distribución y correcta implementación de los materiales POP y piezas de comunicación en los puntos de venta dentro de los deadlines acordados.
  • Liderar, desarrollar y coordinar las prioridades del equipo a su cargo, ser referente de liderazgo de manera transversal con el resto de las áreas.
  • Velar por el desarrollo del equipo y por el NPS de clima.


¿Que buscamos?

-Graduado/a de Comercialización, Marketing, Adm. Empresas, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial o afines.

-Formación en Intelligence, Data Analytics o Estrategia Comercial.

-Experiencia en posiciones comerciales, Trade Marketing, Planeamiento Comercial o BI Comercial en Consumo masivo, retail, gastronomía.


Ofrecemos

-Formar parte de una compañía de trayectoria en el mercado.

-Muy buenas condiciones de compensaciones.

-Modalidad full presencial (lu a vier)

-Ubicación: CABA

Muchas empresas argentinas tienen oportunidades concretas para crecer expandirse a nuevos mercados, financiar inversiones, optimizar su estructura financiera o fortalecer su competitividad.

En Grupo ST buscamos una persona con fuerte ADN comercial para liderar un cluster de clientes corporativos. No para administrar relaciones existentes, sino para generar nuevas oportunidades, abrir puertas y desarrollar negocios donde otros todavía no los ven. Alguien que disfrute construir relaciones desde cero, liderar equipos y esté convencido de que el crecimiento de los clientes es el motor del crecimiento del negocio

¿Cuál va a ser tu desafío?

📌 Impulsar el crecimiento comercial del cluster, desarrollando nuevas relaciones y oportunidades de negocio.

📌 Liderar y desarrollar un equipo de Ejecutivos de Negocios, promoviendo una mirada consultiva centrada en los desafíos y objetivos de cada cliente.

📌 Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y construir propuestas integrales junto a las distintas compañías y áreas del Grupo.

📌 Gestionar los resultados del negocio, potenciando la productividad comercial a través de datos, tecnología e inteligencia artificial.


Requisitos


¿Qué buscamos?

✅ Formación universitaria en Ciencias Económicas, Ingeniería o carreras afines. Posgrado o MBA será valorado.

✅ Experiencia liderando equipos comerciales y desarrollando negocios en banca corporativa, servicios financieros o entornos B2B complejos.

✅ Perfil marcadamente comercial, con capacidad para generar nuevas relaciones y desarrollar oportunidades desde cero.

✅ Visión integral de negocios y capacidad para construir soluciones alineadas a los desafíos de cada cliente.

✅ Experiencia gestionando indicadores comerciales y resultados.

¿Por qué postularte?

Porque las oportunidades más valiosas rara vez llegan solas. Hay que salir a encontrarlas.

¡Te estamos buscando! 🚀

En Grupo ST creemos que las ganas de crecer merecen convertirse en realidad. Por eso, desde hace más de 20 años acompañamos a personas y empresas en todo el país, impulsando su desarrollo con soluciones concretas en crédito, inversión, seguros y más. Somos un ecosistema de compañías especializadas que comparten una misma convicción que el crecimiento de Argentina empieza por quienes se animan. Hoy, más de 1.200 personas trabajamos juntas para transformar oportunidades en logros reales. ¿Y si tu próximo paso es desde adentro?

We are looking for a Group Travel Specialist! 🏢🎉🌍

At Pure! Travel Group, a leading Destination Management Company (DMC) in South America, we are seeking a creative, commercially-driven, and highly organized Group Travel Specialist for our Pure! Argentina office. Your mission will be to design and execute unforgettable corporate events, incentives, and group travel across Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, and Brazil.

🎯 The Challenge

Your main objective will be the end-to-end design, bidding, and execution of group travel, while actively developing international accounts.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Design & Bidding: Crafting creative tailor-made proposals, budgets, and responding to RFPs for group trips and group series.
  • Business Development: Strengthening relationships with active international event agencies and corporate accounts, while expanding the portfolio in the US, Europe, and Asia.
  • Logistics & Procurement: Managing full group operations, negotiating group rates, allotments, and special terms with hotels, venues, and local suppliers.
  • Site Inspections & On-site Support: Coordinating and hosting site inspections, and providing on-site hospitality support during events when required.

📝 What Are We Looking For? (Requirements)

  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience handling Groups within an Inbound DMC or tour operator.
  • Languages: Advanced English (Mandatory). Flawless written and spoken communication is essential for international client pitching.
  • Destination Expertise: Deep knowledge of venues, hotel infrastructure, and logistics capabilities in the Southern Cone and Brazil.
  • Key Skills: Outstanding attention to detail, ability to work under tight deadlines, strong negotiation skills, and a creative mindset.

💼 What Do We Offer?

  • Work Model: Hybrid.
  • Location: Offices in Belgrano, CABA.
  • Environment: A dynamic, international, and passionate team.

🎯 Tu misión

Garantizar el control y la correcta registración de la información contable y administrativa de los establecimientos agropecuarios, actuando como nexo con la administración central y contribuyendo al cierre contable mensual.

  • Controlar y supervisar la carga de información administrativa y contable proveniente de los campos en el sistema de gestión de la empresa.
  • Realizar conciliaciones de cuentas bancarias y controles de las cajas de los establecimientos agropecuarios.
  • Revisar y controlar planillas de cereal, información de producción y documentación respaldatoria de las operaciones.
  • Verificar facturas, gastos e inversiones, asegurando su correcta imputación contable.
  • Utilizar el sistema de gestión Physis para consultar, localizar y verificar facturas, movimientos y registros.
  • Detectar inconsistencias, diferencias o información faltante, gestionar su resolución y realizar el seguimiento correspondiente.
  • Coordinar con los responsables de los establecimientos agropecuarios el envío oportuno de la información y documentación necesaria.

  • Formación secundaria completa. Se valorarán estudios terciarios vinculados con Administración, Contabilidad o Administración Agropecuaria.

  • Organización, atención al detalle, autonomía y capacidad resolutiva.

Are you passionate about Building Automation and creating intuitive, high-quality graphical interfaces?

We are looking for a BMS Graphics Designer to join our Smart Buildings team and develop customized graphic solutions that help customers monitor and control their buildings effectively and efficiently.

In this role, you will work on a variety of projects including commercial buildings, campuses, data centers and other complex facilities, transforming engineering information into clear and functional building management interfaces.

What will you do?

  • Develop and customize BMS graphics using Desigo CC.
  • Create graphical backgrounds based on engineering drawings and project documentation.
  • Add dynamics, point blocks and advanced functionality to graphical user interfaces.
  • Work with HVAC systems, mechanical and electrical schematics to accurately represent building systems.
  • Use tools such as AutoCAD and Revit to support the development of graphics and layouts.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering and project teams to understand project requirements and deliver the right solution.
  • Review and proof designs to ensure accuracy and quality.
  • Estimate the effort required for graphics projects and support on-time delivery.
  • Present graphics concepts and solutions to internal teams and customers.
  • Support pre-bid estimates and share technical knowledge with other members of the team.

What are we looking for?

  • Hands-on experience working with Desigo CC, ideally developing and configuring building graphics.
  • Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS), Building Automation or HVAC controls.
  • Professional experience with AutoCAD and/or Revit.
  • Ability to read and interpret HVAC, mechanical and electrical schematics.
  • Understanding of building automation systems and how different equipment and control points are represented within a graphical interface.
  • Good PC and software skills, including Microsoft Office.
  • Technical education or professional experience in electromechanical, engineering, drafting, design, building automation or a related field.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!

We value your unique identity and perspective, recognizing that our strength comes from the diverse experiences and perspectives of our team. We are committed to equal opportunity and to building a work environment that reflects the diversity of society. We support your personal and professional growth by providing the resources you need to thrive. Come as you are and help us build a better tomorrow.

It is our commitment to protect the environment, promote health, and ensure that all our activities are carried out under safe conditions.

descriptionHtml:
OKTO's continuous growth demands high-caliber candidates who embody professionalism, passion, and creativity. For those who join us, we offer significant career advancement, stimulating challenges, and a clear runway for growth.

OKTO is the next-generation Payment Service Provider — AI-native, precision-engineered, and relentlessly merchant-obsessed. Built for merchants operating in the most complex and demanding eCommerce sectors, our platform goes far beyond transaction processing. We solve for scale, compliance, and performance with one unshakable focus: delivering outcomes that power merchant growth.

From payments and banking to treasury and settlement, we engineer the financial infrastructure that gives our partners a competitive edge. The result? Faster onboarding, smarter operations, and resilient, real-time performance.

At OKTO, we enable merchants to Play Differently, transforming payments from routine transactions into true differentiators that deliver personalized, frictionless experiences.

Our AI-native innovation harnesses data and insight to power every decision, while our proprietary in-house engineering ensures precision and control. Combined with deep, trust-based relationships worldwide, we're redefining what it means to build, scale, and win in complex digital commerce.

Summary

As a Java Middleware Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining the middleware services that power our next-generation payment platform. You will contribute to the development of scalable, secure, and high-performance applications that process millions of financial transactions, while collaborating with Product, Architecture, Infrastructure, QA, and Security teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain middleware applications and backend services using Java and Spring technologies
  • Develop new product features and platform capabilities based on business and technical requirements
  • Build scalable, resilient, and high-performance microservices that support payment processing and financial transaction workflows
  • Write clean, maintainable, and performance-optimized code, ensuring high-quality standards and comprehensive unit test coverage
  • Participate in the design and implementation of distributed systems and event-driven architectures
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and secure service integrations using modern authentication mechanisms such as OAuth2
  • Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Production environments, identifying and resolving issues to ensure platform stability
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product Managers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and Solution Architects, to deliver high-quality software solutions
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize software quality, development processes, and system performance
  • Work with version control systems and CI/CD pipelines, following engineering best practices and software development standards
  • Produce technical documentation, including product specifications, design documentation, and implementation details

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience developing middleware or backend applications using Java
  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience with Java 11 or newer
  • Proven experience working within the FinTech, Payments, Banking, or Financial Services industry
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD), SOLID principles, and Functional Programming concepts
  • Experience designing and developing microservices architectures using Spring Boot and Spring Cloud (Netflix OSS)
  • Solid knowledge of the Spring Framework 5 ecosystem
  • Experience implementing secure authentication and authorization using OAuth2
  • Experience with JPA, ORM modeling, and persistence frameworks
  • Strong experience designing and developing RESTful APIs
  • Familiarity with Event-Driven Architecture, asynchronous messaging, and distributed software design patterns
  • Experience working with Git and collaborative source control workflows
  • Good understanding of software development best practices, including unit testing, clean code principles, and code review processes
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within an international engineering team
  • Excellent technical writing skills for documenting requirements, software designs, and technical specifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience working in high-volume transaction processing environments
  • Knowledge of payment processing concepts, transaction lifecycle, settlement, reconciliation, or payment gateway integrations
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and application performance optimization

Languages

  • Advanced English (mandatory), with the ability to participate in technical discussions, collaborate with international teams, and produce technical documentation
  • Spanish (mandatory)

Please submit your resumé in English.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary package
  • Career Growth - Career development opportunities in a growing global fintech
  • Continuous Learning - Access to challenging projects and continuous learning opportunities
  • Inclusive Environment - Collaborative, diverse, and international work environment
  • Birthday Leave - Paid day off on your birthday

PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Descripción del empleo

¿Te apasiona resolver problemas complejos de ingeniería y trabajar sobre sistemas con altos niveles de confiabilidad?

En Core Services tenemos una oportunidad para vos. Estamos buscando Senior Software Engineer Backend para sumarse a nuestro equipo.

Core Services es responsable de construir y operar servicios fundamentales para la plataforma de PedidosYa. Trabajamos sobre múltiples servicios que forman parte de flujos centrales de la operación, como órdenes, productos y autenticación. Vas a tener la oportunidad de trabajar sobre servicios Tier 1 y sistemas distribuidos que forman parte de flujos centrales de PedidosYa, participando en la construcción de nuevas capacidades y la evolución de los sistemas existentes.

Si disfrutás resolver problemas complejos, tomar ownership end-to-end y generar impacto más allá de tu propio servicio, este puede ser un gran desafío para vos.

¿Qué desafíos te esperan?

  • Tomar ownership end-to-end de iniciativas técnicas complejas, desde el entendimiento del problema y la investigación inicial hasta el diseño, implementación, despliegue y seguimiento posterior a producción.
  • Investigar y resolver problemas complejos utilizando datos, logs, métricas, trazas y análisis del código para identificar causas raíz.
  • Participar en discusiones técnicas, revisiones de diseño y decisiones de arquitectura, comunicando claramente los trade-offs involucrados.
  • Colaborar con otros equipos y stakeholders para identificar dependencias, destrabar problemas y generar valor de manera pragmática.
  • Comunicar de forma clara y concisa el estado de las iniciativas, riesgos, bloqueos y decisiones relevantes.

Requisitos

  • Experiencia sólida desarrollando servicios backend en Golang. Se valoran conocimientos en Kotlin o Java.
  • Experiencia trabajando con arquitecturas distribuidas y microservicios.
  • Conocimiento de bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales, entendiendo los trade-offs de cada alternativa.
  • Experiencia en observabilidad (logging, métricas, alertas, trazas y monitoreo con Grafana o similares).
  • Valoramos fuertemente que cuentes con conocimientos en plataformas Cloud (AWS) y manejo de contenedores (Docker y Kubernetes).
  • Capacidad para desenvolverse con autonomía en contextos ambiguos, estructurar problemas y llevar iniciativas hasta su resolución sin requerir supervisión constante.

Información adicional

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

👉 Conocé nuestros valores aquí.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. Jugamos en equipo en todo lo que hacemos, y lo que más nos gusta de eso es que promovemos la creación de equipos diversos e inclusivos que puedan aportar diferentes perspectivas a PedidosYa. Nuestras oportunidades laborales están abiertas a todas las personas, independientemente de su identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, religión, edad, discapacidad y/o otras características individuales.

En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o accesibilidad particular para tener la entrevista, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación. Además, siéntete libre de indicarnos tus pronombres (él/ella/elle) desde el primer contacto.

The Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center Buenos Aires and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Project Manager within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will oversee and coordinate various projects to facilitate successful delivery within budget and timeline. You will leverage strong organizational and communication skills to effectively manage teams and stakeholders. As a Manager, you will enhance your leadership style by motivating, developing, and inspiring others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center Buenos Aires, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will work with team leadership to establish collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables. This is an opportunity to develop skills outside your comfort zone and encourage others to do the same, while upholding and reinforcing professional and technical standards.

Responsibilities

- Leading project management workstreams to optimize project portfolios and drive strategic business outcomes
- Coordinating and overseeing project selection, prioritization, and resource allocation to facilitate successful delivery
- Managing stakeholder engagement and communication to align project goals with business objectives
- Developing and implementing project governance frameworks to maintain quality and timelines
- Conducting risk identification and management to mitigate potential project challenges
- Coaching and mentoring team members to enhance their skills and performance
- Analyzing project data to identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate project management practices across the organization

What You Must Have

- At least a High School Diploma or the equivalent degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Utilizing Agile Methodology for efficient project management
- Demonstrating proficiency in Project Management
- Excelling in stakeholder engagement and management
- Developing business process improvement strategies
- Embracing change and innovation in project delivery

descriptionHtml:
Proposito Del Cargo

Llevar a cabo las tareas operativas y administrativas necesarias para la efectividad y eficiencia de las operaciones de la estación

Agente: Implica la realización de tareas operativas y administrativas incluyendo pero no lmitandose a : ingreso de datos, actividades operativas de aeropuerto, actividades de clasificación, actividades de seguimiento, servicio al cliente .Responsable de completar los procesos y procedimientos definidos hasta la fecha límite, asegurando la precisión, integridad y cumplimiento de estándares internos y externos relevantes. Identifica anomalías a medida que surgen y usa su juicio basado en reglas y procedimientos para resolver. Para problemas complejos, puede escalar a los miembros principales del equipo

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES: Dentro de las principales responsabilidades del cargo encontramos:

Coordinar espacio en el avión para los envíos de RESOL 3196/11

Reporte semanal del Load factor con datos de los vuelos diarios.

Coordinar posiciones para el vuelo de LAN desde EZE y SCL a VCP / MEM.

Coordinar tipo de contenedores con ITC

Transferencias de equipos vacíos / Mantener Stock

Transferencias de carga, Ej: Air Class

Informar sobre demoras de vuelo y/o cambios de ruta ( es la primera persona que se entera )

Compartir con Rampa medidas de carga ya sea para paletizar o para transferir al Feeder

Confirmar reservas vs espacio en el avión

Ingresar diariamente al sistema las guías aéreas e información

Manejar los impuestos y derechos de aduana e informar a los clientes sobre los pagos generados.

Recopilar información para diferentes reportes de la empresa.

Preparar documentación de paquetes

Asistir a los clientes resolviendo las preguntas básicas que se generen referentes a las características de los servicios.

Desarrollar diferentes tareas de archivo

Garantizar que todos los trámites y los requisitos de informes (en línea o manuales) sean completos , precisos y oportunos. Utiliza herramientas definidas para realizar el escaneo, la grabación y la transferencia de datos según sea necesario.

Llevar a cabo con seguridad las tareas operativas, incluidas la carga y descarga, en línea con procedimientos estándar de la empresa y requisitos legales.

Adherirse a las políticas y procedimientos estándar, incluida la salud y la seguridad, los productos peligrosos, la conducción, requisitos y normas de seguridad de la aviación y de manejo de aeronaves según sea necesario. Se asegura de estar pendiente de actualizaciones y cambios a procedimientos y regulaciones.

Trabajar estrechamente dentro del equipo para garantizar un flujo óptimo de los procesos operativos en los plazos requeridos. Contacto limitado con clientes o personal externo.

Realizar procedimientos y procesos definidos con precisión e integridad. Asegurar el tiempo , compromisos y cumplimiento de los plazos. Los procesos pueden incluir el uso de procedimientos manuales locales, sistemas regionales, internacionales o globales. Verificar datos y completa comprobaciones de procedimiento contra procesos o criterios predefinidos para garantizar la precisión y la calidad. Utilizar herramientas y equipos apropiados según sea necesario. Puede tomar decisiones relacionadas con verificaciones de procedimiento, incluidas situaciones en las que el resultado no está claramente indicado. Buscar el apoyo de los miembros principales del equipo según sea necesario.

Proporcionar comentarios sobre procesos y procedimientos de forma proactiva, haciendo recomendaciones para la mejora continua a miembros del equipo senior

Estas responsabilidades son las principales o las que se realizan con mayor frecuencia. Cualquier otra tarea podrá ser solicitada para su cumplimiento.

Es una posición DINAMICA que requiere flexibilidad por parte del candidato.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Syngenta is a global leader in agricultural innovation with a presence in more than 90 countries. Syngenta is focused on developing technologies and farming practices that empower farmers, so they can make the transformation required to feed the world's population while preserving our planet. Its bold scientific discoveries deliver better benefits for farmers and society on a bigger scale than ever before. Guided by its Sustainability Priorities, Syngenta is developing new technologies and solutions that support farmers to grow healthier plants in healthier soil with a higher yield. Syngenta Crop Protection is headquartered in Basel, Switzerland; Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States.

Job Description

Syngenta’s LATAM Regulatory team is seeking a LATAM Product Chemistry Lead, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, Bogotá or Colombia or CDMX, Mexico. This regional expert will provide regulatory chemistry support for Crop Protection products, connecting LATAM Regulatory teams with Global Product Chemistry, Production & Supply (P&S) and project teams to enable registrations and effective product life-cycle management.

Accountabilities

  • Manage the technical aspect (regulatory chemistry) of a portfolio of active ingredients and their corresponding marketed products for LATAM, including life cycle management responsibilities. This will be in full alignment with globally defined ways of working, and with a dotted reporting line to the Global Product Chemistry Team Manager.
  • Collaborate with Global Product Chemistry Managers and Global/Local Regulatory Managers to develop regulatory chemistry strategies that are in alignment with LATAM and country-specific regulatory requirements, guidelines, and company policies.
  • Provide technical expertise in regulatory chemistry to all relevant stakeholders, including internal teams (such as product safety, production & supply), external partners, and regulatory authorities. This involves interpreting complex regulatory requirements, providing strategic advice on issues, and ensuring that all product chemistry documentation meets the highest standards of accuracy and completeness. Additionally, act as a key resource for troubleshooting and resolving technical challenges related to product chemistry and regulatory processes in LATAM.
  • Prepare, outsource, and submit comprehensive technical documentation and pertinent sections of registration dossiers to support registration processes in LATAM. Ensure that all documentation is accurate, complete, and submitted in a timely manner to meet regulatory requirements.
  • Effectively advocate for the company's positions on pertinent issues. This involves presenting robust scientific evidence to support the company's stance

Qualifications

Required

  • University degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy or an equivalent scientific discipline.
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in product registration, regulatory chemistry, product development, or production/formulation in a manufacturing environment.
  • Sound knowledge and experience of Crop Protection Regulatory requirements and/or regulatory science issues, with a broader understanding of LATAM processes.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex scientific data and develop evidence-based technical positions.
  • Ability to work within and contribute to cross-functional teams
  • Clear evidence of results orientation, project coordination / management and communication skills
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical topics and transfer knowledge effectively.
  • Fluent English and proficiency in the local language; ability to collaborate effectively with regional and global teams.

Desired

  • Postgraduate qualification in a relevant scientific field.
  • Experience with LATAM registration processes and product chemistry requirements.
  • Experience working across multicultural teams.

Additional Information

What We Offer

  • A culture that celebrates diversity & inclusion, promotes professional development, and strives for a work-life balance — with flexible work options to support your personal and professional needs.
  • Full benefits package.
  • The opportunity to work across multiple ACM markets and collaborate with local, regional and global teams in a role that connects commercial strategy, operations, data and digital tools.
  • Continuous learning and development in a leading multinational environment.

Equal Opportunity

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Responsibilities

Octave is seeking a Senior Proposals Management Administrator to join our team. Are you a document professional looking for a new challenge? If you enjoy working with documents and are exceptional at managing changing priorities, consider joining our Americas proposal management team. This team supports more than 50 account executives across the Americas. The current opening is specifically to assist us in supporting our account executives in South America and Mexico.

  • The Senior Proposals Management Administrator will focus on document creation using established Microsoft Word templates as a starting point and coordinate with the technical resources needed to obtain the updated technical content. Your understanding of fixed price and time and materials consulting service offers will support your review of the key components in statements of work and technical proposals. Your understanding of the complexity of RFx responses for software and consulting services, both public and private sector, and coordination of a response team mean you are prepared to support a response from receipt of the request to submission.
  • You will work closely with our technical teams - Sales, Services, Legal, and Finance departments to finalize these proposals. You will manage timelines/deadlines, communicate questions, communicate with other departments, and finalize the proposal. As a Senior Proposals Management Administrator, you will be managing requests received by prioritizing and dispersing requests to appropriate technical resources and updating Salesforce.
  • Manage document builds from templates and coordinate with others to manage the development of content
  • Review and edit content of statement of work, technical proposals, budgetary estimates, and RFx responses (acting as an editor and a writer (limited)).
  • Critically analyze and review potential risks that may impact the assumptions for the execution of the services.
  • Maintain timelines, deadlines, and responsibility matrices, communicate with other teams, and finalize proposal-related documents.
  • Prioritize and disperse requests to appropriate resources for input.
  • Update our internal tools as the process moves from one resource to another and one stage to the next.

Education / Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in business, marketing, technical writing.
  • Experience preparing proposals and technical documents.
  • Software consulting service statements of work, technical proposals and budgetary estimates.
  • Complex software and software consulting services RFP/RFI responses, for public and private entities.
  • Proficient with Microsoft® Office applications, including Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel.
  • Basic understanding of risk management.
  • Skilled at prioritization and managing multiple changing priorities.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and hold others to expected deadlines.
  • Experience with Responsive, Salesforce or similar applications.
  • Advanced spoken and written Spanish, Portuguese, and medium proficiency working in English, are required.
  • Familiarity with software and database terminology is an asset but not required.

Octave provides mission-critical software that empowers organizations to make informed decisions across every stage of the asset lifecycle - Design, Build, Operate and Protect - where performance, safety, and reliability are non-negotiable and failure is not an option.

Octave has more than 7,000 employees in 45 countries. Learn more at octave.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

All in. Always forward. That's the way we do things around here. We put trust in our people because we believe it's the best way to unleash potential, bring ideas to life, and keep moving ahead. Respect is the cornerstone of how we operate, so speak up and be yourself. You're valued here.

Description

JOB SUMMARY

Solution Design is responsible for managing the strategic solution development process for customer proposals and ensuring there is integration both within and across functions and business units.

This role will work closely with the VP, Solution Design, Business Development Generalists & Specialists to ensure opportunities go through assessment and business optimization review for quality control and deliver an integrated bespoke proposal that will be created for the customer.

Job Responsibilities

  • Works with the Leadership, Business Development and other key members across the Syneos organization to create the initial solution design, approach and the various follow-up actions needed to bridge prospective clients from an initial solution presentation to sold (i.e. awarded) work.
  • Partner with BD to align on proposed solution to customer.
  • Works with different stakeholder groups both within the Deployment Solutions team and across the greater Syneos Health organization
  • Clearly communicate communicating with internal partners all relevant and necessary information (including opportunity approach) to design an initial solution.
  • Checks work throughout the solution development process, asking critical questions where necessary to ensure the solution is integrated, is aligned with the approach, and meets the client needs.
  • Determines the approach for leading any follow-up activities that bridge to sold (i.e., awarded) work. As these activities can vary greatly in complexity and effort, the SD must be comfortable working through ambiguity.
  • Keeps all key stakeholders updated on the opportunity status, including client decision timing and outstanding actions.
  • Support existing customer programs to analyze current state and provide insights on how to evolve based on customers’ business needs

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in related field of study.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in the Lifesciences industry or consulting
  • 4+ years Program and Project Management experience in matrixed organizations
  • Management consulting or services company experience (e.g., CRO, CCO)
  • Excellent communications and people management skills
  • Proficiency in MS Office suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word)
  • Ability to handle ambiguity and multiple concurrent assignments
  • The drive for self-development, the ability to collaborate, and an action-oriented work ethic

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

Why Syneos Health? We partner with industry experts to solve and execute against today’s toughest commercialization challenges facing the world’s leading healthcare companies. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities on our Commercial Operations and Leadership teams. Join our game-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)

En C&S estamos en búsqueda de un/a Representante de Ventas B2B – Analista con experiencia en telecomunicaciones para sumarse a un proyecto de un importante cliente líder de telecomunicaciones.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia comercial en B2B, Inside Sales o desarrollo de clientes empresa, que disfrute de la venta consultiva, el contacto directo con decisores y el trabajo orientado a objetivos.

El desafío será desarrollar de punta a punta una cartera asignada de empresas, combinando llamadas, WhatsApp y correo electrónico, con el apoyo de datos, métricas e inteligencia artificial para priorizar oportunidades y definir la mejor estrategia comercial.

Modalidad

  • Esquema: Híbrido (1 vez por semana presencial en Parque Patricios, CABA).
  • Jornada: Lunes a Viernes de 9:00 a 18:00 hs.
  • Bajo relación de dependencia con C&S

¿Qué vas a hacer?

  • Gestionar una cartera de empresas de punta a punta: contacto, calificación, presentación, negociación y cierre.
  • Realizar venta consultiva multicanal a través de llamadas, WhatsApp y email.
  • Trabajar con playbooks comerciales y aportar ideas para mejorar guiones, cadencias y estrategias mediante una lógica de test & learn.
  • Utilizar recomendaciones de un motor de Inteligencia Artificial para priorizar cuentas y definir la próxima mejor oferta.
  • Validar y enriquecer la información de las cuentas y oportunidades.
  • Construir relaciones comerciales con dueños, responsables y decisores de empresas.
  • Registrar el 100% de la gestión y seguimiento en el CRM.
  • Cumplir objetivos individuales y analizar métricas de performance para detectar oportunidades de mejora.

¿Qué buscamos?

  • Experiencia en ventas B2B, Inside Sales o captación y desarrollo de clientes empresa.
  • Experiencia en venta consultiva y trato directo con interlocutores de negocio.
  • Capacidad para interpretar métricas comerciales y tomar decisiones a partir de datos.
  • Buena comunicación oral y escrita, especialmente para utilizar WhatsApp y email como canales de venta.
  • Manejo de CRM.
  • Excel intermedio.
  • Uso activo de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial en el trabajo.
  • Perfil proactivo, metódico y orientado a resultados, con capacidad para construir relaciones comerciales.
  • Graduado/a o estudiante avanzado/a de Administración, Comercialización, Marketing, Economía o carreras afines.
  • Español excluyente.

Será un plus

  • Experiencia en telecomunicaciones o venta de productos/servicios tecnológicos.
  • Experiencia comercial con PyMEs y comercios.
  • Conocimiento de productos B2B de telecomunicaciones, conectividad o servicios digitales.
  • Experiencia en Inside Sales / Digital Sales.
  • Experiencia utilizando WhatsApp como canal formal de venta.
  • Manejo de herramientas de automatización o sales engagement.

Beneficios

  • Revisiones salariales cuatrimestrales.

  • Descuentos en universidades y centros educativos.

At Zarego, we are looking for a Marketing Specialist / Content Creator. If you are a creative, strategic marketer who excels at translating technical solutions into compelling narratives —from blog posts and social media to visual assets— we want to meet you!

What you'll do:

  • Marketing Strategy & Calendar: Define how to communicate Zarego's services across target industries. Build and execute the content calendar, ensuring tone and brand consistency across all channels.
  • Editorial & Content Creation: Research, write, and edit high-impact tech blogs, website copy, landing pages, and newsletters—translating complex technical concepts into accessible, engaging commercial content.
  • Social Media Management: Create engaging posts and campaigns for LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook to share company news, events, achievements, and team culture.
  • Visual Asset & Graphic Design: Design visuals for social media, campaigns, newsletters, and web sections using Figma and Photoshop, ensuring assets adapt across formats.
  • Multimedia & Repurposing: Optimize YouTube titles, descriptions, and thumbnails for our videos, while turning recorded talks and transcripts into structured articles and social snippets.
  • Commercial Campaigns & Email Marketing: Build ad creatives and copy for Meta Ads, write landing page copy, design email newsletters, and manage campaign content execution.


What we're looking for:

  • Relevant Experience: Proven experience in marketing, content creation, copywriting, and visual design within tech or B2B environments.
  • Design Tools: Hands-on experience with Figma and Photoshop for design, image editing, and layout composition.
  • Web & Technical Basics: Familiarity publishing and formatting content in WordPress, along with basic HTML/CSS knowledge to adjust newsletters and landing page layouts.
  • Language Skills: Exceptional written English to craft clear, high-impact technical content across primary channels, with proficient written Spanish for occasional content needs.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, Advertising, or a related field.
  • Location: Remote. Candidates must reside in Latin America (LATAM).


Nice to have:

  • Video Production & Motion Graphics: Experience scripting, editing, and animating short-form video content (reels, promo videos) using After Effects or similar tools.

descriptionHtml:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

Design is foundational to our product and our company. As a Web Designer at Profound, you'll shape how the world experiences our brand online, from our marketing site to campaign landing pages to the surfaces where product meets story. You'll work closely with front-end engineers, design engineers, and the brand team to turn ideas into shipped, high-craft web experiences, with deep ownership over how Profound looks and feels on the web.

What you'll do

  • Design and ship marketing pages, landing pages, and campaign sites that reflect Profound's dark, editorial, precise brand
  • Partner closely with front-end and design engineers to take work from concept to production, staying involved through build, QA, and launch
  • Design with real components and constraints in mind, working within (and helping evolve) our web design system
  • Prototype interactions and page-level motion, handing off specs and details that hold up in code
  • Own web design end to end for key initiatives, from homepage updates to launch pages for new product features
  • Collaborate with brand and product marketing to translate briefs into high-conversion, on-brand web experiences
  • Continuously audit and refine our existing site for craft and consistency
  • Occasionally extend into email, social, and event assets when the work connects to a web campaign

Who you are

  • You work with full autonomy and can take a brief and own it end to end, from concept to shipped page, without hand-holding
  • You have real command of web design fundamentals: layout, type, grid, hierarchy, and how they translate into code
  • You have a portfolio that shows a high bar for craft on real, shipped websites
  • You're fluent in Figma and AI tools, comfortable working close to the metal with front-end and design engineers; bonus for hands-on HTML/CSS or experience in a component-based design system
  • You sweat the finish (typography, spacing, rhythm, and consistency) and know what separates a good page from a great one
  • You move fast and reliably deliver high-quality work on short timelines without sacrificing craft
  • You're a versatile generalist, equally comfortable on a marketing landing page and a product-adjacent surface
  • You like to experiment and build with AI and new tools to work faster and push your craft further
  • You're a strong communicator who can articulate creative decisions and incorporate feedback to continuously improve the work
  • You can just do things

Note from our co-founder

In the evolving landscape of product development, exceptional design is not merely a nice-to-have, it is foundational. As software engineering becomes increasingly accessible, it is taste, creativity, and thoughtful execution that differentiate outstanding products from the rest.

I believe deeply that design sits at the core of our success. At Profound, my goal is to build a design team renowned for setting a new standard of excellence, crafting experiences so compelling they become benchmarks in our industry.

If you are someone who believes in the transformative power of great design and wants to create work that genuinely shapes the future, join us. Let's redefine what's possible together.

Dylan Babbs, Co-founder & CTO

Location

This is an on-site role based in our Buenos Aires or NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. NYC comp range for this role will be: $165 - $190k.

Comp varies by location. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

descriptionHtml:
Somos SOUTHBAY, apasionados distribuidores oficiales de la marca NIKE en Argentina y en Uruguay.

Formamos parte del Grupo Regency, líder en la distribución de marcas de indumentaria, accesorios, calzado y otros productos en 13 países de Centroamérica y América del Sur

Con 20 tiendas entre Argentina y Uruguay, junto con los e-commerce de ambos países y más de 700 colaboradores, representamos la marca deportiva más valiosa del mundo.

MISION :

Como agente de cambio en Southbay, JR. ARCHITECT contribuye a la transformación y el crecimiento del negocio, velando por los resultados comerciales y los objetivos estratégicos de la empresa. En un entorno de constante movimiento y expansión, este rol desempeña una función clave, colaborando la construcción de las tiendas físicas, desde el diseño hasta la ejecución y seguimiento de los KPI´s claves del área. La pasión por el deporte y la innovación se reflejan en cada proyecto, asegurando que cada iniciativa esté alineada con nuestra visión de dominar el juego y tomar la delantera en el mercado, haciendo que cada jugador cuente y jugando limpio en cada paso del proceso.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Supervisión de obras .


Consiste en supervisar cada etapa de la construcción. Esto incluye coordinar y controlar a proveedores, asegurar la calidad de la ejecución y cumplir con los plazos y presupuestos establecidos.

  • Presupuestos y licitaciones.


Implica realizar y evaluar los cómputos, presupuestos y licitaciones para optimizar los recursos. El objetivo es elaborar las herramientas necesarias para que se puedan tomar decisiones informadas que aseguren la rentabilidad de cada proyecto. Esto incluye definir propuestas, analizando sus ofertas y negociando los términos para optimizar los recursos.

  • Coordinación Cross Functional.


Colaborar de manera efectiva con las diferentes áreas para alinear el diseño y la construcción de las tiendas según objetivos operativos y comerciales de la empresa, asegurando que el cronograma y los tiempos acordados se cumplan.

  • Control de gastos.


Consiste en contraponer Capex vs. gastos de obra reales creando mapeo de los gastos realizados para cada obra. Esta información es fundamental a fin de dar seguimiento, control y generar KPI´s de medición.

  • Revisión de Layouts y Documentación.


Asegurando que se ajuste a las necesidades del negocio.

COMPETENCIAS:

  • Capacidad para planificar, ejecutar y supervisar proyectos de principio a fin, incluyendo el manejo de cronogramas y presupuestos.
  • Habilidad para interactuar con proveedores y equipos internos, resolviendo conflictos y asegurando que las necesidades del proyecto se cumplan.
  • Dominio de herramientas como AutoCAD, Monday y Excel, además de una comprensión sólida de los procesos constructivos y la normativa de obras.
  • Enfocarse en alcanzar los objetivos del negocio, finalizando las obras de las tiendas a tiempo y dentro del presupuesto.


REQUERIMENTOS:

  • Profesional recibido en Arquitectura, Ingeniería Civil o carreras afines.
  • Dominio de AutoCAD y del paquete Office.
  • Se requiere un mínimo de 2 años de experiencia previa en roles similares, específicamente en Retail.
  • Es necesario contar con disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional e internacional para la supervisión de obras y relevamiento de sitios.
  • Dominio de inglés.


-- Modalidad de trabajo híbrida --

descriptionHtml:
RYZ Labs is seeking a skilled BI Analyst to join one of our client's team.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Analyze business and operational data to answer complex questions and support decision-making
  • Develop reliable metrics and analytical frameworks, ensuring numbers are clearly defined, traceable, and supported by accurate source data
  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and translate findings into practical recommendations
  • Build and maintain recurring analyses, dashboards, and reporting processes, with a strong focus on improving efficiency and reducing manual work
  • Identify inconsistencies, data quality issues, and misleading results, and establish reliable validation practices to prevent them from recurring
  • Communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders
  • Manage multiple analytical projects independently, prioritizing work based on business impact and urgency
  • Contribute to data governance by documenting metrics, sources, assumptions, and analytical methodologies


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or Computer Science
  • 4+ years of professional experience in analytics, including 3+ years in a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar role
  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL and Python for data analysis, statistical analysis, and visualization
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets in a high-volume, transactional environment
  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts and the ability to go beyond basic reporting and aggregation
  • Demonstrated experience using data to influence or change business decisions
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to validating analytical results
  • Experience automating recurring reporting or analytical workflows and measuring the resulting efficiency gains
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings clearly and concisely
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment


About RYZ Labs:

RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents in order to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world.

Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting-edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries,planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years.

At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion, and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists.

Our values and what to expect:

  • Customer First Mentality - every decision we make should be made through the lens of the customer
  • Bias for Action - urgency is critical, expect that the timeline to get something done is accelerated
  • Ownership - step up if you see an opportunity to help, even if not your core responsibility
  • Humility and Respect - be willing to learn, be vulnerable, and treat everyone who interacts with RYZ with respect
  • Frugality - being frugal and cost-conscious helps us do more with less
  • Deliver Impact - get things done in the most efficient way
  • Raise our Standards - always be looking to improve our processes, our team, and our expectations. The status quo is not good enough and never should be

Description

At Amazon Web Services (AWS) we are inventing the future of cloud computing with a team of builders who try new things and dream big dreams. Our services provide a platform for IT infrastructure in-the-cloud that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world. Ten years ago, we couldn’t have imagined how far we would come. Now we’re inventing for the next ten years and beyond. But it is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, testers, and doers.

Our Solutions Architects team is seeking candidates to join our AWS team with a variety of skills to help shape and deliver on our cloud strategy for our global customers and partners. As a Solutions Architect, you will be on the front line of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies, linking technology with measurable business value for organizations ranging from start-ups to large, enterprise customers. You will be a trusted customer advocate, helping our partners understand advanced cloud-based solutions and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, building relationships with senior stakeholders to influence their cloud adoption strategy and technology direction
  • Lead end-to-end solution design for complex workloads, making architectural trade-offs across performance, reliability, security, and cost
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, professional services, support, and engineering teams to deliver comprehensive technical solutions aligned to customer business outcomes
  • Develop and deliver technical content (reference architectures, design patterns, presentations) and represent AWS as a thought leader at industry events and customer engagements
  • Mentor and develop other Solutions Architects while translating customer feedback into actionable product and service improvement recommendations

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English and Spanish

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
  • Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
  • Experience working with end user or developer communities

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Join our Buenos Aires Service Center!

We are looking for a Cash Application Analyst to join our global team. This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented and analytical professional who enjoys working with financial data, resolving payment allocation issues, and collaborating with international stakeholders to support the Firm’s cash application processes in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.


What will be your impact?

  • Process and accurately allocate cash receipts to client invoices, ensuring compliance with Firm policies and procedures.
  • Review daily banking activity, investigate unidentified or unmatched payments, and resolve allocation issues.
  • Monitor, analyze, and report on unallocated or suspense funds, escalating matters as needed.
  • Resolve complex cash application discrepancies by collaborating with Finance teams and internal stakeholders.
  • Ensure all assigned activities are completed accurately, confidentially, and within agreed service levels.
  • Support ongoing cash application and broader finance-related activities while adapting to evolving business needs.


What will help you succeed in this opportunity?

  • University studies or degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, International Trade, or related fields.
  • Advanced or Bilingual English (mandatory).
  • Portuguese language skills are considered a plus.
  • Previous experience in Cash Application, Accounts Receivable, Finance, or a related area.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience working with financial or accounting systems; SAP knowledge is a plus.
  • Interest in leveraging AI tools and technology to improve efficiency and productivity.
  • Excellent communication, organization, flexibility and time management skills.


What do we offer?

  • Hybrid work model | Offices located in Puerto Madero, Buenos Aires.
  • Parking space available.
  • Private health insurance (family plan).
  • Discounts on internet services, gym memberships, and universities.
  • Birthday day off.


If you believe you meet the requirements, please apply by sending your CV in English in PDF format.
